jobs.title: Junior Copywriter
jobs.excerpt: Not all heroes wear capes – but plenty of them use toilet paperWant to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world?
jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes – but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading planet-conscious household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we've contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we're really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses in the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we're hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

We're looking for a Junior Copywriter based remotely in the Philippines to join our creative team and dig into the world of growth and paid advertising. This is a role for someone who loves writing, is curious about what makes an ad actually work and wants to get hands-on with briefs that are driven by real performance data. You'll be writing scripts and copy for paid social (still and video), collaborating with our local creative strategists and video team, and doing the kind of fast-paced, purposeful work that puts more planet-conscious toilet paper in the world. Which is, it turns out, a great thing to put in the world.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Joining a creative workshop with the AU creative strategist to brainstorm ideas for a new paid video campaign – and walking out with three concepts you're actually excited to write
  • Reviewing performance data on a batch of still ads and rewriting three hooks to test new angles based on what the numbers were telling you
  • Writing and submitting five paid social scripts (still and video) hitting the brief deadline with a day to spare
  • Attending a prioritisation call to align on which ad concepts to develop next, and flagging a hooky idea you'd been thinking about
  • Sitting in on a video review round with the video team, adjusting a script line that wasn't landing in the edit

Let's talk about you

You can write.

This sounds obvious, but it matters. You have a feel for language, rhythm and tone – you know when a sentence is working and when it isn't. You've got some real copywriting experience (even if it's not a lot), and you're already good at matching your voice to a brand's. Crucially, you can write with humour and lightness without it feeling forced. Our tone is a lot of fun to write in, but it takes genuine instinct to pull off.

You're curious about what makes ads work.

You don't need a deep background in performance marketing – we'll teach you the things you don't know. But you need to be genuinely interested in learning. When someone shows you an ad that performed well and explains why, your instinct is to lean in, not tune out. You're the kind of person who thinks about why something catches your eye, why it works, and what might make it land differently.

You're fast-paced and collaborative.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving team. You're comfortable working across multiple briefs, responding to feedback quickly, and jumping into a workshop or prioritisation call and actually contributing. You don't need every detail spelled out before you start, and you communicate proactively when things aren't clear or capacity is getting tight.

You give a crap.

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence – us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We're in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that's why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn't be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you're still reading, we think there's a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here's the thing, though – research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don't check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

jobs.title: Senior AI Video Editor
jobs.excerpt: Senior AI Video Editor — Performance Creative & Social Commerce About STERRYSTERRY is a high-growth, cross-border women's intimates brand and e-commerce group scaling rapidly across the US, APAC, and global marketplaces (Shopify DTC, Amazon Worldwide, and TikTok Shop).
jobs.description:
Senior AI Video Editor — Performance Creative & Social Commerce

About STERRY

STERRY is a high-growth, cross-border women's intimates brand and e-commerce group scaling rapidly across the US, APAC, and global marketplaces (Shopify DTC, Amazon Worldwide, and TikTok Shop). We combine high-performance digital acquisition with lean, high-velocity global execution — and video is a core growth lever across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, and social commerce.

We are hiring a Senior AI Video Editor to own AI-accelerated video production for performance and brand: short-form ads, listing/lifestyle cuts, UGC polish, and disciplined creative testing. We care more about tighter, higher-converting cuts than raw volume.

Due to the nature of the brand (women's intimates), we seek someone with visual taste and real empathy for the modern consumer — fit, comfort, body-positive storytelling, and the aesthetic precision required to build authentic brand trust on camera.

The Role

You will own end-to-end video editing and AI-assisted production for STERRY’s global growth engine. You will turn briefs, raw footage, UGC, product shoots, and motion assets into high-converting ads and marketplace video — then systematically test hooks, cuts, and formats so winning creative scales across channels.

This is an edit-only seat: you will not be required to shoot or direct talent. You will be both a craft editor and an AI power user — obsessive about timing, typography, color, and brand consistency, and relentless about using AI to multiply quality output without lowering the bar.

You will report to STERRY’s marketing / creative leadership (Head of Marketing or Creative Lead).

What You'll Own

  • Performance Video Production: Cut short-form and mid-form video for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and TikTok Shop — hooks in the first 1–3 seconds, tight pacing, captions, and platform-native formats. We want fewer, sharper versions that are ready to test and scale, not a flood of average cuts.

  • AI-Accelerated Workflows: Champion and operationalize AI video tools (e.g. Runway, Kling, Pika, CapCut/Jianying AI, ElevenLabs, Midjourney/image-to-video, Claude/ChatGPT for scripts and iterations) to generate smart variants, clean footage, localize, and raise quality and speed — with human QA on every ship.

  • Marketplace & Listing Video: Produce and refresh Amazon A+/storefront video, Shopify PDP and lifestyle cuts, and channel-specific assets that stay on-brand and conversion-focused.

  • Creative Testing System: Build a documented testing cadence (hooks, offers, testimonials, fit/comfort claims, CTAs). Tag, version, and hand off winners to media buyers with clear naming and brief notes on what changed.

  • Brand Taste & Intimates Standards: Protect visual quality, model portrayal, and compliance for women's intimates (tasteful framing, hygiene/fit sensitivity, region-specific ad policies).

  • Cross-Functional Rhythm: Partner with marketing leadership, media buyers, designers, and copywriters during Shenzhen hours; take briefs, flag what’s missing, and turn around revisions fast.

What You Bring

Required (Must-Haves):

  • 5+ years of professional video editing, with 2+ years in performance creative, e-commerce, or social ads (DTC or marketplaces).

  • AI Champion & Power User: Hands-on, current experience with modern AI video/image/audio tools and automated edit workflows — not “curious,” but shipping with them weekly.

  • Craft Mastery: Expert in at least one professional NLE (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut/Jianying at a professional standard), plus motion typography, color, sound design, and captioning.

  • Portfolio of shipped ads or social/video work with clear before/after or performance context (hook tests, CTR/thumb-stop, iterative versions). We will judge taste and conversion-mindedness, not reel length.

  • Obsessive attention to detail: frame-accurate cuts, clean audio, typo-free on-screen text, consistent brand kits, and zero broken exports or wrong aspect ratios.

  • Fluent English (Mandatory): Full professional proficiency in spoken and written English to join Shenzhen-hours standups, take global briefs, mark up versions, and work with a distributed marketing team.

  • Comfort editing women's fashion, beauty, or intimates/body-close product content with taste and respect.

  • Ability to work full-time as a contractor, with reliable internet, your own edit setup, and consistent overlap with Shenzhen (UTC+8).

Strongly Preferred (Pluses):

  • Based in the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, or a closely aligned time zone.

  • Direct experience supporting Amazon, Shopify DTC, and TikTok Shop creative in the same org.

  • Motion design (After Effects / equivalent).

  • Experience building SOPs, templates, and AI prompt libraries other editors can run.

Who You Are

  • AI-Forward Editor: You use AI to raise quality and kill grunt work — then you personally protect taste and brand.

  • Detail-Obsessed: You catch a bad crop, a mistimed caption, or an off-brand color grade before it hits ads manager.

  • Performance-Minded: You edit for hooks, retention, and conversion, not only for a beautiful timeline.

  • High-Velocity Collaborator: You take feedback without drama and turn around the next cut the same day when the test calendar demands it.

What We Offer

  • $2,000-3,000 USD per month + performance bonus, as a full-time contractor.

  • Direct partnership with marketing / creative leadership, and a clear path to Creative Lead for the right operator.

  • Opportunity to define STERRY’s AI video production system, with global creative scope, from a remote SEA base.

Security Analytics Engineer

Role Overview

The Security Analytics Engineer designs, operates, and continuously improves the organization's security telemetry, analytics, detection engineering, and observability capabilities. The role provides the data and analytics foundation used by Security Operations while extending traditional SIEM capabilities through behavioral analytics, automation, AI-assisted correlation, and observability for autonomous and agentic systems.

  • Integrate, normalize, enrich, and correlate telemetry from endpoint, identity, cloud, application, infrastructure, network, and AI-enabled systems.
  • Develop and tune behavioral detections, correlation logic, dashboards, and alerting strategies.
  • Translate threat intelligence, incidents, vulnerability findings, and offensive-security results into improved detection content.
  • Build observability for AI agents and autonomous workflows, including identity, tool usage, execution activity, and security-relevant behavior.
  • Apply AI-assisted techniques to log analysis, correlation, anomaly detection, enrichment, and investigation support.
  • Automate telemetry management and security workflows while maintaining appropriate human oversight and explainability.

  • Scripting or software-development experience and familiarity with APIs and Infrastructure-as-Code.

jobs.description:
About Remote People

At Remote People, we're building the infrastructure to power borderless teams. By handling global payroll, benefits, taxes, and compliance, our technology enables businesses to hire anyone anywhere compliantly at the push of a button.

If you're interested in adding to our vision of enabling people to work in dream jobs, for every company, and from anywhere in the world, apply now!

We're committed to building a global, diverse team representing different and varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, or disability. Being part of Remote People means being part of a growing, international family.

Position Overview:

As an Onboarding Specialist at RemotePeople, you will be a trusted partner to our clients as they hire talent around the world. You will guide clients and their new employees through every step of the onboarding journey, making international employment feel simple, clear, and well supported from day one.

You will manage multiple onboarding cases at the same time, reviewing employee information and documentation with great attention to detail, preparing employment contracts, and coordinating amendments when needed. You will also coordinate medical check-ups where required and partner with internal teams to ensure payroll and benefits are set up on time. Before each employee’s start date, you will make sure everything is in place for a smooth and compliant first day.

More than an administrator, you will act as a consultant: helping clients understand country-specific onboarding requirements, setting clear expectations, anticipating potential blockers, and offering practical solutions. You will bring a solid understanding of employee onboarding processes across different countries, as well as the local employment requirements and practices that shape each case.

Working closely with our Legal, Payroll, Finance, Sales, and Client Success teams, you will help deliver the seamless, high-quality experience RemotePeople is known for.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end onboarding for employees across multiple countries, from receiving the case through the employee’s first day.
  • Guide clients and employees through onboarding requirements, timelines, documents, and next steps.
  • Review and verify employee information and documentation, ensuring all records are accurate, complete, and compliant before the start date.
  • Prepare employment contracts using internal templates and coordinate contract reviews, signatures, and amendments when needed.
  • Coordinate country-specific onboarding requirements, including medical check-ups, right-to-work documentation, visas, tax forms, and other local requirements where applicable.
  • Partner with Payroll, Benefits, Legal, Finance, and Client Success to ensure payroll and benefits are activated on time and all onboarding requirements are in place.
  • Manage multiple active cases at once, prioritising effectively while maintaining a high level of accuracy and service.
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding actions and signatures; flag potential blockers or risks early, including contracts that remain unsigned after 24 hours.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients by explaining country-specific processes, setting expectations, and helping find practical solutions.
  • Support employee onboarding and manage contract amendments throughout the employee lifecycle.
  • Keep client and employee data accurate and up to date across internal platforms and CRM systems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, documentation, and the overall onboarding experience.

Key Qualifications:

  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.
  • 2+ years of experience in employee onboarding, HR administration, global mobility, payroll operations, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Experience supporting onboarding in multiple countries; experience in EOR, PEO, global employment, payroll, or HR tech is strongly preferred.
  • Good understanding of employment onboarding processes and country-specific requirements, including employee documentation, benefits enrolment, contracts, and compliance.
  • Familiarity with employment contracts and contract amendments, including working from established templates.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage several cases, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • A consultative and customer-focused approach, with confidence guiding clients through complex processes.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to identify and escalate risks early.
  • Comfortable collaborating with Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, Sales, and Client Success teams.
  • Experience using HRIS, CRM, ticketing, and collaboration tools; HubSpot and Confluence experience is a plus.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote, global environment and handling confidential information with care.

What it's like working at Remote People

Our service & product. We're a technology company, not an accountancy, payroll provider, recruitment firm or similar. We build a workforce management platform that allows our customers to hire the best talent in minutes, without worrying about compliance, payroll, or HR admin.

Our amazing team and environment. Working at Remote People means you're working on something very exciting: Allowing every person on the planet to have access to equal opportunities in living a fulfilled work and personal life. We believe in hiring from within and going the extra mile to retain top talent. As the company continues to grow extremely fast, you will be given the opportunity to develop and grow alongside.

Our benefits and perks. Being part of Remote People means that you get the benefit of:

  • A competitive salary

  • A "Remote-First" company environment (or Hybrid) - based on the nature of the job
  • The ability to work from abroad for a short period of time

  • We provide all new joiners with the necessary hardware to ensure you have the tools you need to succeed from day one

About Numa

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

The Role

We’re looking for a Support Engineer Intern to help deliver reliable, responsive technical support for our dealership customers. In this hands-on role, you’ll own assigned support tickets from start to finish, following detailed procedures to manage user access, address caller ID and texting issues, and investigate automated system health alerts.

You’ll work primarily in HubSpot, Numa’s admin tools, and our telephony platform, with little to no phone support. As you ramp, an experienced Support Engineer will review your work and help you build the technical knowledge needed to troubleshoot issues, document findings, and know when to escalate. This internship is an opportunity to gain practical experience in technical operations, B2B SaaS support, and customer success.

What You’ll Do

  • Own tickets end to end. Pick up assigned tickets in HubSpot, follow the documented procedure, update the requester through approved templates, and close each ticket with clear internal notes
  • Manage dealership users. Add, update, and remove users; set roles and permissions; assign teams; and handle password reset requests
  • Improve caller trust. Submit CNAM (caller ID name) registrations and apply outbound “Spam Likely” fixes in Twilio
  • Make routine configuration changes. Update business and holiday hours and other pre-approved account settings
  • Investigate system health alerts. Work automated “Check Engine Light” tickets, including drops in inbound call volume, failed text messages, DMS integration errors, and integrations left active on cancelled accounts. Diagnose the cause, resolve issues covered by the procedure, and hand off clear findings when another team is needed
  • Keep data clean. Categorize every ticket you touch so the team can report accurately on volume and trends
  • Improve documentation. Flag gaps in our Notion procedures and draft new step-by-step guides for review

What You’ll Learn

  • How a B2B SaaS support team operates, including ticket workflows, SLAs, escalation paths, and handoffs to Engineering
  • Telephony and messaging fundamentals, including caller ID (CNAM), call authentication (STIR/SHAKEN), 10DLC texting registration, and SMS hosting
  • How dealership software, including DMS and scheduler integrations, connects to an AI platform
  • How to use HubSpot, Twilio, and AI assistants to investigate and resolve technical issues

What You Bring

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on technical experience
  • Curiosity about how systems work and comfort asking questions when something is unclear
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to follow written technical procedures carefully and notice when a step does not match what you see
  • Clear, concise written communication for both customer-facing replies and internal notes
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a steady queue of tickets accurately

Nice to Have

  • Experience with a ticketing or CRM tool such as HubSpot, Zendesk, or Salesforce
  • Basic knowledge of VoIP, phone systems, or SMS messaging
  • Experience using AI assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT for research or troubleshooting
  • An interest in the automotive industry

What Success Looks Like

  • Assigned tickets are handled accurately and consistently, following the documented procedures
  • Customer updates are clear, timely, and sent using the approved templates
  • Issues outside the documented procedures are escalated with useful troubleshooting notes and findings
  • Tickets are categorized correctly, supporting accurate reporting on support volume and trends
  • Gaps in existing procedures are identified and useful documentation improvements are drafted for review

How We’ll Set You Up for Success

  • A dedicated Support Engineer buddy who reviews your work during your first 30 days
  • A structured 90-day ramp: you’ll start with user management and password resets, then add caller ID, CNAM, and system health alerts as you gain confidence
  • Detailed, step-by-step procedures for every ticket type you’ll own
  • A clear escalation path for anything outside a documented procedure. You’re never left guessing

Why Join Numa

  • We believe in everyone’s growth
  • Be part of an industry leader named the #1 fastest-growing AI Automotive company by Inc. 5000

At Numa, you’ll have the chance to work with game-changing technology in an industry that’s ready for innovation. If you’re curious about how systems work, enjoy solving problems, and want to build practical experience at a high-growth company, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Section helps organizations build AI-powered workforces. Our software (Section HQ and Section Coach) coaches employees to become AI-powered and measures the progress and ROI of employee AI use. Alongside the platform, our consultants work directly with client leadership teams to change how work gets done.

Most large companies have bought AI tools. Very few have changed how their people actually work, and that gap is where we spend our time. We believe AI transformation is mostly a people problem: leaders have to set a clear direction, managers have to change how their teams operate, and success should be measured in business results, not logins. We've now worked with more than 150 organizations on this, including Nike, MetLife, Adobe, Okta and Gap.

We are looking for a senior consultant to own a set of our largest client accounts. You'll be the client's main partner at Section, working directly with their senior leaders on what is, for most of them, the biggest change to how their company works in a generation. You'll set the strategy for each account, deliver the work yourself, and grow the partnership over time.

The playbook for this work is still being written, at Section and everywhere else. If you've led client engagements at a strong consulting firm and want to work on problems no one has solved yet, this is a good place to do it.

What the Work Looks Like

On any given account, you might be:

  • Working with a CEO and executive team to define their AI ambition and turn it into a manifesto the whole company can rally behind

  • Building a transformation plan: where AI should change the business first, what the 90-day roadmap looks like, and how progress will be measured

  • Running Lighthouse Teams, where we work with a single team to redesign how it does its core work with AI, then use the results to scale across the company

  • Designing programs that equip managers to lead their teams through the change, since managers are where adoption succeeds or stalls

  • Embedding with a client for six to twelve months as part of their operating team, working through priorities with them as they shift

  • Using our platform data to show leaders where their workforce stands and what's moving the business

What You'll Own

Your strategic accounts (~75%)

  • Own a book of our largest client accounts, typically enterprises with 10,000 or more knowledge workers. You're accountable for the relationship, the account strategy, and the results.

  • Deliver the work and write the strategy and deliverables yourself. Clients should be able to take what you hand them straight into their own leadership meetings.

  • Meet weekly with clients during active delivery and monthly otherwise, and run quarterly business reviews with each client's executive sponsor.

  • Work with an engagement team that handles logistics, scheduling and platform setup, so your time goes to the work that changes how the client operates.

Account growth (~15%)

  • Own the growth number on your accounts. Understand where each client needs to go next, build the case for it, and partner with sales to close it.

  • Build relationships with new sponsors and teams inside each account, so the partnership doesn't depend on a single contact.

The team and the practice (~10%)

  • Work with an analyst or junior consultant on your accounts and help them develop.

  • Join a small number of core accounts quarterly, or when a growth opportunity comes up.

  • Write down what works on your accounts so the rest of the team can use it.

What Success Looks Like

  • Your accounts renew and your clients can point to specific business outcomes from our work together.

  • Your accounts grow, and are on a path to becoming a $1M+ partnership.

  • Client executives see you as their partner and bring you into decisions before they're made.

  • Your deliverables go to clients with minimal rework.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience leading strategy or transformation engagements with senior executives at large companies, including owning the storyline, the final deliverable, and the client relationship. Engagement manager or senior consultant at a top consulting firm, or equivalent experience at a boutique firm or AI company.

  • Confidence with senior clients. You lead the conversation, ask hard questions, and push back when it's warranted.

  • Experience growing client accounts beyond their original scope.

  • Strong writing. You can turn a messy problem into a clear recommendation an executive will act on.

  • A real interest in how people and organizations change, not only in the technology.

  • Comfort working without a set playbook, on a lean team where you'll do a lot of the work yourself.

  • Daily use of AI in your own work, with concrete examples of how it has changed the way you work.

Details

  • Full-time, remote-first, with travel to client sites (approx 1x/month)

  • Reports to the Head of Enablement Consulting

What You'll Do

Performance Intelligence & Reporting

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Lead prioritized, cross-functional process improvement initiatives across charge capture, claims, denials, AR follow-up, payment posting, onboarding, and credentialing/enrollment handoffs.
  • Map current- and future-state workflows, identify rework and delays, and partner with accountable operations leaders to standardize scalable processes and SOPs.
  • Develop quality measurement and audit frameworks with operational leaders; analyze results and recommend training or workflow changes.
  • Measure onboarding performance and time-to-value for new RCM clients, including readiness, early production performance, and stabilization.
  • Manage improvement initiatives from business cases through implementation, adoption, and post-launch benefit validation.

Vendor & BPO Performance Accountability

  • Partner with the Vendor Manager to define, validate, and report vendor SLAs, transaction volumes, productivity, turnaround time, accuracy, and quality measures.
  • Develop consistent vendor scorecards for weekly reviews and quarterly business reviews, using reconciled source data wherever available.
  • Quantify performance gaps, recommend corrective actions, and monitor resolution with vendor and operations owners.
  • Support transaction forecasting, work allocation, staffing assumptions, vendor transitions, and contract negotiations through fact-based analysis.
  • Reconcile vendor invoices to contracted rates, eligible transaction types, and verified volumes; flag discrepancies and savings opportunities.

Unit Economics, Capacity & Financial Performance

  • Build and maintain transaction-level cost models and unit economics by client, service, function, and BPO partner.
  • Track actual versus modeled vendor savings, cost-to-collect, service margin, and productivity; partner with Finance to validate assumptions and explain variances.
  • Develop capacity and throughput models that inform vendor allocation, staffing decisions, and backlog recovery plans.
  • Recommend opportunities to improve gross margin without compromising cash collections, quality, or client experience.

Technology, Automation & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Translate operational needs into business requirements, support UAT, and quantify benefits after deployment.
  • Analyze payer and clearinghouse edit performance and recommend enhancements; technical rule ownership remains with Product and Clearinghouse teams.
  • Partner with Service Management on client-facing insights, Finance on forecasts, and Sales and Implementation on demand and onboarding capacity.

How Success Is Measured

  • Measurable improvements in revenue-cycle performance, including AR aging, denial rates, first-pass resolution, and client time-to-value.
  • Timely identification and closure of vendor performance gaps through documented corrective action plans.
  • Validated improvements in unit cost, vendor savings realization, cost-to-collect, and RCM gross margin.
  • Completed improvement initiatives with documented operational, financial, or client experience impact.

Location: 100% Remote (Global)

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced, systems-driven Wholesale Operations Manager to take full leadership of our Wholesale and Order Capturing operations. In this role, you will directly manage, mentor, and govern distributed teams while owning the end-to-end operational pipeline for all wholesale and retail partner orders—from initial inquiry and order capture to invoice generation, payment tracking, and global warehouse dispatch.
You will serve as the operational bridge connecting internal teams, international retail buyers, global 3PL/warehouse hubs, and finance stakeholders. If you excel at managing remote personnel, driving daily accountability, building rock-solid Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), eliminating fulfillment bottlenecks, and steering teams toward zero-error order accuracy, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
1. End-to-End People & Team Management
  • Directly manage, develop, and supervise the Wholesale and Capturing Team across multiple shifts and international time zones.
  • Establish clear daily operational expectations, individual task allocations, and attendance/output benchmarks across all team members.
  • Lead structured weekly 1-on-1s, pod standups, performance calibrations, and hands-on coaching sessions to ensure high accountability and engagement.
  • Monitor pod capacity, balance workloads during peak retail cycles, and oversee onboarding, training, and continuous skills development for new and existing team hires.
  • Track individual and pod-level KPIs, holding team members accountable for order accuracy rate (>99%), first-response turnaround time (TAT), and SLA adherence.
2. Buyer Communication & Warehouse Alignment
  • Supervise team interactions with all B2B retail buyers, guaranteeing timely, professional, and accurate responses regarding order statuses, inventory availability, shipping updates, and custom account requirements.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for buyer inquiries, resolving complex logistics issues and maintaining high buyer satisfaction.
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison with global warehouse and 3PL teams to coordinate stock allocations, pack-and-ship timelines, and custom dispatch schedules.
  • Rapidly troubleshoot and direct team resolution on shipment discrepancies, backorders, damages, or transit delays with logistics partners.
3. SOP Architecture & Process Optimization
  • Author, maintain, and continuously refine detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) spanning order capture, verification, buyer communication, warehouse dispatch, and returns/claims.
  • Enforce strict team compliance with documented SOPs, ensuring workflow standardization across all account coordinators.
  • Continuously audit workflows to identify manual bottlenecks, streamline communication loops, and implement process improvements that shorten order fulfillment cycles as volume scales.
4. Invoicing, Payment Tracking & Reconciliation
  • Ensure all wholesale and retail commercial invoices, credit memos, and packing lists are accurately generated, logged, and organized by the capturing team.
  • Supervise the recording and tracking of incoming buyer payments, matching settlements against open purchase orders to prevent documentation gaps.
  • Partner directly with internal Bookkeeping and Accounting teams to facilitate timely payment reconciliations and resolve billing disputes promptly.
  • Identify, audit, and escalate payment or credit anomalies directly to executive leadership.
Qualifications & Requirements
  • 5+ Years of Operations Experience: Proven background in B2B wholesale operations, retail order management, or e-commerce supply chain operations.
  • Direct People Management Track Record: Minimum 2–3 years of proven experience directly managing, supervising, and coaching distributed remote teams (customer support, order capturing, or operations coordinators).
  • Performance & Accountability Driven: Demonstrated experience running performance evaluations, conducting 1-on-1s, managing team SLAs, and handling corrective action or workload reallocations.
  • Logistics & 3PL Literacy: Direct experience liaising with third-party logistics (3PL) providers, freight forwarders, and warehouse teams across multiple geographic hubs.
  • Financial & Billing Acumen: Solid experience with B2B commercial invoicing, payment term tracking (Net terms, wire transfers, deposits), and working alongside bookkeeping teams on reconciliations.
  • SOP & Systems Mastery: Proven ability to build clear, scalable SOPs, process maps, and workflow automations using modern tools (Lark/Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, ERP/WMS platforms).
  • Communication & Fluency: Exceptional written and verbal business English communication skills, with experience managing professional relationships with international retail accounts and leading internal team alignments.
  • Autonomous & Detail-Oriented: Highly structured mindset with an uncompromising standard for documentation, protocol-driven execution, and zero-error order entry.
What We Offer
  • 100% Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with a structured, asynchronous operational rhythm.
  • High-Impact Leadership: Direct autonomy to lead teams and shape operational infrastructure for high-growth global consumer brands.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside dedicated executive leadership, creative minds, and operational specialists.
How to Apply
Please submit your resume along with a brief cover note detailing:
  1. Your experience managing remote teams (team size, structure, and how you manage day-to-day accountability and SLAs).
  2. Your background managing B2B wholesale order lifecycles and coordinating with 3PL warehouses.
  3. The operational tools/ERPs you have used to manage inventory, invoicing, and order capture.
  4. An example of an SOP or process workflow you built that measurably improved accuracy or turnaround time.

Manager, Financial Reporting & Analysis Terms: Full-time (37.5 hours/week), Permanent Location: Remote in Canada, with hybrid or in-office options for cities with an office Salary: $100,000 MakeWay is looking for a Manager, Financial Reporting & Analysis to provide timely financial reporting, analysis, budgeting and forecasting to inform strategic, financial and operational decisions across the organization. Reporting to the Director of Finance, this role partners with cross-functional teams including Executive Leadership, Strategic Programs, Philanthropic Services, Operations, and Shared Platform to strengthen financial understanding and accountability. Responsibilities include coordinating key reporting deliverables, supporting external regulatory reporting and year-end audit activities, and contributing to the continuous improvement of financial systems and processes.

About MakeWay:

MakeWay is made up of two legal entities – MakeWay Foundation and MakeWay Charitable Society. MakeWay Charitable Society is an operating charity that houses 50+ environmental and social change projects across the country, also known as the Shared Platform. MakeWay Foundation is a national charity and public foundation with a goal to enable nature and communities to thrive together. We do this by building partnerships, providing solutions, grants, and services for the charitable sector across the country. If our values align with yours and you want to learn, grow, and develop within a supportive team that shares knowledge and cares, then we want to hear from you! Join us and make a difference.

What You’ll Do:

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Lead the accurate and timely monthly and quarterly financial reporting and analysis for internal teams, committees, board and external stakeholders. Analyze financial results, investigate variances and identify risks, opportunities and practical recommendations. Prepare regular and ad hoc financial reports, dashboards and key performance measures to support strategic and operational decisions. Coordinate quarterly Shared Platform revenue reporting for consolidation. Improve report design, consistency, quality assurance and efficiency in collaboration with Finance and Information Systems.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Business Partnering

Prepare the annual consolidated organizational budget and quarterly forecasts, including materials for senior management, the Finance & Audit Committee and Board. Partner with department managers through regular financial reviews, budget-to-actual analysis and forecasting discussions. Develop financial models to support planning and decision-making.

Compliance, Audit & Year-End

Support preparation of audit working papers and combined year-end financial statements. Support annual regulatory filings, including T3010 and IRS Form 990, for MakeWay Foundation and MakeWay Charitable Society, as applicable. Maintain reliable reporting practices aligned with applicable accounting standards and MakeWay policies. Coordinate year-in-review financial datasets and visualizations related to revenues and expenditures.

Process Improvement & Capacity Building

Work with Finance and Information Systems colleagues to identify reporting, accounting process and system integration improvements. Provide clear financial guidance to non-finance colleagues and help build financial literacy across business units. Develop or facilitate training on financial reporting, analysis, expense coding and related processes. Contribute to cross-functional initiatives and other finance priorities as required.

Who You Are:

Analytical Thinking: You excel at evaluating complex financial data, identifying trends and variances, optimizing reports, and using key metrics to support informed decision-making. Communication: You confidently present financial insights, explain complex concepts, and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to support understanding and alignment. Collaboration: You work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, partnering across teams to coordinate financial reporting, support regulatory requirements, and advance organizational priorities. Problem Solving: You identify and address financial reporting and system challenges, improve accounting processes and systems, and develop practical, actionable solutions. Detail-oriented: You demonstrate a high level of precision and accountability, proactively identifying errors and inconsistencies to ensure accurate and reliable financial information.

Experience You Bring:

A minimum of 5 years of progressive responsibility with financial reporting, analysis, budgeting or related experience; non-profit or charitable sector experience preferred. A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. Knowledge of accounting principles relevant to not-for-profit and charitable organizations. Experience preparing financial statements, audit support, regulatory reporting and management reporting. Strong Excel and financial modelling skills; experience with reporting software and financial systems. Full-cycle accounting processing experience in a complex reporting environment. Experience providing financial information and reporting services to a diverse portfolio of internal and external clients, including experience in writing ad hoc reports. Hands-on experience with regulatory filings (e.g., T3010, IRS 990) and audit processes, including preparing working papers and year-end financial statements. Demonstrated ability to produce concise and complex financial reports; must be able to interpret, explain, report on, and provide advice on a variety of accounting, budgetary, and financial management issues. Proven ability to quickly learn complex business structures and accompanying system of coding and classification of financial transactions. Experience working with a remote team.

It Would Be a Bonus if You Have:

Accounting designation (CPA) or progress toward designation. Prior experience working in a mission-driven or non-profit organization. A solid understanding of compliance requirements for charitable organizations.

If you are interested in this role but are unsure if you qualify, send us your application anyway and tell us about why you can be a good fit for this position. We’d love to hear from you!

What We Offer:

The opportunity to have an impact on communities from coast to coast to coast. Full-time annual salary of $100,000. Comprehensive employer-paid extended health, vision, and dental benefits package, including an annual $300 Health Spending Account starting on your first day of employment. Year-end RRSP contribution. Pregnancy and Parental/Adoption Leave top up (subject to eligibility). Three weeks’ paid vacation (that increases with tenure) plus statutory holidays. MakeWay has implemented a Substitution Statutory Holiday policy which allows employees the flexibility to substitute another day for a statutory holiday. Winter office closure and 9-day summer fortnight program. 10 annual sick and personal days. Flexible work environment with remote working. An Indigenous Employees Network. Committed colleagues and a culture of collaboration, caring, and learning. High level of responsibility and autonomy. Opportunities and support for professional learning and development.

How to Apply:

Please submit a resume and cover letter through Dayforce. In your cover letter, please share a little bit about what inspired you to apply, why you’re interested in joining MakeWay, and how your experiences and skills could contribute to the team. We encourage candidates to apply as early as possible as applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Thank you!

Hiring Process:

Application Review: Our Manager of People, Engagement, and Learning reviews all applications as they are submitted and works with the Hiring Manager to shortlist candidates to invite to the phone screen stage. Phone Screen: Our Manager of People, Engagement, and Learning will conduct a 30-minute phone call with the candidate. Interview 1: Candidates selected to move forward from the phone screen will participate in a first-round panel interview through Microsoft Teams. Interview 2: Candidates selected to move forward will participate in a second-round interview panel through Microsoft Teams. Offer and References: 2–3 professional references will be conducted, and the selected candidate will be extended a verbal and written offer letter.

Supporting Equity in Our Hiring Process:

In an effort to recognize the time and energy that it takes to participate in a hiring process, MakeWay offers a $75 compensation for each panel interview. Interview questions will be provided 24 hours in advance.

MakeWay is strongly committed to equity and creating a diverse workplace community. We recognize that our recruiting and hiring processes are key to this commitment. We strive to reflect the diversity of our society on our teams and to provide a respectful workplace and equal working opportunities for all employees and applicants. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply. If you require accommodations at any point during the application or hiring process, please contact us at . This role is for a current vacancy, and MakeWay does not use artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, or select applicants. Our sincerest appreciation to all those expressing interest in the position, however, only those applicants invited for an interview will be contacted. Thank you!

jobs.description:
ABOUT SITELINE

Siteline is a fast-growing Series A startup transforming how construction companies get paid, headquartered in San Francisco.

Specialty trade contractors build the infrastructure America runs on, from data centers and schools to highways and hospitals. Yet most are still managing millions of dollars in billing and payments through spreadsheets and manual processes.

We’re changing that.

WHAT PROBLEMS ARE WE SOLVING
Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. For those 96 days, subcontractors are funding payroll, materials, equipment, and the cost of actually doing the work - all before seeing a single payment. It’s little wonder they describe themselves as “America’s largest bank”.

Our mission is simple: get subcontractors paid faster. And we’re damn good at it. Siteline customers average just 55 days to payment, and that number keeps falling.

We’re building in a massive, underserved market with no true direct competitor. And while AI is reshaping industries everywhere, the physical infrastructure our customers build isn’t going anywhere. Data centers, hospitals, schools, roads, and power infrastructure still have to be built -and the contractors building them need a radically better way to manage their receivables.

WHY ARE WE BUILDING THIS?

Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

These businesses are managing millions of dollars on spreadsheets, printouts, ERP reports, and a whole lot of manual work to get paid.

Every project has different billing requirements, different deadlines, and different paperwork. Miss something, and payment can get pushed out another 30 days.

Subcontractors deserve software built specifically for them. That’s why we built Siteline.

ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re looking for an Account Executive to join us at a pivotal stage of our growth. We’ve built a sales playbook that works, now we’re looking for great sellers to execute it and help us scale. The entire US is your territory. You’ll own deals end-to-end, work directly with our Head of Sales, and have close access to Marketing and Product as we continue to grow.

This is a role for someone who loves to sell; competitive, curious, coachable, and hungry to win. You love the hunt: prospecting, cold calling, creating your own pipeline, and turning a cold account into a closed deal.

You know how to create urgency, run a tight process, and close. You’ll get the upside and impact of an early-stage startup, with a proven playbook ready to execute.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 6+ years of closing experience as an AE in tech with a consistent track record of achieving sales targets (bonus: experience in construction technology)
  • Experience selling $70k+ ACV deals in a quick sales cycle (45-90 days) to $200M revenue+ companies
  • Experience selling to finance functions (CFOs, Controllers, AR Managers) and/or tech laggard industries (AEC, manufacturing, agriculture, real estate, healthcare, etc.)
  • Experience selling against the status quo - creating urgency and convincing customers to move away from spreadsheets, manual processes, or legacy systems.
  • Ability to own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demo, negotiation, and close.
  • You’re a hunter. This is an outbound-first role, and you’ll self-source 50%+ of your pipeline through cold outreach, referrals, and creative prospecting. You have a track record of building and closing pipeline you generated yourself, and genuinely enjoy doing it.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup environment where cross-functional collaboration is key.
  • Willingness to travel 10% for on-site demos and trade shows
  • Bonus: Experience selling a product that integrates with ERPs

WHAT WE OFFER
Competitive Salary: We provide a salary that reflects your skills and experience, along with opportunities for performance-based bonuses. The range for this role is $110k-120k base / $220k-$240k OTE based on experience.

Health & Wellness Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance to support your well-being, along with wellness programs and resources.

Professional Development: Annual $1K learning stipend to use toward classes, certifications, conferences, or other meaningful career development.

Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive team that values creativity, innovation, and open communication, where your ideas are encouraged and celebrated.

Equity Options: As a startup, we offer equity options to ensure that you share in our success as we grow together.

Paid Time Off: Unlimited PTO policy with an encouraged three-week annual minimum.

Team Events: We regularly host team social activities and happy hours, and travel for company wide offs-sites once per year

INTERVIEW PROCESS

We value a transparent and straightforward process, and hope that providing this context up front gives you useful insight into what to expect.

  1. Application Review
  2. Head of Sales Interview | 45 min (Online)
  3. Take Home Assignment
  4. Take Home Assignment Presentation w/ Head of Sales + Head of Marketing | 45 min (in person)
  5. CEO Interview | 30 min (In Person)
SF Pay Range
$220—$240 USD

Company values

Move Quickly, Together

Speed is our advantage, but alignment is our path to victory. We will go farthest, fastest if we work in unison. Prioritize the mission, establish clear owners and deliverables, and execute with confidence.

Reach for the Sky

We are curious, open-minded, and courageous. We challenge ourselves and each other to ask more questions, push boundaries, and deliver excellence every day.

Run Lean

Construction is a scrappy industry where companies must do more with less. Same here. Operate efficiently, optimize strategically, and always get the most bang for our buck.

Be the Steel

Builds fail when the foundation is faulty. The same is true for us. Exercise good judgment, deliver on your commitments, and know your capacity—every base has its threshold, after all. Most importantly, back your teammates. We’re stronger than reinforced concrete when we support each other.

Build Our Fanbase

Our mission is to grow the size of the pie for everyone in construction. We only achieve that audacious goal if we keep our customers front and center. Work tenaciously to build smarter systems that solve real problems for our customers, positively impact their businesses and lives, and make them loyal fans.

Shoot Straight

We speak directly, candidly, and respectfully. We prioritize transparency, err on over-communicating, and understand that differing opinions and perspectives are part of a healthy company. Ultimately, it’s okay to disagree with—but still commit to—the chosen direction.
At Siteline, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. We know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. jobs.title: Administration Assistant (NDIS) - Payroll, Rostering and Finance Administration
jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyOur client is an NDIS provider, established in 2022, preparing to become a registered provider and delivering core support and capacity building to around 120 participants with a team of around 45 to 50 staff.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is an NDIS provider, established in 2022, preparing to become a registered provider and delivering core support and capacity building to around 120 participants with a team of around 45 to 50 staff. They are looking for one dedicated, full-time Administration Assistant to take over the repeatable, process-driven administration currently handled by the management team, so the team can stay focused on participants, staff and growing the business.

About the Role

This is a hands-on administration role centred on payroll preparation, finance administration, rostering support and compliance documentation. You will work in Xero, the client's rostering system (ShiftCare) and a custom-built CRM, follow documented processes exactly, and prepare work for review and approval by the Operations and Administration Manager. The role does not approve payments or pay runs. It prepares, checks and flags. It also prepares standard documents and contracts from approved templates and maintains the policy and procedure register, without changing template terms or policy content.

The role suits a careful, procedure-driven administrator with solid Australian payroll and Xero experience, who reports anomalies instead of correcting them silently, and who handles personal and confidential information with care. Attention to detail is the top priority, along with a teachable, collaborative approach to learning the client's way of working. A healthcare or nursing background is not required; a background in bookkeeping, information management or program administration is what matters, and NDIS awareness is favourable. The final task list will be confirmed with the client through a task transfer exercise, and the role will grow as processes are documented and handed over, with additional tasks within the scope of the role (for example, preparing staff training documents) added over time.

In practice, shift adjustments, roster changes and CRM administration are expected to take more daily time than payroll itself. Payroll, billing and invoicing form a concentrated block of work in each pay cycle (indicatively around one working day), alongside roughly an hour a day of ongoing bookkeeping and an hour a day of shift management. These are indicative estimates, to be confirmed in the task transfer. Training will be provided through guided walkthroughs by the Operations and Administration Manager.

Primary Purpose

To give the client's management team accurate, well-checked payroll and finance administration, an up-to-date and clash-free roster, organised compliance and recruitment records, accurate documents prepared from approved templates, a well-maintained policy and procedure register, accurate shift and billing records, and a reliable daily update on what has been done and what is next.

Key Responsibilities

    Payroll Preparation

  • Prepare pay runs in Xero for approval, applying award-based pay rates, overtime, penalty rates, superannuation and leave entitlements

  • Check timesheets against rosters before each pay run, and report any differences, gaps or unusual entries to the approver rather than correcting them silently

  • Prepare and check payroll only: the role does not approve or process payments, and brings any discrepancy to management's attention

  • Work to the pay-cycle schedule, which is currently fortnightly and processed on Mondays, and be ready to adapt if the client moves to a weekly cycle or a mid-week processing day

  • Keep clear records of what was checked, what was flagged and what was changed

    • Bookkeeping and Invoicing

  • Reconcile bank accounts and code transactions in Xero, and match receipts

  • Manage the invoicing workflow end to end, including creating, sending and tracking invoices, completed after payroll because errors are harder to correct on NDIS invoices than on pay

  • Check that NDIS billing details, rates and line items are correct before invoices are issued, recognising that NDIS billing and SCHADS pay each carry their own complexity

  • Complete month-end processes to the documented checklist

  • Run aged-debtor reports

  • Follows up plan managers and support coordinators using approved templates. Overdue amounts owed directly by families are escalated to management, not chased.

    • Rostering, Shift Management and CRM Administration

  • Enters and amends shifts as directed. Does not make mentor-to-participant matching or replacement decisions. Flags clashes, gaps and unfilled shifts to the Relationship Coordinator or Operations and Administration Manager.

  • Work in the rostering software (ShiftCare preferred, Deputy, Employment Hero or similar is acceptable)

  • Support the link between rostering and payroll, including how rostering data flows into Xero

  • Check that each shift is recorded correctly, with the right billing information, in the rostering system, because this data carries through to invoicing and payroll

  • Process shift adjustments and roster changes communicated by staff, and record them in the CRM and rostering system

  • Learn and work in the client's custom-built CRM, adapt to improvements, and give constructive feedback on how it works

    • Compliance and Documentation

  • Backfill registration and compliance documentation, following the existing process

  • Track and chase recurring compliance items in the Hub compliance register, including NDIS Worker Screening, Working With Children Checks, first aid and driver's licences, so nothing lapses

  • Keep documents and records organised, accurate and easy to find

    • Document and Contract Preparation

  • Prepare employment contracts, participant service agreements and other standard documents from approved templates, using details supplied or held in the Hub

  • Check every draft for accuracy (names, dates, rates, NDIS line items) before sending it for review

  • Does not alter template clauses, pay rates, prices or terms; any non-standard request is escalated

  • Sends documents for signature only after approval, and files signed copies in the correct record

    • Policy and Procedure Administration

  • Maintain the policy and procedure register, including version numbers, owners, approval dates and next review dates

  • Flag documents due for annual review ahead of time and track them through to approval

  • Make formatting, template and approved wording changes as directed, and keep a change log for each version

  • Publish approved versions and arrange staff read-and-sign acknowledgements

  • Does not change policy content or approve changes; raises suggested updates (for example, legislative or NDIS Commission changes) for management review

    • Recruitment Administration and Data

  • Training is provided for these tasks, so prior experience is helpful but not essential

  • Screen applications against role requirements, book interviews and schedule reference checks

  • Enter and update records in the CRM or database, and check data quality, reporting errors and duplicates

  • Maintain spreadsheets, using filters, lookups and basic formulas

    • Communication, Process and Privacy

  • Write clear, polite and accurate emails and online messages to Australian staff and business contacts

  • Question anything that does not look right (a gap, a missing detail or an inconsistency across shift records, invoices and payroll) rather than assuming it is correct

  • Work exactly to documented processes, be open to learning the client's way of doing things, and raise suggested improvements and ideas instead of changing steps independently

  • Send a short daily update to the Operations and Administration Manager covering what was completed, what is next and any roadblocks or pending items

  • Handle personal information, including participant and employee details, with care and in line with the client's privacy and security requirements, working from a private and secure workspace

    • Hours and Location

  • Remote, home based, full-time (40 hours per week), Monday to Friday

  • Working hours must overlap with Adelaide business hours (9:00 am to 5:00 pm ACST/ACDT)

  • Reliable internet and a private, secure workspace required

  • Computer literacy and comfort learning new systems are required for daily work

Qualifications and Experience (Essential)

  • Australian award payroll preparation in Xero: 2+ years, including bank reconciliation and coding.
  • Reports anomalies rather than correcting them silently.
  • Clear, polite written English, including emails and online messages to staff.
  • Privacy and data security, including willingness to provide an NBI clearance.
  • Reliable internet, a secure workspace and full overlap with Adelaide business hours (9:00 am to 5:00 pm ACST/ACDT).

Highly Desirable

  • Knowledge of the SCHADS Award (Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services), including broken shifts, minimum engagement and sleepovers. This is weighted above general award experience.
  • Experience with the NDIS, including NDIS billing (rates, line items and billing systems), or with Australian disability, aged care or community services. This is a priority, but strong candidates who can learn it quickly will be considered.
  • Familiarity with the NDIS provider portals (PRODA and PACE), which will become relevant as the client completes NDIS registration. This is desirable rather than required.
  • Rostering or scheduling software experience (ShiftCare preferred, Deputy, Employment Hero or similar acceptable), including how it syncs with Xero
  • Teachable and adaptable: willing to learn the client's way of working, comfortable sharing ideas, able to adapt to a custom-built CRM, and works exactly to documented processes with clear records of what was done

How to Apply

Please submit a CV along with a short cover note outlining your years of hands-on Xero experience with Australian businesses, your Australian award payroll experience (including any award, such as the SCHADS Award, you have worked with), any NDIS billing experience, your willingness to provide an NBI clearance, the rostering software you have used, and your availability for full overlap with Adelaide business hours. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted to progress to the next stage of the process, which includes a written assessment, a phone screen and a recorded video interview.

As our senior SDET, you’ll lead the way we test Live: recreating the moments a live event creates, like a vote opening just as an ad ends, long before the event does, so we know we’re ready instead of finding out during the show.

What we’re working on:

  • The FIFA Women's World Cup, coming to Netflix in 2027 and 2031, will feature new experiences built for global, multi-match sport tournaments.
  • Interactive and navigational features that help members move through a live event and catch the moments that matter.
  • Real-time voting, which lets members influence a live show as it unfolds, alongside millions of others watching at the same moment.

Mobile Core

The DVX Mobile Core team develops and advances the architecture of Netflix's Android member app. We leverage systems and infrastructure widely available at Netflix and determine the best way to adopt and apply them on Android, enabling easier, more efficient patterns for downstream product engineering teams.


What we’re working on:

  • Modernizing our app architecture for the iOS and Android member app. This involves driving migrations and a cross-platform Player rewrite, creating leverage for product teams to ship faster and more reliably on iOS and Android.
  • Driving Quality of Experience (QoE). Owning monitoring and performance improvements across Player UI and canvases, as we scale.

The Role


Problem you’ll help solve:

  • Testing and making sure millions of members see our Live-specific UI features and capabilities at the right moment, on every TV and phone.
  • Giving every platform the same test plan, so TV, iOS, and Android are consistently validated the same way.
  • Making tests reliable enough that PMs, designers, engineers, and our partners trust them, and fast enough to run on every change.
  • Keeping quality steady while the iOS and Android apps modernize, including a cross-platform player rewrite, so faster delivery doesn’t come with more regressions.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead testing for complex features across platforms.Agree on one test plan per feature that teams can trust and validate together, and implement it on TV, iOS, and Android, rather than reconciling differences afterward.
  • Build automation that people trust.Evolve our test systems and CI integration across platforms so tests are fast and reliable.
  • Make tricky live moments easy to test. Build ways to recreate them on demand instead of waiting for a real event, using mocks, overrides, real devices, and test data that looks like a real event and doesn’t expire.
  • Make large migrations safe.Build the test strategy that lets the iOS and Android apps modernize without regressions reaching members
  • Own quality metrics.Track how well we’re covered, how reliable our tests are, and which bugs reach members, and use that to decide what to improve next. That includes the client metrics that reveal problems only scale shows, and the alerts that tell us about them quickly.
  • Make sure bugs only surprise us once.When a bug reaches members, make sure it comes back as a test, using agents to turn each finding into several, and document how to test each feature so the knowledge doesn’t live in one person’s head.
  • Build and leverage AI tools.Act as a force multiplier to flag unwanted behaviors before they reach members, and apply agents to test authoring, failure triage, and bug analysis.
  • Shape testability from the first commit.Partner with engineers on architecture and code that are easy to test, and help them write better tests themselves.
  • Test where teams meet.Agree with partner teams on the contracts between our features and theirs, so end-to-end tests verify where teams meet and rehearse what members experience, rather than retesting every team’s systems.
  • Collaborate beyond the team.Work with partner teams on shared test data, environments, and tools, and with teams that run live events to ensure features are ready before showtime and can be safely switched off if needed.
  • Mentor and grow others,including engineers and SDETs, by reviewing test plans and test code, sharing practices, and making quality everyone’s job.

What we’re looking for:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in software testing and test automation, with a strong record of leading testing for large, cross-team features or projects.
  • Comfort working across platforms. You’ve tested consumer apps on more than one platform, and you’re eager to learn the platforms you haven’t used yet.
  • Strong coding skills, with experience designing and building test frameworks and tools, not just writing test cases.
  • Experience or strong interest in using AI for testing, such as writing tests, triaging failures, or finding gaps in coverage, with clear ways to check its results.
  • Deep experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and diagnosing flaky tests, infrastructure failures, and dependency issues.
  • Experience with mocking, test data, or other ways to make hard-to-reproduce situations repeatable in tests.
  • A practical, risk-based approach to quality: knowing where to invest in tests, which risks are acceptable, and when more testing isn’t the answer.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including explaining quality risks and trade-offs to engineers, product managers, and partners in terms they can act on.
  • Alignment with Netflix's culture and values.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with live streaming, video playback, ads, or other systems where split-second timing matters.
  • Hands-on experience with testing frameworks on several platforms, such as Jest, Puppeteer, Espresso, or XCUITest.
  • Experience driving shared testing infrastructure or quality strategies adopted by multiple teams.
  • Experience testing how systems behave when things go wrong, such as chaos testing or failure drills.

Growth opportunities: We’re hiring a senior engineer, and we see this role growing into one that sets the standard for how Netflix tests its Live experiences and mobile apps at scale. Over time, you can:

  • Lead testing strategy across teams, creating the practices and tools that other teams adopt.
  • Shape client architecture for testability across platforms.
  • Influence partner teams' tooling and roadmaps, so our experiences are easy to test for everyone.
  • Mentor and grow engineers and SDETs across the organization.

To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. jobs.excerpt: About SundaySunday is on a mission to empower everyone to care for their little plot of land.
jobs.description:
About Sunday

Sunday is on a mission to empower everyone to care for their little plot of land. The simple act of getting outside, getting your hands dirty, and caring for your home is more than it seems. It's a reconnection to something written in our DNA, and it's at the core of us working together toward a better planet.

We're bringing safer, science-backed products and personalized, data-driven guidance to the American yard. Our in-house R&D team builds the products. The largest soil database ever created, along with Sunny, our AI yard companion, tailors a plan to every home.

In 2024 we helped our one millionth customer. Today Sunday offers 75+ products across lawn, garden, pest control, and pet, sold online and in about 7,000 stores nationwide, including Home Depot, Walmart, Target, and Costco. On any spring weekend, roughly 750 people are out in their yard using Sunday at any given moment. Sunday is becoming a household name, and we're making a dent.

Position Overview

As the Logistics Lead, you will be responsible for getting Sunday orders to customers. You will own our 3PL relationship with Radial for DTC and Retail fulfillment, manage orders from creation to delivery, and keep shipping fast, accurate, and cost-effective through our spring peak. You will be the main point of contact for Customer Service and Quality on anything that affects delivery.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You will work autonomously, set the standards for how orders flow, and bring the data and judgment the Sr. Director of Supply Chain Operations needs for contract negotiations and strategic decisions. You will partner closely with the Operations Production Director, who owns Costco production and fulfillment through Innomark. Success means orders that arrive on time and in full, a well-run peak season, and a steadily lower cost per order.

Key Responsibilities

3PL Management

  • Own the day-to-day Radial relationship, including daily operations, escalations, and weekly and quarterly business reviews
  • Hold Radial accountable to SLAs and productivity terms, including units per hour, and drive corrective actions when performance slips
  • Plan and staff peak with Radial across Retail Pipe (December–January), Reauth (January to mid-April), and new-subscriber orders (peaking mid-April)
  • Manage 3PL production work at Radial, including kitting, pre-kitting, display builds, and rework

Order Management & Shipping

  • Own DTC and B2B orders from creation to delivery, finding and resolving stuck, short-shipped, or misrouted orders
  • Lead daily B2B order routing, including our Claude-based routing process, and maintain its rules and SOPs
  • Partner with the Retail team on wholesale order inquiries and retailer routing and compliance requirements
  • Evaluate carriers and ship methods for cost and reliability, and recommend changes

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Partner with Customer Service to run the customer-facing steps of out-of-stock protocols, based on decisions from Planning
  • Partner with Quality and vendors to track and reduce defects affecting delivery, including product, packaging, and soil tests
  • Define functional requirements for order and shipping systems with Tech, and maintain data integrity across our ERP, Radial, and order systems

Cost, Reporting & Process

  • Own logistics budget line items day to day, and find cost savings and avoidance in warehousing and outbound shipping
  • Report on logistics KPIs, including on-time and in-full, order accuracy, cost per order, and damage and claims, and provide performance, volume, and cost data for annual Radial contract negotiations
  • Review 3PL and carrier invoices with the Purchasing & Inventory Analyst and Finance
  • Build and maintain SOPs for order handling, kitting, and shipping

Qualifications

Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in logistics, fulfillment, or customer operations, including hands-on 3PL management
  • Experience running DTC e-commerce fulfillment at volume
  • Retail and wholesale fulfillment experience (EDI, routing guides, chargebacks) is a strong plus

Skills

  • Proficient with ERP, WMS, and order management systems; strong in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Build and read KPI reports, and use data to hold partners accountable and make decisions
  • Calm, decisive problem-solving during peak, with good judgment on when and how to escalate with a proposed solution
  • Interest in using AI tools to automate routine order work

Core Competencies

  • Communication & Collaboration
  • Expertise
  • Problem Solving and Evaluating Alternatives
  • Feedback & Resilience
  • Scope & Autonomy
  • Prioritization

We work to build a culture that attracts a diverse mix of talented people to help us bring lawn care out of the dark ages. We are committed to building a diverse, vibrant team that brings determination and passion to our work everyday.

jobs.description:
AutoCAD Drafter

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced AutoCAD Drafter to convert PDF plans and hand‑drawn sketches into clean, professional CAD drawings. The drafter must ensure accuracy by verifying scales before delivery, as even minor errors can render plans unusable. This role requires precision, technical expertise, and a strong commitment to quality drafting outputs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Convert PDF plans and sketches into accurate AutoCAD drawings.
  • Verify and apply correct scales to all drawings before submission.
  • Produce clean, precise, and project‑ready drafting outputs.
  • Collaborate with architects, engineers, and project managers to clarify requirements.
  • Revise and update drawings based on feedback or site conditions.
  • Maintain organized drawing files and documentation for project records.
  • Deliver outputs within agreed timelines while adhering to quality standards.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Drafting Technology, or related field.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of professional experience in AutoCAD drafting.
  • Demonstrated ability to convert PDF/sketches into scaled CAD drawings.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD (mandatory).
  • Strong knowledge of architectural standards, construction methods, and detailing.
  • Ability to verify and apply correct scales with precision.
  • Familiarity with Revit or other CAD/BIM tools is an advantage.

Core Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in drafting.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration with design teams.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and adapt to project changes.
