Ce que notre Développeur logiciel principal fera 

Participer aux processus d’estimation et de développement du cycle de vie du logiciel (SDLC) et fournir des conseils généraux aux membres de l’équipe.

Conception

  • Déterminer et définir des solutions techniques pour tous les éléments
  • Examiner les solutions de conception proposées par les autres développeurs
  • Connaître les modèles de conception courants
  • Créer des conceptions visant à réduire ou à éliminer la maintenance et la validation manuelle continue par des essais
  • S’efforcer de réduire la complexité de la base de code
  • Élaborer des propositions de conception et fournir un soutien au prototypage pour de nouveaux domaines problématiques et le développement initial de solutions hautement complexes ou de technologies nouvelles et émergentes

Développement

  • Rédiger de la documentation technique pour des solutions logicielles destinées à un public cible, pouvant inclure des clients internes et externes
  • Élaborer des solutions pour résoudre des problèmes et apporter des améliorations
  • Contribuer à l’établissement de normes de codage
  • Respecter les normes d’Insurity en matière de codage et de documentation
  • Assurer le leadership technique et la supervision des membres de l’équipe, y compris des partenaires tiers
  • Être responsable de l’estimation et de la planification des projets et des solutions
  • Procéder à l’examen par les pairs des conceptions, du code et de la livraison des artefacts
  • Assurer un dépannage technique approfondi, ainsi que l’investigation et la correction des défauts

Tests

  • Rédiger du code et des tests unitaires conformément aux normes d’Insurity, en suivant une solution technique approuvée, pour les améliorations et les corrections de bogues
  • Développer des tests unitaires pour les modifications de code et les cas d’utilisation assignés

Documentation

  • Rédiger régulièrement des documents
  • Rédiger un document d’évaluation d’impact
  • Préparer et présenter une solution technique, par exemple à l’aide de PowerPoint, Lucid, etc.

Leadership

  • Assurer le leadership, offrir du coaching, du mentorat et des conseils techniques aux membres de l’équipe
  • Fournir de la rétroaction sur le rendement des membres de l’équipe
  • Préparer des présentations et les présenter à toutes les parties prenantes, y compris les clients
  • Se tenir au courant des tendances et des pratiques exemplaires du secteur et liées au poste, notamment en lisant les publications, articles et blogues pertinents, etc.
  • Autres tâches selon les besoins

La personne que nous recherchons 

  • 6 à 8 ans ou plus d’expérience en développement logiciel.
  • Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe; une expérience professionnelle équivalente peut être prise en compte.
  • L’esprit d’analyse et la pensée critique sont essentiels. Les candidats doivent être capables d’apprendre, d’assimiler et de prendre des décisions éclairées.
  • Compétences en communication écrite et orale, notamment pour présenter avec précision des informations techniques à des publics variés.
  • Capacité avérée à définir de manière autonome des solutions techniques, à examiner des conceptions et à diriger des travaux de développement complexes.
  • Solide expérience en développement avec les technologies full-stack de Microsoft (.NET Framework, .NET, SQL Server).
  • Une expérience avec Angular est fortement souhaitée.
  • Une expérience dans le domaine de l’assurance est un atout; la volonté d’apprendre le secteur de l’assurance est indispensable.
  • Planification du travail, établissement des priorités, organisation et souci du détail.
  • Capacité à travailler efficacement tant de façon autonome qu’en collaboration; autonomie et apprentissage continu.
  • Capacité à donner et à recevoir de la rétroaction de façon constructive, à animer des réunions et à soutenir le changement.
  • Maîtrise avancée de l’IA appliquée au développement, des approches multi-agents et de divers outils. Doit être capable de déterminer quand ces outils formulent des suggestions pertinentes et quand ce n’est pas le cas.
  • 0 à 25 % de déplacements

Ce que nous vous offrons

Travailler là où vous vous épanouissez

Trouvez l’environnement de travail qui vous convient le mieux, qu’il soit à distance, au bureau ou hybride, en fonction de votre rôle et de votre lieu de travail. Notre approche Flex First Workforce offre de nombreuses possibilités de travail à distance, tandis que certaines équipes suivent des horaires hybrides ou au bureau pour rester en contact et collaborer.

Prenez du temps quand vous en avez besoin

Nous faisons confiance à nos équipes pour gérer leur temps grâce à notre politique de congés ouverts (PTO), ce qui vous permet de vous ressourcer lorsque c’est le plus important.

Des avantages qui commencent dès le premier jour

Dès votre premier jour, vous bénéficiez d’une couverture santé complète et de régimes d’épargne-retraite avec contribution de l’employeur, car nous savons à quel point ces avantages sont importants pour vous.

Vivre nos valeurs au quotidien

Nos valeurs fondamentales sont plus que des mots sur un mur – elles guident la façon dont nous recrutons, développons et conservons les meilleurs talents.

Une intégration primée

De votre premier jour à votre premier anniversaire, notre programme d’intégration est conçu pour vous mettre sur la voie du succès et vous aider à avoir un impact immédiat.

Faites évoluer votre carrière de l’intérieur

Nous croyons en la promotion interne. En fait, plus de 25% de nos postes ouverts sont occupés par des candidats internes.

Un mentorat qui compte

Notre programme de mentorat vous met en contact avec des dirigeants expérimentés qui s’engagent à vous aider à progresser sur le plan personnel et professionnel.

Podcasts Insurity

Découvrez les podcasts de notre équipe Formation et développement pour mieux comprendre les produits Insurity, l'innovation au sein de l'entreprise et son activité dans son ensemble.

Continuez à apprendre, toujours

Alimentez votre croissance en bénéficiant d’un accès complet à LinkedIn Learning et Kaplan – car la formation continue est essentielle à la réussite.

Investissez dans votre avenir – et celui de votre famille

Grâce à notre partenariat avec l’Université du campus mondial de l’Arizona, vous et les membres de votre famille bénéficiez de frais de scolarité réduits pour poursuivre vos objectifs éducatifs à moindre coût.

Touchez une prime pour chaque personne référée

Vous aimez votre emploi? Invitez vos proches à nous rejoindre! Notre programme de primes de recommandation récompense votre contribution à bâtir une équipe exceptionnelle.

La transparence des salaires vous aide à prendre la meilleure décision pour vous.  Nous analysons et mettons à jour en permanence nos fourchettes de salaires pour nos postes en fonction des tendances du marché, non seulement pour nous assurer que nos employés sont payés équitablement, mais aussi pour contribuer à combler les écarts salariaux basés sur le sexe, la race et le handicap.  En plus des avantages énumérés ci-dessus, la fourchette salariale pour ce poste est comprise entre 84,000 $ et 165,000 $. Nous communiquons un salaire indicatif correspondant au niveau de carrière, mais le salaire réel peut varier en fonction de votre expérience et de vos qualifications. Si votre candidature est retenue, votre recruteur examinera ces détails avec vous lors d'un entretien vidéo.

Langues pour les candidats du Québec : Il faut savoir parler français pour les postes permanents au Québec. L'anglais est nécessaire pour ce poste pour pouvoir communiquer avec les clients, les partenaires et les collègues qui sont tous basés à l'extérieur du Québec. Une formation en français sera offerte aux candidats qui ne maîtrisent pas bien cette langue. 

INSURITY est fière d'être un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances. 

Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail exceptionnel pour tous nos employés en intégrant une culture de diversité, d’équité, d’inclusion et d’appartenance dans le tissu même de notre société. Nous acceptons les différences et la diversité d'identité, d'expérience et de pensée, et nous nous efforçons activement d'adopter des comportements inclusifs dans toute l’entreprise.  

Nous veillerons à ce que les personnes handicapées bénéficient de mesures d’adaptation raisonnables pour participer au processus de soumission de candidatures et/ou d'entrevues, pour accomplir les fonctions essentielles du poste et pour bénéficier des autres avantages et privilèges liés à l'emploi. Nous vous remercions de l'intérêt que vous portez à Insurity, et de comprendre qu'en raison du volume de candidatures que nous recevons, nous communiquerons uniquement avec les candidats sélectionnés.

jobs.description:
Do you want to work with prospecting and meeting booking for various companies in the Tech industry? Do you have experience in sales? Do you want to work in a company where you have the opportunity to grow and take on more responsibility?

If that sounds like you, welcome! It's you we're looking for.

We are Brightvision, a Growth Agency for B2B-tech companies. For over 20 years, we have made our mark in the industry, promoting growth and increased sales through our range of services in sales and marketing, for a wide range of products and companies.

Transparency, teamwork and personal development characterize our company culture. Our idea is that we want to be the best agency for companies with innovative products in B2B to hire, in order to increase their sales in different ways. We think that's hilarious! But we also think it is important, as many of our customers' products offer good solutions through the power of technology to many of our societal problems, large and small. Read more about us and our culture here .

The role and duties

As an SDR/meeting booker, you work closely with our customers and our project managers. Customers expect us to book qualified sales meetings for them, with decision makers or other relevant people at companies that are part of their target group. So you act as a hired SDR/meeting booker on their behalf.

Your duties will consist of proactively working with prospecting and appointment booking via various channels such as telephone, email and linkedin, for our customers.

For this position, we offer a salary that is partially commission-based.

We think you have a background that may include:

  • At least 2 years of experience in sales/prospecting/meeting booking

  • Experience in B2B sales is advantageous

  • Has own drive and is motivated by working towards set goals

  • Has basic experience with different CRM systems and environments

  • Be comfortable in a project-based environment

  • Fluent in Swedish(both written and spoken) and professional proficiency in English

Why choose Brightvision?

We are a nice bunch of "humble winners" with a good sense of humor (if we do say so ourselves). Since the start in 2000, we have strived to be "remote first", which means you can work from home as much as you want, no matter where you live in the world. But it is just as well to work in our Gothenburg office as well.

Areas that make you feel comfortable at Brightvision (according to the staff themselves):

  • Good team spirit with fantastic colleagues.

  • Work with the largest and most challenging customers in the technology industry and gain a lot of experience by working with different customers.

  • Decentralized organization where you work in smaller teams.

  • Focus on competence development and internal coaching.

  • Great kickoffs and social activities.

  • Lots of transparency and good communication.

  • International environment with colleagues around the world.

  • Bonus program for everyone.

  • Scholarship if you work remotely to contribute to your costs.

  • Focus on world-class leadership.

  • Meetings with your manager every two weeks.

If you feel that Brightvision would be a perfect match for you, please submit your application as soon as possible.

We hope to hear from you, welcome with your application!

jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionThe Revit Drafter / 3ds Max Drafter will be responsible for producing detailed architectural and interior design drawings, 3D models, and visualizations that accurately represent project concepts and specifications.
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Revit Drafter / 3ds Max Drafter will be responsible for producing detailed architectural and interior design drawings, 3D models, and visualizations that accurately represent project concepts and specifications. This role requires strong technical proficiency in Autodesk Revit and 3ds Max, with an eye for precision, aesthetics, and functionality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop detailed architectural and interior drawings using Autodesk Revit.
  • Create high-quality 3D models and renderings using 3ds Max for design visualization.
  • Collaborate with architects, designers, and project managers to ensure design accuracy and compliance with project standards.
  • Update and maintain drawing sets throughout project development phases.
  • Coordinate with engineering and design teams to integrate structural and MEP components.
  • Ensure all drawings adhere to company drafting standards and client requirements.
  • Assist in preparing presentation materials and design documentation.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Architecture, Drafting Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in Revit drafting and 3D modeling.

Technical Skills

  • Proficient in Autodesk Revit and 3ds Max; experience with AutoCAD is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of architectural detailing, construction documentation, and design visualization.
  • Familiarity with rendering engines such as V-Ray or Corona Renderer is a plus.
  • Ability to interpret architectural plans and translate concepts into accurate 3D models.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
  • Creative mindset with technical precision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in interior design or furniture modeling.
  • Knowledge of BIM workflows and coordination.
  • Portfolio demonstrating Revit and 3ds Max projects.

jobs.excerpt: Adjunct Faculty – Introduction to Criminal Justice Department of Applied Sciences and Professional Studies | University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC) This position is specifically to teach remotely for stateside applicants.
jobs.description:
Adjunct Faculty – Introduction to Criminal Justice

Department of Applied Sciences and Professional Studies | University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC)

This position is specifically to teach remotely for stateside applicants. Local applicants only; UMGC does not sponsor logistical support for this role.

Introduction to Criminal Justice (CCJS 100):

An introduction to the three primary components of the criminal justice system: law enforcement, courts, and corrections. The objective is to identify the components of the system, the practitioners within the system and their role in policy formation and implementation, and the major theoretical tenets of criminal behavior. Topics include community relations, the impact of criminal behavior, and the importance of research in the field of criminal justice.

At UMGC, we don’t just teach; we empower. Founded in 1947, UMGC is an open-access, minority-serving institution serving over 90,000 nontraditional learners worldwide, including a proud, large military-affiliated population. Our students are mature, highly dedicated, and balancing careers, families, and service. As an Adjunct Faculty member, you are the essential partner helping them bridge the gap between classroom theory and real-world career success.

Why Teach with UMGC?

  • Focus on Students, Not Course Design: All courses follow a standardized, pre-designed, unified course model. Standardized rubrics, OER materials, library resources, and digital textbooks are fully provided at no cost to you. You get to focus 100% of your energy on mentoring, facilitating, and providing high-quality feedback—no unpaid course-building required.
  • True Asynchronous Flexibility: Teach with flexibility, on your own schedule. As long as you meet weekly grading, responsiveness, and engagement milestones, your daily hours are entirely up to you.
  • Ongoing Growth: We invest in you. All newly hired faculty receive comprehensive online orientation, alongside ongoing, cost-free professional development opportunities.

The Rhythm of Your Week (Key Responsibilities)

Adjunct faculty bring our pre-built curriculum to life through real-world expertise and active mentorship.

Classroom Engagement & Presence

  • Be Visible: Maintain an active classroom presence at least 5 days per week, introducing yourself with a welcome announcement and driving discussions.
  • Bridge Theory & Practice: Enrich the pre-built curriculum with your own professional expertise and real-world examples.
  • Build Belonging: Foster an inclusive, culturally responsive environment where adult learners feel supported and motivated.

Responsiveness & Feedback

  • Stay consistently engaged with learners throughout the course by responding to inquiries, returning feedback, and posting final grades within the expected timeframe.

Proactive Support & Collaboration

  • Monitor Progress: Use available data tools to track student engagement and conduct proactive outreach to at-risk students.
  • Team Up: Partner with success coaches, academic staff, and portfolio directors to refer struggling students to UMGC support resources.
  • Stay Connected: Participate in UMGC's vibrant faculty community, including the Program Hub and ongoing training.

Course Structure & Time Commitment

  • Format: 100% Online & Asynchronous
  • Term Length: 8-week sessions (3-credit courses)
  • Class Size: Typically, 25–35 students (smaller sections for select courses)
  • Time Commitment: The adjunct faculty role requires a substantial commitment throughout the term focusing not only on academic success but also the social, personal, and professional growth of students

jobs.excerpt: Talent Acquisition Sourcer Location: Remote (Canada-wide) Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent Category: Corporate & Support Team / Talent Acquisition About VetCareVetCare is a proud Canadian community of veterinary practices committed to offering exceptional patient care and client experiences.
jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Sourcer

Location: Remote (Canada-wide)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Category: Corporate & Support Team / Talent Acquisition

About VetCare

VetCare is a proud Canadian community of veterinary practices committed to offering exceptional patient care and client experiences. We combine the personal touch, local culture, and clinical autonomy of independent practices with the robust support, resources, and connection of a nationwide network.

At VetCare, our values guide everything we do:

  • Come together as one: We support each other as one team.

  • Always focus on the patient: We prioritize clinical excellence, patient care, and client connection.

  • Raise the bar: We pursue continuous improvement, personal development, and positive change.

  • Engage with empathy: We seek understanding and lead with compassion in every interaction.

Position Purpose

The Talent Acquisition Sourcer / Junior Recruiter is the core outbound pipeline engine for VetCare’s national talent team. This role is built specifically for a true hunter—someone energized by proactive search, direct headhunting, and tracking down passive clinical professionals across Canada, with an acute focus on rural, northern, and hard-to-fill markets.

We already have great recruiters managing relationship stewardship and process management; what we need now is an outbound specialist who thrives on uncovering hidden talent and feeding qualified Doctors of Veterinary Medicine (DVMs) and Registered Veterinary Technologists/Technicians (RVTs) to our senior recruiters. You will partner closely with our internal recruiting team as your primary stakeholders, handling screening and interview handoffs while providing the administrative velocity that keeps pipelines moving. Direct exposure to multi-site practice managers and regional leadership will serve as a natural operational growth path as your role evolves.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Passive Sourcing & Pipeline Hunting (50%)

  • Execute aggressive outbound headhunting strategies across specialized platforms, including LinkedIn Recruiter, provincial veterinary licensing registries, university faculties, associations (CVMA), and clinical networks.

  • Target, map, and nurture talent communities in persistent, hard-to-fill markets (e.g., Northern Ontario, rural Alberta, interior British Columbia, and rural Atlantic Canada).

  • Craft highly customized, compelling cold-outreach messaging that cuts through the noise, articulating VetCare’s clinical autonomy, practice culture, and sustainable workload model.

  • Conduct initial phone screens to evaluate clinical interests, licensing eligibility, relocation appetite, and mutual culture fit before handing warm leads off to our senior recruiters.

Recruitment Coordination & Team Support (30%)

  • Partner side-by-side with our senior recruiters to manage candidate logistics, schedule seamless recruiter interview handoffs, and ensure candidate momentum across multiple Canadian time zones.

  • Maintain rigorous ATS hygiene—tracking lead statuses, pipeline movement, and sourcing channel metrics to keep team dashboards accurate and actionable.

  • Support pre-employment administration, including professional clinical reference checks, regulatory credential verifications with provincial colleges, and offer package documentation.

  • Maintain job board postings across regional and academic platforms, ensuring alignment with provincial standards and pay transparency legislation.

Market Intelligence & Candidate Engagement (20%)

  • Serve as an engaging, authentic first contact for clinicians, navigating sensitive discussions around burnout, relocation barriers, and scheduling needs with high empathy.

  • Keep a pulse on competitor offerings, compensation trends, and provincial licensing shifts, sharing real-time market insights with the talent acquisition team.

  • Support early-career student outreach, campus career events, and RVT externship pipelines alongside the senior recruiters.

What You Bring (Qualifications & Competencies)

  • Hunter Mindset (Essential): You are a relentless outbound sourcer who enjoys the thrill of the chase. You prefer prospecting, direct outreach, and cold pipeline creation over administrative "farming" or waiting for applications to arrive.

  • Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on recruitment sourcing or coordination experience within an agency or in-house talent team. Prior experience in healthcare, locum staffing, or niche/scarce-talent industries is a strong asset.

  • Education: Post-secondary diploma or degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical work experience).

  • Sourcing & Digital Tools: Strong working command of Boolean logic, LinkedIn Recruiter workflows, and modern ATS/CRM systems. Proficient with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.

  • Canadian Regulatory Landscape: Foundational understanding of Canadian employment standards; exposure to provincial veterinary colleges (e.g., CVO, ABVMA, BCVMA) is considered an asset.

  • Bilingualism: Fluency in French is considered an asset.

  • Resilience & EQ: High emotional intelligence to build instant rapport with guarded medical professionals, combined with the persistence needed to thrive in tight candidate pools.

Key Success Measures (KPIs)

  • Outbound Pipeline Delivery: Volume of vetted, qualified DVM and RVT candidates passed along to internal recruiters monthly.

  • Sourcing Velocity: Conversion rates from initial cold outreach to completed preliminary screen.

  • Hard-to-Hire Impact: Consistent candidate discovery and engagement in remote, rural, and high-vacancy clinical regions.

  • Coordination Efficiency: Smooth handoffs to internal recruiters with minimal turnaround delay or candidate drop-off.

  • ATS Integrity: Pristine candidate records, updated stage tracking, and clear communication notes.

What We Offer (Compensation & Benefits)

  • Competitive Compensation: Base salary range of $65,000 – $75,000 CAD per year, commensurate with sourcing depth and industry background.

  • Incentive Potential: Eligible for an annual performance bonus (5%–10%) plus placement-based milestone bonuses per DVM hire retained past 6 months.

  • Work Arrangement: 100% remote work flexibility from anywhere in Canada.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Group coverage including extended health, dental, vision care, life insurance, and disability.

  • Professional Growth: Clear advancement path into full-cycle recruiting and regional operations, supported by an annual professional development budget for recruitment training, certifications, and HR memberships.

  • Collaborative Culture: A supportive internal team where your sourcing impact directly shapes clinic success and community pet care.

VetCare is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion across all our practices and corporate teams. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

We are seeking a Senior ASIC Physical Design Engineer to help implement advanced SoCs that power next-generation satellite and space systems. In this role, you will contribute to the full physical design flow—from synthesis to GDSII—working closely with architecture, RTL, verification, and packaging teams. You’ll be a key contributor in achieving timing closure, optimizing PPA, and supporting design integration with external partners. You will be part of a collaborative design team developing state-of-the-art mixed-signal SoCs to be hosted on some of the largest, most powerful, rapidly designed and rapidly manufactured satellites ever deployed in space. In your first 6 months, you will develop and implement new SoC sub-systems for satellite communications and beyond. In your first two years, you will have contributed to developing cutting-edge SoCs that will fly in space. 

Responsibilities

  • Execute the complete physical design flow for complex SoC blocks and top-level integration, including synthesis, floorplanning, place & route, CTS, STA, and physical verification.
  • Perform timing closure and optimization across multiple corners and modes using industry-standard tools.
  • Collaborate with front-end, verification, and DFT teams to ensure clean handoff and predictable convergence.
  • Work with external physical design service providers and internal leads to review deliverables, resolve issues, and ensure schedule alignment.
  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation to improve flow efficiency and consistency.
  • Support physical sign-off activities including DRC/LVS, IR drop, EM, and power analysis.
  • Assist in chip-level integration, ECOs, and tapeout preparation.
  • Contribute to methodology development, tool evaluation, and flow documentation.
  • Support your product through production and spaceflight.

Required Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 5–10 years of experience in ASIC physical design for complex SoCs.
  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard tools (Synopsys ICC2/Fusion Compiler, Cadence Innovus, or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of timing analysis, power optimization, and physical verification flows.
  • Experience with hierarchical or flat SoC design methodologies.
  • Familiarity with FinFET technologies.
  • Working knowledge of DFT, UPF/CPF power intent, and ECO implementation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work cross-functionally in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Exposure to radiation-hardened or space-qualified ASICs.
  • Experience with chip-package co-design or advanced packaging (2.5D/3D).
  • Familiarity with physical design service vendor management or offshore collaboration.
  • Experience with sign-off through TSMC.
  • Experience with Gate-All-Around technologies.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range for this role is $170,000 – $250,000 + equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

The role will be based in Europe and will support a global audience while partnering across functions and operating businesses. The specific European location and work arrangement will be defined in the requisition.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Use program data, employee feedback, phishing metrics, and human-risk indicators to measure effectiveness, identify trends and opportunities, and recommend improvements that strengthen security behaviors and reduce business risk.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Multiple years of professional experience spanning cybersecurity awareness or culture, human risk management, phishing simulation, security awareness platforms, learning technologies, instructional design, project management, information technology, organizational change, learning and development, communications, or closely related disciplines, including experience using the Abnormal Security platform.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

- Experience supporting global, matrixed organizations or regulated life sciences, diagnostics, biotechnology, healthcare, or technology environments

- Experience with policy governance and risk management; and content or web-management tools such as Synthesia, Adobe Captivate, and SharePoint.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

About the Role:

Forbes Advisor is hiring a Creative Strategist to develop and scale direct-response advertising across paid social for our home categories, including Home Security, Roofing, Windows, Showers, among others.

The role reports to the Creative Director of the home vertical and works closely with Editors, the production team, and our growth and media teams. You take an idea from research and angle through script, hook, and visual direction, and you execute it. That means directing talent on set or remotely, briefing Editors and creators, and giving creative notes through final delivery. A production team supports you with logistics and casting. When results come in, you read them and turn them into the next round.

You are a direct-response thinker with real creative taste. You can write a script that converts and direct a creator to deliver it. You know why an ad worked, not just that it did, and you use that to build the next winner. You understand hooks, awareness levels, objections, mechanisms, offers, and proof, and you know what feels native on Meta and TikTok.

We produce from three content sources: in-person shoots, remote UGC, and AI-generated video. You will concept for all three. We are a human-led shop that uses AI to work faster without lowering the bar. AI fluency is a baseline expectation, not a bonus.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver at least 2 net-new concepts a week across video and statics. Each includes a distinct strategic angle with supporting research, hooks and scripts or copy, visual direction and references, production and editing instructions, and recommended variations for testing.
  • Optimize existing creative every week. Use performance data to build iterations on winners, such as new hooks, angles, formats, and static variations, and retire what has stopped working.
  • Own each concept end to end through the pipeline, from idea through final delivery, including directing talent and creators on set and remotely.
  • Research audiences, competitors, customer reviews, and cultural conversations to find new angles.
  • Write scripts, hooks, headlines, CTAs, and ad copy for different formats and stages of customer awareness.
  • Brief Editors, the production team, and creators, and give specific, constructive creative notes through final delivery. Align with the Creative Director on concepts and direction.
  • Analyze creative performance to find winning concepts, messaging, hooks, and formats, and turn those learnings into iterations and new tests.
  • Partner with growth and media teams so creative work lines up with business goals.
  • Use AI tools for research, ideation, scripting, visualization, and production, and know where they help and where they don’t.
  • Make sure concepts meet legal, platform, and brand guidelines before production.
  • Help build repeatable processes that raise testing velocity and output.

Requirements:

  • A portfolio of 3–5 direct-response examples you personally developed, concepted, or wrote, preferably video, with a clear account of your individual contribution.
  • Measurable results behind that work (ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, conversion rate, or spend scaled), and examples of iterations you built from performance insights.
  • 3+ years in direct-response creative strategy for paid social.
  • Strong direct-response fundamentals: hooks, consumer psychology, awareness levels, objections, mechanisms, offers, and proof.
  • Exceptional copywriting across formats and audiences.
  • Strong visual taste: composition, styling, pacing, editing, and social-first creative, in video and statics.
  • Experience directing talent and UGC creators, including remotely.
  • Experience handing work to editors, creators, and a production team with briefs and notes they can act on.
  • Ability to read performance metrics and use them to inform creative decisions.
  • Comfort with AI tools and a point of view on where they help.
  • Comfort working at high volume and pace, managing creative end to end through a pipeline, and shipping many concepts, variations, and optimizations a week without dropping the bar.
  • A self-starter who is comfortable in a fast, start-up style environment.

Strong Pulses:

  • Performance creative in home categories like Home Security, Roofing, Windows, Showers, etc.
  • Journalism or documentary-style storytelling in addition to UGC.
  • Experience concepting for AI-generated video.

jobs.excerpt: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster.
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

This position is open to candidates with existing work authorization in the location where the position is advertised.


JOB OVERVIEW

The Program Manager, Housing Counseling provides technical and administrative support for the development of network-wide Housing Counseling toolkits, curricula, guidelines, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that build IRC’s capacity to deliver and sustain housing counseling services under IRC’s Housing and Urban Development (HUD) Housing Counseling Multi-State Organization (MSO). The role will support local offices in expanding housing counseling activities that strengthen client housing stabilization and homelessness prevention. This role will also support IRC’s housing programs and services in collaboration with the HQ Resettlement Team, Economic Empowerment Team, and other teams across RAI US. The position sits within the HQ Resettlement Housing Team and reports to the Director, Initial Resettlement.


MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Draft and update Housing Counseling curricula, toolkits, and SOPs aligned with HUD regulations and guidance (e.g., Handbook 7610.1 and 24 CFR part 214) and IRC’s Strategy 100, for use by housing counseling staff across IRC’s U.S. network and those preparing to take the HUD Housing Counselor Certification exam.
  • Prepare client-facing housing counseling curriculum materials for in-person counseling and workshop, plus online LMS platforms.
  • Maintain and update Resource Navigation tools that map available local, state, and federal housing stabilization, homelessness prevention, and rental assistance resources across the network.
  • Help plan and facilitate Housing Counseling and counselor certification training, as well as other IRC housing training, peer learning, and knowledge-sharing opportunities across the network, including through the Monthly Housing Call, Communities of Practice, Switchboard, and similar forums.
  • Serve as a first point of contact for day-to-day operational questions, providing technical assistance to support offices in launching, expanding, and sustaining housing counseling programming and other IRC housing programs and their requirements.
  • Respond to office requests for guidance on housing counseling program design, documentation, and compliance, applying established HUD requirements and IRC guidance, and escalating complex or ambiguous cases as needed.
  • Collaborate with the HQ Housing Team, HQ Economic Empowerment Team, Resettlement colleagues, and other HQ departments (e.g., Preferred Communities and Policy) to support the alignment of housing counseling programming with IRC’s broader housing and resettlement strategy.
  • Support data collection, outcome tracking, and HUD-required reporting (e.g., HUD Form 9902), compile and summarize program data to flag trends and gaps for program improvements, and contribute to housing related grant proposals, donor reports and applications, including mapping local funding opportunities in collaboration with field offices and HQ staff.
  • Draft standardized practices and quality assurance protocols (e.g., case file review guidance, supervisory monitoring templates) that align affiliate housing counseling practice with HUD Housing Counseling Program requirements, for review and approval.
  • Monitor changes to HUD Housing Counseling Program regulations and guidance, flag their implications for the network, and update network tools, curricula, and training materials as directed.
  • Attend HUD, intermediary, and national housing counseling meetings or forums, as assigned, and share key updates with the team.
  • Other duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree in Social Work, Urban Planning, Public Policy and Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • HUD Housing Counselor Certification strongly preferred, or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire; demonstrated working knowledge of HUD Housing Counseling Program requirements (24 CFR part 214, HUD Handbook 7610.1) required. Experience supporting HUD-approved housing counseling agency in compliance, technical assistance and capacity-building support preferred.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years of relevant professional experience in housing counseling, affordable housing programs, or housing case management, including experience contributing to curricula, SOPs, or training materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to draft, adapt, and facilitate curricula, toolkits, and training materials for adult learners across diverse organizational contexts.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with experience supporting multi-site or multi-state initiatives, and the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Experience working with refugee, immigrant, or other underserved populations preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to promote an organizational culture that reflects IRC’s core values of integrity, service, equality, and accountability.

The Global Solution Consulting team works with Sales, Product, Professional Services, Managed Services, Customer Support, Security, Commercial, and partners to shape and win customer opportunities. Experience

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • You think beyond marketing metrics and focus on business growth.

  • You take ownership and continuously optimize for better results.
  • You thrive in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B digital marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation.

    • Pipeline growth
    • Qualified leads (MQLs & SQLs)
    • Revenue impact
  • Hands-on experience with:

    • Google Ads

    • B2B attribution

What Success Looks Like

  • Lower customer acquisition costs and improved marketing ROI.

  • Higher conversion rates throughout the marketing funnel.
  • Scalable marketing systems that support long-term business growth.
  • Clear reporting and actionable insights that drive strategic decisions.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Strategy & Growth Discussion
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a performance-driven marketer who knows how to build scalable growth systems, optimize every stage of the B2B funnel, and turn marketing into measurable pipeline and revenue, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we help improve the quality and reliability of clinical trial data by providing specialized clinical assessment, training, and quality oversight solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies around the world.

Our team partners with sponsors and research sites to support the consistent administration, scoring, and review of clinical outcome assessments across global clinical trials. Through services including central scoring, central review, image-based review, rater training and certification, calibration, and quality review and remediation, we help reduce variability, strengthen data quality, and ensure greater confidence in clinical trial endpoints.

Our work spans multiple therapeutic areas, including dermatology, where we engage experienced clinicians to bring indication-specific and scale-specific expertise to clinical trial programs. Our experts help ensure assessments are performed and evaluated consistently, from training and certifying site raters to centrally reviewing scores and images and identifying opportunities for remediation.

Our global team brings together clinical, scientific, operational, data, and technology expertise to solve complex challenges in clinical trials. At Cogstate, our goal is simple: to help sponsors generate high-quality, reliable data that supports confident decision-making throughout clinical development.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

About the Role

Cogstate is seeking experienced Dermatologists to support clinical research studies through a range of centralized assessment and quality oversight services. In this fully remote, contract-based role, clinicians may perform Central Scoring, Central Review, Image-Based Review, Site Rater Training & Certification, Calibration Activities, and Quality Review & Remediation across a variety of dermatology clinical trials.

Cogstate provides comprehensive, fully compensated training on study protocols, scoring methodologies, review processes, and operational requirements before clinicians begin study work. Ongoing calibration exercises and quality oversight activities help ensure consistency, reliability, and regulatory compliance across all study assessments.

Depending on study needs and individual expertise, consultants may contribute to one or more service areas, including:

  • Central Scoring: Independent scoring and interpretation of dermatology-specific clinician-reported and observer-reported outcome measures.
  • Central Review: Secondary review of completed assessments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and protocol adherence.
  • Image-Based Review: Evaluation of clinical photographs and imaging data to assess disease severity, treatment response, and endpoint compliance.
  • Site Rater Training & Certification: Training, certifying, and supporting site-based raters on proper scale administration and scoring procedures.
  • Calibration Activities: Participating in ongoing calibration exercises to maintain inter-rater reliability and scoring consistency across global studies.
  • Quality Review & Remediation: Identifying assessment quality issues, providing corrective feedback, and supporting remediation efforts to improve data quality and protocol compliance.

These are fully-remote, contract positions. Work is provided on an as-needed basis and scheduled according to clinician availability.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD or DO with specialization in Dermatology.
  • Board-certified or board-eligible Dermatologist preferred.
  • Active and unrestricted medical license in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of post-training clinical practice experience in dermatology.
  • Experience evaluating and managing patients with dermatologic conditions in clinical, academic, or research settings.
  • Demonstrated experience with dermatology clinical outcome assessments, disease severity scales, and clinician-reported outcome measures.
  • Experience with one or more dermatology indications such as atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, vitiligo, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata, prurigo nodularis, eczema, chronic pruritus, or other inflammatory and rare dermatologic disorders.
  • Familiarity with dermatology rating scales and assessments such as EASI, IGA, SCORAD, PASI, DLQI, VASI, PP-NRS, HiSCR, CDLQI, and other study-specific outcome measures.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently apply scoring criteria and identify assessment quality issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide training, feedback, and remediation guidance to site personnel.
  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and web-based clinical trial systems.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

The role, in a nutshell:

As a Senior Renewal Manager, Public Sector at Chainguard, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the retention and long-term success of our Public Sector customers across federal, state, and local government, along with the systems integrators and partners who serve them. You will own the renewal process for a book of our largest and most complex public sector contracts, managing renewals from early planning through award while navigating government budget cycles, contract vehicles, and procurement requirements.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, Partners, and Ops. By owning renewals, you enable Customer Success to focus on adoption and mission outcomes, and Sales to focus on expansion and new business. Your work ensures renewals are planned around fiscal year timing and funding realities, so customers keep their coverage in place without gaps, while supporting Chainguard’s broader revenue and retention goals.

You will act as a trusted partner to customers, resellers, and primes, guiding renewal conversations with clarity, patience, and confidence. Attention to detail, fluency in government contracting, and strong cross-functional collaboration are essential, as public sector renewals involve long lead times, many stakeholders, and little room for error.

What you’ll do:

  • Renewal Management: Own the end-to-end renewal process for a portfolio of public sector customers, starting renewal planning 6 to 9 months ahead of contract end to align with budget cycles, fiscal year-end, and option year exercises.
  • Contract Vehicles & Partners: Manage renewals through resellers, distributors, and contract vehicles (such as GSA Schedule, SEWP, and agency-specific vehicles), coordinating quotes, pricing, and paperwork with channel partners and primes.
  • Commercial Execution: Generate renewal quotes, lead pricing and contract discussions, and coordinate with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and Contracts to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely execution.
  • Funding & Procurement: Track funding status, continuing resolutions, period of performance dates, and procurement milestones, and escalate early when timing puts a renewal or coverage at risk.
  • Forecasting & CRM Hygiene: Maintain accurate renewal data in CRM, including forecasts, risks, and renewal status, to provide clear visibility and predictable outcomes.
  • Risk & Retention Strategy: Identify renewal risks early, including budget cuts, program changes, and competitive pressure, and collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, and Partners to mitigate churn and improve gross retention.
  • Process & Playbooks: Develop and refine public sector renewal playbooks, including fiscal year-end planning and vehicle-specific processes, to increase efficiency and improve on-time renewal rates.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as the subject matter expert on public sector renewals, mentor other Renewal Managers, and help shape how the function scales as Chainguard grows its government business.

What we're looking for:

  • 6+ years of experience in renewals, contracts, account management, or sales supporting U.S. federal, state, or local government customers, with direct ownership of customer contracts and commercial conversations.
  • Deep knowledge of government procurement, including contract vehicles, resellers, option years, and federal fiscal year timing.
  • Track record of owning government contracts, including enterprise license agreements, and renewing them at or above value.
  • Proven ability to drive renewals with predictability and deliver against gross retention targets.
  • Experience working with channel partners, distributors, and systems integrators on quoting, pricing, and order execution while maintaining strong customer relationships.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple renewal cycles simultaneously.
  • Comfort generating quotes, preparing order forms, and maintaining CRM hygiene, ideally in Salesforce.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to operate with full autonomy in a fast-paced, evolving environment and lead the build-out of new processes where needed.

Pay Range: Up to $195,000 70/30 OTE

If your experience is close, but doesn’t fulfill all requirements, please apply. Chainguard is on a mission to build the best team. To achieve our goal, we are focused on hiring Chainguardians with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

jobs.description:
Controller

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Job Status: Full-Time

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Location: Remote

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Controller manages the day-to-day financial operations of Grenova and its sister companies, Peak Robotics (PRI) and Peak Analysis and Automation (PAA). The role is responsible for the accuracy and timeliness of the books, the monthly and annual close, financial reporting, internal controls, and regulatory compliance. We run a lean finance function and use AI and automation wherever we can, so this is a hands-on role for someone who wants to be in the detail and to build better ways of working. The Controller is also the accounting lead for the move from three separate ERP systems to a single NetSuite environment, and partners with the CFO, who leads financial strategy and planning.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • CPA required; Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Public accounting experience, ideally Big 4 or another well-regarded firm.
  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools (for example Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot) and a track record of using them to automate close, reconciliation and reporting work, or a strong interest in learning to.
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience; Controller or Assistant Controller experience is a plus but not required.
  • Strong working knowledge of GAAP and financial regulations.
  • Experience with month-end and year-end close for multi-entity organizations, including intercompany; international (US and UK) experience is a plus.
  • Experience with cost and inventory accounting; manufacturing, lab automation or other technology experience is a plus but not required.
  • Experience supporting or leading an ERP implementation or migration; NetSuite experience strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with business accounting software (Dynamics 365 Business Central a plus) and advanced Excel skills.
  • Familiarity with payroll systems and HR-related financial processes.
  • Working knowledge of tax compliance requirements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with close attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and work with outside providers; experience supervising staff is a plus.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, comfort with direct feedback, and a high sense of ownership.
  • Experience in a small to mid-sized company is a plus. Remote; any US time zone, with some overlap with UK hours.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Accounting Operations and Financial Reporting

  • Manage accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, cost accounting, and inventory accounting.
  • Own the month-end and year-end close, including account reconciliations, accruals, and intercompany eliminations.
  • Prepare and review accurate financial statements, including income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow reports, for management, lenders, and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP or other applicable accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting policies and procedures and document key processes.
  • Use AI and automation to streamline the close, reconciliations and reporting, including data feeds from source systems, and keep a written runbook for each process.
  • Supervise, train, and develop accounting staff and outside providers as the team grows.

Inventory and Cost Accounting

  • Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, cycle count review, and related reporting.
  • Maintain standard costing, variance analysis, and cost-of-goods-sold accuracy.

Cash Management and Working Capital

  • Monitor daily and weekly cash position and prepare cash flow reports.
  • Manage collections, vendor payment timing, and other working capital processes in coordination with the CFO.

Budgeting and Forecasting Support

  • Provide actuals, variance analysis, and supporting data for the annual budget and forecasts led by the CFO.
  • Prepare budget-to-actual reporting and explain material variances to department heads.

Internal Controls, Audit, and Compliance

  • Design, implement, and monitor internal financial controls, including segregation of duties and approval workflows.
  • Coordinate external audits and tax preparation and respond to auditor requests.
  • Ensure timely and accurate local, state, and federal tax filings and other regulatory compliance, including sales and use tax and payroll tax.

ERP Management and NetSuite Migration

  • Serve as the accounting lead on the migration of three legacy ERP systems to NetSuite, working with the CFO, internal stakeholders and the implementation partner.
  • Define financial requirements, including chart of accounts, entity and subsidiary structure, dimensions, and reporting needs.
  • Lead data cleanup, mapping, migration, and validation of opening balances and historical data from each legacy system and reconcile differences in charts of accounts and processes across systems.
  • Participate in system configuration, user acceptance testing, and cutover planning.
  • Update and document accounting processes and internal controls for the new system.
  • Train finance team members on NetSuite and manage the first closes after go-live.
  • After go-live, maintain data quality and ensure the ERP is used consistently for reporting and inventory tracking.

Collaboration

  • Work with department heads to provide financial information, budget tracking, and accounting guidance.
  • Support the CFO and leadership team with accurate, timely financial data for decision making.
  • Promote continuous improvement in accounting processes, with a focus on automation.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager — Client Onboarding, Activation & Retention
jobs.excerpt: Wing Assistant is a venture-backed, Silicon Valley-based startup with global operations.
jobs.description:
Wing Assistant is a venture-backed, Silicon Valley-based startup with global operations. We match US businesses with dedicated, fully managed remote professionals (executive assistants, customer service reps, healthcare admins, bookkeepers, and more) and run the delivery behind them: recruiting, onboarding, management, and support. We're also building exciting AI technologies to help clients get even more done across our Wing suite and sister companies we operate in the AI space.

Our talent and delivery teams are based in the Philippines; our clients are mostly in the US; our leadership works across Hong Kong and the US. We've scaled fast. Now we're obsessed with getting every customer we win live quickly, and keeping them for the long haul.

The Role

    The biggest lever on Wing's growth is what happens after a customer signs: how quickly they get value, and how long they stay. We're hiring one person to own the entire post-sale journey (onboarding, activation, and retention) from the moment a deal closes to month 12 and beyond.

    This is not an advisory role. You won't hand off a deck and walk away. You'll diagnose where and why customers stall or leave, build the systems and tools to fix it, and hold multiple teams accountable to the numbers. If you've spent years recommending changes and want to be the person who actually makes them happen, this is that job.

What you'll own

  • The onboarding pipeline. Every new account from signed deal to fully live. You know where every account sits, where it's stuck and why, and you make sure it moves faster.
  • Activation and early-life health. The first months decide whether a client stays. Define what a healthy start looks like, spot accounts going off track and intervene early.
  • Retention and churn as numbers. Define them, measure them and break them down (logo vs. revenue, early-life vs. mature, by role, segment, acquisition channel and team). Set the targets and own the trend lines.
  • Root-cause analysis. Funnels, cohorts, survival curves, leading indicators. Go beyond the dashboard into the qualitative and raw data to find what really drives outcomes.
  • Process improvement. Map the handoffs across teams, find the friction, redesign the process, run experiments and measure the impact.
  • Building tools. Vibe-code dashboards, alerts and workflow tools using Claude and other AI coding tools. Ship useful things in days, not quarters.
  • Deep data work. Write the SQL, reconcile the sources and build the models. When two systems disagree, you find out which one is right and why.
  • Stakeholder leadership. Work with sales, recruiting, customer success, finance, product and our Philippines operations team: people from very different backgrounds, functions and time zones. Drive change through clarity and evidence often without direct authority.
  • Reporting to leadership. A crisp weekly view of pipeline, activation and retention health: what changed, and what you're doing about it.

What success looks like

    First 30 days: You've mapped the customer journey end to end, have access to every relevant data source, and have built trusted baselines for the metrics you own.

    First 60 days: You've identified the highest-impact opportunities with hard evidence, launched the first interventions, and shipped your first tools.

    First 90 days: You can show measurable improvement on at least one core metric, yourun a weekly operating cadence, and the tools you built are used daily by the teams.

Working Arrangements

  • Remote, full-time role. Occasional in-person meetings in Hong Kong.
  • Location: Hong Kong.
  • Hours: Our clients and many team members operate on US time. Your working day will generally run from the evening into the night, Hong Kong time. This is a core requirement of the role, not an occasional ask.
  • Travel: Occasional trips to our operation center in the Philippines.
  • Pace: This is an intense, high-ownership role in a fast-moving company. Expect high standards, tight feedback loops and real accountability for results. It's a great fit if you want to grow fast and see your work move the numbers, and probably not the
    right fit if you're looking for a steady 9-to-5.
  • Commitment: This is a high-ownership, full-time role, and we expect it to be your only professional commitment. If you have other employment, consulting work or business interests, please mention them when you apply so we can discuss them openly.

How to apply

  • Send your CV and a short note (no more than 200 words) about a time you found the number nobody else had noticed, and what happened next. Links to anything you've built with AI tools are a strong plus.

  • Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical case exercise using real-world style data.

Fine Print

  • Background and reference checks. Final-stage candidates may be asked to complete background and reference checks, with their consent and in line with applicable law.
  • Equal opportunity. Wing is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applicants of every background, regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality or any other characteristic protected by law.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

jobs.description:
Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will lead the migration to FleetDM and build the shared platform capabilities that support dependable endpoint operations. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical planning, partnering with Windows, macOS, and Linux engineers to introduce changes safely across a distributed environment.
You will develop automation, integrations, and configuration-as-code workflows, validate platform capabilities, and guide phased adoption. Beyond migration, you will improve platform reliability, visibility, and maintainability, helping the team reduce manual work and operate the service with shared ownership.
You will partner with Security, IAM, CorpInfra, and support teams to resolve dependencies and make practical trade-offs. This is an individual-contributor position with technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the FleetDM migration. Define scope, requirements, architecture, dependencies, and a phased delivery plan with OS specialists and partner teams.
  • Engineer and operate the shared platform. Maintain configuration, agent workflows, policies, queries, integrations, and operational automation.
  • Make deployment safe and repeatable. Build version-controlled configuration with automated checks, peer review, controlled rollout, drift detection, and recovery.
  • Validate capabilities and coexistence. Identify gaps, clarify management authority, and establish which responsibilities should migrate or remain with existing tools.
  • Make platform health actionable. Establish trustworthy device populations, data freshness, enrollment and agent health, and owned remediation workflows.
  • Protect service continuity. Use representative pilots, acceptance gates, employee-impact checks, and clear pause and recovery decisions.
  • Strengthen team capability. Create reusable patterns, documentation, and shared support coverage through pairing, mentoring, and operational handoffs.
  • Improve efficiency and cost. Reduce recurring manual work and recommend tooling consolidation where evidence supports it.

Requirements

  • Significant hands-on experience engineering enterprise endpoint platforms, including deep expertise in at least one of Windows, macOS, or Linux and experience working across OS boundaries.
  • Personal ownership of a multi-phase platform migration or comparable change, including discovery, pilots, rollout, recovery, and operational handover.
  • Strong practical programming or scripting skills, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or shell, with production automation and API integration experience.
  • Demonstrated use of Git, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for configuration or infrastructure changes.
  • Ability to diagnose enrollment, agent, policy, identity, networking, and integration failures and distinguish missing data from healthy devices.
  • Experience establishing monitoring, failure handling, least-privilege access, secrets management, and maintainable operational workflows.
  • Ability to independently define priorities, align cross-functional stakeholders, communicate trade-offs, and mentor engineers.
  • Clear written and verbal communication and effective asynchronous collaboration across regions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience with FleetDM configuration, policies, queries, APIs, agent operations, or deployment automation.
  • Practical osquery and SQL experience, including query validation, performance considerations, targeting, and stale or missing results.
  • Migration or coexistence experience involving Intune, Jamf, or comparable endpoint-management platforms.
  • Experience integrating endpoint platforms with identity, security, inventory, or ITSM services.
  • Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments.
  • Demonstrated improvements in platform operating effort, tool consolidation, or lifecycle cost.

Durable Skills

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
