Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

EXPECTED COMPENSATION RANGE: $42K-$45K
Overview

The IT Compliance Analyst supports the organization’s security and compliance program through audit coordination, technical evidence review, control testing support, and remediation tracking. This role works with technical and business teams to demonstrate that controls are operating effectively, maintain reliable compliance records, and identify gaps before they become audit findings. The analyst evaluates what evidence demonstrates rather than simply collecting and organizing submissions.

Responsibilities

Audit Coordination and Readiness

  • Coordinate assigned activities supporting SOC 1, SOC 2, SOC 3, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS audits and assessments, as applicable, from preparation through evidence submission and finding closure.
  • Serve as a day-to-day contact for auditor requests and follow-up questions, escalating interpretation, policy, and risk decisions to the appropriate owners.
  • Manage evidence trackers, control mappings, recurring compliance activities, and audit deadlines.
  • Coordinate evidence requests across technical and business functions, communicating requirements, ownership, and timelines clearly.

Technical Evidence Review and Control Testing

  • Gather, review, organize, and validate evidence for relevance, completeness, accuracy, and alignment with the control and review period.
  • Evaluate technical evidence, including vulnerability scans, logging reports, access records, configuration data, change records, tickets, and system reports.
  • Assist with control testing by distinguishing documented requirements, control design, and evidence that a control operated effectively.
  • Identify evidence that does not adequately demonstrate the control being tested and work with control owners to resolve gaps or obtain clarification.
  • Translate compliance requirements into actionable evidence requests while engaging technical owners for engineering decisions and implementation.

Findings and Recurring Control Follow-Through

  • Track findings, exceptions, remediation actions, accountable owners, and deadlines through documented closure.
  • Review remediation evidence for completeness and alignment with the identified issue, escalating unresolved questions to the appropriate reviewers.
  • Identify missed recurring activities, outdated evidence, documentation gaps, and approaching deadlines.
  • Follow up consistently with stakeholders and escalate delays or unresolved gaps that could affect audit readiness.

Documentation and Compliance Records

  • Maintain policies, procedures, control narratives, diagrams, evidence guides, and supporting audit documentation in collaboration with responsible owners.
  • Maintain a traceable record of requests, responses, exceptions, remediation activity, and approvals.
  • Keep compliance records organized, current, and accessible to authorized stakeholders.
  • Recommend improvements to evidence quality, documentation consistency, and audit coordination practices.

Additional Expectations

  • Demonstrates and promotes the company's Impact Behaviors in all interactions and decision-making.
    • Design
    • Ownership
    • First Team
    • Performance
  • Maintains a professional, collaborative, and client-focused approach while supporting team and organizational objectives.
  • Performs other duties, responsibilities, and special projects as assigned to meet business needs.

Qualifications

Required

  • Working knowledge of one or more relevant compliance frameworks or requirements, such as SOC, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS.
  • Ability to interpret control requirements and determine what evidence reasonably demonstrates control design and operation.
  • Foundational understanding of Linux and Windows systems, networking, firewalls, access controls, authentication and MFA, vulnerability management, patching, logging, backups, retention, encryption, change management, incident response, and business continuity.
  • Ability to interpret technical records and explain what they demonstrate, including the relevance of terms such as syslog, CVE, subnet, TLS, root, ACL, and service account.
  • Ability to manage substantial evidence sets, simultaneous auditor requests, and recurring compliance deadlines.
  • Comfort working with ticketing systems, documentation platforms, spreadsheets, dashboards, and security or compliance tools.
  • Strong written communication, documentation, organization, and follow-through.
  • Sound judgment, attention to detail, curiosity, and professional persistence when resolving incomplete or unclear submissions.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with multiple relevant compliance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting audits or assessments in a technology or infrastructure environment.
  • Experience improving evidence guidance, control documentation, or remediation tracking practices.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Quality, completeness, and relevance of audit evidence.
  • Timely completion of evidence requests and recurring compliance activities.
  • Effective tracking and escalation of findings and remediation.
  • Accuracy, currency, and traceability of compliance documentation.
  • Clear coordination with auditors, control owners, and technical teams.

Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • While performing the essential duties of this job, the individual is regularly required to speak and hear

Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.

About the project

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.

About the roles

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience& skillsets.

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November

  • Languages: Dutch

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

  • Project compensation: varies depends on different programming language

  • Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

  1. Language test: short exercises in the target language.

  1. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

  1. Financial Onboarding & Role placement:complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

  • Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What you have:

  • Experience leveraging data-driven reporting and automation to identify and implement strategic process enhancements, driving operational efficiency and organizational effectiveness.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in financial services, project/program management, risk, compliance, audit, or operations.
  • Integrative critical thinking skills, basic risk management knowledge, good organizational, communication and influencing skills.
  • Demonstrated experience performing analytic and through assessments to form defensible conclusions.

  • Proven ability to cultivate a cohesive team environment through strong interpersonal skills, manage conflict calmly under pressure, and thrive in a demanding, high-volume environment.

What sets you apart:

  • Project management experience or experience supporting complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated experience writing executive level summaries and risk assessments.

Job Title:Tax Compliance Auditor

Department/Business Unit:Dept 94 - Compliance

Reports to:Director of Compliance

Status:Seasonal

FLSA Status:Hourly

Job Summary

The Tax Compliance Auditor will work directly with the Director of Compliance and Compliance Process Manager to review individual tax returns with certain schedules and tax credits. This position is integral to help identify unusual tax practices in our tax offices, test compliance with Liberty Tax policies and procedures, the Internal Revenue Service and state statutes, rules and regulations. The position will perform analytical and investigative services working directly with compliance staff.

Responsibilities/Duties

  • Assist in the process to monitor franchise and managed operation stores tax compliance with the IRS, Liberty Tax policies and procedures and federal and state tax statutes,
    • Perform review of individual tax returns, to monitor compliance with IRS regulations pertaining to the filing of personal income tax returns; including, but not limited to, returns reporting:
      • W-2 income
      • Schedule C business income and expense
      • Schedule A deductions
      • Refundable Education, Fuel Tax, Earned Income Tax and Additional Child tax credits
      • Re-signature of tax returns
    • Communicate findings to franchisees and managed operation’s store personnel
    • Report results to appropriate departments and upper management
  • Cultivate and maintain a positive, productive, and professional relationship with staff, colleagues, and franchisees.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Knowledge of IRS regulations pertaining to the Earned Income Tax Credit and preparer Due Diligence
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, research and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
  • Proficient with technology; solid knowledge of computer operations and software
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Products: Outlook, Excel, and Word

Education and Experience

  • CPA or EA certification preferred
  • Three or more years of individual income tax preparation experience preferred

Physical Requirements

Position requires working at a desk at an office for periods of time up to eight hours.

Work Environment

This position will require the employee to work at one of our Corporate offices in Hurst, TX or Virginia Beach, VA or remote. As an employer, we are looking for employees that convey our R.E.A.L mission and values. We encourage team bonding & interacting with colleagues. jobs.title: Consulting Engineer – Government Cloud Managed Services
jobs.excerpt: The Consulting Cloud Engineer – Government Cloud Managed Services is responsible for implementing, onboarding, and operationalizing Managed Services for customers operating within regulated Government Cloud environments.
jobs.description:
The Consulting Cloud Engineer – Government Cloud Managed Services is responsible for implementing, onboarding, and operationalizing Managed Services for customers operating within regulated Government Cloud environments. This role partners with customers, architects, and operations to transition customer environments into secure, supportable, and repeatable operational models.

The Engineer designs, implements and manages cloud management capabilities, automation, monitoring, operational processes, documentation, and governance across Azure Government / Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud, and Google Cloud Assured Workloads.

This role requires strong technical expertise, customer consulting skills, operational discipline, and knowledge of Government Cloud security and compliance requirements.

What You Will Do

  • Implement Government Cloud-focused tools, processes, operational standards, and secure cloud landing zones supporting Managed Services delivery across Azure Government / Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud, and Google Cloud Assured Workloads, aligned with CDW Managed Services standards and customer security requirements.
  • Support customer onboarding, implementation, transition readiness, operational acceptance, and production handoff activities.
  • Follow change management, security, testing, validation, and deployment processes for Government Cloud customer environments.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation supporting critical Government customer environments, including after-hours, weekends, and holidays as required.
  • Develop documentation including architecture validation, runbooks, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, observability, backup, disaster recovery, and operational management solutions to support Managed Services delivery.
  • Configure cloud governance, identity, networking, security controls, logging, and operational standards consistent with Government Cloud best practices.
  • Build repeatable automation using Infrastructure as Code, scripting, configuration management, and orchestration technologies.
  • Participate in customer design reviews, implementation workshops, technical planning sessions, and operational readiness reviews.
  • Clearly communicate technical issues, implementation risks, recommendations, and project status, and collaborate with Cloud Architects, Security Engineering, Customer Success, Managed Operations, and Sales Engineering throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Validate Managed Services operational readiness prior to production support transition.
  • Support security reviews, compliance validation, audit requests, and implementation of required Government Cloud controls.
  • Maintain relevant cloud, security, automation, and Government Cloud certifications, and adhere to time compliance, documentation standards, and project management requirements.

What We Expect of You

  • Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of IT engineering experience supporting cloud, infrastructure, systems, networking, or platform engineering OR 7+ years of equivalent professional IT engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and supporting at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure (Azure Government / Azure GCC High preferred), AWS (GovCloud preferred), or Google Cloud (Assured Workloads).
  • Understanding of Government Cloud operational models, Managed Services delivery, and customer onboarding processes.
  • Working knowledge of cloud compute, storage, networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, load balancing, firewalls, segmentation), identity, backup, and disaster recovery concepts.
  • Ability to resolve customer-impacting issues while balancing project priorities, service level commitments, and operational requirements.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and executive audiences and to establish customer trust through expertise and professionalism.
  • Strong customer-service orientation, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with a self-motivated, continuous learning mindset and willingness to mentor peers.
  • Certain customer workloads (for example, those involving ITAR or CUI data) may require U.S. citizenship.
  • Experience supporting public sector (Federal, DoD, State and Local Government, or Education) cloud environments, a plus.
  • Advanced-level certifications in at least two major cloud providers (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud), a plus.
  • Experience creating implementation plans, operational runbooks, knowledge documentation, and operational handoff documentation, a plus.
  • Experience with enterprise multi-cloud environments, Managed Services environments, ITSM (e.g., ServiceNow), observability, Infrastructure as Code and scripting, and cloud management platforms, a plus.
  • Experience designing and implementing secure cloud landing zones, cloud governance, networking, identity, monitoring, automation, backup, and disaster recovery solutions, a plus.
  • Working knowledge of Government security frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, CMMC, CJIS, or ITAR, and how they apply to cloud environments, a plus.

Pay range: $77,725 - $108,265 depending on experience and skill set.

Quarterly bonus target of 10% subject to terms and conditions of plan.

Benefits overview:

Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials.

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

jobs.excerpt: We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure.
jobs.description:
We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

About this role

As a Project Manager, Solar Construction on Intersect's Construction Team, you'll lead the execution of utility-scale solar facilities exceeding 300 MW from pre-construction through commissioning and substantial completion.You'll own complex, cross-functional execution from detailed design and procurement through construction, commissioning, and commercial closeout, ensuring our storage assets are delivered safely, on schedule, and within budget.

You'll partner closely with Development, Finance, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Operations as well as EPC contractors, utilities, and Owner's Engineers to deliver safe, high-quality power infrastructure on time and on budget. By combining rigorous project controls with modern platforms like Terabase and AI Clearing, you'll drive predictable execution and build assets that create long-run value.

Team overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition by turning ambitious development pipelines into operating utility-scale power plants. The Construction Project Management team bridges engineering design, procurement, financial governance, and field execution to build resilient infrastructure at scale. Joining this team means taking ownership of high-impact capital projects and growing alongside collaborative leaders who prioritize safety, operational excellence, and long-term asset performance.

What you'll do

Lead Full-Lifecycle Solar Project Execution

  • Manage the end-to-end construction of utility-scale solar PV projects, managing civil, pile-driving, tracker/structural, module installation, and DC/AC electrical scopes through mechanical completion, commissioning, and closeout.

  • Track daily and weekly field progress, productivity rates, and schedule adherence using the Terabase Platform, AI Clearing, and project scheduling platforms, proactively mitigating bottlenecks before they impact COD.

  • Monitor and align master schedules across contractors and stakeholders, tracking critical path milestones, schedule updates, and owner-supplied material deliveries tied to milestone payments and contractual notices.

Manage EPC and External Partnerships

  • Manage owner, contractor, and third-party deliverables across EPC and land contracts, representing Intersect in meetings with contractors, utilities, and grid operators.

  • Lead the administration of construction and equipment supply contracts, including change orders, RFIs, submittals, and document control.

  • Review and approve construction strategies, procurement plans, and execution methodologies while maintaining productive alignment across stakeholder groups.

  • Conduct regular on-site reviews with EPC leadership, utilities, and owner’s engineers to maintain clear communication, resolve field challenges, and uphold Intersect's construction standards.

Drive Financial and Commercial Discipline

  • Prepare comprehensive executive and stakeholder reporting covering schedule performance, financial health, risk registers, and mitigation strategies.

  • Lead weekly and monthly budget reviews and reporting, including cash flow forecasts, actuals, accruals, invoice validation, and lien waiver reviews to maintain strict alignment with approved targets.

  • Build and maintain project trackers to govern quality assurance, commissioning workflows, and performance testing through substantial completion.

  • Ensure full compliance with contractual obligations, interconnection agreements, permitting stipulations, and commercial requirements.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related technical field (Master's degree in Engineering or Construction Management preferred).

  • 5+ years of progressive project management experience delivering utility-scale solar PV construction projects from pre-construction through commissioning and COD.

  • Deep expertise in utility-scale EPC contract administration, construction scheduling platforms (e.g., Primavera P6 or MS Project), budget and cash flow management, and change order negotiation.

  • Hands-on proficiency with digital construction, document control, and collaboration tools including Bluebeam, Terabase Platform, AI Clearing, Google Workspace (G Suite), Microsoft Office, and Slack.

  • Strong working knowledge of solar civil, mechanical/tracker, and electrical construction scopes, utility interconnection coordination, and QA/QC commissioning standards.

  • Proven leadership and communication skills, with the composure to align cross-functional teams, contractors, and utilities under tight deadlines.

  • Commitment to safety, accountability, and collaborative problem-solving aligned with Intersect's core values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

Equity: Beyond your salary, you’ll receive an Equity Grant, giving you a meaningful stake in our parent company.

Health & wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance available for employees and dependents

Family support: Up to 18 weeks of fully paid parental leave; access to family planning and family care support through Maven

Financial support: Generous 401(k) and RRSP retirement plans

jobs.excerpt: The Principal Consultant Engineer – Government Cloud Managed Services is the senior technical leader for CDW’s Government multi-cloud Managed Services practice, supporting Federal, State and Local Government, and Education customers, as well as commercial customers serving federal agencies, across AWS GovCloud (US), Microsoft Azure Government / Azure GCC High, and Google Cloud.
jobs.description:
The Principal Consultant Engineer – Government Cloud Managed Services is the senior technical leader for CDW’s Government multi-cloud Managed Services practice, supporting Federal, State and Local Government, and Education customers, as well as commercial customers serving federal agencies, across AWS GovCloud (US), Microsoft Azure Government / Azure GCC High, and Google Cloud.

This role sets the architecture standards, automation strategy, and compliance-aligned operating model for regulated customer environments, serves as the top technical escalation point for the practice, and acts as the technical lead for pre-sales engagements.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in at least one government cloud platform with working knowledge of another, a strong Infrastructure as Code and automation background, hands-on experience applying Government security frameworks, and the ability to mentor and grow a team of engineers.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as the technical lead and escalation point for Government Cloud Managed Services across Microsoft Azure Government / Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud (US), and Google Cloud.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, secure landing zone standards, and operational patterns for regulated Government customer environments.
  • Lead the design and delivery of Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform), automation, and CI/CD pipelines that standardize customer onboarding, deployment, and day-to-day operations across clouds.
  • Translate Government compliance requirements, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CMMC, DISA STIGs, and CIS Benchmarks, into implementable controls, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Participate in pre-sales technical engagements, including discovery, solution design, architecture input, effort estimation, scopes of work, proposals, and presentations.
  • Lead customer design workshops, architecture reviews, and operational readiness reviews for onboarding and transition into Managed Services.
  • Oversee complex implementations, migrations, upgrades, and modernization efforts through operational handoff and service onboarding.
  • Participate in on-call rotation, provide escalation support for critical incidents, and lead root cause analysis and preventative actions.
  • Follow and strengthen incident, change, problem, request, and knowledge management processes within the ITSM platform (ServiceNow).
  • Drive resiliency, capacity, performance, backup and disaster recovery, and cost optimization across customer environments.
  • Maintain trusted advisor relationships with Government customers and account teams, and communicate technical strategy, risks, and solution direction to customers and CDW leadership.
  • Mentor senior and consulting engineers, guiding solution design, engineering practices, and cross-training across cloud platforms.
  • Develop practice standards, runbooks, reusable templates, architecture documentation, and training materials for customers and internal teams.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Project Management, Security, Legal and Contracts, and cloud provider partners to develop and grow Government Cloud Managed Services offerings and identify growth opportunities.
  • Research emerging government cloud, security, and automation technologies and regulatory changes, including the evolving FedRAMP program, and present recommendations.

What We Expect of You

  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of IT engineering experience supporting cloud, infrastructure, systems, networking, or platform engineering OR 14+ years of IT engineering experience supporting cloud, infrastructure, systems, networking, or platform engineering.
  • Minimum 8+ years of IT engineering experience supporting one or more cloud, hybrid infrastructure, platform, automation, security, monitoring, database, network, systems, or service management solutions.
  • 3+ years of experience with large, cross-brand Managed Services projects.
  • Experience designing and operating cloud environments aligned with Government security frameworks, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CMMC, DISA STIGs, and CIS Benchmarks.
  • Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform), scripting, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience aligning technical solutions to business outcomes and developing technical roadmaps, architecture documentation, project plans, and schedules for complex initiatives.
  • Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead critical escalations.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, including executive-level interaction, and the ability to build trusted customer relationships.
  • Ability to mentor and lead technical teams and manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.
  • Certain customer workloads (for example, those involving ITAR or CUI data) may require U.S. citizenship.
  • Experience supporting public sector (Federal, DoD, State and Local Government, or Education) cloud environments strongly preferred.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one government cloud platform (Microsoft Azure Government / Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud (US), or Google Cloud Assured Workloads) and working knowledge of a second major cloud platform, strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting Azure GCC High or CMMC-regulated customers, a plus.
  • Professional-level certifications in two or more of Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, and published case studies, white papers, reference architectures, or technical thought leadership, a plus.

Pay range: $172,000 - $240,800 depending on experience and skill set

Annual bonus target of 10% subject to terms and conditions of plan

Benefits overview:
Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials 

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

jobs.description:
About the Team/Role

WEX Health & Benefits Product Marketing sits between Product, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Engineering. The team improves commercial outcomes by leading go-to-market strategy, serving as the voice of the customer, and partnering with Product from discovery through build and launch. The portfolio spans Consumer Directed Healthcare (including HSA/FSA), COBRA, benefits administration, and Medicare, serving customers ranging from HR leaders and brokers to individual account holders. The team works across multiple initiatives in a lean environment and uses AI to work faster, think bigger, and improve the quality of its work.

In this role, you will own the commercial story and go-to-market strategy for a product portfolio, including positioning, messaging, launch, and commercialization. You will partner with Product on pricing and packaging decisions and bring customer and market evidence into discovery to help shape what WEX builds. You will step into critical GTM work supporting the 2027 roadmap and major launches. This is an AI-forward role for a product marketer who actively builds and improves AI-enabled workflows and can demonstrate the impact.


How you'll make an impact

  • Own portfolio GTM and commercialization. Lead positioning, messaging, and launch strategy across the portfolio using the commercialization framework, from concept through post-launch performance.
  • Partner with Product on pricing and packaging. Bring customer insight, competitive context, and field feedback to decisions, working alongside Product, RevOps, and Commercial to drive resolution.
  • Partner with Product in discovery and build. Use customer research, win/loss insights, competitive analysis, and experimentation to inform roadmap decisions and product-market fit.
  • Be the voice of the customer. Synthesize customer feedback, advisory board input, and sales insight into jobs-to-be-done messaging and positioning.
  • Equip the field. Build and lead enablement, including playbooks, battlecards, and pitch decks. Own cross-functional rollout of key initiatives for Sales and partners.
  • Align the platform story. Connect narratives across CDH, COBRA, benefits administration, and Medicare where cross-solution value exists, partnering with Revenue Generation Marketing on integrated launches.
  • Build with AI. Design and use AI-enabled workflows, tools, and agents for research, competitive intelligence, content, enablement, and reporting. Share effective practices so the team improves speed and quality.
  • Measure and iterate. Define launch success metrics such as adoption, pipeline influence, win rate, and attach rate. Report results and adjust strategy based on performance.
  • Mentor and lead by example. Raise the bar on PMM craft and process, and share knowledge with junior PMMs.

Experience you'll bring

  • 3–5 years of product marketing experience in B2B or B2B2C environments, consistent with the PM3 level discussed for this requisition.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-product portfolio or multiple product initiatives, with accountability for or measurable influence on revenue, adoption, pipeline, or win-rate outcomes.
  • An AI-native working style, supported by concrete examples of something new you built with AI, efficiencies you created, and improvements to throughput or quality.
  • Experience partnering with Product on pricing and packaging decisions; direct ownership of pricing or monetization is not required.
  • Experience influencing product strategy through customer research, competitive insight, and experimentation during discovery.
  • Experience launching and growing data-centric or AI-enabled platforms, including post-launch measurement.
  • Strong sales enablement experience in complex or regulated selling environments.
  • Ability to synthesize customer insight, regulatory guidance, and market dynamics into clear positioning and strategy.
  • Comfort with data, including the ability to pull and interpret performance and usage data to guide decisions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication, with strong cross-functional influence and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships, influence without authority, prioritize competing work, and context-switch across multiple products and launches.
  • Proficiency with Google Suite, Salesforce or comparable CRM tools, and AI-driven marketing tools.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in healthcare, employee benefits, fintech, or another compliance-heavy industry. Direct benefits experience is valued but is not a non-negotiable.
  • Familiarity with CDH products such as HSA/FSA, COBRA, benefits administration, or Medicare.
  • Hands-on experience with ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, and market-team.ai.
  • Pragmatic Institute product management certification or active participation in the Product Marketing Alliance.
  • A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, marketing, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.

Why This Role Matters

Product Marketing at WEX is a strategic partner with visibility into product direction from the earliest stages of discovery. You will help shape how products are built, launched, and adopted while working closely with Product, Commercial, RevOps, and Marketing. The role offers exposure to senior stakeholders, a chance to help advance an AI-enabled way of working, and opportunities for continued career growth across Product Marketing and the broader organization.

About the Role:

WEX is transforming how businesses manage spend and fleets—with a vision beyond traditional fueling through a growing set of payment, discounting, and platform capabilities built on shared platform investments.

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and execution-driven Senior Product Manager (Level 4) to own and scale our next generation of Merchant Product solutions. Sitting within the North American Mobility (NAM) Product Team, you will act as an emerging strategic leader and trusted influencer owning a significant set of initiatives aligned to our core merchant systems—including discount networks (such as the EDGE Savings Network), pricing programs, and merchant-to-fleet communication channels.

In this role, you will drive the full product lifecycle from ideation to market delivery, connecting deep customer insights to broader company strategy, and owning customer adoption, usage, and financial value. You will work closely with senior product leaders, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to create capabilities that communicate dynamic pricing and discount programs to fleets, driving mutual value across our merchant and fleet ecosystems.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop Bold Vision and Product Strategy: Act as an emerging strategic leader to develop a bold vision and clear priorities for WEX’s merchant product ecosystem. Shape product strategy across our portfolio of discounting solutions, identify market gaps, and serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership.
  • Own Product and Financial Outcomes: Drive the execution of complex merchant initiatives, owning customer and business outcomes. Proactively define input and output metrics, utilizing rigorous business modeling and OKRs to tell the performance story of your product and drive customer and financial outcomes.
  • Lead Deep Customer and Partner Discovery: Dive deep into user behaviors and establish ongoing relationships with key merchants and fleets. Integrate qualitative and quantitative insights to pinpoint top partner problems and guide core product trade-offs.
  • Drive Multi-Channel Experiences & Portal Enhancements: Own and optimize customer journeys as they utilize our discounting programs across digital portals and platforms. Streamline onboarding workflows, automate administrative operations, and represent merchant product priorities within broader platform initiatives to reduce friction.
  • Design & Execute Iterative Experiments: Formulate hypotheses and design test-and-learn experiments to improve system administration, portal usability, and customer workflows, driving measurable adoption and delivering on key OKRs.
  • Partner & Influence Cross-Functionally: Build trust and facilitate alignment across Digital, Technology, Commercial, Risk, and Operations teams to ensure technical, operational, and financial systems are fully aligned and revenue is secure.
  • Manage Full Business & System Lifecycle: Oversee the evolution of merchant capabilities from initial ideation to a scalable, repeatable model. Detail how data flows through core systems and merchant-specific platforms, ensuring operational readiness at every stage.

Merchant Product Specifics:

  • Collaborate Across Customer-Facing Product Teams: Partner closely with adjacent WEX product owners who manage mobile apps, web portals, and communication channels to ensure they understand, align on, and prioritize the necessary features and configurations required to support seamless driver and fleet manager discounting and incentive use cases.
  • Align Go-to-Market & Value Communications: Coordinate across marketing, product marketing, customer service, and commercial teams to ensure consistent external communications that clearly articulate the value of WEX discounting programs to fleets.
  • Expand Platform & Merchant Communication Capabilities: Drive enhancements to our core pricing, discounting, and merchant platforms to enable partners to configure, manage, and effectively communicate dynamic, self-set discounts directly to participating fleets.
  • Design & Execute Fuel-Saving Behavioral Experiments: Formulate hypotheses and run test-and-learn experiments to understand when, where, and how drivers and fleet managers utilize pricing and discount information, optimizing their decision-making for maximum fuel savings.

What You Bring:

  • Minimum of 5+ years: of professional Product Management experience (or 8+ years of professional experience with significant tenure in product leadership), ideally within payment platforms, fintech, merchant services, or B2B platforms.
  • Strategic Leadership: Proven experience owning and strategically leading a significant set of initiatives aligned to a major product area or platform capability.
  • Technical Domain Expertise: Strong expertise in systems thinking and platform strategy, with a background in payment platform products, merchant ecosystems, APIs, and partner integrations.
  • Metrics & Outcomes Focus: Proven track record of defining and leveraging metrics/OKRs to tell a product's performance story, justify strategic priorities, and deliver customer and financial outcomes.
  • Roadmapping & Scaling: Strong strategic planning and roadmapping capabilities, with the ability to define repeatable patterns from one-off integrations and establish clear development phases.
  • Collaborative Influence: Excellent collaborative influence and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build trust, facilitate difficult conversations, and align stakeholders.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Insights-proficient and highly comfortable utilizing qualitative and quantitative data and interactive tools to drill down and make informed product decisions.
  • Mentorship: Proven leadership and mentorship skills, with the ability to guide and role-model discovery methods and strategic thinking for junior PMs.

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience with core pricing, discounting, or ledger systems.
  • Fluency running GTM experiments, channel testing, or behavioral A/B tests.
  • Master’s Degree in business, technology, or a related field.

Why This Role Matters:

WEX is expanding its merchant systems and platform capabilities, unlocking critical growth opportunities through our discounting and pricing ecosystems. This role will help shape how we:

  • Deepen Relationships: Deepen connections between merchants and fleets by facilitating seamless, dynamic value exchange and direct communications.
  • Simplify Savings: Simplify and optimize how fleets discover, utilize, and maximize savings programs.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive cross-functional alignment across digital interfaces, core processing layers, commercial, and risk teams to scale unified solutions.
  • Empower Partners: Ensure that merchants have comprehensive, flexible tools to configure discounts and attract fleet volumes, establishing repeatable platform patterns.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Strategic Roadmapping: You define and drive the strategic roadmap for a portion of WEX Merchant Products, translating a bold vision into market-ready features and platform capabilities.
  • Cross-Functional Trusted Partnership: You foster close, collaborative relationships with cross-functional partners, ensuring operational, technical, and risk readiness for new discounting schemes and merchant configurations.
  • Behavioral Experiments: You leverage qualitative and quantitative insights to design experiments that increase merchant-to-fleet communication effectiveness and optimize driver savings.
  • Mentorship and Alignment: You act as a trusted leader and influencer, mentoring junior product managers and driving alignment across tech, commercial, and customer-facing product teams.

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Patient Communications Representative is responsible for performing customer service activities to service and collect patient accounts receivables for medical accounts. Patient Communications Representative will locate and communicate with patients via the telephone, email, chat, text, etc. to obtain repayment in full or to establish acceptable payment arrangements. Additionally, Patient Communications Representative will resolve issues of a non-routine nature as necessary as well as answer patient’s questions and research account changes when necessary and contract observance functions to ensure compliance of all company, client, and federal and state regulations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

This position is 100% remote. Must reside in the United States.

Communicate with patients regarding the repayment of their medical debt.

  • Achieve assigned goals (resolutions, call quality, productivity standards – specified by line of business)
  • Provide customer service to patients resolving medical account balances.
  • Profile patients and obtain financial information. Update demographic and financial information on each call.
  • Negotiate the best possible arrangements.
  • Proficiency with company telephone system while placing outbound calls and accepting inbound calls.

Perform account research and route accounts through appropriate client workflows

  • Use job aids and crosswalks to answer patient questions and resolve accounts in an efficient manner.
  • Perform account research and document findings.
  • Effectively communicate with patients and client to obtain necessary account information.
  • Ensure strong communication skills to convey intricate account information.

Ensure all accounts are worked within client standards and Federal Regulations.

  • Maintain high quality account handling per client standards.
  • Work within FDCPA, state regulations, department/division & all Compliance Policies.
  • Maintain clear, concise, and accurate documentation of all attempts and/or contacts made and received for

accounts in accordance with company and client specifications.

Maintain continuing education, training in industry career development

  • Maintain current knowledge of and comply with all federal and state rules and regulations governing phone calls, patient contacts, and collections including HIPAA, FDCPA, Privacy Act, FCRA, etc.

jobs.excerpt: Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick TeamFCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.
jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

We are an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to providing a barrier-free pathway throughout our recruitment process. We welcome accommodation requests to help make our hiring and onboarding experience as accessible as possible. Please advise us about accommodation needs at any point by contacting our Recruitment Team at

🏆 Travel Weekly Magellan Awards: Silver Winner (2023)
🌟 GBTA WINiT Top 50 Award Recipients (2018–2025)
💫 CHHR: 5-Star DE&I Employer (2023, 2024)
🌍 Seramount, FCTG Mexico: Member of the Global Inclusion Index (2023–25)
📰 Newsweek: America’s Greatest Workplaces for Diversity (2024)
💛 Benefits Canada: Health/Wellness Program and Mental Health Program (2023, 2025)
✈️ OutThere Awards: Inclusive Travel Finalist (2025)
🏅 Canadian HR Awards: Excellence in Diversity and Inclusion Awardee (2025)

  • Serve as a quality partner to operational teams by providing guidance on quality issue management, quality risk identification, escalation requirements, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to facilitate the progression and resolution of quality issues within the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Monitor and drive timely progression of quality issues while identifying and escalating risks that may impact compliance, quality, or client commitments.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to develop, implement, and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) to support sustainable issue resolution.
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of quality systems, processes, and regulatory requirements to support effective quality issue management.
  • Partner with Quality Lead Managers and senior quality leadership to support quality issue progression, escalation activities, and client communications as required.

  • 5 years of experience in a regulatory environment, including experience in GxP roles.
  • Strong understanding of QMS and the CAPA process.
  • Knowledge of GCP and GxP requirements.

  • Ability to communicate quality issue summaries to clients, where applicable.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences preferred, or equivalent Life Science experience.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Electric Vehicle & Connected Fleet)
jobs.excerpt: About the Role: WEX is transforming how businesses manage spend and fleets—with a vision beyond traditional fueling through a growing set of electric vehicle (EV) charging, payment, and connected fleet capabilities built on shared platform investments.
jobs.description:
About the Role:
WEX is transforming how businesses manage spend and fleets—with a vision beyond traditional fueling through a growing set of electric vehicle (EV) charging, payment, and connected fleet capabilities built on shared platform investments.

We are looking for an execution-driven, collaborative Product Manager (PM3) to own and scale key digital capabilities within our mixed energy and connected fleet ecosystem. Sitting within the North American Mobility (NAM) Product Team, you will focus on merchant network integrations, third-party partner connections, and user experience enhancements across our mobile app and online web portals.

In this role, you will work hands-on with cross-functional partners—including engineering, design, operations, marketing, and commercial teams—to deliver practical, friction-free solutions that fleet managers and drivers rely on every day. You will also benefit from working alongside a Senior PM who will mentor and guide you as you ramp up on WEX’s ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive Tactical Product Execution: Own features end-to-end across our mobile app and customer portal, translating user needs and technical requirements into actionable user stories and sprint priorities.
  • Optimize Multi-Channel User Journeys: Improve usability and streamline digital onboarding workflows for fleet managers and drivers to reduce friction and drop-offs.
  • Conduct Field Research & Customer Discovery: Participate in customer call sessions, talk directly with fleet managers, and analyze operational feedback to ensure user pain points guide daily product trade-offs.
  • Execute Test-and-Learn Scenarios: Formulate hypotheses, evaluate behavioral data/dashboards, and test workflow improvements to measure adoption and deliver on team OKRs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, UX design, operations, and merchant partners to keep product delivery aligned and stakeholders updated on roadmap progress.
  • Design & AI Prototyping: Collaborate with UX design teams to create prototypes and test concepts quickly before engineering build-out.

EV & Connected Fleet Specifics:

  • Expand Partner & Network Integrations: Support standard third-party partner and network integrations to expand overall EV charging transaction coverage, real-time authorizations, and session management.
  • Support Fleet Charging Journeys: Help enable smooth onboarding, reporting, and operational support across public, private, and home charging scenarios.
  • Explore Connected Car Data: Work with vehicle data and connected car capabilities to help fleets optimize energy consumption and operational efficiency.
  • Hands-On Troubleshooting & Testing: Partner with internal operations and customers to test EV solutions in real-world scenarios, ensuring friction-free execution.

What You Bring:

  • 3–5 years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning features or product capabilities through the full development lifecycle.
  • Tactical Execution Focus: Strong ability to write user stories, define acceptance criteria, prioritize backlogs, and deliver value iteratively in an agile environment.
  • Frictionless User Experience: Conduct customer discovery and field research with fleet managers and drivers to optimize onboarding, reduce workflow friction, and enhance daily operational usability. Comfortable reviewing behavioral data/dashboards and speaking directly with users/operations teams to inform trade-offs.
  • Data-Driven Innovation: Leverage vehicle data to build tools that help fleets optimize energy consumption, monitor operational efficiency, and transition smoothly to EV models.
  • Prototyping & UX Comfort: Familiarity collaborating with product designers and leveraging AI/design tools for quick workflow prototyping.
  • Strong Stakeholder Communication: Ability to communicate clearly across engineering, business, and operational teams.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience or background in Electric Vehicle (EV) charging networks, connected fleet data, payments, or API-based partner integrations.
  • Hands-on experience working with fleet management systems or B2B platforms.
  • Ability to drive cross-functional delivery using AI tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, as a first-pass baseline to scale operational capacity.

Why This Role Matters:
WEX is expanding its EV and connected fleet capabilities, unlocking a critical growth opportunity in fleet electrification. This role will help shape how we:

  • Simplify and reimagine digital fleet experiences from the customer perspective.
  • Seamlessly connect drivers and fleet operators to widespread, real-time charging networks.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across technology, merchant, and commercial teams to scale unified solutions.
  • Ensure that fleets have comprehensive and easy-to-use solutions that optimize operations as they add electric and connected vehicles to their fleet.
The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $89,800.00 - $120,400.00

Become a part of our caring community

The Lead AI Automation Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership for the design, engineering, and productionization of AI-enabled automation across the Data Governance organization. This role is focused on building reliable automation products and agentic workflows—not training foundational models or serving as a traditional data scientist. The engineer will combine generative AI, workflow orchestration, APIs, enterprise integrations, low-code automation where appropriate, and production engineering practices to automate complex governance processes. The role will lead technical design, establish reusable engineering patterns, mentor other engineers, and take high-value automation opportunities from concept through secure, scalable production deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design and hands-on development of AI-enabled automations, agentic workflows, and intelligent process orchestration for enterprise Data Governance use cases.
  • Build solutions that combine large language models, deterministic business logic, workflow engines, APIs, enterprise data, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Design reusable automation frameworks, services, connectors, prompts, tools, and patterns that accelerate delivery across multiple governance workflows.
  • Integrate AI automation with metadata management, data catalog, data quality, lineage, policy, ticketing, collaboration, and enterprise data platform capabilities.
  • Engineer APIs and services that allow agents and automations to safely retrieve context, execute approved actions, and interact with enterprise systems.
  • Use Power Platform and other low-code automation technologies where they are the appropriate engineering choice, while applying software engineering discipline to maintainability, security, testing, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish patterns for agent orchestration, tool use, state management, exception handling, observability, auditability, human approval, and failure recovery.
  • Define and implement evaluation, testing, monitoring, and quality controls for AI automations, including accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and operational performance.
  • Partner with architects, security, AI/data science teams, product owners, governance leaders, and application teams to translate business processes into secure and scalable automation solutions.
  • Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, improve engineering standards, and provide technical direction without becoming removed from hands-on delivery.
  • Identify processes that are strong candidates for automation and challenge unnecessary manual steps, handoffs, and duplicated workflows.
  • Own production readiness and operational support, including CI/CD, release management, telemetry, incident troubleshooting, continuous improvement, and responsible AI controls.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing AI/ML, generative AI, intelligent automation, or advanced automation solutions, with demonstrated recent experience building LLM-enabled or agentic solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience taking complex automation or AI-enabled solutions from concept/prototype through production deployment and operational support.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership—such as leading solution design, establishing engineering patterns, conducting technical/code reviews, mentoring engineers, or serving as the technical lead for complex initiatives.

  • Experience leading AI automation, generative AI, agentic AI, or intelligent process automation initiatives in a large enterprise.
  • Experience working in a regulated enterprise environment where security, privacy, auditability, governance, and responsible AI controls are material design requirements.

Position Summary

The Benefits Underwriter is responsible for quoting, rating and issuance of new business, quotes, renewals, and endorsements. The role will work closely with Specialty Sales, Claims and Operations, Finance, Legal, Risk and Compliance to help achieve strategic initiatives, which will assure the long-term growth of profits for Health.

What will your job entail?

Work closely and share responsibility for overall revenue goal through new business and retention targets.•Engage in ongoing education to stay current with industry trends, regulations, and best practices.•Quarterly self-audit process to assure 100% and timely compliance and take necessary actions on audit recommendations and findings.•Training to ensure compliance to underwriting authority and sales practice.•Strategize with other members of assigned territory team to identify target market segments and to develop broker distribution relationships.Work Experience and Education:•Bachelor’s degree in fields such as business, finance, economics, or a related field.•5 years of Health Insurance Underwriting or 3 years of experience with a master’s degree. Licenses & Certifications: •State Accident and Health Insurance license a plus. •Charter Healthcare Consultant (ChHC) or Registered Health Underwriter (RHU) is plus.
