jobs.excerpt: The Center for Technology in Education in the School of Education at Johns Hopkins University seeks a Software Engineer - AI Focus to continue the development of AI-powered data tools for early intervention programs.
jobs.description:
The Center for Technology in Education in the School of Education at Johns Hopkins University seeks a Software Engineer - AI Focus to continue the development of AI-powered data tools for early intervention programs. In this role, the Software Engineer extends the build of an interactive dashboard that helps Part C teams explore their Child Outcomes Summary (COS) data and receive guidance grounded in that data and in national technical assistance resources. The position owns the application end to end, from data processing and the user interface to its AI capabilities and their evaluation. The role involves working independently with a domain expert who calibrates the work at key milestones, and calls for sound engineering judgment, fluency with generative AI, and vigilance over the privacy of sensitive education data.

Responsible for the creation, implementation, maintenance, performance, production support and documentation of various departmental and enterprise-wide application systems. This includes but is not limited to the installation, modification, and testing of new and/or upgraded applications (packages or homegrown), operating systems, file structures, hardware, communication devices, and productivity tools. Applies analysis techniques and procedures to gather and then translate business requirements into functional/technical specifications and designs. Using functional specifications and designs, produces all or part of the deliverables. Maintains databases and application system code.

Responsible for full life cycle of medium to large sized complex projects; strong technical skills; strong ability to understand complex business processes. Develops solutions based on extensive technical knowledge, skills and experience; influences client towards innovative/integrated solutions.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

  • The responsibilities listed below are typical examples of the work performed by this position.
  • Not all duties assigned to this position are included, nor is it expected that everyone in this position will be assigned every job responsibility.

Analysis & Requirements Gathering

  • Define complex business/clinical/education problems by meeting with clients to observe and understand current processes and the issues related to those processes. Provide written documentation of findings to share with the client and other IT colleagues.
  • Gather complex system requirements by meeting with clients and researching existing technology to understand the business requirements and possible solutions for new applications.

Design & Development

  • Develop detailed tasks and project plans by analyzing project scope and milestones for complex projects to ensure product is delivered quickly according to software lifecycle standards.
  • Write functional/technical specifications from the complex system requirements, putting them into functional and technical descriptions for use by programmers and business analysts to develop technical solutions.
  • Develop/change data input, files/database structures, data transformation, algorithms, and data output by using appropriate computer language/tools to provide technical solutions for complex application development tasks.
  • Document code and associated processes by adhering to development methodologies, adding code comments and appropriate documentation to various knowledge-base system(s) to simplify code maintenance and to improve support.
  • Provide monitoring and guidance in application design and development to more junior staff.
  • Provide thought leadership in designing and developing innovative integrated solutions.

Testing & Documentation

  • Create and document complex test scenarios using the appropriate testing tools to validate and verify application functionality.
  • Test all changes by using the appropriate complex test scenarios to ensure all delivered solutions work as expected and errors are handled in a meaningful way.
  • Author and maintain documentation by writing audience-appropriate materials to serve as technical and/or end-user references.
  • Mentor junior staff in testing tools and technologies by reviewing their work.

Implementation & Maintenance

  • Implement changes by adhering to the change management policies and procedures for any given project to communicate to all parties the nature, significance, and risk factors of the solution.
  • Monitor changes and resolve complex problems by responding as they occur, by reviewing all processing and output of the newly implemented solution, and by proactively ensuring the solution works successfully to satisfy the customer requirements and to provide a smooth transition to the new solution.
  • Provide support by investigating and resolving issues, including complex issues to ensure prompt, effective service.

In addition to the duties described above

  • Application Development: Design, build, maintain, and document an AI-powered data application, from data intake and processing to the interface practitioners use to explore their data.
  • AI Capabilities: Design and build the generative AI features, including retrieval-augmented generation over authoritative domain sources, that help practitioners interpret their data and receive evidence-grounded answers to their questions.
  • Evaluation and Quality: Establish how the system's outputs are measured and improved over time and pair quantitative evaluation with review by domain experts.
  • Privacy and Responsible Use: Design for the privacy of sensitive personally identifiable information and for the responsible, cost-effective use of AI services.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the Frontend UX Engineer and domain experts to align the application's data, AI features, and interface with the needs of practitioners.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree (or foreign equivalent) in computer science, computer information systems, information technology, electronic engineering, or a related field.
  • Five years of related work experience with computer systems and applications.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond HS Diploma/Graduation Equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Knowledge in the assigned application as well as the platform on which it runs.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building data-driven applications (e.g., in Python).
  • Demonstrated experience building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems (e.g., vector databases such as Pinecone or FAISS, knowledge graphs, retrieval evaluation with Recall@K or MRR).
  • Demonstrated experience designing LLM-powered features (e.g., prompt engineering, tool-using agents).
  • Experience building and deploying web applications (e.g., React, serverless functions on Netlify or AWS Lambda).
  • Experience evaluating AI systems with both quantitative measures and human review (e.g., faithfulness and relevancy metrics, review by domain experts).
  • Strong understanding of privacy and security practices for sensitive data (e.g., data minimization, API key management).
  • A portfolio that shows AI systems you have built and evaluated (e.g., retrieval pipelines, agents, evaluation results).
  • Experience with client-side data processing (e.g., in-browser Python with Pyodide).
  • Experience preparing document collections for retrieval (e.g., web crawling, document parsing, text cleaning).
  • Experience with education or public-sector data (e.g., early intervention or federal reporting data under FERPA and IDEA).

jobs.excerpt: Who is Credible? Credible is a leading U. S.  consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products.
jobs.description:
Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

About the Role

Credible is looking for a motivated, experienced Director of Architecture and Infrastructure to join our growing team. This is a remote, player-coach leadership role reporting to the SVP of Technology.

You will directly lead two platform teams of four engineers each, the foundation that every Credible customer- and partner-facing application runs on:

  • Infrastructure Platform (DevOps): infrastructure, AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD processes, and the internally developed applications that support them. This team works primarily in Golang.
  • Application Platform: the shared services and libraries used across our customer- and partner-facing applications, primarily written in Ruby. Examples include authentication, user disclosures, logging, integrations with SaaS products (such as email marketing systems), Kafka tooling, and GraphQL API tooling.

You will also partner with other engineering teams during the architecture and design phase of larger projects, and help advance how we approach architecture and design review across the broader engineering organization. Your work will sit closely alongside our Security team.

This role is posted at the Director level; an exceptionally qualified candidate may be hired at the Senior Director level.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the Infrastructure Platform and Application Platform teams; hire well, set clear expectations, and develop future leaders
  • Make stability the first priority: drive reliability, resilience, and operational excellence across our infrastructure and shared services
  • Bring a security mindset to every decision, working in close partnership with our Security Director and team
  • Support SOC 2 and SOX compliance through well-designed controls, processes, and tooling
  • Own the on-call rotation for the Infrastructure Platform team, ensuring it is sustainable, well-documented, and continuously improving
  • Provide architecture and design guidance on larger projects, partnering with other engineering teams in the design phase and leading design reviews
  • Help evolve our architecture and design review process across the engineering organization
  • Guide our microservices architecture, including the thoughtful decomposition of remaining larger components
  • Set technical direction for CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and developer tooling so that engineers across Credible can ship quickly and safely
  • Stay close to the code: contribute hands-on where it adds value (coding is welcome, though not required)
  • Collaborate with Product, Security, Operations, and engineering leaders to align platform priorities with business goals

Education and Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure, or platform engineering
  • 7+ years of experience managing engineering teams, with strong people management skills
  • Strong software architecture and design skills, with experience leading architecture and design reviews
  • Deep experience with AWS and Kubernetes, and with infrastructure as code and deployment tooling such as Terraform, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, and Helm
  • Experience building and operating microservices-based systems, including decomposing larger components
  • Experience with event-driven systems (Kafka) and API design (REST and/or GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and SOX compliance requirements
  • A strong security mindset, with experience working closely alongside a security organization
  • Experience running on-call rotations and driving reliability improvements
  • Experience with Go and/or Ruby is preferred; experience with similar languages is welcome
  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, but not required

Technical Taste

We are looking for someone who does more than “get something working.” You have strong aesthetic leanings about how systems should be built, and you can explain why. For us, that means:

  • Results-oriented simplicity: you don’t overcomplicate things and keep solutions simple wherever possible
  • Intelligent abstractions: you know when an abstraction earns its keep, and when it doesn’t
  • Systems thinking: you build once and create leverage far into the future
  • Strong API design: you care deeply about the interfaces that teams and services build on

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we’ll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Le/la Spécialiste de la paie travaillera principalement avec les Ressources humaines pour examiner et résoudre les problèmes liés à la paie, en veillant à ce que les préoccupations des employés soient traitées de façon précise, cohérente et conforme aux politiques de l'entreprise et à la législation applicable. Une expérience à l'appui de la mise en œuvre ou de la transition d'un système de paie ou de SIRH constituerait un atout important.

  • Gérer et traiter les cycles de paie réguliers pour les employés au Canada et aux États-Unis, en veillant à l'exactitude et à l'exécution dans les délais.

jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

About the Revenue Operations Team

The Revenue Operations team is the operational backbone and growth catalyst of OpenSesame. While others may see sales mechanics, we focus on something more fundamental: creating the clarity, discipline, and systems that allow revenue to scale responsibly and predictably.

We design, operate and automate the processes, systems, and insights that connect strategy to execution — from first customer conversation through renewal. Our work ensures revenue flows efficiently, governance is strong, and customer experience remains consistent as the business grows.

We partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partner, Finance, Legal, Enablement, and Business Systems to remove friction, enforce smart standards, and help teams move faster without cutting corners.

About the Deal Desk Analyst

The Deal Desk Analyst is a critical partner to Sales and Go-To-Market teams, responsible for accelerating deal velocity while protecting margin, ensuring policy compliance, and improving forecast accuracy.

This role exists to remove friction from selling. You’ll support deals across the quote-to-cash lifecycle, helping sellers close complex opportunities faster while maintaining pricing discipline and clean execution. Success in this role is defined by faster approvals, cleaner deals, fewer escalations, and higher seller confidence — not volume of activity.

Performance Objectives

Establish Strong Deal Execution (First 30 Days)

  • Become fully operational and independently support standard new business, expansion, and renewal deals.
  • Validate pricing, discounts, approvals, and required documentation within defined SLAs.
  • Route and track approvals accurately, maintaining complete and audit-ready CRM and CPQ records.
  • Build strong working relationships with Sales, Partners, Finance, and Customer Success.

Sustain Speed and Discipline (60 Days)

  • Handle increased deal volume independently without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Enforce pricing and approval guardrails consistently across deal types.
  • Identify deal risks earlier to reduce last-minute escalations.
  • Track deal cycle times, exceptions, and execution bottlenecks.
  • Partner cross-functionally to structure deals that protect margin and accelerate close.
  • Proactively identify top issues causing friction in the sales process and present proposed solutions that will drive efficiency and speed to close.

Scale Predictability and Efficiency (90+ Days)

  • Maintain consistent deal turnaround times with minimal oversight.
  • Reduce manual effort through standardization, automation, and AI-assisted validation.
  • Provide clean exception and bottleneck data to inform process and system improvements.
  • Support adoption of new workflows, tools, and AI automation enhancements.
  • Maintain high data accuracy to support billing, forecasting, and audits.
  • Build process documentation to outline existing process and train Sellers on best practices; includes continued enablement regarding policy changes and new tools or automation enhancements

What Success Looks Like

  • Deals move through approval quickly and predictably, even during peak periods.
  • Sellers trust Deal Desk as a partner that helps them win — not a blocker.
  • Pricing, discounting, and approvals are consistently enforced with minimal escalation.
  • Deal data is clean, complete, and audit-ready, reducing post-booking corrections.
  • Manual effort decreases over time as automation and standard workflows are adopted.
  • Leadership has clear visibility into deal health, approval friction, and margin risk.

You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.

We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job — that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.

Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

Location: This position can be located anywhere in the U.S. All positions will require up to 15 days of travel per year for company-wide events (typically January, May, September).

Performance Driven: We’re looking for self-starters with a track record of follow-through, curiosity, and results. We don’t hire based on a checklist — we hire for potential, drive, and evidence of performance. If you’re motivated to learn, comfortable with experimentation, and excited about how technology can make sales more human, you’ll fit right in.

Compensation: On-target earnings for this role range between $80,000 and $90,000 per year, depending on experience, which includes base salary and variable incentive compensation based on performance. At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, relying on market data to determine compensation and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

Pay Transparency: At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.

CPRA (California Candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

Position Summary
Random Bit is seeking an Business and Technology Analyst to support enterprise architecture, technology modernization, and architecture governance initiatives. This is not a traditional business process or requirements-only analyst role. The position works at the intersection of business and technology, with an emphasis on capability modeling, architecture analysis, requirements traceability, solution planning, and architecture decision support.
The successful candidate will be able to structure complex or ambiguous problems, collaborate across business and technical teams, and translate analysis into clear, decision-ready recommendations and work products.
Key Responsibilities
  • Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, technical, non-functional, and architecturally significant requirements.
  • Analyze current-state processes, capabilities, systems, applications, technologies, and integrations to identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain business and technical capability models and map capabilities to business outcomes, requirements, enterprise standards, systems, and modernization initiatives.
  • Establish and maintain traceability among business needs, capabilities, requirements, architecture standards, decisions, and solution components.
  • Support the development of current-state and future-state architecture views, solution plans, assessments, process flows, system diagrams, and related architecture artifacts.
  • Contribute to enterprise architecture standards, principles, procedures, and governance processes, including materials for architecture reviews and decisions.
  • Conduct research, gap analysis, impact analysis, and alternatives analysis and develop evidence-based recommendations.
  • Facilitate stakeholder discussions and collaborate with architects, technical specialists, business stakeholders, project leaders, and vendors to resolve questions and advance work toward decisions.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in business analysis, systems analysis, enterprise analysis, technology consulting, solution planning, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and managing complex business and technical requirements.
  • Experience performing current-state, future-state, gap, impact, or alternatives analysis.
  • Experience establishing traceability among business needs, requirements, processes, systems, capabilities, or solution components.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop clear, evidence-based conclusions and recommendations.
  • Excellent analytical, critical-thinking, facilitation, and written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with both business and technical audiences.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in Agile or iterative delivery environments and using tools such as Jira and Microsoft 365.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting enterprise, business, solution, application, data, or technology architecture initiatives.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

Job Summary:

Seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer with 5-10 years of experience designing and leading mission critical electrical infrastructure projects. Serves as the technical authority for power distribution, utility integration, standby generation, UPS systems, grounding, and overall electrical system resiliency. Responsible for developing reliable, maintainable, and scalable electrical solutions while supporting project delivery, mentoring engineering staff, and serving as a trusted advisor to clients and project teams.

  • Lead electrical design through planning, concept development, schematic design, design development, construction documents, commissioning, and construction administration phases.
  • Perform and oversee electrical load analysis, equipment sizing, fault current calculations, arc flash assessments, and protective device coordination studies.
  • Lead utility coordination efforts including service applications, capacity assessments, and interconnection requirements.
  • Provide technical oversight for medium-voltage and low-voltage distribution systems.
  • Develop power system concepts including utility substations, generators, UPS systems, switchgear, transformers, automatic transfer switches, and power monitoring systems.
  • Coordinate with mechanical, controls, telecommunications, structural, architectural, and civil disciplines.
  • Support commissioning planning, integrated systems testing (IST), and operational readiness activities.
  • Lead technical design reviews and quality assurance/quality control processes.

REMOTO

Sistema.bio, creando valor del desecho

En Sistema.bio, creemos firmemente que la transición a la energía renovable, la reducción de las emisiones globales de gases de efecto invernadero y la adopción de la agricultura regenerativa son cruciales para garantizar un mundo próspero para las generaciones actuales y futuras.

Fabricamos y distribuimos biodigestores rentables y de alta calidad en América Latina , Asia y África. Nuestros biodigestores permiten a los agricultores convertir residuos en energía renovable y fertilizantes orgánicos, lo que les permite reducir su huella de carbono, aumentar la productividad y operar de manera más eficiente.

Al brindar acceso a tecnología innovadora de biodigestores, Sistema.bio se dedica a abordar los desafíos interconectados de la pobreza, la seguridad alimentaria y el cambio climático.

Tenemos la misión de reducir el 1% de las emisiones globa

les de gases de efecto invernadero 🌱 🌏. ¡Sé parte de esta historia de impacto!

¿Cuál será tu misión en Sistema.bio?

Como Practicante de Operaciones técnicas, darás particular soporte al equipo de la región en la generación de propuestas técnicas y sistemas productivos. Tendrás la oportunidad de conocer la relación entre el diseño técnico de sistemas de biogás, el análisis de información de campo y la implementación de soluciones para productores agrícolas.

A través de proyectos reales y en colaboración con los equipos Comercial y TechOps de LATAM y Global, podrá desarrollar habilidades técnicas, analíticas y de coordinación, al mismo tiempo que contribuye a mejorar nuestros procesos y soluciones.

¿Qué harás como practicante?:

Como parte del equipo de Operaciones Técnicas ubicado en México, estas serán algunas de las áreas en las que estarás colaborando, así como tus principales actividades a desarrollar

Como parte del equipo de Operaciones Técnicas, colaborarás de manera remota con los equipos de México y Global en las siguientes actividades:

  • Elaboración de propuestas técnicas: apoyar en la preparación de diseños y propuestas de sistemas productivos de biogás, utilizando la información del proyecto para identificar soluciones adecuadas a las necesidades de cada productor.
  • Coordinación y seguimiento de proyectos: colaborar con los equipos Comercial y TechOps para recopilar información técnica, dar seguimiento a las solicitudes de propuestas y facilitar la comunicación entre las áreas involucradas.

  • Pruebas y desarrollo de nuevos productos: colaborar en actividades de prueba y validación de nuevas soluciones, apoyando en el seguimiento de su desempeño y en la documentación de los comentarios y aprendizajes obtenidos durante las pruebas de campo.

No implica una relación laboral ni responsabilidades propias de un puesto formal. jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Product Designer (Identity UX).

About the job

At Twilio, we’re building the identity layer for both people and the AI agents acting on their behalf. We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer (L4) to define the user experience for Twilio Identity: customer identity (authentication, Hosted Login, and user management) and Agent Identity, which lets developers open their apps and APIs, including remote MCP servers, to AI agents with user consent, scoped access, and human approval for sensitive actions over Twilio channels like SMS and RCS.

You’ll be the lead designer on a small, senior team, working with product and engineering from the first sketch. You’ll own the developer setup experience in One Console, the login and consent flows our customers put in front of their users, and the patterns that make security decisions easy to understand without slowing anyone down. Agent Identity is in private beta and heads to general availability at SIGNAL 2027, so this is a chance to define the core UX of a new product category.

Responsibilities

  • Own Identity UX End to End: Lead the experience for developer onboarding and configuration in One Console, Hosted Login, and end-user authentication flows.
  • Design for Agents and the People Behind Them: Define how AI agents are registered, how users grant and revoke consent, how permissions are scoped, and how users approve sensitive agent actions in real time.
  • Make Self-Serve Fast: Shorten the path from sign-up to a working integration, so developers can evaluate and adopt Twilio Identity without talking to sales.
  • Translate Protocol Complexity: Turn OAuth, tokens, scopes, and approval flows into clear mental models for developers and plain-language choices for end users.
  • Partner Before the PRD: Work with PM and engineering from problem framing through launch, co-owning scope and tradeoffs while holding a high bar for craft.
  • Talk to Customers Directly: Run research and usability testing with design partners and developers, and ground decisions in what you learn.
  • Raise the Bar: Contribute to Twilio’s design system and UX design feedback process, and mentor other designers.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Work schedule: Full-time, US-based, remote.
  • 8+ years of professional product design experience specifically focused on highly technical software products, developer tools, infrastructure, or complex B2B/SaaS platforms.
  • Expert-Level Systems Thinking: Track record designing complex, configuration-heavy products (developer consoles, admin tools, or multi-step setup flows) and unifying them into coherent experiences.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a full-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates based in the US and Canada only, within the Eastern or Central time zones.

The Opportunity:

We are building Mobile Session Replay: a way for teams to see what users actually experienced in their iOS, Android, Flutter and React Native apps, inside Grafana Cloud.

Session Replay connects frontend signals to session-level evidence, so engineers can investigate production issues faster and with more confidence. Web replay is already available publicly. Mobile replay extends the same story to native apps as part of our Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM) strategy.

We are starting with Android. A working prototype already exists, and you will help turn it into a product customers can trust. The plan is to push ahead from there: iOS next, then our Flutter, React Native and OpenTelemetry mobile SDKs, so customers get a consistent replay experience across platforms.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Staff Mobile Engineers who are passionate about working with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team!

What you'll be doing

As a Staff Mobile Engineer you will be the technical lead for mobile capture and replay, working across the device, the ingest path and the player. Specifically, you will:

  • Own the on-device replay library end to end, starting with Android and extending to iOS.
  • Make privacy a default, designing masking and consent controls so sensitive data never leaves the device.
  • Keep the overhead low and measure it on real devices, protecting startup time, UI responsiveness, battery, memory, network use and disk, and profiling the impact of capture and masking while the app is actively being used. Give customers controls to trade fidelity against cost.
  • Build the integration layer so customers do not copy demo glue code: adapters that tie replay to the active RUM session, sampling decisions and screen or navigation changes.
  • Work across the stack with Frontend and Mobile Observability teams on the capture, upload and storage pipeline, session inactivity handling, the timeline player and the mobile sessions and replay experience in Frontend Observability. Evaluate the format and API tradeoffs rather than assuming the current prototype approach is final.
  • Define quality and compatibility: automated tests, CI, device and OS coverage, and backwards-compatible upgrade paths for an SDK that customers cannot easily update.
  • Engage directly with customers: join calls, gather structured feedback, and help teams instrument and adopt Mobile Session Replay
  • Mentor engineers and help grow technical leadership in the team

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Technologies you'll work with

  • Kotlin (primary, Android-first) and Swift (iOS)
  • Android media and graphics APIs (MediaCodec / H.264 encoding, view and window capture, Jetpack Compose and View-based UIs)
  • Faro (Flutter and React Native SDKs) and OpenTelemetry Android and iOS SDKs
  • Go (collector and ingest services) and TypeScript / React (player and Frontend Observability UI), as you partner across the stack
  • OLAP Database / Object storage (S3)
  • Kafka/Warpstream
  • Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Tempo, etc.)

What makes you a great fit

  • You are comfortable working in a remote-first, globally distributed company. Communication is key, and you write and speak clearly in English
  • You are collaborative, friendly, kind and respectful. We operate by consensus: you can contribute, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision
  • You have deep native mobile engineering experience on Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift/Obj-C). We are building Android first, so Android depth is a priority for the first hire. We are hiring across both platforms, and we do not expect you to be an expert in both, but you are willing to learn and contribute across platforms over time.
  • You have built or maintained mobile SDKs or platform libraries used by external developers, and you care about developer experience, API design and safe upgrade paths
  • You have worked on performance-sensitive code (startup time, memory, battery, network efficiency, background execution limits) and make pragmatic tradeoffs
  • You are comfortable with media and rendering pipelines on mobile: capturing screen content, working with frames or bitmaps, and encoding or handling video
  • You are comfortable owning a product from 0 to 1 in ambiguous problem spaces. You can break large problems into increments and work autonomously
  • You take a user-centered approach, and you build understanding of customers' context and goals so you build the right thing
  • You are thoughtful about privacy and security on user devices, including handling of sensitive data
  • You use AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow, for exploration, code review or reasoning through design tradeoffs, and you are thoughtful about where they help and where they don't

Bonus points for

  • Prior work on mobile session replay, screen recording, or sampling for mobile telemetry
  • Experience with video encoding (H.264, MediaCodec, AVFoundation) or on-device masking and redaction
  • Familiarity with rrweb or web session replay concepts
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, crash reporting libraries or other observability open source
  • Experience with cross-platform frameworks (React Native, Flutter) or building native bindings and bridges
  • Experience with observability or debugging tools (Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Sentry, etc.)
  • Familiarity with mobile privacy, consent and platform policy requirements
  • Experience with Go or TypeScript, since the work crosses into our ingest and player

In Canada, the OTE (On-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is $192,891 - $231,469 CAD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

Position Overview

True Zero Technologies is seeking an experienced Cyber Hunt Team Lead to oversee proactive threat hunting operations, advanced threat detection, and adversary analysis within complex federal environments. This leadership position is responsible for directing threat hunting missions, developing sophisticated detection methodologies, and coordinating with Security Operations Center (SOC), Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), and government teams to identify, investigate, and mitigate advanced cyber threats.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on cybersecurity experience, strong technical leadership capabilities, and deep expertise in threat hunting, endpoint and network security monitoring, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and advanced threat detection engineering.

Job Responsibilities

    Job Responsibilities

  • Proactive Threat Hunting & Team Leadership: Lead and coordinate enterprise threat hunting missions, directing proactive investigations, advanced security analytics, and hypothesis-driven hunting activities to identify sophisticated cyber threats and previously undetected malicious activity across federal systems.
  • Advanced Threat Detection & Adversary Analysis: Analyze adversary behaviors, attack patterns, and emerging threats, including advanced persistent threats (APTs), to identify potential compromises, uncover security weaknesses, and develop actionable recommendations to strengthen enterprise defenses.
  • Cross-Functional Security Collaboration: Coordinate with SOC analysts, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) teams, cybersecurity business partners, and government stakeholders to investigate threats, share intelligence, validate findings, and support coordinated detection and mitigation efforts.
  • Threat Hypothesis Development & Detection Engineering: Develop and refine threat hunting hypotheses, behavioral analytics, detection logic, and security monitoring use cases to improve the identification of malicious activity across endpoint, network, and enterprise security environments.
  • Threat Intelligence & Indicator Management: Establish and maintain a centralized knowledge base of indicators of compromise (IOCs), adversary TTPs, threat hunting findings, and detection methodologies to support repeatable investigations, intelligence sharing, and continuous improvement of security operations.
  • Purple Team Exercises & Threat Emulation: Support and lead collaborative Purple Team exercises and adversary emulation activities to assess security detection capabilities, simulate realistic attack techniques, identify monitoring gaps, and recommend enhancements to defensive controls.
  • Security Framework Alignment & Continuous Improvement: Leverage MITRE ATT&CK and recognized threat hunting methodologies to map adversary techniques, evaluate detection coverage, improve hunting procedures, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to threat hunting and security operations personnel.

Job Requirements

    Job Requirements

  • Cybersecurity & Threat Hunting Experience: Minimum of 10 years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including hands-on threat hunting, security monitoring, incident investigation, threat detection, or related defensive security disciplines within complex enterprise environments.
  • Professional Certifications: Must possess at least one of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
  • Threat Detection Technologies & Security Frameworks: Demonstrated hands-on experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Network Detection and Response (NDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, MITRE ATT&CK, and adversary emulation techniques, including developing and executing advanced threat hunting methodologies.
  • Operating Systems, Networking & Adversary Techniques: Strong technical understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems, enterprise networking, network protocols, endpoint security, and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with the ability to analyze sophisticated attack activity across enterprise infrastructure.
  • Technical Leadership & Threat Intelligence Collaboration: Proven ability to lead threat hunting initiatives, develop threat hypotheses and detection logic, coordinate complex security investigations, and collaborate with SOC, CTI, engineering, and government stakeholders to identify, assess, and mitigate advanced cybersecurity threats.

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:


CAREER OPPORTUNITY OFFERING:


  • Bonus Incentives
  • Paid Certifications
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Comprehensive Benefits
  • Career Advancement
  • This position pays between $101,600 - $152,400 based on experience


The Office of the CFO at Ensemble Health Partners is a strategic advisory function. It helps hospital and health system clients make better financial decisions through analytics, insight, and executive-level support. The Senior Financial Analyst combines healthcare finance knowledge with strong data analytics skills. They build the models, dashboards, and executive-ready analyses that help client finance leaders understand performance, spot risks early, and act with confidence. Working closely with the Director, this person turns complex financial and operational data into clear, decision-useful insights.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Financial Performance


  • Analyze client financial performance, including net revenue, cash-to-net variances, AR trends, payer mix, and other revenue cycle drivers.
  • Find root causes of performance gaps and put together clear findings to support client discussions.

Dashboards and Early-Warning Indicators


  • Design, build, and maintain automated Power BI dashboards and recurring KPI reporting.
  • Develop early-warning indicators that flag emerging financial or operational risks before they affect results.
  • Improve data pipelines and automate reporting to cut manual effort and raise accuracy.

Executive Deliverables


  • Produce polished, CFO-ready analyses, presentation materials, and summaries for the Director to use with client and internal leaders.
  • Turn technical findings into concise business messages that state the "so what."
  • Join client discussions occasionally as needed.

Benchmarking


  • Compare client performance with peer groups, national data, and internal benchmarks.
  • Maintain benchmarking frameworks and methods so comparisons stay consistent from client to client.

Ad Hoc Decision Support


  • Provide fast, accurate analysis for escalations, leadership requests, and business development.
  • Work across Finance, Operations, and Data teams to gather data and validate results.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent).
  • 5–7 years of progressive financial analysis experience.
  • Required healthcare finance experience in a hospital, acute care health system, or healthcare revenue cycle setting.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex modeling, lookups, pivots, and Power Query.
  • Hands-on Power BI experience building dashboards and data models.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying and working with large datasets.
  • Healthcare data analytics experience, such as claims, remittance, patient accounting, or financial reporting data.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly in writing and visuals.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • MBA, MS in Analytics, CPA, or CFA.
  • Databricks experience.
  • Familiarity with hospital revenue cycle KPIs and net revenue methodology.
  • Experience supporting senior finance leaders or working in a consulting or advisory setting.
  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

Core Competencies:


  • Analytical rigor and attention to detail
  • Executive-level communication and storytelling with data
  • Curiosity and a problem-solving mindset
  • Ability to manage several priorities in a fast-paced, remote setting
  • Collaboration and a service-oriented approach



Join an award-winning company


Five-time winner of “Best in KLAS” 2020-2022, 2024-2025

Black Book Research's Top Revenue Cycle Management Outsourcing Solution 2021-2024

22 Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) MAP Awards for High Performance in Revenue Cycle 2019-2024

  • Associate Benefits – We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial health of you and your family, including healthcare, time off, retirement, and well-being programs.
  • Our Culture – Ensemble is a place where associates can do their best work and be their best selves. We put people first, last and always. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth, and innovation.

jobs.title: Field Access Manager - Diabetes - Nashville/Kentucky/West Virginia
jobs.excerpt: The Field Access Manager (FAM) will act as the main point of contact at designated accounts providing account management support to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and their staff on behalf of patients who are prescribed a product for approved indications.
jobs.description:
The Field Access Manager (FAM) will act as the main point of contact at designated accounts providing account management support to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and their staff on behalf of patients who are prescribed a product for approved indications. As a part of this strategy, the FAM will provide on-going education to accounts regarding the Patient Services program, the regional payer landscape, and pharmacy channel access. The FAM will help coordinate pull-through efforts for patients who have been prescribed the product, irrespective of channel (HUB, specialty pharmacy, etc.), provided proper HIPAA consent has been secured from the patient. The FAM will be expected to be the primary face of the Patient Services platforms within designated HCP offices. The FAM is also responsible for partnering with internal and external stakeholders to optimize access to the product for patients.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Expand advocacy within HCP offices and equip the staff, through education, to navigate the access and payer approval process, identify access barriers that the HCP must act on to overcome, and highlight HCP actions that support patient access to therapy.
  • Offer educational resources to support the entire patient’s journey by optimizing processes for prior authorizations/appeals/specialty pharmacy and addressing access issues.
  • Coordinate utilization of the patient service platform to seamlessly support the customer and patient when office chooses the HUB or SP as their ideal path to approved therapy.
  • Coordinate annual pharmacy reauthorizations at designated accounts to ensure timely reauthorization and continuation of therapy is maintained.
  • Work cross functionally and collaboratively with partners in Sales, Market Access, Patient Services, Strategic Accounts and more to act as a process and payer expert. The FAM will help identify and address time sensitive market development and implementation efforts to remove access barriers to the product for appropriate patients, while optimizing adherence.
  • Build and execute a strategic business plan to meet the needs of top accounts and ensure successful implementation of market access initiatives.
  • Obtain and maintain knowledge and understanding of payer landscape, including specialty pharmacy and utilization management criteria, on a national, regional and local level so that you can act as a process and payer expert.
  • Continuously strive to understand the alignment of Payer/PBM/SP and how national/regional pharmacy drug formularies impact market access in their designated geography.
  • Assist in providing appropriate field insights to ensure support of all access and patient/payer support programs and resources offered by the company’s Patient Support Programs.
  • Anticipate, navigate and address individual account and patient access issues that arise by partnering with all appropriate stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
  • All other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements below represent the experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for this role.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Healthcare degree advantageous, including MS, RN, PA, PharmD, or similar advanced healthcare/scientific degree.
  • 10+ years in pharmaceutical industry with experience in payer policy and patient access.
  • 5+ years of experience in benefit verifications and/or prior-authorization requirements or equivalent experience in patient access.
  • Knowledge of Centers of Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) policies and processes with experience in Medicare Parts B & D.
  • Knowledge and understanding of specialty markets, HUB/reimbursement services and patient access programs.
  • Strong understanding of specialty product access/reimbursement processes including Patient Support Services programs.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess market dynamics, competitor activity, and continuous diabetes monitoring trends. Ability to gather and interpret data to guide regional strategy, including understanding the role of HUB and patient claims data.
  • Knowledge of Integrated Delivery Network/Integrated Health Systems.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft applications and the ability to conduct virtual engagements via Microsoft Teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills with a high level of initiative and independence.
  • Proven success in working in a cross functional environment.
  • Ability to conduct impactful educational presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of Veeva systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Advanced Degree preferred.
  • Pediatric Endocrinology and/or Endocrinology experience preferred.
  • Previous launch experience in Access/Reimbursement role
  • Previous experience in other functions within the biopharmaceutical industry a plus (e.g. product marketing, managed care, field sales, case management or large healthcare practice experience).

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS

Patient Minded - I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight - I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action - I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

Grow Talent - I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together - I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters - I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity - I create an environment of awareness and respect.

jobs.excerpt: At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

Your Mission: Join our team in a pivotal role that combines solid technical quality assurance skills with strong business acumen. As a QA Analyst, you will work directly with the client's teams and alongside our QA Lead, helping to safeguard product quality at every stage of the software lifecycle. Your mission is to design and execute thorough test coverage, truly understand the business rules and overall functioning of the project, and bring AI-augmented practices into your day-to-day testing work.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, produce, and execute test cases (manual and automated) across functional, regression, integration, and non-functional testing.
    - Work directly with the client's teams to learn the business rules, user flows, and overall functioning of the project, translating that understanding into effective test coverage.
    - Analyze requirements and user stories to identify test scenarios, edge cases, and potential risks early in the development cycle.
    - Execute test cycles, log and track defects, and work closely with developers to validate fixes.
    - Contribute to the QA strategy defined by the QA Lead, suggesting improvements to test coverage, processes, and tooling.
    - Communicate test results, risks, and quality status clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
    - Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners to clarify requirements and ensure testability of new features.
    - Organize and prioritize your own testing activities independently, managing competing deadlines with minimal supervision.
    - Apply AI tools to improve test design, test data generation, defect analysis, and overall testing efficiency.
    - Document test cases, test plans, and quality reports to ensure standardization and alignment with the client's compliance and performance standards.

Requirements for this Position:

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the confidence and clarity to engage directly with the client's teams.
    - Strong self-organization and autonomy, with a proven ability to manage priorities and deliver without close supervision.
    - Solid technical background in QA, including test case design, execution, defect tracking, and test automation concepts.
    - Hands-on experience in software testing, with a track record of owning test coverage for non-trivial features or modules.
    - Business-oriented mindset, genuinely interested in learning the project's business rules and overall functioning, not just its technical layer.
    - Current, practical experience using AI tools applied to QA (e.g., AI-assisted test case generation, AI-powered test automation, or AI-driven defect analysis).
    - Experience with Agile methodologies and QA processes within Agile delivery.
    - Strong communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
    - A proactive mindset, comfortable raising risks and proposing improvements rather than just executing scripts.

Stand-out Requirements: You will be one step ahead if you have:

  • Hands-on experience working in an agentic AI setting applied to QA, leveraging autonomous or semi-autonomous AI agents to support test generation, execution, or analysis.
    - Experience working directly with a client's teams, without an intermediary layer of stakeholders.
    - Familiarity with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
    - Experience working in digital consulting environments.

  • Meal and food allowance

  • Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;

jobs.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Threat Research Engineer, you’ll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. You’ll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster.

What you’ll do

  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
  • Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
  • Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
  • Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs.
  • Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code.
  • Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
  • Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen.
  • Ability to map possible attack vectors, name trade-offs, and make data-driven decisions, balancing quality and speed with customer outcomes in mind while keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
  • Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
  • Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.

You don’t need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

About the team

The Threat Research group researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab’s dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. You can read more on the Security Labs blog.

jobs.excerpt: Shape the Future with Dun & BradstreetAt Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow.
jobs.description:
Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet

At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at .
The Client Success Director is the primary point of responsibility and accountability for the overall service relationship and long-term success of D&B’s most strategic and complex Global and Enterprise Clients. The role acts as a trusted advisor within the Sales Channel, bringing D&B’s best ideas, innovations and service capabilities to these Clients to ensure Driving Adoption and Value Realisation, Client Satisfaction, renewal readiness and measurable value from D&B solutions.

As the senior-most strategic individual contributor within the Client Success career path, the Client Success Director leads senior customer success ownership through executive customer relationships, customer maturity discussions, value plans, external service reviews, customer health insight, risk mitigation/get well plans and strategic T-Minus Retention Planning. The role works closely with Sales and relevant internal stakeholders to align D&B capabilities to customer outcomes, ROI, adoption, retention readiness and long-term success.

Commercial ownership remains with Sales. Technical implementation, integrations, workflow configuration, solution architecture, technical assessments, AI architecture and AI readiness assessments remain with Technical Client Success Managers, Technical Advisory resources or other specialist functions.

Essential Key Responsibilities

  • Be accountable for the assigned full lifecycle of the Client’s overall success with D&B for the most strategic and complex Global and Enterprise Clients, including Driving Adoption and Value Realisation, Client Satisfaction, supporting renewals and long-term customer value.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior and executive customer stakeholders, bringing D&B’s best ideas, innovations, service capabilities and peer best practices to help Clients achieve measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead senior customer maturity and transformation discussions for the most strategic and complex Global and Enterprise Clients, helping customers progress toward more advanced, scalable and integrated use of D&B solutions where relevant to customer outcomes.
  • Guide strategic T-Minus Retention Planning in partnership with Sales for the most complex customer environments, using customer value, health, maturity, risk, stakeholder and renewal-readiness insight to support on-time renewal success.
  • Translate customer health, maturity, risk and growth insight into senior-level actions that support value realisation, retention readiness, risk mitigation, Voice of the Client input and appropriate commercial follow-up by Sales.
  • Guide strategic Client Success playbook execution for the most complex Global and Enterprise customer engagements, ensuring consistent focus on customer maturity, value realisation, customer health, strategic T-Minus planning, risk mitigation and retention readiness.
  • Create and maintain strategic value plans that link D&B solutions to customer business goals, measurable outcomes, ROI, adoption priorities, maturity development and long-term success.
  • Lead external service reviews with senior customer stakeholders to review solution adoption, progress key initiatives, assess Client sentiment, confirm value realisation and agree next actions.
  • Identify risks to Clients achieving their stated business goals and work with the account team and relevant specialists to build a risk mitigation plan/get well plan.
  • Develop specialist industry knowledge relevant to the Client base and advise on industry dynamics, peer best practices, customer maturity, automation opportunities and how best to utilize D&B solutions.
  • Help Clients understand practical AI-enabled business value, adoption opportunities, automation use cases and maturity considerations where these support customer outcomes and value realisation.
  • Share senior Voice of the Client insights, customer maturity signals, risks, product feedback, service improvement opportunities and strategic customer themes with internal leadership and relevant functional teams.
  • Work within an account team matrix and coordinate Sales, Product, Data, Technology, Delivery, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, Legal and Customer Success stakeholders around strategic customer priorities and outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Technical Client Success Managers, Technical Advisory resources or other specialist functions where customers require technical implementation, integrations, workflow configuration, solution architecture, technical assessments, AI architecture or AI readiness assessments. These activities remain outside the Client Success Director role.
  • Partner with Sales on renewal readiness, customer intelligence and account planning while maintaining clear boundaries. Commercial ownership, pricing, negotiations, revenue responsibility, sales quotas, new business and expansion contracting remain with Sales.
  • Maintain accurate and timely information in relevant CRM systems and internal tools to support Strategic Account Planning, customer health visibility, value plans, T-Minus Retention Planning, risk mitigation and internal reporting.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned, provided they are within the overall scope, qualification level and purpose of the role and in line with applicable local legal and company requirements.

Education/Experience and Competencies

  • Minimum of ten years of experience working with large global enterprise clients in customer success, enterprise client success, strategic account management, value realisation, retention strategy or comparable senior post-sales customer-facing roles.
  • Solid customer success or account servicing experience with complex enterprise solutions, preferably involving data, analytics, technology or highly integrated business solutions.
  • Proven track record in delivering retention results through successful Client Success engagements, renewal readiness, value planning and risk mitigation.
  • Strong ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with Global and Enterprise Clients, including CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CFOs and other senior customer stakeholders.
  • Excellent listening, communication, presentation, stakeholder influence and interpersonal skills at all business levels.
  • Client-centric approach with good commercial instincts, while maintaining clear ownership boundaries with Sales for pricing, negotiations, revenue responsibility, sales quotas, new business and expansion contracting.
  • Strong service management, Strategic Account Planning, value planning, ROI, external service review, customer maturity and T-Minus Retention Planning capability.
  • Ability to identify risks to customer outcomes and work with the account team and specialists to create clear risk mitigation plans/get well plans.
  • Specialist industry knowledge relevant to the assigned Client base, with the ability to advise on industry dynamics, peer best practices and effective use of D&B solutions.
  • Understanding of AI-enabled business solutions, adoption, automation opportunities and customer maturity discussions from a business-value perspective, without owning technical AI architecture or implementation.
