The Risk Manager (Clinical Research) plays a pivotal role in developing and executing risk-based monitoring strategies, ensuring data quality and integrity in clinical research projects. This position involves cross-functional collaboration to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the clinical trial lifecycle, supporting the seamless implementation of Risk-Based Study Management (RBSM) principles in a CRO or pharma industry.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Risk Manager must:

  • Provide subject matter expertise for developing and updating the risk-based monitoring strategy tailored to project needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate risks associated with complex indications.
  • May have to coordinate with central monitor team and verify work.
  • Point sur provide budget recommendations, change orders.
  • Draft initial risk assessments and support the finalization of Risk Assessment and Categorization Tools (RACT).
  • Guide Project Managers (PMs) in transferring identified risks to the appropriate tracking systems and ensure ongoing reviews.
  • Advise on developing functional plans to mitigate risks effectively.
  • Utilize available tools to conduct remote data reviews and centralized statistical monitoring, identifying risks to data quality and integrity.
  • Facilitate internal and sponsor reviews of findings, seeking cross-functional support for complex risks and mitigations.
  • Deliver initial and ongoing training for study teams on risk assessment, centralized monitoring, and risk-based monitoring strategies.
  • Escalate risks or deliverables at risk to the PM, including scope changes.
  • Provide strategic input on risk characterization and reporting to leadership.
  • Take on additional responsibilities as required, ensuring qualifications and training align with assigned tasks.

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research;

Experience

  • Must have experience in a CRO or pharma industry
  • Minimum of 3 years in risk management within a clinical research setting.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience across clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety.

Requirements:

  • Expertise in Good Clinical Practice/ICH E6 (R3) Guidelines and other regulatory requirements.
  • Proficiency in Risk-Based Monitoring strategies, processes, and tools.
  • Mastery of MS Excel (sorting, filtering, pivot tables).
  • Advanced skills in analytical data visualization tools.
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and web based RACT tools.
  • Strong analytical and statistical understanding.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to anticipate critical issues and develop proactive contingency plans.
  • Skilled in project workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Training, mentoring, and organizational capabilities.
  • High level of autonomy.

  • Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
  • Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.

Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

OUR COMPANY

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position

About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Travefy is the connected system powering the travel industry.

More than 50,000 travel agencies and advisors trust Travefy to help them prove their value, simplify their work, and grow their businesses. Our platform is where they go to manage clients, design and sell stunning trips, market their brands, and run the back office.

Travel is booming, a new generation of advisors is reshaping the industry, and Travefy builds the tools they run on. Come help shape how an entire industry works.

About the Role

Training is how advisors and agencies get to value fast. When someone learns Travefy from one of our trainers, they build better trips sooner, use more of the platform, and stay with us longer.

This is our most senior training seat. Almost all of your day is live 1:1 and group trainings over Zoom, for advisors and agencies of every size. In person is rarer, but it matters: when we need it, you're the trainer we send, solo to a top partner's headquarters to train a room of 50 to 100 advisors, to select conferences, or into a working session with a partner's leadership team. You'll also set the quality bar for the rest of the training team and help them reach it.

You'll report to our Director of Client Experience and work closely with our CX, Strategic Accounts, sales and product teams. This is not an on-the-road job, but expect occasional travel to partner headquarters and select industry events.

What You'll Own

Daily training that sticks. Live 1:1 sessions over Zoom that solve a specific problem, especially in a customer's first 90 days, taught once so the customer moves on. Every session is prepped, delivered and followed up.

Group sessions at scale. Recurring group trainings over Zoom and office hours, host agency and consortia sessions, and onboarding cohorts for large rollouts reaching thousands of advisors.

Our most important partners, in person when it counts. Solo onsite trainings at partner headquarters, and being the polished face of Travefy with their leadership.

Select conferences and partner events. Booth, breakout sessions, and the dinner afterward. You know the product cold and represent us well.

The quality bar. The session standard, the QA rubric, onboarding for new trainers, and coaching the trainers around you so every session gets better.

The curriculum. Build and refresh training content, recordings and certifications as the product ships new features.

Your Day to Day

  • Run live 1:1 and group trainings over Zoom every day
  • Follow up on every session through our systems, every time
  • Prep for the occasional onsite or event
  • Sit in on teammates' sessions and give feedback
  • Update curriculum and recorded content as features ship
  • Bring what you're hearing back to Product, CX and our account teams

What We're Looking For

You've trained software users for a living. Three or more years delivering customer training, ideally in SaaS, with real time in front of a room, not just on Zoom.

You're polished with senior people. If a partner's CEO pulls you into their office, you're ready.

You can run a room. Groups of 10 to 100, live questions, competing perspectives. A 1:1 that turns into a team of ten doesn't rattle you.

You learn a product cold. And you can explain it simply to anyone.

You raise the bar for others. You hold yourself to a high standard and help teammates get there too.

You can represent us solo. When an onsite or event comes up, you're comfortable traveling and being the face of Travefy on your own.

You are authorized to work in the United States.

Bonuses

  • You've used Travefy yourself
  • Experience in the travel industry, especially with host agencies, consortia or advisor networks
  • Experience with Intercom, HubSpot, Zoom webinars or a learning platform
  • Experience building curriculum or certifications

  • Unlimited Vacation + Annual Travel Stipend.
  • Annual all team retreat to connect the whole company in person.
  • Technology, learning budgets, and more.

This position is available as a remote opportunity within our distributed team, or as a hybrid role based in our Pennington, NJ, Lincoln, NE, or Omaha, NE offices. Candidates based in Florida are a strong plus, given where several of our largest partners are located, but not required.

jobs.title: Director, National Partnerships
jobs.excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

You will oversee a team of relationship managers and lead our engagement strategy across a portfolio of top-tier financial advisory firms. In this high-impact role, you will leverage your expertise in institutional relationship management to deepen partnerships, ensure strategic alignment, and drive new sales growth. Acting as a trusted executive partner to our corporate clients, you will guide a team dedicated to maximizing partnership value and elevating financial advisor engagement.

The ideal candidate is a driven strategic operator and relationship-builder who thrives in a matrixed organization, works seamlessly across functions, and is confident in navigating both internal leadership and senior external stakeholders. You will build relationships that translate into pipeline, revenue, and long-term market advantage.

This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in how Human Interest partners at scale, particularly in the Financial Advisory channel, while shaping new ways to drive long-term value for our customers and our partners.

About the team

You will be responsible for working cross-functionally with leadership across Sales, Solutions, Marketing, Customer Success, and the Partnerships team to build the infrastructure that drives outcomes at scale. Your direct team will be focused on supporting sales, external partners relationships and net new partnerships.

What you get to do every day

  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead and mentor a high-performing team of Relationship Managers and Due Diligence process. Manage the cultivation, execution, and delivery of partner training and development for sales teams and stakeholders. Foster a culture of accountability, excellence, and partner-centricity.
  • Build the infrastructure: Effectively enable advisor sales processes to work efficiently, create repeatable go-to-market motions, and build and manage an engaging events calendar.
  • Identify & execute on strategic initiatives: Work with partners on current initiatives and growth goals while driving near-term sales revenue.
  • PartnerRelationship Strategy: Own the strategic vision and relationship development for a portfolio of high-value Partnerships. Serve as the executive sponsor for key accounts, cultivating long-term, trusted relationships with senior leadership across RIAs, aggregators, asset managers, banks, and wealth managers.
  • Turn relationships into outcomes: Create repeatable programs that generate pipeline, customers, and strategic value, not just logos or introductions.
  • Raise the communication bar: Build exceptional presentations, pitches, and partner materials, and coach the team to do the same.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Product and Engineering leaders to define priorities, manage roadmaps, and execute the strategy for initiatives with new partner organizations. Collaborate with Sales, Finance, and Operations leadership to develop specific account management plans and partner support.
  • Partner Enablement: Provide ongoing training, support, and resources to ensure partners are up-to-date with the latest product features, tools, and best practices.
  • Conflict Resolution: Proactively identify and address any issues or challenges within partner relationships, and provide solutions that align with business objectives.
  • Decision Making: Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance

What you bring to the role

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field. MBA is a plus.
  • Experience: 6+ years of experience in growing and leading partner management, strategic alliances, preferably in the Financial Services/FinTech Industry. Direct experience in leadership, including hiring, coaching, developing, and managing professionals against measurable revenue goals. Successful history of working with or managing relationships in the financial advisory/institutional space.
  • Leadership: You have led and scaled a strategic partnerships or channel function with clear accountability for revenue. You have managed and developed strong teams, and people want to work for you, learn from you, and follow your leadership.
  • Relationship Management: Proven ability to manage and grow strategic partner relationships, with experience in negotiating contracts, setting expectations, and resolving conflicts.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence, present, and articulate complex concepts to diverse audiences including internal senior leadership.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess partnership performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Project Management: Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Sales/Marketing Experience: Knowledge of sales strategies, marketing programs, and business development techniques. Use data to improve pipeline quality, conversion, forecast accuracy, partner coverage, and seller performance.
  • Technical Acumen: Familiarity with Financial Advisory partners, SaaS, FinTech, Banking, or related solutions.

Nice to have

  • Results-Driven: A proactive, goal-oriented leader with a focus on driving measurable outcomes.
  • Strategic Visionary: Ability to see the big picture and formulate long-term strategies for growth. Proven Organizational Leadership, Strong Business Acumen, Strategic Insights.
  • Collaborative: Strong team player who thrives in cross-functional environments and can work effectively across departments.
  • Customer-Focused: Deep commitment to understanding the industry and meeting the needs of the corporate partner, financial advisors and internal stakeholders.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in a fast paced environment.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.

  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance

Job Title: Area Business Manager - Allergy San Antonio, TX

Location: Remote, US


Sanofi focuses on developing specialty treatments for debilitating diseases that are often difficult to diagnose and treat, providing hope to patients and their families.

Sanofi has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for patients affected by rare and debilitating diseases for over 30 years. We accomplish our goals through world-class research, collaboration with the global patient community, and with the compassion and commitment of our employees. With a focus on rare diseases, oncology, immunology and multiple sclerosis, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve. Sanofi Genzyme's portfolio of transformative therapies, which are marketed in countries around the world, represent groundbreaking and life-saving advances in medicine.

At Sanofi, we are committed to the growth of our people, connected in purpose by career, life and health.

About the job:

The Area Business Manager (ABM) is responsible for engaging Allergists, and other key customers within an assigned geography and presenting clinically focused selling messages to create and grow revenue and to consistently deliver product goals related to atopic dermatitis and asthma indications. The ABM will demonstrate initiative, drive, independence, and take ownership for meeting and exceeding individual business goals. This will be accomplished by driving performance and delivering results in a compliant manner with a high degree of integrity strictly following all Sanofi Genzyme US policies and in compliance with all policies and procedures governing the promotion of pharmaceutical/biological products in the US.


Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:


· Engage Allergy/Immunology customers within assigned geographical territory and deliver clinically focused message to introduce, launch, grow brand-share and revenue and to consistently deliver on product goals for atopic dermatitis and asthma indications.

· Collaborate and coordinate with other key field-based stakeholders such as Regeneron Sales Professional counterparts, Medical Science Liaisons, Field Reimbursement and Market Access teammates, Thought Leader Liaisons, and others in their territory to proactively address customer needs, identify market dynamics and trends, develop strategies which support brand and corporate objectives, and ensure optimal account success within their assigned geography.

· Develop strong working relationships with Allergy experts in assigned geography as well as biologic coordinators, office staff and other important health care personnel and key patient advocacy support groups as directed.

· Drive results by identifying key opportunities and developing strategic business plans to generate product utilization and grow territory business.

· Plan, organize, and execute local promotional speaker programs and activities.

jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote (Global)
Job Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor
Department: Wholesale

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced, systems-driven Wholesale Operations Manager to take full leadership of our Wholesale and Order Capturing operations. In this role, you will directly manage, mentor, and govern distributed teams while owning the end-to-end operational pipeline for all wholesale and retail partner orders—from initial inquiry and order capture to invoice generation, payment tracking, and global warehouse dispatch.
You will serve as the operational bridge connecting internal teams, international retail buyers, global 3PL/warehouse hubs, and finance stakeholders. If you excel at managing remote personnel, driving daily accountability, building rock-solid Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), eliminating fulfillment bottlenecks, and steering teams toward zero-error order accuracy, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
1. End-to-End People & Team Management
  • Directly manage, develop, and supervise the Wholesale and Capturing Team across multiple shifts and international time zones.
  • Establish clear daily operational expectations, individual task allocations, and attendance/output benchmarks across all team members.
  • Lead structured weekly 1-on-1s, pod standups, performance calibrations, and hands-on coaching sessions to ensure high accountability and engagement.
  • Monitor pod capacity, balance workloads during peak retail cycles, and oversee onboarding, training, and continuous skills development for new and existing team hires.
  • Track individual and pod-level KPIs, holding team members accountable for order accuracy rate (>99%), first-response turnaround time (TAT), and SLA adherence.
2. Buyer Communication & Warehouse Alignment
  • Supervise team interactions with all B2B retail buyers, guaranteeing timely, professional, and accurate responses regarding order statuses, inventory availability, shipping updates, and custom account requirements.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for buyer inquiries, resolving complex logistics issues and maintaining high buyer satisfaction.
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison with global warehouse and 3PL teams to coordinate stock allocations, pack-and-ship timelines, and custom dispatch schedules.
  • Rapidly troubleshoot and direct team resolution on shipment discrepancies, backorders, damages, or transit delays with logistics partners.
3. SOP Architecture & Process Optimization
  • Author, maintain, and continuously refine detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) spanning order capture, verification, buyer communication, warehouse dispatch, and returns/claims.
  • Enforce strict team compliance with documented SOPs, ensuring workflow standardization across all account coordinators.
  • Continuously audit workflows to identify manual bottlenecks, streamline communication loops, and implement process improvements that shorten order fulfillment cycles as volume scales.
4. Invoicing, Payment Tracking & Reconciliation
  • Ensure all wholesale and retail commercial invoices, credit memos, and packing lists are accurately generated, logged, and organized by the capturing team.
  • Supervise the recording and tracking of incoming buyer payments, matching settlements against open purchase orders to prevent documentation gaps.
  • Partner directly with internal Bookkeeping and Accounting teams to facilitate timely payment reconciliations and resolve billing disputes promptly.
  • Identify, audit, and escalate payment or credit anomalies directly to executive leadership.
Qualifications & Requirements
  • 5+ Years of Operations Experience: Proven background in B2B wholesale operations, retail order management, or e-commerce supply chain operations.
  • Direct People Management Track Record: Minimum 2–3 years of proven experience directly managing, supervising, and coaching distributed remote teams (customer support, order capturing, or operations coordinators).
  • Performance & Accountability Driven: Demonstrated experience running performance evaluations, conducting 1-on-1s, managing team SLAs, and handling corrective action or workload reallocations.
  • Logistics & 3PL Literacy: Direct experience liaising with third-party logistics (3PL) providers, freight forwarders, and warehouse teams across multiple geographic hubs.
  • Financial & Billing Acumen: Solid experience with B2B commercial invoicing, payment term tracking (Net terms, wire transfers, deposits), and working alongside bookkeeping teams on reconciliations.
  • SOP & Systems Mastery: Proven ability to build clear, scalable SOPs, process maps, and workflow automations using modern tools (Lark/Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, ERP/WMS platforms).
  • Communication & Fluency: Exceptional written and verbal business English communication skills, with experience managing professional relationships with international retail accounts and leading internal team alignments.
  • Autonomous & Detail-Oriented: Highly structured mindset with an uncompromising standard for documentation, protocol-driven execution, and zero-error order entry.
What We Offer
  • 100% Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with a structured, asynchronous operational rhythm.
  • High-Impact Leadership: Direct autonomy to lead teams and shape operational infrastructure for high-growth global consumer brands.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside dedicated executive leadership, creative minds, and operational specialists.
How to Apply
Please submit your resume along with a brief cover note detailing:
  1. Your experience managing remote teams (team size, structure, and how you manage day-to-day accountability and SLAs).
  2. Your background managing B2B wholesale order lifecycles and coordinating with 3PL warehouses.
  3. The operational tools/ERPs you have used to manage inventory, invoicing, and order capture.
  4. An example of an SOP or process workflow you built that measurably improved accuracy or turnaround time.

jobs.description:
Organizational Unit:Communications

Reports To:Associate Director, Media

Supervises: This position does not supervise staff.

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in the UK.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

Working across Equality Now’s international Communications Team, the Associate Manager, Media will play a central role in advancing the organisation’s mission to promote and protect the rights of women and girls through strategic media advocacy. Combining proactive and reactive media management, high-quality content production and media impact analysis, the role will help bring greater public attention to priority women’s rights issues across regions. Responsibilities include securing positive national, regional and international media coverage that raises the profile of Equality Now, its experts, coalition partners and advocacy priorities; builds public and political support for progressive legal reform and the effective implementation of legal protections; and promotes Equality Now’s reputation as a trusted, authoritative and influential leader on gender equality and women’s rights. The role will also provide dedicated communications support to Equality Now’s Eurasia programme.

PORTFOLIO OVERVIEW:

The Associate Manager, Media will play a strategic role in driving global media visibility for Equality Now, the issues we work on, the knowledge products we produce, and the coalitions we are members of. Working remotely with Communications and Programmes colleagues across regions, the role combines media strategy planning and execution, editorial excellence, and journalist/ editor relationship management to capitalise on timely media opportunities tied to campaigns, strategic litigation, research launches, and news moments. The role will also lead on media monitoring, tracking and recording media KPIs, and media impact reporting.
Additional responsibilities include horizon scanning, narrative mapping and media risk analysis to identify emerging narratives, anti-rights activities, gendered disinformation, misinformation and malinformation, and potential communications risks. The role will use AI and digital analysis tools responsibly, with appropriate verification and human editorial oversight, to provide insights that anticipate and mitigate backlash and harmful narratives, inform narrative briefings, evidence-based communications strategies, messaging, crisis communications and proactive approaches. Risk-sensitive media engagement will advance Equality Now’s programme and advocacy objectives while safeguarding colleagues, partners and those whose stories and expert insights are featured in communications content, including in vulnerable contexts where security risks and restrictions on civic and media freedoms are heightened.
The Associate Manager, Media will provide dedicated, comprehensive communications support to Equality Now’s Eurasia programme, and fluency in written and spoken English and Russian is essential. The Eurasia portfolio advances the rights of women and girls through legal and policy advocacy, partnerships, and public engagement across the region. Media work helps bring attention to the issues and perspectives emerging from that work and build understanding of the changes advocates are seeking.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following is a general outline of duties and responsibilities for this role. It is not an exhaustive list, and additional duties may be assigned or removed at the discretion of the Associate Director, Media is to meet organisational needs and priorities.

Purpose: Apply Foundational Knowledge

  • Produce high-quality media content for a range of audiences, outlets and platforms.
  • Generate impactful national, regional and international media coverage of Equality Now’s experts, partners and priority work. Pitch and place media coverage and support and oversee media placement by communications team colleagues.
  • Support the development and implementation of media strategies across regions and thematic areas to advance advocacy and campaign objectives, raise awareness of priority issues, engage target audiences, and position Equality Now and its experts as trusted sources and thought leaders.
  • Collaborate with communications colleagues to identify and capitalise on media opportunities, and plan and deliver outreach campaigns. This includes developing news angles and pitches, identifying priority outlets, coordinating content production and journalist engagement, managing timelines and approvals, and adapting approaches to maximise media coverage, reach and impact.
  • Support communications colleagues in planning and adhering to media production timelines, establishing realistic and comprehensive schedules, managing sign-off processes, and ensuring timely delivery of media content and plans.

Engagement: Knowledge Building & Collaboration

  • Support media training for Equality Now staff and external partners; develop and update high-quality training materials and toolkits that reflect best practice and gender sensitivity.
  • Maintain and update Equality Now’s global media contact database and media outreach logs.
  • Lead the management of Equality Now’s media monitoring, evaluation and impact reporting, working closely with the Officer, Media to ensure coverage is systematically tracked, analysed and reported internally.
  • Use analytics tools, including Meltwater and Muck Rack, to generate performance reports and actionable insights that demonstrate impact and inform future media and advocacy strategies. Support communications colleagues with using these tools.

Delivery: Operational Awareness & Action

Media content production

  • Write, edit, and sub-edit media content, including press releases, op-eds, media briefings, case studies, Q&As, and blog posts.
  • Translate complex research, policy, and legal material into accurate, accessible, and persuasive content suited to advocacy and media audiences.
  • Adapt stories, tone, and format for different outlets, audiences, cultures, and media markets, taking care that content does not reinforce stereotypes or cause harm.
  • Ensure media content meets Equality Now’s editorial, brand, style, and messaging standards and is appropriate for the intended audience and channel.
  • Apply relevant search and geographic targeting practices to improve the visibility of digital media content without compromising accuracy or editorial integrity.
  • Ensure all media content is factually accurate, compelling, well-structured and consistent with Equality Now’s brand, tone of voice, house style, messaging and values. Apply SEO, GEO, AEO and geographic targeting best practices, including relevant keywords, metadata and search-friendly language, to maximise visibility, reach and engagement without compromising editorial quality or integrity.

Media engagement and relationship management

  • Build and maintain relationships with journalists, editors, and producers across national, regional, and international media.
  • Identify and maintain media contacts by issue, geography, and outlet type, and seek opportunities across traditional and emerging media.
  • Develop tailored pitches and proactively place stories, interviews, and op-eds in outlets that reach priority audiences.
  • Respond promptly to media requests, coordinating with subject matter experts and regional teams. Arrange interviews, prepare briefings and spokespeople, draft or edit quotes, and manage follow-up.
  • Identify notable media coverage and work with communications and digital colleagues to amplify it through appropriate channels.

Communications support for the Eurasia programme team:

  • Work closely with Equality Now’s Eurasia programme team to develop and implement regional communications strategies, workplans and editorial calendars. Plan and coordinate communications for regional campaign launches, research publications, advocacy events, webinars and other external engagement opportunities, including developing promotional materials, coordinating media outreach and managing production timelines and approvals.
  • Integrate regional priorities into global communications planning, coordinate messaging and content production. Help build an understanding among program colleagues and coalition partners of communications procedures and workflows.
  • Produce, edit and coordinate high-quality communications content for regional and international audiences, including website copy, blogs, press releases, op-eds, media pitches, social media content, case studies, key messages and other advocacy and campaign materials.
  • Support development and delivery of Eurasia-focused digital communications, including producing and managing content for regional social media channels and collaborating with the Digital Team on website content, digital campaigns and audience engagement.
  • Produce, edit and coordinate Russian-language communications content, including adapting materials for regional audiences and overseeing translations to ensure accuracy, cultural sensitivity and consistency with Equality Now’s editorial standards.
  • Identify and capitalise on media opportunities across Eurasia, developing news angles and tailored pitches, securing media coverage, and building relationships with journalists, editors and producers. Develop and maintain regional media contact lists.
  • Collaborate with Equality Now’s network of civil society partners and coalitions across Eurasia to develop and amplify communications relating to joint advocacy, campaigns, research, legal and policy developments, and other priority activities. Provide guidance and training to strengthen regional and partner communications capacity.
  • Monitor regional media coverage, public discourse, anti-rights activities and emerging narratives to identify communications opportunities and risks. Apply risk-sensitive approaches to messaging, media outreach and public engagement, anticipating potential backlash and safeguarding requirements.
  • Track Eurasia communications activities, media coverage and performance against agreed objectives and KPIs. Contribute communications results and impact analysis to internal and donor reporting, using insights to inform future planning and strengthen communications effectiveness.

Narrative intelligence, information integrity, and communications risk

  • Monitor and analyse how gender equality and women’s rights issues are framed across media and digital platforms, including emerging anti-rights narratives and gendered disinformation.
  • Identify communications risks and opportunities that may affect Equality Now, its partners, spokespeople, or advocacy objectives, and share findings to inform media planning and messaging.
  • Produce or contribute to narrative intelligence reports and briefings, translating findings into practical recommendations for campaigns, media outreach, and timely responses.
  • Help colleagues develop accurate, evidence-based responses to harmful or misleading narratives, working with relevant teams and external partners where appropriate.
  • Use AI and other digital tools responsibly in media monitoring and narrative analysis, verifying findings and applying human editorial judgment before using them in communications decisions.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Understanding of international media landscapes, news cycles, and regional sensitivities.
  • Strong news judgement and ability to identify what makes a story relevant, timely, and newsworthy across global markets.
  • Adept at extracting key messages from reports, strategic litigation, legal decisions, and other complex materials.
  • Understanding of reputational and safeguarding risks involved in rights-based advocacy across countries and regions.
  • Knowledge of social media for amplifying news and content.

Communication Skills

  • Fluent written and spoken English and Russian required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop, refine, and distil complex concepts into clear messaging, speaker briefings, and program or event-related content.
  • Strong interpersonal and cross-cultural communication skills, with a proven ability to foster collaboration and cultivate trust-based relationships aligned with Equality Now’s mission and values.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage organisational leadership, high-profile individuals, speakers, supporters, donors, and local partners with poise, professionalism, and diplomacy.

Execution Skills

  • Exceptional copywriting, sub-editing, and storytelling skills, with a demonstrable record of producing high-quality press and editorial content.
  • Comfortable working independently as a proactive self-starter within a remote, global team environment.
  • Strong workload, workflow, and time-management skills, with the ability to perform under pressure, meet tight deadlines, balance competing priorities, and respond flexibly to breaking developments.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder approval processes in large or matrixed organisations.
  • Demonstrated ability to pitch and place stories persuasively in national and international media; strategic, persistent, and proactive in media outreach and content placement.
  • Excellent interpersonal, diplomatic, and relationship-management skills, with a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively across time zones with global staff, partners, and vendors.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally on occasion, and to work evenings and weekends as required by events and media moments.

Targeted Specialised Knowledge

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in media and communications.
  • Knowledge of and interest in international human rights issues; familiarity with human rights frameworks and global policy processes is desirable.
  • Experience in advocacy-driven communications or NGO campaigns.
  • Experience with media monitoring, evaluation, and reporting is desirable.
  • Experience managing databases and familiarity with analytics and database tools such as Meltwater and Muck Rack are desirable.

COMPENSATION:

At Equality Now, our compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to advancing the human rights of women and girls through lasting legal and systemic change. We approach pay holistically, recognizing base salary as one part of a broader total rewards package designed to support employee wellbeing, growth, and long-term engagement.

Base Salary Range: USD $40,342 to $47,416 (£31,063.34 - £36,510.32 GBP)

The final offer will be determined based on several factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and internal equity. Equality Now also provides a comprehensive total rewards package, including retirement benefits, generous leave, and professional development opportunities.

Vice President, Digital

Global Specialty Business Unit Leader • Virtual position in US • 30–40% travel

The Vice President, Digital leads Diversified’s Digital Business Unit — one of the company’s global specialty business units — with responsibility for growing the digital business worldwide. The role owns Diversified’s digital portfolio — digital signage rollouts, IPTV, and media content management — and leads Digital Experience as a horizontal growth engine that helps every region and every specialty bring immersive, content-led experiences to clients. This is a build-and-scale leadership role, not an individual-contributor sales role. The Vice President carries a global quota and full business accountability against aggressive growth targets, and succeeds by making Digital something every region can sell, win, and deliver. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, the Vice President, Digital is a peer to the leaders of Diversified’s other global specialty business units and works closely with regional sales leadership, Engineering, Delivery, Marketing, Commercial Operations, and the Partnership and Alliance organization. Key Accountabilities Business Ownership & Growth

Own global results for the Digital business, measured as one worldwide number across every region and channel, with accountability for both revenue and margin quality. Build and execute the multi-year growth plan for digital signage rollouts, IPTV, and media content management across priority markets including retail, quick-service restaurants, convenience, hospitality, healthcare, and venues. Grow recurring revenue through subscription and managed offerings, including Digital Signage as a Service, remote monitoring, content operations, and retail media enablement for clients. Govern pricing and deal strategy through the deal lifecycle — disciplined entry pricing to win marquee clients, followed by expansion through services and recurring offerings.

Integrated Solutions Across Business Units

Align and work with the Live Venue and Media & Broadcast business units to create holistic solutions that combine Diversified’s specialty capabilities into unique value and client-specific outcomes. Cross-unit collaboration is both a significant growth opportunity and an expectation of the role. Partner with the Live Venue Business Unit on in-venue displays, IPTV, and fan-engagement content, and with the Media & Broadcast Business Unit on content workflows and media operations, so clients receive one integrated solution.

Digital Experience — Enterprise Growth Engine

Lead Digital Experience as a horizontal business-development motion across Diversified, helping regional teams and the other specialty units bring experiential, content-led solutions into their own client work. Build and lead the Digital Experience business development function, including creative-agency partnerships, thought leadership, and proposal and pursuit excellence. Establish how Digital Experience contribution is identified and measured so its impact across the business is visible and properly recognized.

Regional Enablement & Go-to-Market

Make Digital sellable in every region: equip regional sellers with playbooks, discovery guides, reference stories, pricing tools (in alignment with the Commercial Operations organization), and marketing, presentation, and proposal content developed with the Proposal Management team. Lead a direct hunting motion for new enterprise clients while co-selling through regional teams under a published, consistent credit model that recognizes regional sellers for the business they bring in. Align engagement with Diversified’s Global Accounts Program so the company’s largest clients experience one coordinated motion. Partner with Marketing on target-market and account-based programs that build qualified pipeline for the business.

Solutions, Delivery & Partners

Define the Digital offer set, solution standards, and delivery model so multi-site programs are repeatable, scalable, and delivered consistently worldwide, including through third-party installation partners. Direct the Digital-focused sales engineers, who report through Engineering on a dotted line, setting technical priorities, deal coverage, and solution standards. Partner with the Partnership and Alliance organization, which owns vendor and OEM relationships, to bring Digital’s volume and roadmap requirements to display, software, content, and ad-tech partners. Along with the Global Managed Services Practice, shape product and platform direction for monitoring, content management, and client-financing models that unlock larger programs.

Team Leadership

Build, develop, and lead a high-performing team of 6–10 direct reports, including enterprise sellers and the Digital Experience business development lead. Add capacity with discipline as the business earns it, drawing first on proven talent inside Diversified, and develop a bench the regions actively want to work with. Represent the business with clients, partners, and industry bodies, and to the executive team and the board.

Qualifications Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree welcomed. 12+ years in enterprise technology sales, business development, or business leadership, including 5+ years leading teams and owning a revenue book, practice, or business line. Deep specialty expertise in digital signage, IPTV, content management, digital experience, or adjacent display and experiential technologies — with real command of the technology, the delivery model, and the buyer. Proven track record selling and delivering large multi-site rollout programs to enterprise clients in retail, quick-service, hospitality, healthcare, or similar markets, including long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Experience building recurring revenue through as-a-service, managed services, or subscription models. Experience leading through a matrix — delivering results through regional sellers, engineering, delivery, marketing, and partners who do not report directly. Experience standing up a new team, motion, or business line, including operating cadence, governance, and sales enablement. Comfort presenting to client executives, senior leadership, and a board, and defending the business under scrutiny. International experience strongly preferred — selling or operating across multiple regions, leading distributed teams, and adapting a commercial model to local markets.

Skills & Attributes

Leader first. Deliberately trades personal production for team and regional success; measures success by how many regions can win without them in the room. Commercial discipline. Holds pricing standards and deal quality under pressure and walks away from deals that do not fit. Influence without authority. Earns pull from regional teams by being genuinely useful, never by claiming credit. Intellectual honesty with numbers. Builds the measurement before asking to be measured on it. Strategic communicator. Can explain the Digital opportunity to a client executive, a seller, and a board member in each of their terms. High integrity and sound judgment in complex, multi-stakeholder situations.

Position Details

Location: Remote / virtual, leading a globally distributed team Travel: Approximately 30–40% — client sites, regional offices, industry events, and project locations Direct reports: 6–10 Education: Bachelor’s degree required Compensation: Competitive base salary plus variable incentive tied to global business performance.

The Leidos Chief Data & Analytics Office (CDAO) is seeking a Network Observability Engineer; this position will allow for full time telework from any U.S. based location.


POSITION SUMMARY:

Leidos CIO Services is seeking a talented and innovative Network Observability Engineer to join our growing team within the CDAO division, which is responsible for enterprise observability and for enabling the enterprise with AI solutions. The successful candidate will engineer, operate, and continuously improve the systems that monitor the health, performance, and availability of the Leidos enterprise network, leveraging technologies such as Splunk, OpenSearch, OpenConfig, OpenTelemetry, and Machine Learning, as well as SNMP-based monitoring and NetFlow analysis. In this role, you will turn network telemetry into actionable operational intelligence, building the data pipelines, dashboards, alerts, and automation, using modern AI-assisted development tools, that help operations teams detect, troubleshoot, and resolve issues faster. You will actively participate in all phases of the systems engineering lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, integration, testing, documentation, and implementation. Your work will align with best practices, operational excellence, and forward-thinking approaches to network observability.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate with network operations, engineering teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver effective network observability solutions.
  • Onboard, normalize, and analyze network telemetry (syslog, SNMP, NetFlow, and streaming telemetry) in Splunk and OpenSearch, building searches, dashboards, alerts, and reports that provide situational awareness of network health and performance.
  • Deploy and maintain modern network telemetry solutions leveraging OpenConfig and OpenTelemetry standards.
  • Design and develop software, scripts, and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) and integrate with REST APIs to collect data, enrich events, and connect monitoring platforms with other enterprise tools.
  • Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or OpenAI Codex to accelerate development of integrations, automation, and monitoring content, applying sound code review, testing, and version control practices to AI-generated code.
  • Integrate monitoring alerts and events with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms to support automated incident creation, routing, and closed-loop resolution.
  • Apply Machine Learning and AI techniques for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and event correlation to enhance network performance and reliability.
  • Utilize SNMP, NetFlow, and other monitoring techniques to maintain and optimize network performance.
  • Document procedures and maintain detailed audit-level records of systems and processes.
  • Provide tiered troubleshooting, resolution, and root-cause analysis for complex network monitoring and performance issues.
  • Engage with senior management and stakeholders as necessary to communicate technical insights and strategic recommendations.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or related field with 4+ years of relevant industry experience; additional years of experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree.
  • Strong understanding of network design, protocols, and performance management, with the ability to interpret device and traffic telemetry.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk and/or OpenSearch, including data onboarding, search languages (SPL, KQL/Lucene), dashboards, and alerting.
  • Hands-on experience with SNMP, NetFlow, OpenConfig, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Proficiency in programming and scripting (Python preferred), with a track record of building automation and developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar to write, test, and maintain code.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Machine Learning techniques within network monitoring and analysis frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of Aruba/Silver Peak SD-WAN and related networking technologies.
  • Proficiency in SQL and database interfaces, including ODBC.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM platform, and with ITIL Incident, Change, and Configuration Management practices.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with modern network monitoring platforms such as SolarWinds NPM.
  • Experience with Splunk ITSI, OpenSearch Observability, or similar AIOps and service monitoring tools.
  • Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD practices for automation and monitoring code.
  • Experience with telemetry pipeline tools such as Cribl Stream or the OpenTelemetry Collector.
  • Experience building ServiceNow integrations (e.g., Event Management, IntegrationHub, REST APIs, or MID Server).
  • Exposure to SD-WAN management technologies and protocols.
  • Familiarity with IP SLA or similar synthetic monitoring tools.
  • Tessaral mesh routing.
  • Current or past certifications such as Splunk Core Certified Power User or Admin, Aruba Certified SD-WAN Professional (ACSP), Aruba Certified SD-WAN Expert (ACSE), SolarWinds Certified Professional (SCP), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), or equivalent.

*** Candidates selected for an interview should note that it will be conducted live via video, with cameras on at all times. As part of our identity verification process, a photo will be taken during the interview to confirm your identity and help protect against fraud. At hire, candidates complete formal identity verification. ***

jobs.excerpt: Senior Product Marketing ManagerAbout NiobiumNiobium builds infrastructure and software for computing on encrypted data.
jobs.description:
Senior Product Marketing Manager

About Niobium

Niobium builds infrastructure and software for computing on encrypted data. Every current approach to data security depends on decrypting data at the moment it is used, which is precisely when attackers and AI agents can reach it. Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) closes that gap: computation runs directly on ciphertext, and the customer never shares the decryption key. There is nothing for an attacker to breach or a court to compel.

Our cloud platform, The Fog™, is live today running production FHE workloads such as encrypted semantic search on FPGAs that mirror our accelerator design. Applications built on The Fog today will move to our custom ASIC in 2027 without reengineering.

The company grew out of a DARPA program and is funded by $24M in non-dilutive US government awards and by venture investors including Mighty Capital, Analog Devices, and Fusion Fund. The team pairs the FHE architects from the DARPA program with operators from Broadcom, Groq, Intel, Google Cloud TPU, and AWS who have shipped 30 production ASICs. Our customers are enterprises and government organizations in finance, healthcare, defense, and sovereign cloud whose most sensitive data cannot be exposed, even in use.

Niobium is headquartered in Dayton, Ohio with a remote team across the US and around the world. We are not limited by geography for the right candidate.

About This Role

Niobium is hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own how we describe, position, and sell two product lines: The Fog™, our FHE cloud service, and our hardware line of accelerator chips, boards, servers, and sovereign Fog deployments for customers who run on their own premises.

You will lead Niobium's marketing function through 2027, including the website, public relations, analyst relations, content, conferences, social media, and sales enablement. When we add a head of marketing, you will hand off the corporate marketing programs and concentrate on product marketing: positioning, competitive analysis, launches, and the material our sales team uses every day.

You will report to the CPO and work alongside the product, sales, and engineering teams. You will spend real time with our cryptographers and hardware and software engineers. You will be responsible for turning engineering results into performance and privacy claims we can publish and defend.

Responsibilities

Messaging and positioning

  • Own the positioning and messaging for The Fog and for Niobium's chip, board, server, and sovereign deployment products: who each product is for, what it replaces, and why it wins. Keep those answers consistent across the website, sales material, press, and conference content.
  • Work directly with our cryptographers and hardware and software engineers to understand benchmark results and turn them into performance claims, with the emphasis on system-level performance per watt and per dollar against GPU systems.
  • Own the competitive framing: how FHE hardware compares with GPU, CPU, and other accelerator approaches, and how Niobium compares with other FHE vendors. The product team and the CTO support you with data and review, and you are responsible for the framing.
  • Propose pricing for the hardware products and for The Fog, based on a business case and market analysis.
  • Spend time with customers and prospects, most of them evaluating the chip, board, or rack-level products, so the messaging is tested against real buyers. Support the Fog sales effort with the same positioning and collateral work.
  • Run win/loss and voice-of-customer reviews with sales, and feed what you learn back into messaging and the product roadmap.
  • Define buyer personas and the message for each segment we sell to, including financial services, healthcare, defense and government, and sovereign cloud operators.
  • Own market sizing and segment analysis for the board and for fundraising material.

Content

  • Write and manage blog posts, press releases, white papers, product briefs, solution briefs, and case studies, including getting approval from customers and partners to name them.
  • Produce reference architectures and sizing guides with engineering: how many boards or servers a given workload needs, and the Fog equivalent.
  • Plan and run product launches, including announcements for new chips, boards, and systems, and support launches of new Fog capabilities.
  • Contribute to Fog developer documentation and give user-experience feedback on the Fog console and onboarding.

Sales Enablement

  • Create sales presentations, pitch decks, one-pagers, demo scripts, battlecards, proof points, and objection-handling material. Our sales team sells a technology most buyers have never bought before, so this material has to hold up in front of a skeptical security architect.
  • Train sales on new messaging and products as they ship.
  • Maintain a single source of truth for product claims and specifications that sales, business development, engineering, and executives use.

Public Relations and Analyst Relations

  • Manage our PR firm, including the editorial calendar, press releases, and press and analyst interviews for the CEO, CTO, and CPO.
  • Own the relationship with industry analysts: briefings, inquiry, and placement in relevant research.
  • Pitch and support speaking submissions and awards.

Website and Agency Management

  • Own niobium.co, including the product demos on the site, and work with our agency and internal web dev team on site improvements, outbound marketing material, and sales collateral.
  • Keep the site current with each launch, release, and announcement.
  • Own product naming and brand guidelines, and keep them consistent across everything we publish.

Events, Partners, and Community

  • Plan and run Niobium's conference presence, including RSAC, ISC High Performance, and SC, from target lists and meeting scheduling through follow-up.
  • Run partner and ecosystem marketing: joint content and announcements with ISVs, cloud providers, consortia, and resellers.
  • Support hackathons and developer events that put The Fog in front of customers.

Social Media

  • Run Niobium's social media program.

How we will Measure Success

Marketing at Niobium is measured on what it puts in front of buyers and what comes back. In your first year you will be measured on:

  • Inbound: qualified inbound contacts from the website, content, and events, tracked quarter over quarter.
  • Pipeline influence: the share of open and closed opportunities that touched marketing material, a briefing, or an event, tracked in the CRM by tagging each opportunity with the assets and campaigns it used.
  • Outreach: meetings booked at RSAC, ISC, SC, and other events; press and analyst briefings held; coverage earned, by outlet; placement in analyst research.
  • Launches: for each launch, coverage earned, briefings completed, inbound inquiries in the following 30 days, and sales readiness on launch day. We expect two major launches in 2027.
  • Sales enablement: which assets sales actually uses in deals, checked with the sales team each quarter.

What we are looking for

  • 8 or more years in product marketing, with at least 3 of them at a semiconductor or hardware-systems company such as AMD, Intel, NVIDIA, Marvell, Qualcomm, or a comparable startup.
  • A portfolio of work you produced yourself: sales presentations, product and solution briefs, white papers, launch messaging, blog posts, and social campaigns.
  • Experience marketing a hardware product and a cloud or software service, or a clear ability to do both.
  • Comfort reading benchmark data and performance claims, asking engineers the right questions, and writing accurate, defensible comparisons against competing products.
  • Experience managing a PR agency and working with industry analysts such as Gartner.
  • Experience planning and running a presence at technical conferences.
  • Strong writing. You will write most of what we publish, and it has to be clear to a technical audience.
  • The ability to work independently in a small company.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25 percent of the time for conferences and customer events.

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing AI accelerators, data center systems, or HPC products.
  • Background in security, privacy, or cryptography products. Prior FHE experience is not required; we will teach you the technology.
  • Experience selling to regulated industries, government, or defense customers.
  • Experience with a cloud service launch, usage-based pricing, or developer onboarding.
  • Experience managing a website and working with a design agency.
  • An engineering or technical degree.

Location, travel, and compensation

This role is remote; we are headquartered in Columbus Ohio, but hire anywhere we can employ people.

Expect up to 25 percent travel for conferences, customer events, and team meetings.

Benefits

Niobium offers a highly competitive benefits program to support employees and their families, including:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Equity in the form of Incentive Stock Options (ISO)
  • Employer paid medical insurance plan
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions
  • Dental and vision reimbursement account (HRA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer match
  • Flexible work location with remote options
  • Flexible time off

How to apply

Apply through our careers page with a resume. Links to public work you produced, such as launch pages, blog posts, published briefs, or talks, are welcome but not required. We will ask shortlisted candidates for two or three samples of their work.

We’re a team of technologists, clinicians, and industry experts working together to push the limits on technology used in medicine. We’re confident enough to move fast and talented enough not to break things. Check out this short video to learn more about our mission and our culture.

About the Role:

As Enterprise Customer Success Manager, your primary role is to drive the successful implementation, deployment and adoption of Suki with our major health system clients. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with key client stakeholders, and ensuring that Suki is delivering exceptionally well on key success metrics. You will ensure strategic and tactical alignment, and manage on-time delivery across all functional areas with our clients and your Suki colleagues. You will be responsible for proactively identifying and driving the resolution of risks and issues, and developing creative solutions that will best meet the needs of our clients. Requirements:*

*Not sure if you meet all of the qualifications? We don’t expect every candidate to have done everything listed above, but you should be able to make a credible case that you meet most of the criteria and are ready for the challenge of adding new technologies to your résumé. This position can be remote and supports team members with clients across the United States. You are welcome to visit and/or work out of our office in Redwood City, California. One week a year, we gather for a company-wide retreat. Quarterly, we gather for an in-person working session at/near our office.

  • Impact: You’ll make an impact from day one. You’ll join a team working towards a shared purpose with a culture built upon deep empathy for doctors and passion for making their lives better.

Suki is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to building a company that fosters inclusion and belonging and reflects the diverse communities we serve across the country. We know we are stronger this way and we look forward to growing our team with these shared values.

jobs.title: AI Solution Development Consultant- Forward Deployed
jobs.excerpt: SummaryAs part of Workiva's Growth Solutions team, the AI Solution Development Consultant is forward-deployed with clients.
jobs.description:
Summary

As part of Workiva's Growth Solutions team, the AI Solution Development Consultant is forward-deployed with clients. You help enterprise customers solve complex reporting, regulatory, and business process challenges by designing, configuring, and delivering AI-powered solutions on the Workiva platform. This hands-on, client-facing role combines consultative problem-solving, enterprise software configuration, and applied AI. You work directly with clients to understand how their processes operate, find where they can improve, and turn those needs into working solutions using existing and emerging platform capabilities.


You are equally comfortable facilitating a client workshop, turning business requirements into a solution design, and configuring and deploying that solution yourself. You understand how AI, including agents and intelligent automation, applies to enterprise workflows, and you have practical experience turning those opportunities into solutions that real clients use. The work happens where client requirements, platform capabilities, and emerging AI meet. You decide how to deliver value today and help shape the reusable solutions of tomorrow. You do this in regulated environments, so governance, auditability, and scalability matter as much as speed.


This role is/is not


This role is

  • Client-facing and consultative, with ownership of outcomes
  • Hands-on configuration of a platform that is not turnkey
  • Practical application of AI and agents inside real client processes

This role is not

  • A pure software engineering role
  • A pre-sales or demo role
  • An advisory role that stops at the recommendation

What you'll do


Run discovery that ends in a design

  • Lead workshops and working sessions with regulatory, finance, tax, and IT stakeholders. For example, sit with a tax team to map how a country-by-country report is assembled today, then leave with a documented process and a clear view of what the platform covers and what it does not.

Configure the solution yourself

  • Design, build, and test client-specific solutions on the Workiva platform. For example, set up the forms, data structures, business rules, and workflow for a regulatory filing, and connect it to the client's ERP data.

Put AI to work inside the process

  • Identify where AI and agents improve how clients run reporting and compliance workflows, then configure and deploy them. For example, build an agent that drafts a first pass of a disclosure from source data, with a human review step, an exception queue, and an audit trail.

Take it live and make it stick

  • Own the outcome through validation, deployment, and adoption. For example, run testing with the client's preparers and reviewers, fix what breaks, and measure cycle time and error rates after go-live. Serve as the trusted advisor throughout, and be clear about trade-offs.

Turn client work into reusable patterns

  • Capture what works so the next engagement starts further ahead. For example, document a configuration pattern from one client for the team's shared knowledge base, and log a platform gap with evidence for Product and Engineering.

What you'll need


Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years in client-facing enterprise software consulting, implementation, or solution development, with hands-on involvement in delivering to clients.
  • 5+ years of experience working with enterprise software architecture, data flows, APIs, and system integrations, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with regulatory reporting processes, such as financial, sustainability, tax transparency, or statutory reporting, or related audit, risk, and compliance work.
  • Experience configuring enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, or Workiva.
  • Experience with ERP and finance systems such as SAP or Oracle, and an understanding of how upstream data quality and structure shape reporting outcomes.
  • Practical experience designing or configuring AI agents and workflows, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, output evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or JavaScript for scripting, data manipulation, or integration.
  • Experience working with Product Management and Engineering to turn client requirements into reusable capabilities.
  • Experience alongside implementation partners, systems integrators, advisory firms, or audit firms.

Travel and working conditions

  • Up to 25% travel for client engagements and internal meetings.
  • Reliable internet access when working remotely or outside a Workiva office.

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $111,000.00 - $180,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.
