jobs.title: Platform Engineer - AI
jobs.excerpt: TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India.
jobs.description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role

HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.

What you will do

• Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,
and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.
• Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering
leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is
reproducible and version controlled.
• Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature
flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us
how it behaves there.
• Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established
application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that
has to be preserved.
• Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they
live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match

the existing ones.

• Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and
much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.
• Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis
through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.

What we are looking for

You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the
tools from day one.
Where you need depth
• Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe
and defend.
• Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error
handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a
language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.
• Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub
Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers
to be shipped.
Where working knowledge is enough
• Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
• Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and
containers.
• Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production
monitoring and alerting.
Across everything
• Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
• Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,
and careful, staged rollout.
• Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is
written.
• Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work
with your counterparts rather than around them.

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,
wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the

domain to the right engineer.

• Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
• AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
• Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

Recruitment Notice

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

Protect yourself by following these steps:

  • Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.
  • Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
  • If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

jobs.description:
Hello,

Role: Senior macOS Cyber Security Engineer, Endpoint Security (C++/Swift)

Location: Remote (PST working hours)

Client: Accenture/Amazon

Work Authorization: U.S. Citizen (USC) or Green Card (GC) holders only

Requirement Type: Contractual

Experience: 6-10 years, we can evaluate more senior as well but need to build a pyramid.

W-2 Rate: $65 - $70/hr.

Job Description:

About the work

You'll work on the macOS sensor for CrowdStrike Falcon, an on-device security agent. It monitors file, process, network and identity activity, blocks malicious behavior, and streams telemetry to the cloud. The sensor runs entirely in user space as a System Extension. Much of the code is shared with Windows and Linux. The work requires high concurrency, high reliability, careful attention to memory & CPU usage and performance.

Required

  • Languages: modern C++ (C++17/20) and Swift 6 (async/await, actors, strict concurrency checking). Also Objective-C++ to bridge Swift, C++ and C APIs.
  • macOS systems programming: Foundation and CoreFoundation, GCD and pthreads, POSIX/BSD APIs, Mach IPC, launchd daemons and agents, and XPC (C API and NSXPCConnection).

· Performance, debugging and test:

o Profiling CPU and memory with Instruments and os_signpost.

o Debugging with LLDB, crash logs and os_log.

o XCTest, sanitizers, fuzzing, and xcodebuild-based CI.

o Apple Silicon and Intel.

  • Experience with codebases shared across Mac, Windows and Linux.

Core skills (one or more of the areas listed below)

  • Process model and IPC: launchd daemons and agents, and XPC (C API and NSXPCConnection).
  • Endpoint Security and System Extensions: Endpoint Security clients handling both blocking (AUTH) events and notification events, user/MDM approval, upgrades.
  • Network Extension: content filters, both flow-level (NEFilterDataProvider) and packet-level (NEFilterPacketProvider), and Network.framework.
  • Security and crypto: Verifying code signatures (SecCode / SecStaticCode) and validating certificates (SecTrust), Keychain, Entitlements, hardened runtime, and macOS privacy permissions.
  • Devices and storage: IOKit (hardware and device enumeration) and DiskArbitration (disk and volume events).
  • Packaging and deployment: installers, notarization, and MDM configuration profiles deployed through Jamf, Intune or similar tools.
  • Performance, debugging and test: Profiling CPU and memory with Instruments and os_signpost, Debugging with LLDB, crash logs and os_log, XCTest, sanitizers, fuzzing, and xcodebuild-based CI.

Nice to have

  • UI: SwiftUI and AppKit apps and app extensions.
  • Testing against macOS and Xcode betas before public release.
  • Experience shipping EDR/AV, network security or device-management products.

At Merit Medical, our mission is to create innovative medical devices that improve lives. Our goal is to hire and develop people who want to build something special through hard work, team effort, and commitment. Together, we are making a difference in the lives of patients around the world.

We are looking for a commercially driven and strategically minded leader who can leverage their business acumen, market expertise and leadership skills to drive sustainable revenue growth across Germany and Switzerland through Strategic Accounts, GPOs, procurement organisations, healthcare systems and key customer partnerships.

The role requires a strong understanding of the German and Swiss hospital, procurement and reimbursement environments, including purchasing consolidation, hospital reform, digital procurement, outpatient care and supply-chain requirements.

jobs.excerpt: Job TitleData ScientistHiring ManagerDavid CorneySalary£41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experienceLocationRemote first within the UK.
jobs.description:
Job Title

Data Scientist

Hiring Manager

David Corney

Salary

£41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experience

Location

Remote first within the UK. We work primarily from home but also have an office available in Central London for quarterly in-person meetings with the AI team and with meetings with the rest of Full Fact. You can expect to travel to the office at least 4 times per year.

Please note that we do not hold a UKVI Sponsorship Licence, so we cannot consider sponsoring a visa applicant or issuing a Certificate of Sponsorship.

Reporting to

Senior Data Scientist

Employment Type

Permanent

We are happy to talk about flexible working, including part time.

Application Closing Date

10 am on Monday 30 November 2026.

Introduction to the role

At a moment when our information environment is under significant strain, this is an exciting opportunity: a role with real autonomy, meaningful mission, and genuine influence at the intersection of AI and web scale engineering.

As a Data Scientist at Full Fact, you will make sure those who make false claims in public can't get away with it. This is a rare opportunity to work for a non-profit tackling internet-scale misinformation problems with a global user base. The fact checks our users publish are seen hundreds of millions of times each year and embedded in many of the most well-known internet services.

Every day, 100s of people around the world find, check, archive and challenge false claims identified by AI-enabled products produced by Full Fact. Your job will be to help us improve and expand this software for our growing user base. You’ll be working at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and real-world impact.

Whether you're responding to a new feature request from users in Nigeria covering a general election, helping fact checkers in Australia verify politicians' claims in real time, or enabling health-focused charities to identify and reduce harmful content spreading online, you will be working at pace on projects that make a substantial difference in the world. In this role that means prototyping and developing features with robust APIs, writing clean Python, and working closely with engineers and other data scientists to bring AI-powered features into production.

It is an exciting time to join Full Fact. You will be joining a team of technical, data, and product specialists working on genuinely novel problems in applied AI, from natural language processing and claim detection to trust benchmarks and harm detection.

We will support you to keep learning, and if you are interested in applying but not sure you have all the skills, please do apply. We are open both to supporting learning on the job and to rearranging tasks within the team to suit the skillsets of the best applicant

Job Definition

As an experienced Data Scientist, you will be a key contributor to a number of new and ongoing projects. You will use your technical skills to design and develop software that identifies and counters misinformation. You will develop and use a variety of datasets to train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with non-technical colleagues and other users of our tools. You will participate in code review, both of your own and of others' code.

Outcomes

Some of the projects you will be contributing to include:

  • Extending our new “Public Interest AI Trust Benchmark” to provide a deeper analysis of how reliably AI chatbots answer everyday questions.

  • Spotting potentially misleading and harmful claims across a broad range of media

  • Identifying and characterising potentially harmful narratives as they spread

  • Helping to integrate the technologies you build into products that will have an immediate use, for both fact checkers and journalists

  • Identifying sightings of previously checked claims at real-time speed

  • Measuring and improving the quality of the system

What we are looking for from you

Political impartiality and sensitivity:

You are committed to the political neutrality of our work and have a good understanding of impartiality (please see the rules on our website).

Understanding of public debate in the UK and sensitivity to the political context we work in.

Skills/competencies

  • Software engineering for data science. You are familiar with the software development lifecycle. You can design, code, test, correct and document moderate to complex programs and scripts from agreed specifications with or without AI coding tools. You can use agreed standards and tools. Collaborate with others to review and refine specifications where appropriate.

  • AI and data science innovation. You are broadly familiar with recent advances in AI including LLMs. You proactively research and explore areas of innovation in our industry. You can identify the value for innovation within the organisation.

  • Applied maths, statistics and scientific practices. You understand and can help teams apply a range of practices. You know how to develop deeper expertise on a narrower range of specialisms. You can start to apply emerging theory to practical situations.

  • Developing data science capability. You promote and monitor continuous professional development within your organisation. You know how to develop knowledge of cutting-edge techniques and share this knowledge. You can develop and support data science capability across the organisation.

  • Domain expertise. You can create automated fact-checking products that are proportionate to the operational benefit and achieve significant impact. You know how to present analysis and visualisations in clear ways to communicate complex messages. You can develop data science communication skills within your team. You support the evolution of data governance and take responsibility for applying ethical data science.

  • Understanding analysis across the product life cycle. You understand and can help teams apply a range of techniques to analyse data and provide insight. You are proactive and can present compelling findings that inform wider decisions. You are starting to apply innovative approaches to resolve problems.

What we offer

A salary between £41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experience.

Workplace Pension

Generous holidays:

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.

  • In addition, we usually close the office for a period between Christmas and New Year.

Comfortable, centrally located London office with good transport links

Employee Assistance Programme

Emergency Housing Loan and support for moving home

Volunteering day

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter using the link below by 10 am on Monday 30 November.

Our recruitment platform will remove identifying details such as email addresses to allow us to sift applications anonymously.

Before applying, please read the requirements we place on staff to protect Full Fact’s independence and non-partisanship

How the application process will work

We want to see you at your best to understand your strengths and the contribution you could make at Full Fact with strong support, including for your learning and development. We also want to make sure that we use your time well during this process and don’t ask for more from you than we need to. We will make any reasonable adjustments we need to make to this process to help ensure you can perform at your best. For more information about this before applying, please .

The interview panel will be Ellie Ashman (Head of AI), David Corney (Senior Data Scientist), and James McMinn (Senior Engineer).

The process starts off with an anonymised covering letter and CV. This will be read by at least two people to produce a shortlist for the panel interview.

The first round interviews will be an audio (not video) interview, lasting no more than half an hour, at a time that’s convenient for you. We will record it so at least two people can review each interview to decide who we invite back for the second round. The recordings will be deleted at the end of the process.

The second round will include a structured interview during which you will be asked to present some of your recent work in any way you choose. The interview will be with the full panel by video and last no more than an hour. We’ll tell you everything you need to know to prepare in advance.

This is a remote position.

Be Part Of A High-Performing Team

Join a global climate technology organization developing advanced thermal solutions for high-density data centers and the broader semiconductor ecosystem. This team operates at the intersection of mechanical engineering, liquid cooling, controls, system integration, and product commercialization.

The organization is expanding its data center capabilities to support next-generation computing environments with reliable, scalable, and energy-efficient cooling architectures. Team members collaborate with engineering leaders, product teams, customers, consultants, and industry organizations to transform emerging technologies into practical commercial solutions.

This opportunity is designed for an experienced data center thermal professional who can bring immediate technical credibility, influence system direction, and communicate effectively with customers and senior stakeholders.

What s In Store For You

  • A highly visible role supporting advanced data center cooling initiatives
  • The opportunity to influence next-generation liquid cooling architectures
  • Remote flexibility for highly qualified candidates
  • Collaboration with senior engineering, product, commercial, and customer teams
  • Participation in industry associations, technical committees, conferences, and standards development
  • Exposure to system design, simulation, validation, commissioning, and commercialization
  • Opportunities to mentor technical professionals and shape long-term engineering strategy
  • Comprehensive health, retirement, family-building, educational, wellness, and paid-time-off programs

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for advanced data center thermal management and liquid cooling systems.
  • Develop integrated cooling concepts spanning chips, racks, coolant distribution units, facility water systems, controls, and heat rejection.
  • Evaluate system architectures, equipment capabilities, operating modes, control strategies, and performance tradeoffs.
  • Perform or guide thermal analysis, computational fluid dynamics, modeling, simulation, and equipment evaluation.

  • Collaborate with product teams, technical specialists, consultants, customers, and commercial leaders.
  • Provide technical guidance during strategic customer pursuits and system commercialization efforts.
  • Deliver technical presentations to customers, leadership teams, sales organizations, and industry audiences.
  • Participate in organizations such as ASHRAE, the Open Compute Project, IEEE, or other relevant standards groups.
  • Translate emerging cooling technologies into reliable, scalable, and market-ready solutions.

  • Bachelor s degree in mechanical engineering, thermal sciences, controls engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • At least eight years of relevant engineering, system integration, or technical product experience.
  • Direct professional experience supporting data centers, mission-critical facilities, or data center cooling products.
  • Demonstrated experience with liquid cooling technologies such as direct-to-chip cooling, immersion cooling, coolant distribution units, or facility water systems.
  • Strong understanding of thermal-fluid systems, HVAC equipment, cooling infrastructure, controls, and heat rejection.
  • Ability to evaluate complete thermal management systems rather than individual components.
  • Experience with CFD, ANSYS, thermal modeling, fluid modeling, or system simulation is strongly preferred.
  • Absorption cooling experience is highly valued.
  • Experience developing system modes, control requirements, or sequences of operation is preferred.
  • Commissioning, field validation, troubleshooting, or facility integration experience is strongly valued.
  • Strong customer-facing, presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both engineering and business audiences.
  • Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Professional Engineer licensure, advanced technical education, or industry committee participation is beneficial but not required.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

Senior Compensation Analyst

What you will be doing:

The Senior Compensation Analyst supports the design, administration, analysis, and continuous improvement of Premier’s compensation programs. This role conducts job evaluations, market pricing, salary and incentive analysis, and compensation reporting to help ensure pay programs are internally equitable, externally competitive, and aligned with business needs. The Senior Compensation Analyst partners with the Compensation team, HRBPs, HRIS, Employee Relations, and business leaders to provide data-driven recommendations, support audits, improve processes, and communicate compensation guidance clearly and effectively. This role also serves as a Workday compensation functional lead by supporting configuration, release testing, job profile maintenance, compensation-related transactions, and the annual compensation cycle, including merit and incentive planning through Workday Advanced Compensation.

Compensation Administration – 35%

· Annually migrate job matches to updated salary data in MarketPay.

· Prepare analytics and reports for the Compensation team, CHRO, HRBPs, and business leaders.

· Partner with Employee Relations to provide documentation and analysis for compensation audits.

· Partner with Talent Acquisition to provide salary recommendations for new hire offers.

· Monitor and triage the Compensation general email box, ensuring timely responses to routine inquiries, appropriate routing of requests, and escalation of complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate Compensation team members.

· Identify opportunities to improve compensation processes, policies, and service levels.


Workday Administration – 35%

· Serve as the Workday compensation functional lead, including configuration, product knowledge, issue resolution, and team updates.

· Complete testing for compensation products during biannual Workday releases and validate that functionality supports compensation requirements.

· Partner with HRIS to configure and update Workday as needed to reflect changes to compensation programs.

· Complete Workday tasks as the Compensation administrator, including items related to position management, employment agreements, and one-time payments.

· Update job profiles as needed and maintain current job descriptions in the job repository.

Annual Compensation Cycle (ACC) – 30%

· Administer annual merit increases and annual incentive awards in alignment with budgets and guidelines.

· Work with HRIS to configure and implement Workday Advanced Compensation for the cycle.

· Complete ACC project tasks and assist with testing as required.

· Prepare draft communications for review by VP, Compensation.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description: Job Title: Senior AccountantLocation: Remote | USA, Canada Reports to: Senior Director, Financial Accounting Employment Type: Full-time This is an existing vacancyAbout the Role:We are seeking a high-performing Accountant / Senior Accountant to join our growing finance organization.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Senior Accountant

Location: Remote | USA, Canada
Reports to: Senior Director, Financial Accounting

Employment Type: Full-time

This is an existing vacancy

About the Role:

We are seeking a high-performing Accountant / Senior Accountant to join our growing finance organization. This role is designed for an experienced accounting professional who brings both strong technical accounting foundations and the ability to take ownership of complex accounting areas. The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, partner cross-functionally, and play a meaningful role in ensuring accurate, timely, and insightful financial reporting.

This position blends core accounting responsibilities with advanced senior-level duties, including independent judgment, process ownership, and mentoring. It offers strong upside and the opportunity to grow alongside the company as our finance function continues to evolve.


In this role, you will:

  • Prepare monthly journal entries and account reconciliations related to various areas of the balance sheet including but not limited to capitalized assets and/or fixed assets
  • Prepare monthly accruals across multiple cost centers
  • Serve as the primary accounting resource for one or more foreign subsidiaries, with responsibility for month-end close activities in compliance with U.S. GAAP
  • Review financial information on a regular basis for variance analysis purposes and confirmation of accuracy and completeness
  • Support other month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities as needed
  • Support external audit requests and preparation of supporting documentation
  • Partner with accounting and finance leadership on technical accounting matters and other ad hoc projects as needed
  • Perform other accounting, reporting, compliance, and finance-related responsibilities as assigned

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in accounting or related field
  • Minimum 3+ years of relevant accounting experience in a corporate accounting or public accounting environment (will consider candidates with public accounting experience only)
  • Experience in a multi-entity and multi-currency environment
  • NetSuite (or similar ERP) experience
  • Experience with fixed asset accounting or other capitalized assets such as internally developed software
  • Experience with month-end close activities including accruals, recording prepaid expenses, and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and accounting fundamentals
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Public accounting experience preferred (Big 4 or regional public accounting firm preferred)
  • Active CPA license or CPA candidate preferred
  • Experience preparing technical accounting position papers and accounting policy documentation preferred
  • Experience with system implementations preferred
  • Experience supporting external audits and responding to auditor requests

Experience with financial reporting in a large multi-entity corporate environment [Skills that would strengthen the role but are not required]

Compensation and Benefits

This position has a starting salary range of $81,500 - $108,500 USD or $66,000 - $86,000 CAD per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

· We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

· We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

· We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.


Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here.

Applications

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where employment is offered. JD Power does not provide employment sponsorship for this position.

This position is posted exclusively on and select trusted job boards such as LinkedIn or Indeed. All official communication comes from email addresses ending in @jdpower.com or @jdpa.com. We will never ask for payment, equipment purchases, or upfront fees. We may take additional steps to verify candidate information to protect the integrity of our recruitment process.

To all recruitment agencies: JD Power does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Manager Study Start Up and Regulatory Affairs
jobs.excerpt: The Manager, Study Start Up and Regulatory Affairs is responsible for developing the strategy based on regulatory requirements and for coordinating and overseeing all SSU deliverables from site selection through site initiation readiness.
jobs.description:
The Manager, Study Start Up and Regulatory Affairs is responsible for developing the strategy based on
regulatory requirements and for coordinating and overseeing all SSU deliverables from site selection
through site initiation readiness. The manager actively assists senior management in securing new
business by participating to BDMs and contributing to proposals/budgets. They also provide strategic
regulatory guidance, training, coaching and mentoring to junior members; may be required to line

manage members of staff.

Leads study start-up and regulatory activities for assigned projects of medium to high complexity,
ensuring delivery aligned with timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

Accountable for end-to-end delivery of study start-up and regulatory milestones across assigned

projects.

Ensure collection, review for completeness/compliance, and tracking of essential documents for
Study Start-Up to facilitate efficient site initiation and activation. Investigate incomplete, inaccurate
or missing documents to ensure accuracy and completeness of information. Prepare study team
reports or updates regarding status of essential document collection, review and approval.

Ensure negotiation and execution of clinical site agreements, ancillary agreements as well as
amendments, in accordance with project requirements and country regulations and within the

projected delivery timelines.

Defines and implements study start-up and regulatory strategies at project level, ensuring
alignment with sponsor expectations, regulatory requirements, and operational feasibility.

Proactively identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks impacting study start-up and regulatory
timelines, ensuring timely resolution of issues.

Builds and maintains strong relationships with clients, regulatory authorities, and internal
stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and delivery.

Ensure all team members assigned to the project for departmental deliverables are aware of the
tasks and time allocated, monitor project budgets, hours spent vs budgeted and promptly identify

and escalate any OoS.

Assist in securing new business or repeated business by participating to BDMs, developing and
reviewing regulatory sections of proposals, regulatory costing and budgets.

Provides strategic input into bids and contributes to winning new business opportunities

Provides coaching, guidance, and performance feedback to team members to support

development and delivery excellence.

Performs other work-related duties as assigned.

Graduate degree in Chemistry or Life Sciences, Nursing or equivalent

combination of education and experience.

6-8 years within pharmaceutical or CRO industry or Regulatory
body, of which at least 3 years in a leading/project management

role

Proven ability to successfully manage global projects

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: Account Executive (m/f/x) (English Speaking) Location: EU (Remote) Comp: 120k EUR base Territories: UKI/Nordics Who You’ll Work For:At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration.
jobs.description:
Account Executive (m/f/x) (English Speaking)

Location: EU

(Remote)

Comp: 120k EUR base

Territories: UKI/Nordics

Who You’ll Work For:

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance.

If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation.

Who we're looking for:

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Account Executives who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you!

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.

The role:

  • Own and grow a defined territory of named enterprise accounts across UKI/Nordics.

  • Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion.

  • Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts.

  • Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners.

  • Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles.

  • Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities.

  • Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value.

  • Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities.

Requirements

  • Strong preference for candidates who have verbal and written communication skills in a native language in the Nordics.

  • Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values.

  • Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion.

  • Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects.

  • Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations.

  • Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features.

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments.

  • Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals.

  • Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks.

  • Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue.

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions.

  • Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity.

  • Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers.

  • Nice to have: experience selling services.

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value.

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent).

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development.

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel.

The Experience:

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of.

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect.

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life.

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters.

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Pagehere

Diversity and Inclusion

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

jobs.title: Bilingual Customer Support Specialist - Remote
jobs.excerpt: At the American Cancer Society, we're working to end cancer as we know it, for everyone.
jobs.description:
At the American Cancer Society, we're working to end cancer as we know it, for everyone. Our employees and 1.3 million volunteers are raising the bar every single day. We are a culture comprised of diverse backgrounds and experience, to better serve our communities.

The people who work at the American Cancer Society focus their diverse talents on our lifesaving mission. It is a calling. And the people who answer it are fulfilled.

The Bilingual Customer Support Specialist plays a vital role in delivering exceptional service and technical support to the American Cancer Society’s donors, fundraisers, event participants, staff, and volunteers. This position is instrumental in ensuring smooth and positive interactions across multiple communication channels in both English and Spanish - including phone, chat, email, and/or social media - directly contributing to the success of fundraising efforts and mission-driven events. Success in this role is defined by the ability to efficiently resolve inquiries using a variety of resources and technical platforms, foster meaningful engagement with customers, and maintain accurate records and troubleshooting steps through tools such as Salesforce. As part of the broader customer support team, the Bilingual Customer Support Specialist helps strengthen relationships with customers and upholds the organization's commitment to providing compassionate, mission-aligned service.


Job Description


This is a full-time permanent remote position which can be home-based anywhere in the U.S

Start Date: January 25th, 2027


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Resolves customer inquiries and issues across multiple systems (30%) Leverages analytical expertise, administrative access, and deep knowledge of ACS programs to troubleshoot and resolve technical, programmatic, and website-related issues. Accurately translates complex information into terminology that aligns with the customer’s native language. Ensures thorough documentation in enterprise CRM systems and drives first-contact resolution.
  • Delivers high-quality customer service and engagement (30%) Provides professional, empathetic, and solution-oriented support to customers. Builds rapport, neutralizes escalations, and fosters long-term relationships to encourage continued engagement and revenue growth.
  • Assesses and triages complex or urgent requests (15%) Exercises independent judgment to identify and escalate high-priority or technically complex issues to appropriate support teams, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
  • Educates customers on ACS tools and engagement opportunities (10%) Leverages deep understanding of ACS events, volunteer programs, and digital platforms to guide users in navigating websites and tools. Promotes additional engagement opportunities aligned with customer interests.
  • Identifies and communicates process improvement opportunities (5%) Monitors customer feedback and system performance to report outages, inefficiencies, and enhancement opportunities to relevant teams. Contributes to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Maintains personal performance and professional development (5%) Engages in coaching sessions, training programs, and self-directed learning to stay current on ACS policies, software updates, and customer service best practices.
  • Supports special projects and testing initiatives (5%) Contributes to assigned projects, pilots, and testing of new or enhanced processes, procedures, and systems that align with organizational goals. Translates internal and external English-language content into Spanish to support communication with Spanish-speaking customers and, when needed, assist other staff members.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • Minimum Degree Required: High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Preferred Degree: Associate degree
  • Years of experience: Some college coursework and/or a combination of at least two years of business experience, ideally in a customer service or technical support role. Minimum one year of experience utilizing bilingual English/Spanish skills in a contact center or customer service environment. Remote work experience is also preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY:

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish required, with the ability to convey information clearly to diverse audiences. Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor are essential.
  • Customer Focus: Demonstrated commitment to customer satisfaction, including ownership of customer concerns and proactive resolution efforts.
  • Adaptability and Judgment: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with frequent changes. Demonstrates sound judgment, decision-making skills, and the ability to manage ambiguity and complex situations.
  • Multitasking and Time Management: Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, including oral and written tasks, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.
  • Analytical and Organizational Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities with skill in organizing resources, setting priorities, and using data to inform decisions.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong computer skills required, including proficiency with Windows-based applications. Typing speed of at least 50 WPM and ability to pass pre-hire technology and training assessments.
  • Digital Tools Experience: Experience with Salesforce, online fundraising platforms, mobile apps, and social media tools preferred.
  • Teamwork and Initiative: Self-motivated and capable of working independently or as part of a virtual team. Uses multiple communication channels effectively to collaborate with colleagues and leadership.
  • Resilience and Professionalism: Ability to handle pressure, respond to feedback constructively, and maintain professionalism in challenging situations.

WORK AT HOME REQUIREMENTS:

  • This role is performed within a virtual contact center environment. A home office setup that meets privacy standards and reliable high-speed internet connectivity is required (minimum requirements are 10 mbps download & 10 mbps upload).
  • Modem/Router with a minimum of two ethernet ports, accessible for direct plug in to your Laptop Docking Station.
  • Wi-Fi connectivity, cellular connections, mobile hotspots, and Satellite Internet Service Providers are not permitted, including 5G Ultra-Wideband internet.
  • Candidates must be available to complete approximately 8 weeks of mandatory virtual training, conducted on a fixed schedule. The position requires adherence to a structured schedule and the ability to work in a sedentary, somewhat repetitive environment.
  • Team members are required to be connected to the docking station and hardwired into their router/modem via ethernet cable when taking calls or other forms of engagement with constituents.
  • Flexibility to work shifts between 7:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m. CST, including weekends and holidays, is essential.

Current Schedule Availability

All schedules are listed in Central Time. All positions are 37.5 hours per week, consisting of five working days and two days off.

We offer several schedule options to accommodate different availability needs. Candidates will have the opportunity to indicate their preferred schedule when an offer is extended.

Please note that schedule availability may change as positions are filled; therefore, not all schedules listed below may be available at the time of offer.

Monday–Friday

Days off: Saturday and Sunday

  • 30-minute lunch: 9:30 am–5:30 pm or 10:30 am–6:30 pm
  • 60-minute lunch: 9:00 am–5:30 pm or 10:00 am–6:30 pm
  • 30-minute lunch: 10:00am - 6:00pm or 11:00am - 7:00pm
  • 60-minute lunch: 9:30am - 6:00pm or 10:30am - 7:00pm
  • 60- minute lunch: 8:30am - 5:00pm or 9:30am - 6:00pm

  • 60-minute lunch: 8:00 am–4:30 pm or 9:00 am–5:30 pm

Videogame Studio Accountant

Seismic Squirrel LLC

Job Title: Videogame Studio Accountant

The Role: Provide accounting and operational support for a videogame studio.

Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in a small-business accounting role.

Location: Puget Sound Region (Remote).

Team Size: 24

Pay: $40 - $48 USD per hour – Depends on skills and experience.

Job Type: Full-Time

Job Overview

This is a multi-hat role, requiring a variety of business skills and experience in accounting and adjacent duties. On one hand, we need a careful, detail-oriented accountant and bookkeeper who handles GL, AP, and the other accounting responsibilities of a small business, and on the other hand someone resourceful at administration and operations with a clear talent for organization. The ideal candidate is someone adept at logical and systemic thinking with a collaborative spirit, excellent communication skills, and an enthusiasm for videogames and the videogame industry too. They enjoy working with management and a team of talented creatives, communicate effectively in a small cross-functional remote team environment, bring a passion for working within a product development environment, and have a collaborative spirit and an enthusiasm for supporting a team of creative individuals.

This is a remote, full-time position which requires regular collaboration online during our core work hours (9:30 AM – 5:30 PM Pacific), attending relevant team meetings. Occasional meetings in the Greater Seattle area and calls during late evenings and early mornings should be expected.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the USA. H-1B transfers and sponsorships are not available at this time.

The Company

Seismic Squirrel is a close-knit, fully remote videogame studio with a team spread across the USA and Canada. We are passionate for developing well-crafted story-based games for the thoughtful gamer. Our nimble size allows for everyone to have a voice in our projects, demanding the ability to be both detail-oriented and flexible.

For more information about Seismic Squirrel, go to

Quests

Accounting

  • Support management planning, presenting accounting reports and advice to enable data-driven decisions
  • Create and present financial forecasts
  • Monitor and report on ROI for marketing campaigns
  • Coordinate with outside CPAs on tax compliance
  • Oversee state and provincial government registrations and filings (yes, we're in Canada too)
  • Help manage vendor relationships, setting up and maintaining billing and payment processes and systems

Bookkeeping

  • Handle QuickBooks categorization and bank reconciliation
  • Monitor accounts for funding and irregularities
  • Process sales tax, use tax, and property tax filings
  • Validate timesheets
  • Oversee vacation and sick time accruals
  • Sync PTO (vacation, sick time) between timesheet and payroll systems
  • Process expense reports and reimbursements
  • Administer 401(k) and health insurance enrollments, deductions, and payments
  • Reconcile benefit deductions from payroll with actual benefit payments
  • Keep insurance coverage up to date – e.g. workers compensation coverage when workers are hired, terminated, move locations
  • Ensure that team members and vendors are required issued tax forms: W-2, 1099, T4, etc.

Marketing Support

  • Collect, analyze, and report on marketing campaign data and ROI
  • Help organize and manage marketing events

Personnel Support

  • Ensure that each contractor's contract is up-to-date
  • Assist with preparing and administering team performance reviews
  • Administer eLearning and training compliance
  • Coordinate time-off requests: scheduling, payroll
  • Coordinate travel planning

Recruiting Support

  • Pre-screen job applicants for follow-up reviews by the hiring manager and lead
  • Keep the ball rolling for hiring, scheduling interviews and providing follow-up communications to job applicants

Other Duties

  • Lead relevant meetings, communicating agendas and following up on action items
  • Participate in internal game testing and feedback as needed

Character Stats

  • 5+ years of professional experience in a small-business accounting role.
  • Understands government filing and tax rules.
  • Understands employment and payroll regulations.
  • Enthusiastic for videogames and understands the videogame industry.
  • Excellent written, visual, and verbal English language communication and presentation skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, resourceful, able to find solutions on their own.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, able to work fast and loose or carefully with quality when each approach is needed.
  • Strong self-discipline, motivated, a self-starter with a drive for excellence.
  • Courteous and patient, able to give and receive constructive and inspirational feedback gracefully.
  • Able to work effectively within a team having a variety of roles, personalities, and backgrounds.
  • Adaptable: The job can change according to the needs at hand and requires wearing various hats.
  • Able to work remotely using various collaboration tools.
  • Has a secure and ergonomic workspace separate from personal activities and roommates during work hours.
  • Proficient with QuickBooks Online.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Passionate to learn new tools and technologies.

Bonus Points

  • Located in King County.
  • Experienced dealing with Canadian accounting and payroll.
  • Has foreign language experience.

If this sounds like an exciting opportunity for you and you're located in the Puget Sound region, please submit both your Résumé and Cover Letter to Seismic Squirrel.

Note: Due to the many applications and our team's limited capacity to evaluate them, don't be surprised if we are unable to respond right away if you apply.

Salary: $40 - $48 USD per hour – Depends on skills and experience

Role Title: Ground Combat & Special Operations SME

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Ground Combat & Special Operations SMEs to contribute to a customer's project focused on advanced military-activity evaluation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Author and classify challenging and realistic case studies across operational decision support, destructive execution, and unlawful planning, based on ground-combat and special-operations scenarios.
  2. Apply tactical ground-maneuver and direct-action expertise to ambiguous or complex cases, ensuring fidelity to real-world SOF and ground-mission planning and execution.
  3. Evaluate AI model responses for source management, uncertainty handling, reasoning quality, limitations, and tactical or targeting utility in operational contexts.
  4. Identify and flag instances where the AI model over-refuses legitimate conceptual, doctrinal, or readiness-related questions.
  5. Validate that all scenarios and edge cases accurately reflect how ground and SOF missions are truly conducted, not just stylized or cinematic versions.
  6. Document edge cases thoroughly, providing rationale to keep the evaluation process rigorous and defensible.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Hands-on experience leading in ground-combat (infantry, armor, reconnaissance) or special-operations units (SOF/SF, raiders, or equivalent allied forces).
  2. Proven decision-making responsibility in the planning and execution of ground maneuver, direct action, or close combat operations.
  3. Deep understanding of the lawful/unlawful and permitted/prohibited boundaries in tactical military operations.
  4. Demonstrated ability to instruct, mentor, or conduct formal after-action reviews, debriefs, or training at the team/platoon/company level.
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex tactical concepts.
  6. SOF selection/qualification (SFQC, SEAL/SWCC, allied equivalents), Ranger/equivalent tabs, or advanced NCO/command time.
  7. Experience in joint/combined, interagency, AI evaluation, wargaming, or red-team operations is a plus.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Senior Software Engineer- Platform

Location: Remote, United Kingdom, with travel to London for meetings when required.

Division: Ticketmaster

Contract Terms: Permanent, Full-time

THE TEAM

You will be joining the diverse Global Ticketmaster Platform Engineering team. As a Senior Software Engineer at Ticketmaster, you will be responsible for analyzing, coding, and maintaining the next generation of fan-facing services for Ticketmaster, the global leader in ticket management for large-scale sports and entertainment. You will work closely with other engineers, product owners and managers, and representatives from the business, to deliver unique, high quality, efficient, maintainable, and easy to use services. The software you will work on will be used by millions of people worldwide.


A career at Ticketmaster will challenge and engage you. We support the creators and producers of shows and live performances while connecting more passionate fans to these events. As a global and growing business, we can truly offer a world of opportunities to expand your skills and develop your career. Visit any of our offices, and you'll find a diverse mix of passionate employees, helping fans around the globe connect with the artists, teams and events they love. It truly is a unique and rewarding environment.

THE JOB

In the role of Senior Software Engineer, you’ll guide the development and delivery of our Global Platform which drives over 10 billion dollars of revenue annually. You will be accountable for delivering high quality, maintainable and performant solutions. You must think about solving complex technical problems and the long-term maintenance and cost of change of software solutions.


You will mentor and elevate engineers through technical leadership, code reviews, and engineering best practices to deliver the best ticketing experience across the globe. You’ll help teams fulfil technical, operational, and business requirements by putting yourself in the trenches.


You will emphasise collaboration and mutual support – sharing project workflow with globally distributed teams, contributing code to core global services and applications, and cultural exchange between development groups. It is an exciting time to join Ticketmaster as we are working towards aligning our technologies and products globally.

Because our business is online 24/7, you may on occasion be required to work out of hours or provide on-call duty on a rota basis.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Contribute to and collaborate on development work across globally distributed software teams, driving alignment on shared components and standards.
  • Ensure applicability of global applications to global markets.
  • Ability to organize, prioritise; multitask while coordinating team efforts, reporting to stakeholders and management on the progress of goals.
  • Connect with a series of stakeholders in order to gather as much information as possible regarding the problem at hand and implement short-mid term strategies to evolve products for future success.(UX / Design / Product…etc.).
  • Objectively explore multiple approaches and recommend the best technical direction including logic and reasoning.
  • Meaningful participation in web, native app and service layer architecture design.
  • Spike and prototype.
  • Write exemplary code.
  • Own the full development and deployment cycle for your software.
  • Proactively identify and reduce technical debt, ensuring long-term maintainability of platform services.
  • Design and advocate for clean, well-structured, and secure APIs, ensuring consistency, usability, and resilience across services.
  • Evaluate and select appropriate cloud services and infrastructure patterns, considering scalability, operational overhead, and cost implications for platform components.
  • Encourage and grow developers in their craft.
  • Debug and triage production application issues, often not your own.
  • Automate testing, deployments, performance, and recovery.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, while evaluating AI applicability for software solutions.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident resolution, and contribute to post-incident reviews.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of major software components
  • Experience with Agile methodologies
  • Strong backend development skills
  • Proven ability to design and implement clean, scalable and well-structured APIs
  • Java21/25 programming language experience or of other JVM languages
  • Experience with modern frameworks such as Springboot
  • Test-Driven Development experience
  • Understanding of Continuous Integration practices
  • Knowledge of current software architectural trends and practices
  • Previous experience with Design Patterns and SOLID principles
  • Experience working with AWS or other Cloud Provider
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ELK stack)
  • Experience with distributed systems
  • Knowledge of best practices and IT operations in an always-up, always-available services
  • Understanding of secure coding practices and common vulnerability patterns (e.g., OWASP Top 10)
  • Awareness of cloud service trade-offs, including scalability constraints, operational complexity, and cost implications when selecting infrastructure components.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and their appropriate application
  • Experience with CI/CD servers (Gitlab/Jenkins)
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes or other orchestration/scheduling framework
  • Experience working in an SOA development environment
  • Working knowledge of one or more database products (e.g. Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate closely with remote team members

Nice to have

  • Experience in DevOps
  • Experience with GraphQL and Apollo Studio
  • Experience working with Terraform
  • Experience with Helm package manager
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical topics to non-technical people
  • Demonstrated ability to work well in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary team environment

It is ok if you lack some of the skills listed above, the single most important skill is being able to learn quickly. We believe that a motivated, team-oriented professional will always succeed in mastering a new toolset when a need arises.

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Reliability: You consistently deliver to defined quality standards even under competing priorities. You proactively communicate progress and blockers, often alongside proposed solutions or alternatives.
  • Ownership: You take full ownership of your deliverables -- from design througη production. You handle setbacks constructively, learning from them and adapting your approach.
  • Impact: You consider both short- and long-term effects of technical decisions. You align your work with team and business goals, and actively seek opportunities to improve processes, reduce waste, and simplify systems.
  • Collaboration: You mentor peers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing. You build effective working relationships across distributed teams and adapt your communication style to different audiences -- technical and non-technical alike.

· Growth mindset: You continuously sharpen your own skills and actively help others develop theirs. You stay curious about emerging technologies and practices, and bring that learning back to the team.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

HIRING PRACTICES

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.


Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

Proven ability to successfully manage global projects

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

The Director of IT Finance will manage a complex IT budget supporting hundreds of active projects and technology initiatives.As a key business partner to IT and executive leadership, this individual will identify opportunities to improve financial performance, address budget variances, optimize resource allocation, and drive accountability across the organization.


Your pay and benefits are important components of your journey at Banner Health. This opportunity is also eligible for our Management Incentive Program, as part of your Total Rewards package. Interacts with management across diverse areas and multiple states participating in the evaluation of company plan and initiatives to develop actionable projects and activities in support of the company’s infostructure and infrastructure.

  • Identify Weaknesses: Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration tests on our networks, applications, and cloud environments to find security gaps before attackers do.
  • Harden Defenses: Configure, manage, and optimize our security infrastructure, including firewalls, WAF (Web Application Firewall), IDS/IPS, and endpoint protection tools.

  • Networking fundamentals: Deep understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, and network segmentation.
  • Cloud security: Hands-on experience securing cloud platforms, preferably AWS or Azure.

  • You have a strong grasp of common cyber threats, attack vectors, and vulnerability management lifecycles.
  • You are a proactive problem-solver with excellent analytical skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure during incidents.
  • You can communicate complex security concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

  • Experience with scripting for automation using Python, PowerShell, or Bash.

  • A passion for continuous learning and staying updated with the latest security trends and threats.

  • High-impact role with direct visibility into company growth and strategy
  • Small, high-performing teams with strong ownership and autonomy.
  • Fast execution environment with meaningful career growth opportunities
