Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

  • Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

  • Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

  • Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

  • Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

  • Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

  • Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

  • Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

  • Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

  • Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

  • Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

  • Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Requirements

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a Supply Chain Program Manager (SCPM) to own the supply chain execution of our new product introductions (NPI) for devices and accessories, from concept through mass production. You will be the connective tissue between Product, Hardware Engineering, Operations, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and Logistics, driving cross-functional alignment on schedule, cost, and supply readiness for complete systems rather than individual commodities.

You will lead through influence. You'll set and support program rhythms, surface risks early, drive decisions across teams with competing priorities, and lead Engineering designs that can be built, sourced, and shipped at scale. We also want someone who treats recurring program work (status reporting, risk tracking, readiness checks, data pulls) as something to automate. You'll build and use AI agents and workflow automation to free up time for the judgment-heavy work that moves programs forward.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

Mastermind and power NPI programs end-to-end

  • Champion next-generation device and accessory programs from bold concept stages through EVT, DVT, PVT, explosive ramp, and full mass production, taking full ownership of the end-to-end supply chain master plan
  • Drive flawless launch readiness in close lockstep with world-class JDM partners and internal operations engines, optimizing BOM+MVA, mastering development E&O, mitigating risk, and executing aggressive ramp curves
  • Command program-level cost, precision scheduling, and strategic risk, pitching clear, high-impact decisions and trade-offs to executive leadership
  • Establish and enforce rigorous build-readiness criteria and high-stakes gate reviews at every critical phase—covering materials, custom packaging, and global logistics
  • Engineer lead-time-driven backward-scheduling from OK2MP through demanding REL/CRT testing to secure critical PO release deadlines with total precision
  • Strategically classify process paths early (Full PLCM vs. Legacy Fast-Track exception) and drive ironclad stage-gate documentation from day-one kickoff

Galvanize cross-functional alignment and exert high-impact influence

  • Serve as the indispensable single point of accountability and catalyst for supply chain excellence across Product, Engineering, Operations, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Marketing
  • Unify diverse stakeholders around top priorities, resolve friction with agility, and guide executive decisions with compelling options and bold recommendations
  • Partner dynamically with Hardware Engineering on DFM, design-for-cost, and proactive supply-chain risk mitigation right at the drawing board
  • Lead high-octane schedule stewardship, synchronizing supply roadmaps directly to the stage-gate timeline and orchestrating high-alignment weekly core-team reviews
  • Run dynamic program cadences (core team syncs, readiness reviews, executive updates) that catalyze action and drive transformative momentum
  • Orchestrate seamless, structured handoffs to sustaining Supply Chain Managers post-MP ramp, ensuring long-term operational success and flawless execution

Neutralize supply risks and drive world-class partner performance

  • Join forces with Sourcing, Planning, and global manufacturing leaders to guarantee resilient supply lines, crush long-lead bottlenecks, and deploy bulletproof contingency strategies
  • Power Sourcing initiatives with aggressive cost targets, actionable should-cost insights, and high-stakes supplier negotiations across complex system BOMs
  • Relentlessly hunt down and resolve capacity, supply, quality, or logistics bottlenecks before they ever threaten the critical path
  • Spearhead the strategic Materials Risk Buy approval workflow, evaluating financial exposure and securing rapid executive alignment
  • Manage high-impact engineering changes with precision, driving seamless inventory disposition and cutover plans
  • Oversee NPI Material Spend and NMS budgets with absolute fiscal rigor across tooling, NRE, and ORT investments

Revolutionize supply chain operations with cutting-edge AI and automation

  • Architect high-leverage playbooks, intelligent workflows, and custom tooling that supercharge productivity across the entire global supply chain organization
  • Transform complex data into game-changing insights through futuristic dashboards, predictive risk analytics, and compelling executive briefings
  • Pioneer autonomous AI agents and automated workflows to handle routine program tasks, status roll-ups, and data pulls, freeing your bandwidth for high-value strategic leadership
  • Champion emerging AI advancements and translate state-of-the-art tech into transformative, real-world operational advantages
  • Maintain hyper-accurate, modernized supply chain tracking infrastructure across ERP/PLM platforms, PR/PO tracking, and program dashboards

Embody and lead as an inspirational Samsara leader

  • Embody and champion Samsara's core cultural ethos—Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team—inspiring everyone around you to achieve extraordinary results

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 7+ years of experience in supply chain program management, NPI, or operations for hardware or electronics products, with a track record of taking products from concept to mass production
  • BS in a relevant field (Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain) or equivalent practical experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority
  • Strong understanding of the NPI lifecycle and builds (EVT, DVT, PVT), BOM and ECO management, and CM and JDM operations
  • Experience working with international manufacturing and supply partners at executive levels
  • Advanced analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insights and craft clear executive presentations
  • Strong organizational skills: prioritization, attention to detail, and triage of complicated issues
  • Self-motivated, proactive problem solver who is comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous settings
  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools, agents, or automation (for example LLM-based workflows, scripting, or low-code tools) to streamline recurring work, or a demonstrated passion for learning to do so

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with IoT, telematics, or connected hardware, including accessories, cables, and sensors
  • Experience with ERP, PLM, and planning systems (for example NetSuite) and SQL or Python for data analysis
  • Experience building internal tools or agents that other team members adopt
  • PMP or equivalent program management certification

Total Rewards

Flexible Working

  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy

Freight Dispatch Coordinator — Load Recovery & Service Support

Full-Time | Remote — United States | U.S. Trucking Operations

When a Load Goes Sideways, Someone Has to Get It Back on Track

We are hiring a Freight Dispatch Coordinator to support active U.S. trucking operations with a focus on load recovery, service exceptions, shipment monitoring, and transportation coordination.

This position is designed for candidates with practical U.S. trucking, transportation, or logistics experience who can think clearly under pressure, communicate accurately, and identify appropriate next steps when freight operations do not go according to plan.

Previous employment specifically under the title of Freight Dispatcher is not required. Relevant transportation experience and working familiarity with U.S. freight load boards are required.

Load Recovery & Service Support

  • Monitor active freight movements and identify missed check-ins, scheduling conflicts, delays, and service exceptions.
  • Gather accurate information from drivers, brokers, shippers, and receivers before determining appropriate next steps.
  • Coordinate revised appointment information and authorized recovery actions when shipments are delayed.
  • Assist with identifying workable transportation options when freight plans change.
  • Communicate updated shipment information promptly to applicable parties.
  • Escalate situations requiring management, safety, compliance, or operational review.

Freight Evaluation

  • Use DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards when freight needs to be evaluated or replacement freight considered.
  • Review available freight based on equipment, lane, rate, mileage, deadhead, appointments, and operating requirements.
  • Calculate loaded mileage, deadhead mileage, total trip mileage, and rate per mile.
  • Consider driver availability and Hours of Service when evaluating transportation options.
  • Identify unrealistic schedules, excessive deadhead, equipment conflicts, or other operational concerns.
  • Present appropriate freight options for authorized review and booking.

Service Exceptions

Assist with operational situations involving:

  • Pickup or delivery delays
  • Appointment changes
  • Detention
  • Layover
  • Equipment or mechanical problems
  • Driver Hours-of-Service limitations
  • Missed or delayed check-ins
  • Load cancellations or changes
  • TONU situations
  • Documentation problems
  • Broker or shipment discrepancies
  • Other applicable transportation exceptions

Transportation Documentation

  • Maintain accurate dispatch notes and shipment records.
  • Review rate confirmations and appointment information.
  • Maintain bills of lading, proof-of-delivery records, and applicable transportation documentation.
  • Document delays, revised appointments, detention, layover, TONU, and other shipment exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate communication histories and operational updates.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent information requiring follow-up.

Required Transportation Background

Applicants must have previous professional experience or practical knowledge in an applicable transportation area, such as:

  • CDL-A trucking
  • Fleet operations or fleet support
  • Transportation coordination
  • Logistics operations
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Carrier operations
  • Load planning
  • Dispatch assistance
  • Comparable U.S. trucking operations

Required Skills

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and transportation operations.
  • Familiarity with DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable U.S. freight load boards.
  • Understanding of CDL-A driver schedules and Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Understanding of pickup and delivery appointments.
  • Ability to calculate loaded mileage, deadhead mileage, and rate per mile.
  • Ability to recognize transportation problems and determine when escalation is required.
  • Fluent professional spoken and written English.
  • Calm and professional telephone communication.
  • Strong organization, documentation, and follow-up skills.
  • Computer proficiency and ability to work with spreadsheets and transportation records.
  • Reliable computer and stable high-speed internet connection.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Helpful Additional Experience

  • ELD systems
  • Dry Van or Reefer operations
  • Detention and layover documentation
  • TONU documentation
  • Freight claims or exception tracking
  • Transportation-management systems
  • Broker verification
  • Active-load tracking
  • Rate confirmations, BOLs, and POD documentation

Work Arrangement and Schedule

This is a full-time remote position supporting U.S. trucking operations.

Qualified applicants may be considered throughout the United States.

The position requires availability during assigned U.S. trucking operating hours. Specific working days and schedules will be provided as part of the hiring process.

Applicants must maintain a professional remote-work environment with reliable internet and dependable communication capability.

Compensation

  • Weekly Compensation Range: $2,000–$3,500
  • Employment: Full-Time

Compensation within the stated range will depend on relevant transportation experience, qualifications, demonstrated capabilities, and assigned responsibilities.

jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

We are hiring an HR Automation Engineer to design, build, automate, operate, and continuously improve the applications, integrations, data solutions, and AI capabilities that power HR automation and digital experiences at Lumen.

This is a senior hands-on engineering role responsible for delivering solutions across Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Azure application development, AI platforms, and enterprise integrations. The role partners closely with HR leaders, analysts, product owners, and engineers to transform business needs into secure, scalable, and supportable solutions.

In one sentence: engineer the applications, automations, integrations, and AI-powered experiences that transform manual HR processes into modern digital services.

The Main Responsibilities

Workflow Automation & Robotic Process Automation

Design, build and support end-to-end automated workflows in Power Automate, spanning Microsoft 365, SuccessFactors, ServiceNow and our HR data sources, replacing manual and ticket-driven HR processes.

Build and maintain robotic process automations for systems that lack modern integration capabilities, including exception handling, credential management, monitoring, and operational support.

Implement logging, alerting, retry mechanisms, and operational monitoring to ensure solutions are reliable, supportable, and scalable.

Identify opportunities to eliminate manual effort while balancing automation benefits with long-term maintainability and business value.

Apps, Data & Semantic Modeling

Develop Power Apps solutions, canvas and model-driven, together with the Dataverse data models and security roles behind them, giving HR practitioners and employees a governed front door to those processes.

Design, develop, and support custom applications when business requirements extend beyond low-code platforms.

Build secure web applications, APIs, and services using Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, and related Azure technologies.

Develop APIs and reusable services that enable integration between HR applications, automation platforms, analytics solutions, and AI agents.

Implement application monitoring, telemetry, performance optimization, and operational support practices using Azure-native tools and Application Insights.

Evaluate whether requirements are best addressed through Power Platform, custom application development, vendor capabilities, analytics solutions, process redesign, or other approaches.

Agent Development & Analytics

Build and extend agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, including topics, actions, knowledge sources and connected agent patterns, and wire automation actions into the conversational HR experience the team is standing up.

Develop Fabric data agents grounded on curated semantic models, so HR questions are answered from governed data rather than from spreadsheets.

Deliver Power BI content on top of those models, including DAX measures, row-level security and report designs that HR leaders and COE partners actually use.

Integration & Platform Lifecycle

Build custom connectors and API integrations using REST, OAuth 2.0 and OData where out-of-the-box connectors fall short, including authentication, throttling and pagination handling.

Own application lifecycle management for the platform: solution-based deployments, environment strategy, source control and automated pipelines from development through production.

Manage the maintenance work that keeps the estate healthy, including connector and gateway updates, credential and certificate rotation, deprecation handling and post-change validation.

Governance, Enablement & Delivery

Establish and enforce platform governance, including environment and licensing standards, naming and reuse conventions, and monitoring through the Power Platform admin center.

Create reusable components, templates and patterns that let the wider HR team build safely, and coach analysts and citizen developers on using them.

Work with product managers, analysts, and stakeholders to evaluate, prioritize, and deliver automation and AI opportunities in short, visible increments.

Produce architecture diagrams, solution documentation and run books so automations are supportable by the team rather than by a single builder.

Communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders and recommend solution approaches that balance business value, user experience, maintainability, and long-term supportability.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 7+ years designing and delivering business applications, automation solutions, integrations, or analytics platforms, including at least 5 years of hands-on Power Platform delivery in an enterprise environment.
  • Deep expertise in Power Automate cloud and desktop flows, including connectors, expressions, error handling, approvals and performance tuning at production scale.
  • Experience designing, developing, and supporting Azure-hosted applications and services, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions, APIs, Application Insights, and related Azure technologies.
  • Experience building web applications using .NET, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, or comparable modern development frameworks is preferred.
  • Strong Power Apps and Dataverse skills, including Power Fx, security roles, and both canvas and model-driven design.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Fabric and demonstrated skill in semantic modeling, including star-schema design, relationships, DAX, and lakehouse or warehouse pipelines.
  • Proficiency with Power BI report and dataset development, and comfort working in SQL and Power Query.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems through REST APIs, OData feeds and custom connectors, including authentication, throttling and error-recovery design.
  • Working knowledge of Power Platform administration and governance: environments, solutions, data loss prevention policies, licensing, capacity and the Center of Excellence Starter Kit.
  • Hands-on agent development in Microsoft Copilot Studio, or comparable experience building AI agents grounded on enterprise data, is strongly preferred.
  • Integration experience with SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow or comparable HR and service management platforms is preferred, as is familiarity with Azure Functions, Logic Apps or API Management.
  • Understanding of the privacy, access and audit expectations that come with employee data.
  • Strong communication and consulting skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, HR leaders, business stakeholders, and executive audiences.
  • Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, technical documentation, run books and stakeholder-ready explanations, and to coach less technical builders.
  • Proven ability to evaluate business requirements and recommend solutions that may include automation, AI, custom application development, process redesign, or existing platform capabilities based on business value, complexity, and long-term supportability.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, HRIS, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's degree in a related field is preferred. Microsoft certifications such as PL-400, PL-500, PL-600, AZ-204, AZ-305, or DP-600 are a plus.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a hands-on accounting leader who has built a strong foundation across the accounting function and is ready to take the next significant step in your career. You have developed broad accounting experience within a small to mid-sized, multi-entity organization, where you have been close to the details and understand what it takes to successfully manage the day-to-day accounting needs of a growing business while leading others to deliver results.

You combine strong technical accounting knowledge with a practical, roll-up-your-sleeves leadership approach. You are equally comfortable setting direction and stepping into the work—moving between financial reporting, revenue recognition, cash forecasting, treasury, accounting operations, systems, and process improvement. You do not simply identify problems or delegate them—you take ownership, mobilize the right people, develop solutions, and drive them through to completion.

You are an effective people leader who can establish clear expectations, hold others accountable, develop talent, and execute through a team while remaining willing to step into the details when needed. You understand that strong leadership in a growing organization requires balancing strategic oversight with tactical execution. You are responsive, resourceful, curious, and motivated by the opportunity to build, improve, and lead from the front.

Whether you are currently a strong Accounting Manager, Senior Accounting Manager, Assistant Controller, or an early-career Controller, you have developed the depth and leadership capability to take on broader ownership. You bring experience working within a multi-entity, global accounting environment and are comfortable navigating the complexities that come with supporting operations across multiple entities, countries, and time zones. You are ready for a role where you can lead a global accounting team, influence how the function operates, and continue developing as a Finance leader.

If you are ready for your next significant career move and excited by the opportunity to lead while staying close to the work, FPG may be the right place for you. This role is designed for a high-potential accounting leader who wants meaningful responsibility, visibility, and the opportunity to strengthen and evolve the accounting function of a growing global organization.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As Corporate Controller at FPG, you will serve as a key leader within Finance, providing leadership and oversight across the company's global, multi-entity accounting operations while remaining closely connected to the day-to-day work of the team. This is a player-coach role: you will set expectations and direction, develop and hold the team accountable, execute through others, and roll up your sleeves when the business needs hands-on support.

You will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, strengthening accounting processes and controls, and building scalable infrastructure to support the evolving needs of the business.

You will lead a global accounting organization with team members located across multiple countries and time zones and support the accounting needs of a multi-entity organization. You will oversee financial and management reporting, technical accounting and revenue recognition, cash forecasting, treasury, accounting operations, and financial controls. You will lead the financial close process, partnering closely with the Assistant Controller and accounting team to ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time. Because the team operates globally, success in this role requires flexibility and the ability to connect with and lead team members across different working hours when needed.

You will also play a critical role in advancing the Finance function through automation, systems optimization, and process improvement. You will identify opportunities to reduce manual work, strengthen controls, improve integrations, and create more efficient and scalable ways of working—then lead the team through execution and adoption.

As a leader within Finance, you will develop the accounting team, establish clear expectations and accountability, and foster a culture of responsiveness, ownership, collaboration, and follow-through. You will know when to delegate and coach, when to challenge the team to solve a problem, and when to step directly into the work to ensure the organization delivers.

  • Build and improve scalable accounting processes, controls, and reporting structures across a global, multi-entity organization.

  • Lead and develop accounting staff while establishing clear expectations, accountability, responsiveness, and follow-through.

  • Maintain and strengthen balance sheet reconciliations, accounting controls, policies, and supporting documentation.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes, improve system integrations, strengthen controls, and increase reporting efficiency and accuracy.

This is a remote position.

Operations Assistant — Bookings, Purchase Orders & Field Coordination (ServiceM8, AI Tools)

Remote | Philippines | Full-Time | Php 40,000 – 50,000/month | 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM PHT (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM AEST) | Long-Term Remote Role

If you’re a high-performing operations professional who is confident on the phone, highly organised, and quick to work out the next step, and you want to work with an established Australian air conditioning and mechanical services company that values strategic impact over simple task completion — keep reading.

This isn’t a role for a “message taker” or a reception desk.

This is a focused, outcome-driven position where you’ll own bookings, purchase orders and call coordination for a busy field team, so crews arrive to confirmed jobs with the right materials, and you’ll use ServiceM8 automation and AI to make the office run faster.

Why This Is a Dream Job

You’ll be working directly with a growing Australian commercial and residential air conditioning business who:

  • Champions Innovation:Wants practical AI and automation in the office, and will rely on you to build ServiceM8 automations and AI-assisted workflows that save the team time.

  • Values Your Growth:Offers ongoing learning support in ServiceM8, automation and AI, plus a dedicated Success Manager (CSM) to keep your working relationship on track.

  • Respects Your Expertise:Wants you to use your own judgement, ask questions early and push back with reasons when an instruction will cause rework.

  • Builds Stability:Is hiring for a long-term role that replaces an existing position, not a fixed-term project.

  • Invests in Your Wellbeing:Provides hospital health cover after your first three months.

You’ll get career transformation, real ownership of office operations, and the chance to become the team’s go-to person for AI and automation, without being stuck answering phones and passing on messages.

What You’ll Be Owning

This is a core operations role covering booking confirmations, supplier purchase orders, inbound calls and coordination between customers, the office and the field team. You aren’t just taking calls and logging jobs; you’re keeping the whole field operation moving so crews never waste a visit and materials arrive on time.

You’ll take the lead on:

  • Booking Confirmations:Confirming scheduled jobs ahead of time through automated SMS and email in ServiceM8, and cutting late cancellations and no-access visits.

  • Purchase Orders:Sending accurate purchase orders to suppliers promptly once a sales quote is approved.

  • Calls & Coordination:Owning inbound calls during office hours, returning calls quickly, and resolving or routing every call the same day.

  • Follow-Ups:Chasing quote and payment follow-ups, and flagging scheduling conflicts, late supplier deliveries and missing information before they cause downtime.

  • Process Documentation:Learning from the SOPs handed over by the departing team member, keeping them current, and adding new documented workflows.

  • AI & Automation:Putting ServiceM8 automations and AI-assisted workflows, such as AI-drafted email templates, into regular use and helping teammates adopt them.


Requirements

This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

  • Are an Operations Owner:You have experience in an operations, admin or coordination role where you owned outcomes, not just tasks.

  • Are Confident on the Phone:You speak clear, confident English and can handle Australian customers, suppliers and tradespeople, holding firm when needed.

  • Are Highly Organised:You keep many jobs, orders and follow-ups on track at once.

  • Know Job Management Software:You’re comfortable with job management or field service software.

  • Work With Minimal Guidance:Training is provided, but you can keep bookings, orders and calls moving during busy periods using documented procedures and your own judgement.

  • Ask Early and Flag Problems:You ask clarifying questions the same day and raise issues in writing as soon as you spot them, with a suggested fix.

  • Are Curious About AI:You actively learn and test new tools and share what works.

  • Are High-Accountability:You don’t need to be chased for updates. You’re reliable, meet deadlines, and own your mistakes as much as your wins.

  • Can Commit to the Schedule:You’re comfortable working an early shift, 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM PHT, remotely.

Genuine differentiators (not requirements):ServiceM8 or similar field service tools; experience in trades, HVAC or field service businesses, including purchase orders and Xero.

What Success Looks Like

After 60–90 Days:

  • Crews Arrive to Confirmed Jobs:Nearly every scheduled job is confirmed ahead of time, and wasted visits have dropped noticeably.

  • Orders Go Out Fast and Right:Purchase orders reach suppliers promptly after quote approval, with errors kept to a minimum.

  • Calls Are Handled:Every call is answered or returned quickly and resolved or routed the same day.

  • The Office Runs Itself:You own the booking, ordering and coordination cycle, keep the SOPs current, and have proposed at least one concrete improvement, such as a new ServiceM8 automation.

  • Trust Is Earned:The team relies on you to keep the office moving through busy periods without constant follow-up.

Final Word

If you’ve ever thought:

“I’m the person who keeps everything on track. I’m confident on the phone, I stay organised under pressure, and I love finding faster ways to work with AI. I just want a team that lets me own the operation instead of passing on messages.” This is that role.

Let’s build long-term success — together.

For A Better You

At iHerb, we believe that living a healthy and balanced life should be easy and accessible to everyone. As a team member, we’ll empower you to live this promise each day as you make a truly global impact in your career.

We constantly strive for innovation, while transforming and improving the online shopping experience for our customers. We believe that individually we are incredible, but when we come together, our growth is infinite. In an industry that is constantly evolving, we are on a mission to make an impact on the global market, and the individual and collaborative efforts of our people are paramount to helping us succeed.

Whether you work in one of our logistics centers, technology hubs, corporate offices or even from home, your role at iHerb will take you beyond what’s expected, turning challenge into change. If you're ready for it, we want you to join our team. Get started now.



Principal Application Security Engineer


Location: Remote, United States. Candidates must reside in the Pacific time zone.


About the Role

iHerb is looking for a hands-on Principal Application Security Engineer to own our Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL), security automation, and product hardening strategy. You will protect an ecommerce platform that serves millions of customers in more than 100 countries, and you will respond to current and emerging threats against it.

You will work with engineering teams around the world to define new security capabilities, help hire and grow the Product Security team, and partner with senior leaders to deliver company-wide security initiatives.


Responsibilities

Secure development lifecycle and architecture

  • Lead cross-functional projects and establish modern SDL practices aligned to frameworks such as NIST SSDF, OWASP SAMM, and OWASP ASVS
  • Lead security design reviews and threat modeling for new and existing services, and set the standards for how teams do both
  • Create secure architecture standards, reference patterns, and paved-road libraries that span application, API, data, and infrastructure layers
  • Perform and guide secure code review of high-risk changes such as authentication, payments, and data handling

Security tooling and automation

  • Evaluate, prototype, implement, and operate SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC scanning, and container scanning in CI/CD pipelines
  • Build automation that gives developers fast, low-noise feedback and enforces security gates without blocking delivery
  • Own vulnerability management for application findings: triage, prioritization by real risk, SLAs, and remediation tracking

Assurance programs

  • Drive our security assessment, penetration testing, and bug bounty programs, from scoping through remediation
  • Define and report security KPIs, such as time to remediate, vulnerability escape rate, and security champion coverage, to engineering and executive leadership

Cloud, API, and supply chain security

  • Harden services running on AWS, containers, and Kubernetes, including network, identity, and secrets management
  • Secure APIs and microservices: authentication, authorization, rate limiting, input validation, and abuse prevention
  • Secure the software supply chain with SBOMs, dependency governance, build integrity (for example SLSA), and artifact signing
  • Protect the storefront against web threats such as account takeover, credential stuffing, bots, and client-side (Magecart-style) script attacks, working with Cloudflare, WAF, and fraud teams

Emerging threats and incident response

  • Track emerging threats and vulnerabilities, assess how they apply to iHerb, and implement centralized mitigations
  • Evaluate and set guardrails for security risks in AI and LLM-enabled features and developer AI tooling
  • Participate in security incident response, including root-cause analysis and follow-up fixes

Leadership and community

  • Help mentor security engineers, and build a security champions program with engineering teams
  • Partner with Engineering, Privacy, Compliance, and Legal on PCI DSS, GDPR, CCPA, and other regional requirements that affect product design

Required Qualifications

Experience and foundation

  • 10+ years in application or product security, with demonstrated technical leadership on large-scale consumer, ecommerce, or SaaS platforms
  • Computer Science or Engineering degree, or equivalent experience
  • Proven ability to translate technical vulnerabilities into business risk and to influence engineering and executive leaders without direct authority

Application security depth

  • Expert knowledge of common vulnerabilities and mitigations (OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, CWE Top 25)
  • Hands-on threat modeling and security architecture experience (for example STRIDE or PASTA) across web, mobile, and microservice systems
  • Strong grounding in authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT, session management, RBAC/ABAC), API security, applied cryptography, and data protection
  • Mobile application security experience (iOS and Android)

SDL, automation, and DevSecOps

  • Track record implementing SDL processes, tools, and automation in a CI/CD and DevOps environment
  • Hands-on experience operating SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning tools, and tuning them to reduce false positives
  • Experience with IaC security (Terraform, CloudFormation) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes)

Cloud and supply chain

  • Working knowledge of cloud security in AWS or a comparable provider: IAM, VPC and network segmentation, secrets management, and logging
  • Experience in software supply chain security: dependency risk, SBOMs, build integrity, and third-party code governance

Languages and engineering

  • Working knowledge of major languages and frameworks (Python, C# / .NET, JavaScript / Node.js, Java) sufficient to review code and write security tooling
  • Experience securing large-scale web applications and microservices

Compliance, privacy, and operations

  • Familiarity with PCI DSS and with privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA as they apply to ecommerce
  • Experience running or supporting penetration testing, bug bounty, and security incident response
  • Experience defining security metrics and reporting on them

Soft skills

  • Excellent problem solving, critical thinking, collaboration, and written and verbal communication

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Cloudflare security (WAF, bot management, DDoS protection), AWS networking and compute, and containerized workloads
  • Experience securing AI and LLM-enabled applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and model supply chain risks
  • Experience with runtime protection and detection, such as RASP, IAST, or API gateway security controls
  • Ability to drive decisions through data, with strong attention to detail and a record of delivering KPIs
  • Experience running application security training, security champions programs, and awareness campaigns
  • Active contributor to the security community (research, open source, publications, conference talks) with the ability to attract and hire strong talent
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, OSCP, OSWE, or GIAC (helpful, not required)

Compensation:

The expected salary range for this role is $177,000.00 - $225,000.00 USD. The actual base pay offered will be determined by factors such as the candidate's relevant experience, education, geographic location, and internal equity.

K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

We are seeking a Principal ASIC Package Design Engineer to lead advanced ASIC package architecture and execution, with a strong focus on flip-chip BGA (FC-BGA) and multi-chip module (MCM) solutions. This role owns the end-to-end package strategy for high-performance mixed-signal and digital SoCs from early architecture and trade studies through vendor engagement, qualification, and production ramp. You will operate as the technical authority for package design, defining standards, influencing silicon and system architecture, and ensuring first-pass success for complex, high-speed, power-dense ASICs.

Responsibilities

  • Own ASIC package architecture for FC-BGA and MCM solutions, including substrate stack-up, ball-map strategy, power delivery, signal breakout, and mechanical constraints.
  • Lead package-level trade studies across cost, performance, power integrity (PI), signal integrity (SI), thermal, manufacturability, and reliability.
  • Define long-term packaging roadmap aligned with future ASIC nodes, bandwidth scaling, and multi-die integration.
  • Establish organizational package design standards, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Drive detailed design of FC-BGA packages for high-pin-count ASICs with high-speed SerDes, dense power grids, and RF signal content.
  • Define and review substrate stack-ups, via strategies, impedance control, escape routing, and reference plane planning.
  • Partner with silicon, RF, and systems teams to co-optimize die floorplans and package interfaces.
  • Own package-level SI/PI strategy, including high-speed digital interfaces (e.g., SerDes, JESD, Interlaken), power delivery network (PDN) design, and decoupling strategy
  • Lead thermal architecture at the package level, including lid selection, TIMs, heat-spreaders, and mechanical interfaces to system cooling.
  • Manage relationships with external packaging vendors, substrate suppliers, and
  • OSATs, including vendor qualification, capability assessment, contract negotiation, and performance/quality score carding to ensure roadmap and volume commitments are met.
  • Drive material selection, substrate technology choices, and assembly process optimization.

Required Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in ASIC package design, with deep expertise in FC-BGA.
  • Proven experience delivering high-pin-count, high-performance ASIC packages into production.
  • Strong understanding of substrate technologies and materials, SI/PI fundamentals at the package level, and thermal management for power-dense ASICs.
  • Fluent in SI/PI and EM simulation tools such as SIWave, HFSS, and ADS.
  • Experience working directly with OSATs and substrate vendors.
  • Knowledge of packaging qualification and test methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience with MCM or heterogeneous integration (chiplets, interposers, advanced laminates).
  • Background in high-speed digital or mixed-signal SoCs.
  • Familiarity with aerospace, space, or high-reliability electronics.
  • Experience defining packaging strategy from early architecture through first silicon and volume ramp.
  • Demonstrated history of building or scaling package design methodology within an organization.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $280,000 + equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

Our client is seeking experienced Software Engineers specializing in Open Source Contributions to participate in an advanced artificial intelligence training project focused on high-quality, real-world software development.

This fully remote, project-based opportunity is designed for skilled software engineers who enjoy solving complex programming challenges, contributing to existing open-source repositories, and improving software performance, reliability, and maintainability.

Selected professionals will develop new features, resolve challenging bugs, refactor existing codebases, and validate technical solutions while contributing their expertise to the development of next-generation AI systems.

Previous experience in artificial intelligence is not required. Strong software engineering expertise, advanced programming skills, and practical open-source development experience are the primary qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and refine new features within existing open-source software repositories.

  • Apply competitive programming techniques and advanced problem-solving skills to address complex technical challenges.

  • Evaluate multiple approaches to software engineering problems and identify effective, technically sound solutions.

  • Review proposed code changes and collaborate remotely with other software engineering contributors.

  • Identify potential improvements in existing software architecture, implementation, and performance.

  • Maintain clear technical documentation describing solution design, implementation details, and engineering decisions.

  • Deliver high-quality, well-documented software contributions that meet established project specifications and deadlines.

Programming Languages and Technical Environment

Candidates should demonstrate expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following programming languages:

  • Python 3

  • Java

  • Rust

  • C++

  • TypeScript

  • Go (Golang)

  • C#

Strong experience in open-source software development, complex debugging, feature implementation, codebase refactoring, and performance optimization is particularly valuable.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Strong professional experience in software engineering, particularly in open-source software development and contributions.

  • Expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following programming languages:

    • Python 3

    • Java

    • Rust

    • C++

    • TypeScript

    • Go (Golang)

    • C#

  • Extensive hands-on experience developing and implementing new features within existing software repositories.

  • Proven ability to identify, analyze, debug, and resolve complex software issues.

  • Strong experience in codebase refactoring, legacy code modernization, and performance optimization.

  • Advanced understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.

  • Demonstrated expertise in competitive programming and solving complex algorithmic challenges.

  • Ability to analyze sophisticated programming problems, interpret technical constraints, and evaluate multiple solution approaches.

  • Experience reviewing, validating, and improving code to ensure correctness, consistency, efficiency, and maintainability.

  • Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and understand existing software architecture.

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and technical problem-solving capabilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear technical documentation.

  • Ability to collaborate remotely with other software engineers while working independently on assigned tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated contributions to established open-source software projects.

  • Experience maintaining, improving, or extending complex open-source repositories.

  • Strong background in competitive programming, algorithm design, and advanced coding problem analysis.

  • Experience optimizing software performance, scalability, and code efficiency.

  • Familiarity with collaborative development practices, peer code reviews, and software quality validation.

  • Ability to document technical solutions, explain implementation decisions, and communicate complex engineering concepts clearly.

  • Interest in artificial intelligence and the development of advanced AI coding and reasoning systems.

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, collaborative environment.

jobs.excerpt: We Are:Accenture’s SAP practice, and we live to see how this can transform the way we live and work.
jobs.description:
We Are:

Accenture’s SAP practice, and we live to see how this can transform the way we live and work. We bring reinvention to life using design thinking, modern delivery methodologies, embedding AI into the way we deliver and into business processes.


Additionally, the Life Sciences Industry is going through remarkable levels of transformation with new therapies that improve lives of patients, new implantable devices that improve health and wellness and much more global supply chains. SAP technologies power these organizations with modern cloud-based and AI-enabled solutions, and Accenture is the undisputed market leader in this industry.


We are continuously expanding our SAP team with advisory skills to continue to drive transformation at scale for our clients.


You Are:

We are seeking a hands-on SAP S/4HANA Quality Management (QM) Consultant to support the design and implementation of Quality Management solutions as part of complex SAP transformation programs.


The Work:
This is a hands-on functional consultant role.

  • The individual will be expected to lead and facilitate Quality Management process workshops, understand business requirements and pain points, translate those requirements into SAP solutions, and configure the SAP QM module to enable the target business processes.
  • The consultant will also be responsible for identifying solution gaps and developing detailed functional designs/specifications, working with development and integration teams as necessary, and supporting functional and end-to-end integration testing.
  • The individual should be able to develop test scenarios, validate the configured solution, troubleshoot functional issues, and support defects through resolution.
  • In addition, the SAP QM Consultant will support the definition of master and transactional data requirements for Quality Management, working with business, functional, and data teams to ensure that the required data is appropriately defined and supports the target solution.
  • The individual should be comfortable facilitating workshops, explaining SAP functionality in business terms, articulating design options and implications, documenting decisions, and collaborating across functional and technical teams to deliver an integrated solution.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need:

  • Minimum 3 years of SAP experience, with strong functional experience in SAP Quality Management (QM), including experience developing detailed functional designs/specifications for gaps, enhancements, interfaces, reports, and other non-standard requirements, experience developing and executing functional and integration test scenarios, supporting defect resolution, and validating end-to-end business processes and experience supporting master data and transactional data definition for SAP QM, including identifying the data required to enable the target solution.
  • Minimum of 2 years demonstrated experience designing and implementing SAP QM solutions, preferably within SAP S/4HANA environments.
  • Hands-on experience across the solution lifecycle, including requirements/process workshops, solution design, system configuration, functional specifications, testing, and deployment support.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience and understanding of end-to-end Quality Management processes and their integration with adjacent SAP functions.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience independently configuring the SAP QM module based on approved business and solution requirements.
  • Experience supporting the MedTech/Life Sciences industry and/or clients
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience

Bonus Points if:

  • You have experience implementing SAP QM within SAP S/4HANA as part of a large-scale transformation program.
  • You have a strong understanding of SAP QM integration with Manufacturing, Materials Management/Procurement, Warehouse processes, Sales & Distribution, and other relevant SAP functions.
  • You have experience facilitating business process and solution-design workshops, translating business requirements into SAP solutions and clearly documenting design decisions.
  • You have experience applying SAP standard capabilities and leading practices to minimize unnecessary customization.
  • You have experience supporting data design, cleansing, conversion, validation, and cutover activities related to Quality Management.
  • You have experience in Life Sciences and/or MedTech and familiarity with quality processes in a regulated environment is preferred.
  • You have a strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate complex SAP topics clearly to business stakeholders.

  • Plantões e atuação em janelas de manutenção

Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação de, no mínimo, 360 horas.

Graduação em qualquer curso de nível superior acompanhado e Pós-graduação (especialização, mestrado ou doutorado) na área de Tecnologia da Informação de, no mínimo, 360 horas.

jobs.description:
About Versapay 🚀

Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers from collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end-to-end cash flow clarity and ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms.
By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $300B+ in payments volume annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!
The Opportunity

Partners are an important part of how Versapay reaches the market. Our ERP/VAR, ISV, and Financial Institution partners help us reach new customers, create new routes to market, and drive pipelines.

We're looking for a Partner Marketing Programs Manager to help us get more out of these relationships.

This role sits within Partner Marketing and will help turn partner strategy into marketing programs that partners can use. You'll work across our partner channels to build campaigns, create partner-ready content and enablement, support partner events, and help launch programs that generate demand.

The role will also provide marketing support for select programs outside of Partner Marketing, particularly webinars and other pipeline-focused initiatives.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking an idea and figuring out how to make it happen.

The Role

    The Partner Marketing Programs Manager will work closely with Partner Marketing, Partner Sales, Events, Demand Generation, Content, Product Marketing, and other teams across Versapay.

    You'll help build and execute programs across our ERP/VAR, ISV, and Financial Institution channels, while also supporting the marketing activation around key partner events and broader marketing programs.

    The role is intentionally broad, but the focus is consistent: create scalable marketing programs and assets that help our partners and internal teams generate pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner Marketing Programs: Build and execute marketing programs for our ERP/VAR, ISV, and Financial Institution partners, including campaigns, partner communications, campaign-in-a-box programs, and other demand generation initiatives.
  • Partner Content: Create and adapt content for specific partners and audiences, including emails, landing pages, one-pagers, presentations, sales materials, and campaign assets.
  • Partner Enablement: Develop materials that help our partners understand and sell Versapay, including partner decks, solution overviews, battlecards, playbooks, talking points, and campaign-specific enablement.
  • FI Sales Training & Product Knowledge: Work closely with Partner Sales and Product Marketing to build and maintain sales training and product education for Financial Institution partners. Translate Versapay product capabilities, positioning, use cases, and updates into clear, practical training that helps FI partner teams confidently identify opportunities, explain the value of Versapay, and support effective customer conversations.
  • FI Enablement Support: Provide focused support to Financial Institution partners in two critical areas: strengthening sales readiness through repeatable training, and improving product knowledge through current, easy-to-use materials and access to the right internal subject-matter experts.
  • Partner Events: Run the marketing execution around key partner events, including Microsoft, NetSuite, Sage, and other strategic ecosystem events. This includes event promotion, landing pages, email campaigns, partner communications, speaker support, collateral, and post-event follow-up.
  • Webinars & Marketing Programs: Run webinars and other marketing programs that contribute to pipelines across the broader business. This may include program development, promotion, content, execution, and follow-up.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Work with Partner Sales, Events, Demand Generation, Content, Product Marketing, and other teams to bring programs to life and keep projects moving.
  • Program Scalability: Look for ways to turn one-off partner requests and programs into repeatable plays that can be used across multiple partners and channels.
  • Measurement: Track program performance and use results to improve future campaigns and partner activation.

Qualifications

  • 3–6+ years of experience in B2B marketing, partner marketing, field marketing, demand generation, or a related role.
  • Experience building and executing marketing programs from planning through launch.
  • Strong writing and content development skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences.
  • Experience creating marketing materials such as presentations, one-pagers, campaign assets, emails, and landing pages.
  • Experience developing sales training, product education, or enablement materials that help partner-facing teams communicate product value and use cases.
  • Ability to learn product capabilities and positioning quickly, work with subject-matter experts, and translate technical information into practical partner-facing guidance.
  • Comfortable working across multiple teams and managing several programs at once.
  • Strong project management skills and a bias toward getting things done.
  • Experience working with channel, partner, field, or ecosystem marketing is a plus.
  • Experience supporting Financial Institution partners, or working in banking, fintech, payments, ERP, or enterprise technology, is a plus.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change, and you're expected to figure things out along the way.

Why This Role Matters

    Partners are a significant growth channel for Versapay, and we're investing in the programs and resources that help them succeed.

    This role will help us move faster by giving our partner teams more marketing support, our partners more resources to take to market, and our broader marketing organization additional capacity to execute high-impact programs.

    For our Financial Institution partners in particular, this role will strengthen the sales training and product knowledge they need to represent Versapay effectively, engage customers with confidence, and create more consistent pipeline opportunities.

    It's an opportunity to work across a wide variety of businesses while developing deep experience in partner marketing, demand generation, enablement, and events.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

EnableComp earned its reputation in the toughest corners of the revenue cycle by solving the complex claims no one else could. We developed Complex Revenue Intelligence™ (CRI), a smarter approach to predict and prevent revenue loss. Powered by the e360 RCM® AI-driven platform and the most expansive complex revenue cycle data set, today EnableComp helps more than 1,000 hospitals nationwide recover $3 billion annually from complex claims, denials, and revenue recovery. By cutting through complexity, we help hospitals thrive, resulting in recognition as Black Book’s #1 Specialty RCM provider for complex claims and revenue integrity in 2024 and 2025, a multi-year Top Workplaces honoree, and a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST e1-certified platform.Our Vision is to empower healthcare providers to focus on patient care, not revenue cycle complexity. Our Mission is to uncover what others miss—turning every client dollar recovered into insight that helps prevent future loss. We live our Core Values of Uncompromising Integrity, Ecstatic Clients, and Empowered Team Members by operating with trust, accountability, and a “we before me” mindset. We pursue Innovation and Profitable Growth through continuous improvement and thoughtful problem-solving, and we believe work should include Fun—celebrating success, recognizing our people, and maintaining healthy work-life balance.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Director, Events owns the integrated go-to-market programs that drive pipeline and revenue growth, with events, tradeshows, in-person thought leadership speaking opportunities, and webinars as the primary channels. The role plans and runs the program mix across those channels, including the pre- and post-event nurture that surrounds them, and holds accountability for event- and webinar-sourced and influenced pipeline. Working closely with the commercial teams, the Director ensures every program is tied to business goals, captured accurately through HubSpot and Salesforce, and reported with measurable ROI. This is an individual contributor leadership role that drives results through cross-functional influence and agency partners.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own event and tradeshow strategy and execution across industry events and EC-hosted and corporate-owned events, leveraging technology, content, and multiple communication channels.
  • Build and manage the annual events portfolio and budget, applying a clear ROI framework to decide which events to keep, grow, or retire.
  • Create immersive experiences that reinforce EnableComp's brand and mission and give sales, product, client engagement, and operations teams space to build strong client relationships.
  • Design customer-facing programs such as executive roundtables, client hospitality, and advisory sessions at events.
  • Elevate pre-, during-, and post-event communication to capitalize on nurture opportunities and build the sales pipeline.
  • For large-scale shows, be on site for booth setup and teardown and ensure the team has the support it needs throughout the event.
  • Own the EC-hosted webinar program on Zoom Webinar, from editorial calendar and topic selection through promotion, registration, run-of-show, live delivery, and on-demand repurposing.
  • Partner with EnableComp subject matter experts, clients, and sales to build webinars that influence demand generation and brand awareness.
  • Optimize industry-led webinars and speaking engagements to drive stronger lead generation and brand building.
  • Manage the event and webinar lead journey from source (Zoom Webinar, registration platforms, onsite capture) through HubSpot to Salesforce, ensuring leads are captured, scored, and routed accurately.
  • Secure speaking opportunities for EnableComp experts at conferences, tradeshows, and related events to elevate EnableComp’s position in the market.
  • Source new speaking opportunities and ensure EnableComp takes full advantage of those included in sponsorship and association membership packages (organizations we belong to).
  • Build and own the integrated go-to-market plan across events, tradeshows, webinars, and thought leadership speaking, tying each program to pipeline and revenue goals.
  • Scope is limited to events, tradeshows, webinars, and thought leadership programs. General demand generation (such as paid media, SEO, and broad email or content campaigns) sits outside this role.
  • Allocate budget across events, webinars, and speaking programs based on cost per opportunity, pipeline contribution, and ROI.
  • Run structured tests on event and webinar formats, audiences, offers, and follow-up cadences, and scale what moves pipeline.
  • Partner with product marketing to carry approved positioning, launch messaging, and competitive context into event, webinar, and speaking content.
  • Work with sales on lead-to-opportunity conversion, follow-up speed, and feedback on lead quality.
  • Own event- and webinar-sourced and influenced pipeline, not only lead counts, in partnership with sales and marketing operations.
  • Optimize event tools and processes to capture all lead generation activity accurately.
  • Produce regular, consistent analysis of all event and webinar activity through reports and dashboards to achieve Marketing KPIs.
  • Deliver quarterly business reviews on events and webinars to marketing and executive leadership.
  • Coordinate event targeting with account-based marketing plays and sales outreach.
  • Serve as the single point of ownership for events (including but not limited to conferences, tradeshows, and sponsorships) and webinars, directing agency and vendor partners for logistics, production, and creative support.
  • Manage multiple third-party agencies and vendors to expedite strategies and achieve business outcomes.
  • Partner with peers across sales, product, client engagement, and operations to ensure strong ROI from event initiatives.
  • Motivate cross-functional teams and hold them accountable for maximizing lead generation at EC events.
  • Own the budget and planning for events and webinars.
  • Other duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree required in Marketing, Communications, or other related discipline.
  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including field, integrated, or go-to-market marketing, with ownership of event and webinar programs and leadership of cross-functional programs. Healthcare or RCM experience strongly preferred.
  • Expert-level understanding of event execution and management.
  • Ability to effectively leverage a variety of marketing and communication channels to achieve expected outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoom Webinar, and event registration platforms (critical).
  • Experience managing multiple third-party agencies and vendors.
  • Budget and expense management experience, including ownership of a multi-event portfolio.
  • Demonstrated ability to build dashboards and report on pipeline and ROI.
  • Strong computer proficiency, including MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook), Zoom, and other learning technology.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • Regular and predictable attendance.
  • Willingness to travel, including on-site presence at large-scale shows for booth setup and teardown.
