jobs.title: Spécialiste senior, génération de la demande - Workleap Agent
jobs.excerpt: À propos de Workleap Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006.
jobs.description:
À propos de Workleap

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.

Ton rôle

On vient de lancer un agent IA pour gestionnaires, et la façon dont les acheteur.euse.s le trouvent, ça repose sur toi. On cherche une personne en génération de la demande qui a géré de la publicité payante à grande échelle, qui a l'œil pour le bon marketing et qui veut prendre en charge le chiffre qui compte le plus ici : le pipeline qualifié provenant de nouveaux clients. Tu vas diriger nos agences en publicité payante et en SEO, décider où va le budget et t'assurer que le site convertit ce qu'elles amènent. Un plus si tu as déjà fait passer un produit de 0 à 1.

Ton impact :

  • Connaître notre funnel mieux que quiconque : d'où viennent les leads, où ils bloquent et quoi corriger en premier, pour que nos AEs aient plus de bonnes conversations chaque mois ;
  • Piloter la publicité payante avec notre agence partenaire : décider où va l'argent et ce qui se teste, et tenir l'agence responsable du pipeline plutôt que des clics ;
  • Bâtir et tester quelques approches d'outbound en parallèle de l'inbound ;
  • Faire trouver Workleap sur Google et dans les réponses des LLMs sur lesquelles les acheteur.euse.s s'appuient de plus en plus, avec notre partenaire SEO, et transformer ce trafic en pipeline ;
  • Faire convertir le site : chaque page clé a un rôle clair, un indicateur et des tests en continu ;
  • Définir le mix de canaux dès le premier trimestre, puis le revoir chaque trimestre : arriver à notre revue d'affaires hebdomadaire avec un point de vue sur où doit aller le prochain dollar, et rapporter ce qui a bougé ;
  • Utiliser l'IA pour éliminer le travail ingrat du reporting : automatiser tôt les chiffres hebdomadaires du funnel, les rapports d'agence et les diagnostics de pages, pour que l'équipe passe son temps à décider plutôt qu'à monter des tableaux.

Ton équipe

Tu vas rejoindre une équipe marketing en croissance (bientôt six personnes) et relever de notre Head of Marketing. Tu vas travailler main dans la main avec notre responsable du contenu : cette personne façonne ce qu'on dit ; toi, tu t'assures que les bons acheteur.euse.s le voient. En dehors du marketing, tu auras un rythme hebdomadaire avec RevOps et les ventes, et tu collaboreras avec toute l'organisation.

Ce que tu apportes

  • La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise, car tu vas collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, des clients et des partenaires qui parlent une autre langue que le français. La plupart de nos acheteur.euse.s sont aux États-Unis et au Canada anglais, et la plupart des programmes que tu vas mener sont d'abord en anglais.
  • 5 ans et plus en marketing de croissance, de demande ou de performance dans une entreprise SaaS B2B avec une équipe de ventes, avec la responsabilité de budgets de publicité payante de 50 K$ et plus par mois ;
  • Tu as déjà fait croître un pipeline inbound et testé des approches d'outbound, chiffres à l'appui, et tu sais expliquer ce qui a réellement fait bouger les chiffres ;
  • Du goût : tu sais distinguer un excellent texte d'un texte correct, écrire toi-même une annonce ou une page d'atterrissage quand c'est plus rapide, et repérer des occasions que les chiffres seuls ne montrent pas ;
  • Tu as dirigé des agences et pas juste collaboré avec elles : tu as rédigé le brief, remis en question le plan et changé de cap quand les résultats ne venaient pas ;
  • Assez de SEO pour orienter un.e spécialiste, et un point de vue tranché sur la façon dont l'IA change la recherche ;
  • Du travail concret en conversion sur un site B2B (pages d'atterrissage, formulaires, tests), et l'analytique pour savoir ce qui a marché (GA4, HubSpot ou équivalent) ;
  • Tu bâtis tes propres rapports et tu utilises des outils d'IA comme Claude pour aller plus vite ;
  • Tu prends des décisions sans données parfaites, tu livres, et tu expliques ce qui s'est passé en quelques lignes claires, même quand ça n'a pas marché ;
  • Atout : expérience en technologie RH, auprès d'une clientèle de PME, ou avec une approche d'outil gratuit ou d'essai.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 105 000$ - 140 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
    • OTE : 115 000 $ – 155 000 $ CAD
  • Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap.
  • REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Ce qui nous anime

Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

jobs.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn.
jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Answers that could be about any company will not pass.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in Romania.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

jobs.excerpt: Hi.  We’re Hummingbird. We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it.
jobs.description:
Hi. We’re Hummingbird.

We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it. We partner with healthcare systems to transform how patients access care, enabling their providers to focus on what matters most – caring for patients. By managing patient access as a technology-enabled service, we help health systems stabilize costs and improve patient experience while creating good jobs that attract and retain talent in the industry. Our team of experts is obsessed with the connection between the people, processes, and technology that make healthcare organizations hum. Join us and help build the healthcare experience we want for our communities, our families, and ourselves.

Summary

Responsibilities

Lead the analysts at the heart of our Epic delivery, and grow the people who make it work.


As a Service Delivery Analyst Director at Hummingbird, you’ll lead a team of Epic analysts, supervisors, and managers who deliver high-quality work across our clients’ Epic applications. You’ll set direction, develop leaders, and keep delivery consistent, and you’ll also roll up your sleeves as a working leader, doing analyst work alongside your team.


You’ll work with high autonomy in complex, ambiguous situations, aligning people, resources, and processes so your teams produce dependable results over time. You’ll stay well rounded across Epic applications such as Cadence, Prelude, Ambulatory, and MyChart, and you’ll focus on building clear paths for analysts to grow toward consultant roles and for support specialists to grow into analysts. Many of the managers on this team are newer leaders, so a genuine passion for coaching and developing people is central to the role.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop a team of Epic analysts, supervisors, and managers, setting clear standards and holding the team accountable for consistent, scalable delivery.
  • Coach and support managers, many of them first-time leaders, helping them build confident, high-performing teams.
  • Hire, onboard, and retain top Epic talent, and manage staffing and allocation assignments.
  • Create clear development paths that move analysts toward consultant roles and help support specialists grow into analysts.
  • Direct staffing, utilization, and allocation decisions, balancing company targets, client needs, and each person’s growth.
  • Contribute to delivery as a senior practitioner, staying well rounded across Epic applications such as Cadence, Prelude, Ambulatory, and MyChart.
  • Own Epic certification tracking and training-fund allocation across the organization, including scheduling new certifications and keeping teams cross-skilled.
  • Establish operating rhythms that give visibility into workload, capacity, risk, and throughput, and surface issues early with stakeholders.
  • Partner across functions to align delivery with strategy, resolve dependencies, and support proposals, scopes of work, and smooth sales-to-delivery transitions.
  • Address performance concerns decisively and fairly, in line with Hummingbird values.

The Details

  • Employment Eligibility: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship
  • Work Location: Remote. You must work from a location within the United States with consistent Internet service
  • Work Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Expected range is $162,500 to $211,250. New hires usually start between $162,500 and $195,000, depending on experience and internal equity.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; 401(k); parental leave; career development support; and more

Required & Desired Skills

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of relevant experience, including 4+ years leading teams or functional work.
  • Active Epic certifications, especially Cadence, Prelude, Ambulatory, or MyChart, with real build or application experience, not just certification.
  • Experience leading a team of Epic analysts, and the supervisors or managers who lead them, with a track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining strong talent.
  • Hands-on Epic application knowledge, with the ability to work alongside analysts and guide them through complex, ambiguous problems rather than waiting for a task to be defined.
  • A genuine passion for growing people and leaders, including giving and receiving direct, sometimes difficult feedback.
  • Proven ability to own strategy, operating approach, and end-to-end outcomes for a service delivery area, program, or client operation.
  • Strong executive communication and cross-functional collaboration skills in dynamic, high-ambiguity environments.
  • Ability to make delivery tradeoffs and resolve performance risks across people, process, and resourcing.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience working at Epic is highly preferred.
  • Background as a leader at Epic who moved into consulting or implementation, leading teams of analysts or consultants.
  • Familiarity with the Epic certification process and training-fund management, plus experience building scalable standards in a remote, fast-growing organization.

What Helps You Shine

  • Please note that we use both your resume and your written and oral communication throughout the hiring process to understand your fit for this role.
  • Thoughtful, clear responses help us see your attention to detail, your professionalism, and your ability to communicate with care, all skills that are essential for success on our team.

Expectations for Focus & Presence

  • To support patients and each other, this role requires your full attention during scheduled work hours. Our Outside Employment Policy doesn’t allow overlapping work or “job stacking,” so any outside work must happen fully outside your Hummingbird schedule.
  • We’re a camera-ready team, and you’ll need to be on camera during training and when needed during the workday after training ends.
  • We value connection, teamwork, and being present, which is what keeps our patients safe and our team supported. If that’s what you’re looking for, you’ll feel at home here. If you’re hoping to hold another job during the same hours, this job won’t be the best match.

Growth at Hummingbird

This role sits at the center of our Service Delivery leadership team. You’ll shape how a growing analyst organization develops, and as Hummingbird grows you’ll have the opportunity to expand your scope, take on new functions and capabilities, and help build the next generation of analysts, consultants, and leaders. At Hummingbird, we believe good jobs should lead somewhere, and that starts here.


Please Note: The seniority level of this position may be adjusted during the recruitment process based on candidate skills and experience.


A Note on Authentic Interviews

We believe the best hiring conversations are real ones. Notes are welcome, and jotting things down during the call is completely fine. What we ask is that you don’t use AI tools or similar assistance to generate your responses in real time. We’re genuinely trying to get to know you: how you think, how you communicate, and what you’ve experienced. That connection matters to us, and it’s hard to find when answers are scripted rather than interactive.

We’re a team that makes healthcare more human. We’d love to meet the person behind your application.

The Hummingbird Approach
We value a team that brings diverse perspectives and experiences to the work we do. While there are many ways to do this, people who are successful at Hummingbird:

  • Lead with Respect by valuing kindness and working to actively foster an environment of inclusion and respect.
  • Embrace Growth and seek out learning and growth for themselves and support those around them in their growth journey. They bring curiosity and an openness to innovation to all their interactions.
  • Bring a Win Together mentality by approaching conflict directly, listening carefully, and seeking to understand. They problem-solve with the goal of finding successes, not trade-offs, for all involved.

Equal Opportunity Statement
Hummingbird Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. We value the talents of individuals from all backgrounds and actively seek a diverse workforce.

Our mission is to provide a fair and inclusive recruitment process for everyone, and reasonable accommodations are available to any applicant who may need them. Please reach out to to request accommodations and we’d be happy to chat.

jobs.description:
This role welcomes full remote or hybrid work arrangements. However,applicants must be based in Spain, Italy or France and have a work permit to be considered.

ABOUT LAUNCHMETRICS

Launchmetrics is the leading Brand Performance Cloud used by Fashion, Lifestyle and Beauty (FLB) executives to make smarter decisions around their branding efforts.

With over a decade of industry expertise, we have helped more than 1,200 customers create inspiring, impactful and measurable experiences.

Founded in NYC and with operating headquarters in Paris, we have employees in ten markets worldwide and offer support in five languages. We have been the trusted brand performance technology to brands worldwide such as Dior, Fendi, Shiseido, NET-A-PORTER and Adidas as well as industry partners like IMG, the Council of Fashion Designers of America, the British Fashion Council, and Camera Nazionale Della Moda Italiana.

How we work: pods and crafts

We recently moved our Product and Tech teams to a pod model, and it changes the shape of this job in ways worth understanding before you apply.

  • A pod is a small group, 1 to 4 people, that owns a single mission end to end: from scoping and building through cleaning, enablement and watching adoption. Pods form around a mission and dissolve when it's done. Everyone is a pod owner, from the most junior person to the most senior, because ownership is the point.

  • Your craft is your main area of expertise: Design, Tech, or Data. It's the discipline you go deep in.

  • Your domain is your product-area home, the part of our software suite you know best. Pods change with every mission; your craft and your domain don't.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Principal Data Product Manager with a Data expertise to own missions on our Data Collection and Enrichment Systems.

At Launchmetrics, the core of our Metrics value comes from the data we deliver through our SaaS solution. Our client buy data as much as they buy access to a platform.

The Data Collection and Enrichment domain is in charge of collecting the data, enriching it and making it accessible in an efficient and reliable manner to the other domains. If you like the idea of owning a problem end to end, care about data quality the way other people care about pixel alignment, and want to work on forward thinking and AI centric projects, this role is for you.

As a Principal Data Product Manager here, you'll own missions on that domain from scoping to adoption, and you'll be one of the references for building our Data strategy, with the support of our VP Product. You operate as a fully autonomous pod owner.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Talk to your users. A lot. Turn the needs of customers and internal teams into product requirements that can be measured, and work with engineers day to day to deliver them.

  • Own missions end to end. Scope, build with the pod, enable and monitor adoption for Data Platform missions, keeping a clear source of truth so everyone can see where things stand.

  • Master our data flow. Work across acquisition, enrichment (manual, rule-based and AI-based) and management (datalake, APIs) to make data delivery faster and more reliable.

  • Measure what matters. Define the metrics and KPIs for adoption and performance of what you build, then actually analyse them and feed the learnings back into prioritisation.

  • Keep an eye on the market. Stay close to the competitive landscape and where brand measurement is heading, and let that sharpen your thinking.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders. Collaborate with engineers, business stakeholders and leadership, speaking the right language to each.

  • Raise the bar around you. Contribute to shared tooling and processes, and help the data domain get sharper over time.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This role sits at the Principal stage of our framework. Concretely, that means:

  • Experience. Around 5 and 10 years in product management or data management, ideally shipping alongside engineers in a SaaS environment.

  • Self-sufficient across crafts. You're not a designer or a PM, but you can do enough product thinking and rough interface reasoning to keep a small pod moving without waiting for someone else.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE LAUNCHMETRICS

We're a company that prioritizes people, fostering a relaxed yet dynamic atmosphere. Our international team is filled with enthusiastic, motivated individuals who enjoy their work. Autonomy empowers our team members, allowing them to make a substantial difference in our business, for our customers, and within our organization. When you become part of our team, you'll have access to growth and advancement possibilities, including a learning and development allowance, a benefits package tailored to each location, and flexible work arrangements, along with support for establishing your home office and other perks.

From how we hire and develop our people to how we advance rigorous science, we are building a team committed to transforming medicine in autoimmune diseases, starting with the kidney.

Position Summary:

Vera Therapeutics is seeking Privacy Counsel to join its legal team and report to the SVP, Deputy General Counsel. This role is the company's in-house privacy expert, responsible for addressing the full range of Vera's privacy needs across clinical, commercial, corporate, and employee data, in the U.S. and globally.

The Privacy Counsel will serve as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders across R&D, Clinical, Commercial, Compliance, IT, HR, and Finance. The role requires someone who can work independently, exercise sound judgment, and deliver clear, practical recommendations even when the facts are incomplete. The ideal candidate brings deep life sciences privacy experience, understands the handling of protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII), and can balance risk mitigation with the business's need to move quickly. This is an opportunity to shape and build a privacy program at a growing biotech as it advances its pipeline and builds out its commercial operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Own privacy legal strategy: Serve as the company's primary privacy counsel, advising on all privacy matters across clinical development, commercial operations, corporate functions and IT.
  • Advise internal stakeholders: Provide timely, actionable guidance to business partners and leadership, including making clear recommendations when facts are incomplete and clearly communicating residual risk.
  • Navigate U.S. and global privacy law: Advise on compliance with CCPA/CPRA, CIPA, HIPAA, FTC requirements, other state privacy and consumer health data laws, GDPR, the UK GDPR and Data Protection Act, and other international privacy regimes as Vera's activities expand.
  • Develop policies and procedures: Identify gaps in Vera’s privacy and data governance framework and independently draft, implement, and maintain the policies, procedures, and guidance needed to meet company and legal requirements, tailoring them to the needs of each business function.
  • Address PHI and PII issues: Advise on the collection, use, storage, disclosure, and cross-border transfer of PHI and PII, including in clinical trials, patient support, commercial, and employee contexts.
  • Manage vendor and third party privacy risk: Review and negotiate data protection terms, business associate agreements, data processing agreements, and international transfer mechanisms; support vendor privacy and security diligence.
  • Build and maintain the privacy program: Develop and update privacy policies, notices, procedures, training, and records of processing; support data mapping, data protection impact assessments, and privacy by design in new initiatives.
  • Respond to privacy events: Support the assessment of, response to, and notification obligations for privacy incidents and data security events, and handle data subject and consumer requests.
  • Monitor the legal landscape: Track emerging privacy, health data, and AI related legal developments and translate them into practical guidance and program updates.
  • Collaborate across the company: Partner with Compliance, IT, HR, Clinical, Commercial, and Finance to embed privacy into day to day operations and decision making, and work with outside counsel and consultants as needed.
  • DPO/DPR Management: Manage all interactions with the company’s external DPO and DPRs globally.

Qualifications:

  • Legal Expertise & Credentials: J.D. and licensed to practice law in good standing in at least one U.S. state, and authorized to practice in California as registered in-house counsel (if residing in California), with 8 to 10 years of legal experience focused on privacy, including law firm training and in-house experience.
  • Life Sciences Experience (required): Demonstrated experience advising biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or other life sciences companies on privacy matters, including clinical research and commercial data practices.
  • U.S. Privacy Law: Working knowledge of HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, CIPA, and the growing body of state privacy and consumer health data laws.
  • International Privacy Law: Working knowledge of GDPR, UK GDPR and the UK Data Protection Act, and cross-border data transfer requirements.
  • PHI and PII Expertise: Familiarity with issues involving PHI and PII, including the transfer, collection, storage, and use of such data.
  • Vendor Experience: Experience working with vendors on data protection terms, business associate and data processing agreements, and privacy and security diligence.
  • Independent Judgment: Proven ability to work independently, make sound risk-based recommendations with incomplete information, and advise stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
  • Strategic & Pragmatic Thinker: Hands-on, pragmatic problem solver who can balance day to day requests with longer term program priorities.
  • Interpersonal Excellence: Collaborative, intellectually curious, and an outstanding communicator who can explain complex privacy concepts clearly to non-lawyers and earn trust across the organization.
  • Values-Driven & Mission-Focused: Committed to Vera's values and motivated by the mission to advance patient care and improve outcomes for individuals with serious immunologic diseases.
  • Process and Operational Excellence Mindset: Ability to build practical processes, drive continuous improvement, and use technology and data to scale a privacy program.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

If you're a security engineer who wants to create real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Ready to join the future of innovation in Crypto & Security at NXP?

Become part of a highly talented and dynamic international development team that develops state-of-the art secure cryptographic libraries which are protected against physical and logical attacks, which have applications across all different NXP domains and business lines (payment, identification, mobile, IoT, Automotive, Edge Processing, etc.).

  • Specification and cross-platform implementation of state-of-the-art cryptographic algorithms (incl. Post-Quantum Cryptography) and secure software based on functional requirements.

  • Collaboration with security architects and internal evaluation teams to enhance software countermeasures.

  • Providing technical leadership for cryptographic domains, driving domain evolution, influencing architectural decisions, and supporting project planning.

  • Collaboration with OS and firmware teams to ensure clean and secure integration of the cryptographic software into the final product.

  • Working closely with the group’s test and platform support engineers to ensure maximum product quality.

  • Driving product certification activities and supporting security evaluations.

YourProfile

  • BSc, MSc or PhD in mathematics, cryptography, computer science, electronic/ electrical engineering, information technology or relevant discipline.

  • 10+ years of relevant industry experience in cryptography and embedded security (or an equivalent combination of advanced degree and relevant experience), with strong understanding and implementation of cryptographic primitives (e.g., ECC, RSA, AES, SHA-2/SHA-3).

  • Solid experience in embedded software development using C and Assembly, and strong knowledge of microcontroller architecture (e.g., ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V).

  • Knowledge of hardware and software countermeasures against side-channel and fault-injection attacks.

  • Experience in Post-Quantum Cryptography is a plus.

  • Experience with Rust is a plus.

  • Strong debugging and analysis skills.

  • You are a proactive team player with a strong sense of ownership and a proven ability to deliver results.

Weoffer

  • Work on state-of-the-art cryptographic software, including traditional and post-quantum cryptography, on ARM Cortex-M and RISC-V platforms.

  • Develop innovative countermeasures against Side-Channel Analysis (SCA) and Fault Injection (FI) attacks.

  • Drive the technical direction of cryptographic software, influence architectural decisions, and lead technical discussions across multiple teams.

  • Collaborate with leading security experts across architecture, evaluation, firmware and certification domains.

  • Contribute to solutions that safeguard applications across automotive, payment, identification, mobile, industrial, and IoT markets.

jobs.excerpt: HowGood is an independent research company and SaaS platform with the world's largest database on food product sustainability.
jobs.description:
HowGood is an independent research company and SaaS platform with the world's largest database on food product sustainability. We help food brands, retailers, restaurants, and ingredient suppliers measure, reduce, report, and communicate the environmental and social impact of what they make and sell.

Our platform, Latis, assesses more than 33,000 ingredients across eight sustainability metrics, including on-farm emissions, water use, soil health, biodiversity, animal welfare and labor risk. Sustainability, R&D, and procurement teams at some of the largest food companies in the world use it to make better product and sourcing decisions. HowGood is backed by FirstMark.

The Role

You will grow HowGood's relationships with the customers who already use HowGood, identifying new opportunities inside those accounts and guiding each one through to a signed expansion. This is a quota-carrying Account Executive role with a named list of existing customers, and expansion is your primary focus: additional business units, brands, regions, and product categories, along with additional HowGood licenses, data feeds, and services.

You will work closely with Customer Success, Product, and the Sales Directors who sold the original contracts. The role suits someone who enjoys building relationships with several stakeholders across a single account over time, and who finds satisfaction in helping a customer reach more of the decisions that sustainability data can inform.

What You'll Do

  • Own a named list of existing HowGood customers, and build an account plan for each that maps current usage, key stakeholders, and likely areas for growth.

  • Generate expansion pipeline within those accounts by reaching new teams, business units, and regions, and by watching for buying signals such as new climate commitments, Scope 3 reporting deadlines, retailer data requests, and new sustainability hires.

  • Lead discovery, build the business case, and align stakeholders through to contract for each expansion opportunity, in line with HowGood's pricing and contract policies.

  • Partner with Customer Success on account health, renewal timing, and handoffs, so that expansion conversations complement onboarding and renewal work.

  • Coordinate with the Sales Directors who closed the original contracts, so that each account has a clear owner for expansion and customers hear from one coordinated team.

  • Forecast expansion bookings accurately, and contribute to the sales forecast review.

  • Use Salesforce and AI research tools to prepare for account conversations, personalize outreach and keep CRM records accurate and current.

  • Bring customer feedback and feature requests back to the Product team in a clear, consistent way.

What You Bring

    Must have

  • Prior quota-carrying experience in expansion, upsell, or account executive roles at a B2B SaaS or data company, ideally with five or more years in the field.

  • A track record you can show with numbers, such as expansion bookings, quota attainment, and net revenue retention.

  • Experience generating your own pipeline within an installed base, rather than relying only on inbound requests and renewals.

  • Comfort leading sales cycles through contracting with several stakeholders at enterprise accounts, from sustainability and R&D teams to procurement and executive sponsors.

  • Experience building business cases that quantify value for a customer, whether in cost, revenue, or environmental impact.

  • A collaborative approach to working with Customer Success, Product, and fellow sellers.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and with AI research or prospecting tools, such as Apollo, Clay, or Amplemarket.

  • Familiarity with negotiating and contracting with enterprise clients. Experience with legal software such as Ironclad preferred.

  • A genuine interest in food systems and sustainability.

    • Nice to have

  • Experience selling into food, CPG, retail, or supply chain companies.

  • Familiarity with sustainability topics such as carbon accounting, Scope 3 emissions, or ESG reporting.

  • A second language for customers in Europe, with a preference for German, French, Spanish, or Italian.

Why HowGood

    Food systems produce about a third of global greenhouse gas emissions, and everyone at HowGood is here because we care about changing that. You will join a small, friendly team that shares this goal, and you will work every day with sustainability leaders across food and agriculture, in accounts where HowGood is already part of how decisions are made. As an expansion seller, you will see firsthand how customers use the data and help them apply it to more of their products, sourcing, and reporting.

Own US recruitment and help build the teams driving Eftsure’s next stage of growth.

Eftsure helps businesses protect their payments from fraud. Following our recent acquisition of Relish, a US business specialising in vendor data validation and invoice processing, we’re expanding our teams and looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to support our growing US business.

Reporting to our Talent Acquisition Manager based in Australia, you’ll own end-to-end US recruitment, with an initial focus on hiring for Relish. You’ll partner directly with US hiring managers and work alongside a friendly, supportive global Talent Acquisition and HR team.

We’re looking for someone available to start immediately, based in the United States and working Pacific Time hours to allow regular collaboration with Australia.

The opportunity

This is a busy, hands-on role with real ownership. We’re expanding our Account Executive team, so experience recruiting sales professionals will be particularly valuable. You’ll also recruit across IT, engineering, marketing and customer support, giving you a varied portfolio of business-critical roles.

You’ll need to be proactive, organised and comfortable running your recruitment processes autonomously. With your manager in Australia, you’ll use your judgement to keep things moving, resolve day-to-day challenges and communicate clearly across time zones.

What you’ll be doing

  • Manage end-to-end US recruitment: own role briefings, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, feedback and offer management.

  • Build strong hiring manager partnerships: understand team needs, agree on hiring priorities and provide clear advice throughout the process.

  • Find and engage talent proactively: build pipelines through direct sourcing and outreach, particularly for Account Executive and other sales roles.

  • Manage a high volume of vacancies: balance competing priorities and maintain momentum on business-critical searches.

  • Deliver a great candidate experience: keep candidates informed, engaged and supported from first conversation through to offer.

  • Partner with HR on employment contracts: gather and confirm the information HR needs to prepare contracts and support a smooth transition into onboarding.

  • Keep recruitment information current: maintain accurate records and share meaningful updates on pipelines, progress and challenges.

  • Collaborate across time zones: work closely with your Australia-based manager while independently driving US recruitment forward.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience managing end-to-end recruitment across multiple concurrent vacancies in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ideally, experience recruiting sales professionals, particularly Account Executives within B2B SaaS or technology.

  • Internal recruitment experience would be helpful, particularly experience partnering directly with hiring managers and balancing business priorities.

  • The versatility to recruit across commercial, technical and corporate functions.

  • Strong sourcing skills and a proactive approach to finding talent beyond inbound applications.

  • Confident stakeholder management, with the ability to build trust, set expectations and constructively challenge when needed.

  • Excellent organisation, sound judgement and consistent follow-through.

  • The initiative to work autonomously, make progress without waiting for direction and recognise when to escalate.

  • Clear, proactive communication that makes collaboration across time zones effective.

Why join Eftsure?

  • Make a visible impact: your hires will help shape our US teams and support our next phase of growth.

  • Take ownership: you’ll have the autonomy to run your portfolio and contribute ideas to improve how we recruit.

  • Enjoy variety: work across sales, IT, engineering, marketing and support, partnering with stakeholders throughout the business.

  • Work with supportive people: join friendly, approachable colleagues who share knowledge and help each other succeed.

  • Work remotely: enjoy a 100% remote role within the United States, working Pacific Time hours.

  • Join at an exciting stage: our acquisition of Relish brings new opportunities as we grow our global business.

Ready to get started? We’d love to hear from you. Apply and let us know your availability.

jobs.description:
View All Jobs

Updater is building a category-defining commerce platform with the ambition to become one of the world’s most important commerce infrastructure companies. We’re looking for an exceptional leader to build the company’s Strategic Finance and Business Operations function and help architect the next stage of growth. Reporting to the CFO, this person will sit at the intersection of finance, strategy, data, and execution, owning the financial and operating architecture required to help scale the company toward $1B+ in revenue and beyond.

You will own the company’s forward-looking financial engine, performance-management system, and a portfolio of its highest-priority cross-functional initiatives. You’ll help determine where we invest, what we expect in return, how we measure whether it’s working, and what we do when reality differs from the plan. You’ll inherit a small, high-caliber team and be expected to build a world-class function without unnecessary bureaucracy, combining sophisticated thinking with a highly hands-on, capital-efficient approach.

The mandate is simple: help the company make better decisions, allocate resources more intelligently, and turn strategy into measurable results.

What You’ll Own

Strategic Finance, Planning & Capital Allocation

  • Own the company’s financial planning architecture, including annual planning, rolling forecasts, long-range planning, and scenario analysis.
  • Build and maintain a driver-based financial model that connects operating activities, unit economics, strategic priorities, and resource allocation to long-term financial outcomes and enterprise value.
  • Partner with the CFO and executive team on capital allocation, helping determine where the next dollar, hire, or hour of organizational capacity should go.
  • Develop rigorous business cases for major investments, new products, partnerships, pricing changes, commercial structures, and strategic initiatives.
  • Translate financial and operating performance into concise executive and Board-level narratives: what happened, why it happened, what matters, and what we should do about it.

Company Performance Management

  • Architect and own the company’s KPI and OKR measuring frameworks, with clear leading and lagging indicators tied to the financial plan and strategic priorities.
  • Partner closely with Data leadership to establish a trusted, company-wide source of truth for the metrics that matter.
  • Build and maintain executive dashboards that translate complexity into clarity and make business performance immediately understandable.
  • Run the company’s operating cadence, including monthly business reviews, quarterly planning, forecast reviews, and performance deep dives.
  • Turn variance analysis into action by identifying root causes, establishing accountability, and ensuring corrective actions actually happen.
  • Continuously improve how the company sets targets, measures progress, and holds itself accountable for results.

Business Operations & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning GTM, Product, Operations, Data, and Finance, from initial problem definition and analysis through implementation and durable operating process.
  • Develop the analytical and operating frameworks required to evaluate growth opportunities, pricing, partner economics, unit economics, organizational productivity, and resource allocation.
  • Partner with the CFO and CRO on commercial planning, incentive design, capacity allocation, compensation structures, and the economics of major customer and partner decisions.
  • Identify areas where organizational complexity, unclear ownership, poor data, or broken processes are preventing execution, and fix them.
  • Build scalable systems rather than one-time analyses: when a problem matters repeatedly, establish the process, tooling, ownership, and metrics required to solve it permanently.

Build for Scale Without Building Bureaucracy

  • Design the financial and operating infrastructure required to scale the company to $1B+ in revenue while keeping the organization lean, fast, and capital-efficient.
  • Understand what world-class looks like at scale, while exercising strong judgment about what the company needs now versus later.
  • Build lightweight, durable systems before adding headcount or complexity.
  • Use automation, AI, existing tools, and better processes aggressively before defaulting to new systems or larger teams.
  • Continuously evaluate organizational leverage: where another person or system creates meaningful enterprise value—and where greater rigor, automation, or clearer ownership is the better answer.
  • Develop existing team members while selectively adding talent where additional capability creates meaningful leverage.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of exceptional performance across strategic finance, finance & strategy, FP&A, business operations, investment banking, private equity, consulting, or similarly rigorous analytical and operating environments.
  • A clear trajectory of increasing responsibility. We care less about years accumulated than evidence that exceptional organizations and leaders repeatedly trusted you with larger, harder, and more important problems.
  • Ideally, a combination of rigorous early-career analytical training and meaningful operating experience within a high-growth technology, commerce, payments, marketplace, or platform business.
  • Experience operating through meaningful scale, ideally with exposure to a company growing through the hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue, while maintaining the ability and willingness to work hands-on in a lean environment.
  • Exceptional financial modeling and analytical capability. You can personally build and interrogate a complex model, but your value comes from determining what the analysis means and what the company should do because of it.
  • Deep understanding of forecasting, scenario analysis, unit economics, pricing, capital allocation, investment returns, and business-case development.
  • Strong commercial instincts. You understand that Finance exists to improve business decisions, not simply explain historical performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to build KPI frameworks, operating cadences, and performance-management systems that actually change organizational behavior.
  • Demonstrated judgment around organizational scale: you understand the difference between the infrastructure required today and the infrastructure required at future scale.
  • A player-coach mentality. You are comfortable setting the architecture, leading the team, and personally getting into the model or data when required.
  • Strong executive presence and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You can challenge senior leaders, simplify complicated issues, defend a point of view with data, and make a clear recommendation rather than merely presenting analysis.
  • High intellectual curiosity, low ego, and a natural tendency to go several layers deeper than the question initially asked.
  • Advanced Excel / Sheets capability and strong comfort with BI and analytical tooling. SQL is helpful but not required.
  • Fluency with modern AI tools and agents, with a demonstrated ability to use technology to materially increase personal and team leverage.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $260,000 - $300,000 annually. Factors which may affect the starting pay within this range include skills, experience, and other qualifications aligned with Updater's internal leveling guidelines.

About Updater

Updater is a leading technology platform helping major brands acquire and retain customers at scale. We are on a mission to power millions of complex transactions through intelligent, autonomous systems. By combining deep integrations, real-world data, and purpose-built AI agents, we’re transforming fragmented purchasing workflows into seamless, automated experiences – freeing businesses and consumers from operational friction and enabling a new standard of speed, accuracy, and scale.

Updater has raised over $450 million from leading investors, including SoftBank Capital, Vista Credit Partners, IA Ventures, Commerce Ventures, Second Century Ventures (the strategic investment arm of the National Association of Realtors®), and more. For more information, please visit www.updater.com.

Updater is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants regardless of color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, actual or presumed belonging to an ethnic group, or any other legally protected status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Guardify helps criminal justice teams use technology to accelerate justice and healing for survivors of crime. We are a mission-driven, fast-growing software company that uses modern technology to change how the public sector works.

Guardify is a sustainable social enterprise that got its start working with Child Advocacy Centers to protect sensitive child forensic interview evidence. Today, Guardify provides a secure, cloud-based platform that lets justice teams manage interviews, cases, and evidence in one connected system.

Your Role

As a quota-carrying Account Manager for Public Safety, you will own Guardify’s relationships with prosecutor’s offices and law enforcement agencies. You’ll drive renewals, adoption, expansion, and referrals within those accounts. You’ll also be an active part of our new business engine: prospecting into agencies and booking qualified meetings for our Account Executive. This role suits someone who builds lasting relationships with existing customers and also enjoys opening doors with new ones.

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of prosecutor’s office and law enforcement accounts, and be their trusted advisor and main point of contact.

  • Drive on-time renewals by working within each agency’s budget cycle, fiscal year, and procurement process.

  • Track adoption and usage, and run regular business reviews that show results and uncover opportunities for expansion and new products.

  • Expand accounts to new units, divisions, and partner agencies, such as detectives, special victims units, and neighboring jurisdictions.

  • Turn satisfied customers into references, case studies, and referrals.

  • Bring customer feedback to Product, Engineering, Support, and Onboarding to improve retention and the customer experience.

  • Research and prospect into target agencies, including the law enforcement and prosecutor partners of our existing Child Advocacy Center customers.

  • Run outbound outreach by phone, email, and LinkedIn to book qualified meetings for our Account Executive.

  • Follow up on inbound leads, event contacts, and marketing campaigns, and qualify interest before handing off.

  • Support Guardify at public safety conferences and trade shows.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date for both account and pipeline activity.

Requirements

About You

  • 3–5 years of experience in account management, customer success, or business development, preferably in govtech, SaaS, or public safety technology.

  • Experience working with or inside law enforcement, prosecutor’s offices, or the broader criminal justice system is strongly preferred; related experience in child advocacy or social services is also valuable.

  • Understanding of how government agencies buy, including budget cycles, procurement, RFPs, and grant funding.

  • Familiarity with digital evidence, case management, or chain-of-custody workflows is a plus.

  • A track record of meeting or exceeding renewal, expansion, or pipeline goals.

  • Comfort with outbound prospecting, including cold calls and emails to people who don’t know Guardify yet.

  • Credibility with sworn officers, prosecutors, and agency leaders, plus the patience to work through slow, multi-stakeholder decisions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Proficiency with HubSpot or a similar CRM and sales engagement tools.

  • Organized, self-directed, and comfortable splitting time between account work and prospecting.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites and conferences as needed.

Highlights

Build strong customer relationships, drive renewals and account growth, and help customers maximize the value of Guardify while making an impact in the communities we serve.

Toolbx · Job description

Growth Marketing Manager

Reports to the Senior Director of Growth · Full-time, permanent · Remote

About Toolbx

Contractors count on independent building suppliers every day. Many are family-run businesses that compete with national chains by knowing their customers and helping them get the job done.

Toolbx brings their contractor accounts, ordering, quoting, online storefront and payments together. Contractors can order and pay from their phones, while supplier teams spend less time entering orders and chasing payments. Toolbx connects with the ERP systems suppliers already use.

Forge AI is the assistant in Toolbx that helps supplier teams get work done, so less of their day goes on manual tasks. With AI Order Entry, it turns emailed material lists, takeoffs and PDFs into quotes for the team to review and send to their ERP. We're building Forge to take on more of the work supplier teams do every day.

More than 200 building suppliers use Toolbx across 1,000+ locations. We work with buying groups including Do it Best, LBM Advantage and LMC, and we're expanding beyond lumber and building materials into new verticals.

The role

Toolbx is hiring a Growth Marketing Manager, reporting to our Senior Director of Growth. You will find the independent building suppliers most likely to become customers and turn them into pipelines with Sales. You will own the acquisition plan and channel decisions, manage the approved demand budget and deliver a quarterly sourced-pipeline target. Your primary channels are in-person events and named-account outreach, supported by paid media, search and the website. You will work with Product Marketing & Brand on positioning, content and the marketing plan. We're looking for someone analytical and fast-moving who wants to help independent suppliers use technology to grow and compete.

What you will own

  • Build the quarterly acquisition plan within the integrated marketing plan, and agree sourced-pipeline targets with Sales
  • Segment audiences, then set up, launch and manage acquisition campaigns
  • Run ABM programs to named accounts, agreeing account selection, offers and follow-up with Sales
  • Design outbound plays with Sales for named accounts, including targeting, offers and sequence content. Sales and SDRs run the outreach.
  • Run the trade show, conference and field event calendar, from selection and budget to outreach, lead capture and follow-up
  • Support buying-group and association partnerships with partner events and member outreach
  • Set up, promote and follow up on prospect webinars
  • Own prospect email and nurture programs, from build and send to optimization, using content from Product Marketing
  • Run paid media, search and social in support of events and ABM, and test referrals
  • Own website conversion performance and SEO, including campaign landing pages, forms, analytics and conversion tests
  • Build and maintain ICP target lists, scoring and campaign workflows in HubSpot, with agreed Sales handoff rules
  • Write and test ad, email and landing-page copy, and roll out what wins
  • Support launches, content and customer programs with targeting, distribution and lead capture
  • Work within Product Marketing’s positioning and messaging. Product Marketing owns page content, product content and webinar content; this role owns targeting, distribution and conversion.
  • Allocate the demand budget across channels based on results and sales feedback
  • Track campaign sources and results so channels can be compared
  • Review pipeline weekly with Sales and report monthly on spend, pipeline and conversion
  • Use and improve the team’s AI workflows for research, campaign production and reporting
  • Manage agencies and freelancers
  • Lead, coach and support the Marketing Coordinator

Your first 90 days

  • Audit current acquisition campaigns and channel performance, and present what to keep, cut, test and grow
  • Take over the acquisition campaigns and events in progress, including their committed budget
  • Agree the sourced-pipeline definition, quarterly target and reporting baseline with Sales
  • Launch an ABM pilot with Sales on a set of named accounts
  • Set up the weekly pipeline review and monthly channel report

How success will be measured

  • Sourced qualified pipeline ($) against quarterly target
  • Cost per qualified opportunity and CAC payback
  • Conversion from sourced opportunity to closed-won customer
  • MQL to SQL to opportunity conversion rates
  • Pipeline and ROI per event

You are a strong candidate if you

  • Have 5+ years in B2B marketing, ideally with a SaaS or platform product
  • Have marketed to a traditional, relationship-driven industry; construction, distribution, wholesale or similar is an asset
  • Have owned a sourced-pipeline target and can walk us through the numbers, including what missed and what you changed
  • Have run trade shows, field events and ABM, and know how to allocate budget across channels
  • Have marketed into a defined market of named accounts rather than high-volume lead gen
  • Are hands-on with HubSpot, Google and LinkedIn Ads, and GA4. Experience with ABM tools is a plus.
  • Have designed A/B tests, written the copy for them, and can explain what changed as a result
  • Are comfortable working directly with Sales and treat pipeline, not impressions, as the scoreboard
  • Have coached team members and coordinated agencies or freelancers
  • Use AI tools daily, with a clear process for checking their output
  • Spot upcoming challenges early and act on them
  • Make hard, fast decisions in a data-driven environment
  • Collaborate well with cross-functional teams

Why join us?

  • Competitive compensation with opportunity for growth and equity eligibility
  • Comprehensive benefits plan
  • Quarterly virtual team events
  • No formal dress code, and we'll give you Toolbx swag to rock
  • Experience with a fast-growing start-up
  • A chance to make a huge impact in the trillion-dollar construction industry
  • Outstanding company culture

Compensation, travel and terms

Salary range

Competitive

Travel

Occasional travel to industry events

Terms of employment

Full-time, permanent

Location of work

Remote

Job Description: Tax Preparer – Individual Income Tax (Form 1040), TY2025 (EA/CPA)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote – United States

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Enrolled Agents (EAs) and Certified Public Accountants (CPAs) who actively prepare individual income tax returns to contribute to an AI training and evaluation project.

In this role, you will apply your practical tax preparation expertise to prepare complex individual tax returns, develop realistic tax scenarios, and evaluate AI-generated tax computations for accuracy and completeness.

No prior AI experience is required. Your professional tax knowledge and hands-on preparation experience are what matter.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Prepare complete federal individual income tax returns (Form 1040) from scratch under Tax Year 2025 (TY2025) rules, including relevant worksheets, phase-outs, limitations, and carryovers.
  2. Write clear and concise preparer notes explaining how each figure on the return was calculated, ensuring every amount is traceable and reproducible.
  3. Develop realistic, self-contained tax scenarios involving complex returns, including self-employment income, partnership and S-corporation K-1s, investments, and tax credits.
  4. Specify relevant facts, dates, filing status, and expected results for each tax scenario.
  5. Review AI-generated tax returns and calculations for accuracy and completeness, identifying and classifying errors as critical, secondary, or minor.
  6. Identify ambiguities, exceptions, and conflicts in tax laws or IRS guidance, documenting findings through structured written feedback.
  7. For Expert and Adjudicator levels, strengthen and audit scenarios, review submitted work, and resolve disputed outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  1. Active Enrolled Agent (EA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.
  2. Current hands-on experience preparing individual income tax returns (Form 1040).
  3. Minimum of 3 tax seasons of experience handling complex returns involving Schedule C, K-1s, investments, and tax credits.
  4. Strong working knowledge of Tax Year 2025 (TY2025) tax rules.
  5. Ability to independently calculate complete tax returns, including worksheets, phase-outs, limitations, and carryovers.
  6. Ability to explain tax calculations through clear, accurate, and well-documented preparer notes.
  7. Excellent written communication skills, with an emphasis on clarity, objectivity, and reproducibility.

About Us

We are a stealth-stage fund and tech startup operating at the intersection of alternative markets and quantitative strategy. Backed by experienced operators and growing quickly, we are building the infrastructure to scale a high-performance, data-driven business.

Our business is a funnel. People come in at the top, move through several stages of interviewing, verification and setup, and come out the other side ready to work with us. Every stage of that funnel leaks. Closing those leaks is worth more to this company than almost anything else we could do.

The Role

You are the floor manager for that funnel. Four teams, roughly a dozen people, mostly remote and mostly early in their careers. Interviewers, onboarding specialists, document reviewers and hardware technicians.

Your job is daily output. Every one of those teams has a number, most of those numbers are below where they should be, and your week is spent finding out why and fixing it. Some of the fixes are coaching. Some are scheduling. Some are process. Some are tooling you will spec and hand to an engineer.

This is a hands-on, numbers-in-front-of-you job, not a strategy job. If you like watching a conversion rate move because of something you changed on Tuesday, you will enjoy it.

What You'll Do

Own the daily numbers. Every team, every day. You will know before anyone asks whether we are ahead or behind and why.

Lift conversion at every stage. Our biggest single lever is how many booked interviews people actually show up to. Our second biggest is how many people who start onboarding finish it. Both are yours.

Keep the queue moving. Nobody should sit at a stage waiting on us. Where a single person is the bottleneck, you find the way around it.

Manage a remote, early-career team well. Clear expectations, real coaching, and the direct conversation in the same week a number is missed rather than a month later.

Bring the cost down. Same output, less spend per person we take through. You will know your unit economics.

Fix the tooling or spec the fix. Some of what slows your teams down is software. You will not build it, but you will write a clear, specific request and follow it through.

Requirements

  • You have run daily operations for a high-volume team, ideally at a gig-economy platform, a fulfillment or production operation, or a fintech onboarding function
  • You are obsessed with data. You live in the dashboard, you manage by numbers, and you can spot a bad week on Wednesday rather than the following Monday
  • You are a direct manager. You will have the difficult conversation early, and stay effective with that person afterwards
  • You are resilient under volume. When the queue is backed up and three things break at once, you sequence rather than spiral
  • You hold the standard without turning every enforcement into a conflict

  • You are effective managing people you never see in person

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • A clear growth path as the operation scales and more layers are added below you
  • A flat team with no red tape between you and the decision maker

Job Description: Tax Preparer – Individual Income Tax (Form 1040), TY2025 (EA/CPA)

Role Type: Contractor

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Enrolled Agents (EAs) and Certified Public Accountants (CPAs) who actively prepare individual income tax returns to contribute to an AI training and evaluation project.

In this role, you will apply your practical tax preparation expertise to prepare complex individual tax returns, develop realistic tax scenarios, and evaluate AI-generated tax computations for accuracy and completeness.

No prior AI experience is required. Your professional tax knowledge and hands-on preparation experience are what matter.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Prepare complete federal individual income tax returns (Form 1040) from scratch under Tax Year 2025 (TY2025) rules, including relevant worksheets, phase-outs, limitations, and carryovers.
  2. Write clear and concise preparer notes explaining how each figure on the return was calculated, ensuring every amount is traceable and reproducible.
  3. Develop realistic, self-contained tax scenarios involving complex returns, including self-employment income, partnership and S-corporation K-1s, investments, and tax credits.
  4. Specify relevant facts, dates, filing status, and expected results for each tax scenario.
  5. Review AI-generated tax returns and calculations for accuracy and completeness, identifying and classifying errors as critical, secondary, or minor.

WSA 는 난청인들이 소리를 통해 윤택한 삶을 영위하도록 돕는 기술을 개척하는 데 140여 년간의 경험을 통합하여 난청으로 고통 받는 모든 사람들에게 청력의 기적을 돌려주고 성장할 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다.

이러한 과정은 매우 보람 있는 일이며 우리가 하는 모든 일의 원동력입니다. 우리의 목표는 모든 사람들의 삶에서 멋진 사운드를 만들어 잠재력을 이끌어내는 것입니다.

WSA 는 오늘날 전 세계 사람들이 착용하는 보청기 3개 중 1개를 제조하고 있으며, 130개 이상의 시장에서 활동하며 전 세계적으로 12,000명의 직원을 고용하고 있습니다.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Lead Software Engineer, TM1 Marketing & APIs

Location: Remote, United Kingdom

Division: TM1 Marketing & APIs

Contract Terms: Permanent, 40hours per week

THE TEAM

The TM1 Marketing & APIs team is Ticketmaster’s marketing team producing systems to allow our clients to unlock the power of data to make decisions regarding marketing to our fans.

THE JOB

Ticketmaster Marketing team is looking for an experienced, motivated, and self-driven candidate who can contribute towards various aspects of taking our offering to the next level and building out our new API systems to provide data to our marketing partners and clients. This involves design, development, and production support of the systems as well as working with product teams and other engineering teams in shaping the future of the application.

Now is an exciting time to join the team and make a real difference as well as showcase your design and architecture skills as we shape the next generation of data in ticketing with intelligent profile, AI initiatives, integration with various components of the TM ecosystem, and overall, building a world-class system. If you are the sort of person that enjoys a fast-paced work environment, is able to quickly pick-up cutting-edge technologies and product concepts, and has the desire to experiment with and evaluate new technological paths forward, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Design and develop new systems and implement enhancements to existing systems, breaking down complex problems into essential components and building efficient solutions.
  • Work with product teams to gather and understand requirements, discuss approaches, design solutions based on the requirements and create design documents for implementation keeping in mind costs, capacity, shelf-life and choosing the right tools and technologies.
  • Design and develop high-traffic, large scale software applications as a full-stack developer - systems ranging from front-end UI, web and API services, data models and data flow processes, infrastructure for deploying and long-term maintenance of the systems.
  • Design and develop peripheral systems and processes - monitoring and alerting services, automated build and deployment pipelines, systems for gathering application performance metrics, ensuring efficiency in cost.
  • Ensure best practices in system development ranging from test coverage, use of enterprise standards, adherence to target architecture, high-availability and scalability, low latency, and fault-tolerance, thus ensuring delivery of high-quality systems.
  • Create detailed documentation on systems as well as processes ranging from checklists for onboarding new hires, comprehensive overview of systems, runbooks for developing, monitoring and troubleshooting system issues and recommendations on future improvements.
  • Own solution design discussions and meetings to ensure systems are aligned in the bigger scheme of things. Also evaluating new tools and technologies for feasibility, cost and subsequent use in the company and teams
  • Leading teams in development of new systems and new initiatives by executing the duties mentioned above as well as guiding, mentoring and in general helping team members in learning applications, technologies, best practices and processes. Reviewing code for quality, correctness and efficiency.
  • Owning project delivery from a day-to-day standpoint – participating in daily agile stand-ups, escalating blockers to stakeholders, ensuring timely completion of tasks & overall project & spring goals. Communicating updates to stakeholders and working with them on timelines.
  • Recognized as a subject matter expert who shapes technical standards and practices beyond the immediate team.
  • Influences technical strategy and roadmaps through collaboration with other Tech Leads, architects, product teams, and senior stakeholders.
  • Drives adoption of reusable engineering patterns and improvements across related teams.
  • Represents the team in cross-functional technical decisions and communicates the wider implications of proposed approaches.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

Need to know / be able to do

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages –Java, Typescript, NodeJS and willingness to learn the others.
  • Proven years of experience in building high-traffic web applications and deploying to production with a focus on quality and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience in working with cloud-based platforms (preferably AWS).
  • Experience supporting live applications - good debugging skills, reading logs, reading application dashboards like Grafana / AWS monitors (e.g., CloudWatch) - identifying issues and solving them efficiently.
  • Experience writing SQL queries, working with SQL (e.g., MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., DynamoDB).
  • Experience working with Infrastructure as code tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm.
  • Experience working with code and build tools like Gitlab, CI/CD, Jenkins, and Sonar.
  • Experience working in an Agile team - attending stand-ups, delivering work in a time-boxed setting, etc...
  • Ability to work under some pressure e.g., handling production issues, on-call support for live systems, etc...

An overall calm personality - ability to see the big picture and how the current team / task / project fits into it.

Nice to know / good to have

  • UI design experience, building client facing data applications
  • Experience in the entertainment and/or online ticketing industry
  • Familiarity with operating across diverse cultural and regulatory environments (Europe, Asia, South America)
  • Understanding of your own usage of AI (Claude or similar) in the SDLC

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Strong verbal communication, ability to clearly communicate ideas, work status, advocate for (or against) a particular approach or design.
  • Documentation skills - ability to make the path easier for new team members / new hires / interns by organizing knowledge in Confluence, wiki, or similar.
  • Ability to manage self and own time, deliver work on time, evaluate and estimate work.
  • Ability to work with various teams, including tech and product, incorporate their inputs into the work being done, and manage expectations on issues & enhancements.
  • Experience running teams on a day to day basis (Not people management) and can provide examples of how you’ve handled various scenarios when running those teams.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

HIRING PRACTICES

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.
