As a TV, Video, Audio & Display (TVAD) Strategist, you will plan and improve full‑funnel TV, video, audio, and display programs to grow new customers, revenue, and LTV, while keeping efficiency on track. You’ll translate data and media learnings into clear decisions, run practical innovations, and scale what works. You’ll rely heavily on Bliss Point insights (Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Brand Equity, Creative Insights, Customer Insights) to focus investment where it performs best, and you’ll partner closely with Client Leadership, Media investment, Econometrics, Creative, and other channel teams (e.g. Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media) in your Pod. Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric

  • Lead day‑to‑day client strategy and execution; present growth‑focused updates and QBRs that connect media to business outcomes (revenue, CAC, LTV, incremental reach).

The Tinuiti Way

  • Pair strong TVAD craft (audience/data sources, inventory quality, frequency/overlap control, brand safety/attention) with growing multi‑channel understanding

  • Connect TVAD with Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media, CRM, and Creative to amplify growth, teach clients and teams, and codify playbooks.

Product‑Led

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Principal Engineer

Location: Remote, United Kingdom

Division: TM1 Data Apps

Contract Terms: Permanent, 40hours per week

THE TEAM

The TM1 Data Apps area is a group of Ticketmaster teams that provides Reporting, Marketing and Real Time data insights to our clients and partners, following a recent restructure the teams are now focused on working towards a common data source and accelerating our development of features and capabilities for our clients.

THE JOB

Ticketmaster Data Apps is looking for an experienced, motivated, and self-driven candidate who can work across the teams to foster collaboration, introduce best practices, share learnings and support the Engineering Director with designing and engineering larger initiatives within the teams.

Now is an exciting time to join the team and make a real difference as well as showcase your design and architecture skills as we shape the next generation of data in ticketing with intelligent profile, AI initiatives, integration with various components of the TM ecosystem, and overall, building a world-class system. If you are the sort of person that enjoys a fast-paced work environment, is able to quickly pick-up cutting-edge technologies and product concepts, and has the desire to experiment with and evaluate new technological paths forward, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Design and develop new systems and implement enhancements to existing systems, breaking down complex problems into essential components and building efficient solutions.
  • Work with product teams to understand large units of development and the impact on the teams specifically to identify areas of reuse across the teams to eliminate wasteful development.
  • Own and evolve technical strategy and architectural direction across all three teams.
  • Review existing infrastructure and work with the teams to enhance and refactor to modern architectures again focusing on resuse and simplification, develop and design high-traffic, large scale software applications and data flow processes, infrastructure for deploying and long-term maintenance of the systems.
  • Design and develop peripheral systems and processes - monitoring and alerting services, automated build and deployment pipelines, systems for gathering application performance metrics, ensuring efficiency in cost.
  • Push best practices in system development ranging from test coverage, use of enterprise standards, adherence to target architecture, high-availability and scalability, low latency, and fault-tolerance, thus ensuring delivery of high-quality systems.
  • Establish shared engineering standards, patterns, and guardrails, and ensure their consistent adoption across the wider function.
  • Identify systemic technical risks and dependencies that span multiple products or teams, and lead their resolution.
  • Work with the teams to design and build a comprehensive QA platform/solution to ensure quality and speed of delivery.
  • Own solution design discussions and meetings to ensure systems are aligned in the bigger scheme of things. Also evaluating new tools and technologies for feasibility, cost and subsequent use in the company and teams
  • Influence longer-term technology decisions and investment priorities with senior engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
  • Ensure that solutions developed within individual teams support enterprise architecture, scalability, reliability, and security objectives.
  • Act as a principal technical advisor on decisions with significant or long-term implications beyond the immediate area.
  • Leading teams in development of new systems and new initiatives by executing the duties mentioned above as well as guiding, mentoring and in general helping team members in learning applications, technologies, best practices and processes. Reviewing code for quality, correctness and efficiency.
  • Owning specific work unit deliveries from a day-to-day standpoint – participating in daily agile stand-ups, escalating blockers to stakeholders, ensuring timely completion of tasks & overall project & spring goals. Communicating updates to stakeholders and working with them on timelines.
  • Working with specific team members to aid them in developing their skills.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

Need to know/be able to do

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages –Java, Typescript, NodeJS and willingness to learn the others.
  • 5+ years of experience in building high-traffic web applications and deploying to production with a focus on quality and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience in working with cloud-based platforms (preferably AWS).
  • Experience supporting live applications - good debugging skills, reading logs, reading application dashboards like Grafana / AWS monitors (e.g., CloudWatch) - identifying issues and solving them efficiently.
  • Experience writing SQL queries, working with SQL (e.g., MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., DynamoDB).
  • Experience working with Infrastructure as code tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm.
  • Experience working with code and build tools like Gitlab, CI/CD, Jenkins, and Sonar.
  • Experience working in an Agile team - attending stand-ups, delivering work in a time-boxed setting, etc...
  • Ability to work under some pressure e.g., handling production issues, on-call support for live systems, etc...

An overall calm personality - ability to see the big picture and how the current team / task / project fits into it.

Nice to know/good to have

  • Experience in the entertainment and/or online ticketing industry
  • Familiarity with operating across diverse cultural and regulatory environments (Europe, Asia, South America)
  • Understanding of your own usage of AI (Claude or similar) in the SDLC

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Strong verbal communication, ability to clearly communicate ideas, work status, advocate for (or against) a particular approach or design.
  • Documentation skills - ability to make the path easier for new team members / new hires / interns by organizing knowledge in Confluence, wiki, or similar.
  • Ability to manage self and own time, deliver work on time, evaluate and estimate work.
  • Ability to work with various teams, including tech and product, incorporate their inputs into the work being done, and manage expectations on issues & enhancements.
  • Experience working across multiple teams and working on cross team projects.
  • Desire and experience mentoring junior members of the teams

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

HIRING PRACTICES

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

jobs.description:
Ingeniero/a Senior de Proyectos Eléctricos

En Grupo Clave estamos colaborando con una compañía de referencia en el sector de la ingeniería y la energía en la búsqueda de un/a Ingeniero/a Senior de Proyectos Eléctricos para incorporarse a su equipo técnico.

Buscamos un perfil con experiencia consolidada en el desarrollo y gestión de proyectos eléctricos, capaz de liderar proyectos de forma autónoma y aportar visión técnica en el ámbito de las infraestructuras energéticas.

Modalidad de trabajo: Teletrabajo

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Liderar y desarrollar proyectos relacionados con infraestructuras eléctricas, participando en todas las fases del proyecto, desde la ingeniería y tramitación hasta el acompañamiento durante la ejecución.

  • Redacción y supervisión de proyectos de líneas de Alta, Media y Baja Tensión.

  • Diseño y desarrollo de Centros de Transformación y Subestaciones Eléctricas.

  • Elaboración de ingeniería básica y de detalle.

  • Coordinación técnica con clientes, organismos, suministradoras y equipos de obra.

  • Gestión de presupuestos, documentación técnica y planificación de proyectos.

  • Tramitación administrativa y seguimiento técnico hasta su puesta en marcha.

  • Soporte técnico y acompañamiento a perfiles junior.

¿Qué buscamos?

  • Titulación en Ingeniería Eléctrica, Ingeniería Industrial (especialidad Electricidad) o formación equivalente.

  • Experiencia sólida en proyectos eléctricos, energéticos o de distribución.

  • Conocimiento de normativa eléctrica y tramitación de proyectos.

  • Experiencia en líneas eléctricas, centros de transformación, subestaciones o instalaciones industriales.

  • Manejo de AutoCAD y herramientas técnicas de diseño y cálculo.

  • Capacidad para gestionar proyectos de forma autónoma y coordinar diferentes interlocutores.

  • Disponibilidad para realizar desplazamientos puntuales cuando el proyecto lo requiera.

Valoraremos especialmente

  • Experiencia en compañías de ingeniería, distribución eléctrica o energías renovables.

  • Conocimientos de automatización, protección y control.

  • Experiencia en gestión de equipos o liderazgo técnico de proyectos.

  • Si bien se ofrece teletrabajo, será valorable la predisposición a ir a oficina.

  • Aunque la posición se desarrolla en modalidad de teletrabajo, valoraremos positivamente la predisposición a acudir de manera ocasional a la oficina de Lugo para reuniones de coordinación o seguimiento de proyectos.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Incorporación a una empresa sólida y en crecimiento.

  • Participación en proyectos estratégicos del sector energético.

  • Flexibilidad horaria y modalidad de teletrabajo.

  • Alto grado de autonomía y responsabilidad.

  • Formación continua y desarrollo profesional.

  • Estabilidad laboral.

  • Banda salarial entre 25.000 € y 35.000 € brutos anuales, en función de la experiencia y aportación al puesto.

Ubicación: España | Teletrabajo

Si cuentas con experiencia en proyectos eléctricos y buscas un entorno que te permita asumir nuevos retos profesionales, desarrollar tu carrera y participar en proyectos de alto impacto, queremos conocerte.

Inscríbete o comparte esta oportunidad con profesionales que puedan encajar en el proyecto.

jobs.title: Student - Learn to Be Operations Assistant
jobs.excerpt: Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators.
jobs.description:
Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

The opportunity

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.


Learn To Be is a nonprofit that gives free 1-on-1 online tutoring to K–12 students from under-resourced communities. Every week, some students are waiting for a tutor. As an Operations Assistant, your job is to make sure none of them wait too long. You’ll work with and report to the Learn To Be Operations team.


We’re looking for someone who uses AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude extensively, and not just for homework help or the basic stuff. You’ve built real things with them: an app, an automation, a spreadsheet workflow, a custom GPT, anything. You’d rather figure something out than wait to be told how, and you care about kids getting a fair shot.


Speaking Spanish is a plus, since many of our families speak Spanish at home.


Job Responsibilities

  • Keep track of every student waiting for a tutor, starting with students who come to us through our partner organizations
  • Find out why a student hasn’t been paired yet (no tutor available for that time, subject or grade, or a family that stopped responding) and fix it
  • Follow up with families and tutors by phone, email and text so pairings actually start
  • Use ChatGPT, Claude and similar tools to speed up this work: drafting messages, cleaning up spreadsheets, spotting patterns, building small tools
  • Tell the Operations team what’s broken in the process and help fix it.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current enrollment in classes as part of a SNHU degree program
  • Work study part of financial aid package
  • Students with work study may be prioritized
  • Able to work 15–20 hours every week, reliably and predictably, including during midterms and finals
  • Experience using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude to build something real
  • Clear, friendly written communication and comfortable making phone calls to parents and volunteers
  • Consent to a DOJ Dru Sjodin Sex Offender Database Background check
  • Have access to a device with internet access and a working webcam

Learning Outcomes (NACE Competencies)

  • Develop Communication skills through phone, email and text conversations with families, volunteer tutors and Learn To Be staff
  • Enhance Technology skills by using AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to draft messages, organize data and build small tools that solve real problems
  • Improve Critical Thinking by figuring out why each student is still waiting for a tutor and deciding how to fix it
  • Build Professionalism through reliable weekly hours and follow-through on every family you contact
  • Strengthen Teamwork skills by working closely with the Operations team
  • Develop Equity & Inclusion awareness by working with families from many different backgrounds and communities

Work Schedule
15-20 hours per week on a consistent, reliable schedule set with Learn To Be’s Operations team. Late afternoons and evenings are a plus as that is when families are easiest to reach.


We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.


If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to fully engage in any part of the application or hiring process, please complete the Accommodation Request form or contact us at 603-626-9447. A member from the Employee Accommodation Support Center will be in contact with you within two business days to discuss your request.


Compensation


The hourly pay range for this position is $13.00 - $15.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations.

jobs.excerpt: INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands.
jobs.description:
INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

jobs.title: Head of Technical Content
jobs.excerpt: About UsTameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online.
jobs.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Highlights

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.

jobs.description:
Purpose of the role:

The Senior Technology Delivery Lead is accountable for the successful delivery of complex technology solutions and services, combining deep technical expertise, people leadership, commercial judgement and senior client engagement.
This is a hands-on technology leadership role. The successful candidate will operate comfortably at both strategic and technical levels, working directly with architects, engineers and platform specialists to challenge designs, technology choices and delivery approaches. They will lead multidisciplinary teams and ensure solutions are technically robust, secure, scalable, commercially viable and aligned to client and business outcomes.

Job title:

Technical Delivery Director

Job Description:

*MUST BE ELIGIBLE FOR SC CLEARNACE*


What you'll be doing:


Technology Leadership & Technical Delivery

  • Own end-to-end technology delivery across complex programmes and services, from mobilization, discovery and solution design through implementation, transition and live operation.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, working with architects, engineers and specialists to review and challenge solution designs, technology choices and delivery approaches.
  • Maintain sufficient technical depth to identify design weaknesses, delivery risks and operational issues before they affect outcomes.
  • Ensure solutions address scalability, resilience, security, performance, interoperability, operability, maintainability and cost.
  • Drive resolution of complex technical issues, remove delivery blockers and uphold appropriate engineering and architecture standards.
  • Balance strategic technology direction with practical implementation, delivery constraints and client priorities.

Cloud, Hyperscaler & Enterprise Platform Leadership

  • Work effectively with major cloud, hyperscaler and enterprise platform providers, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Salesforce and ServiceNow, together with their partner ecosystems.
  • Collaborate with platform providers, alliance partners and internal architecture teams on solution architecture, technology roadmaps and complex client opportunities, including Salesforce, Mulesoft, Snowflake and others.
  • Challenge whether proposed solutions make appropriate use of native platform capabilities, integrations, automation and security controls.
  • Prevent unnecessary complexity, vendor lock-in, duplicated capability, technical debt and avoidable run cost.
  • Assess platform and partner proposals against business outcomes, technical fit, delivery risk, commercial value and long-term sustainability.

Client & Senior Stakeholder Leadership

  • Act as a trusted senior technology partner to clients and internal leaders, translating complex technical matters into clear business, operational and commercial implications.
  • Engage credibly with CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects and business executives, as well as senior representatives from strategic technology partners.
  • Constructively challenge client and stakeholder assumptions where proposed requirements or solutions could create unnecessary cost, risk, complexity or technical debt.
  • Present credible alternatives supported by evidence, technical reasoning and a clear understanding of desired business outcomes.
  • Create alignment across technology, operations, commercial and business stakeholders where priorities or viewpoints conflict.
  • Be an excellent communicator that drives decisions and outcomes.

Delivery, Risk & Governance

  • Take accountability for delivery outcomes, quality, timelines, dependencies, risks and commercial commitments.
  • Establish proportionate technology governance that supports pace and control without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Proactively identify technical, operational, security and delivery risks and ensure effective mitigation and escalation.
  • Provide clear, evidence-based reporting to senior leadership and clients.
  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering quality, delivery practices and technology operations.

What we're looking for:


Essential Experience:

  • Significant senior-level experience delivering large-scale, complex enterprise technology solutions or services.
  • A strong technical background with evidence of remaining hands-on and technically engaged while operating in a senior leadership role.
  • Demonstrable experience working with major platforms and ecosystems such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Salesforce, Snowflake and ServiceNow.
  • Experience engaging directly with hyperscalers, software vendors, strategic partners and systems integrators on architecture, roadmaps and client solutions.
  • Broad understanding of cloud, SaaS/PaaS, applications, APIs and integration, data platforms, cybersecurity, infrastructure, automation and DevOps.
  • Proven experience making, reviewing or challenging significant architecture and technology decisions.
  • Experience applying Agile, DevOps and relevant IT service-management principles in complex delivery environments.
  • Proven experience leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams, including managers and senior specialists.
  • Strong client-facing experience, including constructive challenge of senior stakeholders on technology strategy and solution direction.
  • Strong commercial judgement, connecting technical choices with cost, risk, scalability, service performance and customer outcomes.
  • Experience working with regulated industries and/or the public sector

Qualifications & Professional Development:

  • Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience is expected.
  • Architecture, cloud, platform, security, Agile or service-management certifications are advantageous where supported by demonstrable delivery experience. Examples may include AWS, Microsoft Azure, Salesforce, ServiceNow, TOGAF, ITIL or recognised Agile/DevOps certifications.

Leadership Profile:

  • A technologist first, not solely a programme or delivery manager.
  • Able to move seamlessly between detailed design discussions and executive-level client conversations.
  • Confident to challenge senior stakeholders while remaining constructive, evidence-led and collaborative.
  • Combines technical depth, commercial judgement, people leadership and client credibility.

How this aligns to our Capita's values:

  • Customer First, always: Builds trusted client partnerships and delivers secure, scalable and commercially sound technology solutions that are driven by customer needs and measurable business outcomes.
  • Fearless Innovation: Challenges conventional thinking and uses evolving technologies, cloud platforms and engineering practices to simplify solutions, reduce technical debt and continuously improve delivery.
  • Achieve Together: Brings together multidisciplinary teams, clients, technology partners and senior stakeholders to solve complex problems collaboratively and deliver shared outcomes.
  • Everyone is Valued: Creates an inclusive environment where people are empowered to contribute, challenge assumptions, develop their capabilities and take ownership of technology decisions and outcomes.

🤝 Customer first, always​🧑‍💻 Fearless innovation​✅ Achieve together​💙 Everyone is valued


Join Capita – Where Innovation Meets Opportunity


Capita is a dynamic leader in consulting and digital services, helping some of the UK’s most recognized organizations transform and thrive. We use cutting-edge technology and fearless innovation to create smarter, more efficient solutions that make a real difference. jobs.title: Patient Support Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services.
jobs.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.


Position Type: Full-Time | Remote | Hourly, Non-Exempt

Compensation: $20 / hour

Schedule: 40 hours per week withfull-time shifts Monday - Thursday between 8:30am - 8pm CST (preferred 11:30am - 8pm CST); Saturday - Sunday between 8:00am - 5:30pm CST


Who We Are

Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our mission is to empower our patients to live healthier, more rewarding lives through accessible, affordable, and effective mental healthcare tailored to their needs. Our Patient Support Center is the front door to that care, often a patient’s first human connection with Geode and the first step in removing barriers between someone seeking help and the provider who can support them.


The Role


The Patient Support Specialist is a high-impact, phone-first role at the heart of patient access and acquisition. You are an ambassador for patients and care teams and the first voice many prospective patients hear and a key partner in helping them move from interest or referral to a scheduled first visit. You’ll turn high-intent inbound calls, referral callbacks, and web leads into appointments while delivering a warm, hospitality-driven experience. A smaller share of your day is spent helping established patients by resolving simple requests or routing them to the right team.

This is a fast-paced, quality-focused environment for people who care deeply about both outcomes and experience. You’ll use strong virtual human connection, sound judgment, and customer-centric problem solving to remove barriers to care, connect each patient to the right provider, and help activate a trusted relationship with their care team. If you bring empathy, urgency, and a growth mindset, and believe every call is an opportunity to help someone take the next step, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do


Convert High-Intent Inbound Calls

  • Answer new patient inbound calls, including referral callbacks and consumer leads with warmth, urgency, and a bias toward booking the first visit.
  • Match each patient to the right provider using screening questions, insurance, provider preferences, and scheduling tools to secure the best-fit appointment.
  • Guide ambivalent or hesitant callers toward a confident “yes” using empathy, reflective listening, communication frameworks and sound judgment while removing barriers without pressure.
  • Set clear expectations for the first visit so patients arrive informed, comfortable, and ready to attend.
  • Collaborate with internal teams when needed to resolve open questions and create a seamless handoff for patients and providers.

Support Established Patients

  • Handle a smaller volume of established-patient contacts, resolving simple requests or routing to the right team quickly and accurately.
  • Capture complete, accurate patient context and insurance information; follow up to close any gaps.

Grow Through Coaching & Quality

  • Work toward individual and team goals for conversion, answer rate/service level, quality, and after-call work, using feedback and performance insights to keep improving.
  • Welcome regular call auditing and coaching as fuel for growth; apply feedback quickly and consistently.
  • Document every interaction accurately in our systems with the right context and a clear next step for each patient.

Own Patient Experience

  • Create a calm, personalized experience that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.
  • Protect patient privacy by maintaining strict confidentiality and following HIPAA and all privacy requirements.
  • Flex with changing workflows, volumes, and schedules while supporting the broader team as needs shift.

Who You Are

  • A hospitality-minded people person - you make others feel genuinely cared for and you love creating great experiences.
  • Motivated by goals and comfortable using feedback and performance insights to improve.
  • A persuasive, empathetic communicator who can navigate emotional or complex conversations with calm and confidence.
  • You stay organized and calm while handling multiple systems, changing priorities, and a high volume of calls.
  • Coachable and self-aware - you welcome feedback, know your strengths, and actively develop your areas of opportunity.
  • Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

What You Bring

  • 1–3+ years in a customer-facing, phone-based, or hospitality role; healthcare, call center, or sales/conversion experience is a strong plus.
  • Comfort working in a goal-oriented, quality-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with insurance plans and benefits, or the ability to learn them quickly (preferred).
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to navigate multiple systems while maintaining a warm, focused conversation with the patient.
  • A quiet, professional remote workspace and reliable connectivity.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.

At Geode Health, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible schedule

  • In-person and virtual patient visits

  • Comprehensive admin support (front office, accounting, finance, payroll, HR, etc)

  • Professional development opportunities

  • Clinical community, support, and leadership

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Life insurance

  • Short and long-term disability

  • Paid vacation and holidays

  • Matching 401k plan

  • State of the art technology

Why work for Geode Health?

At Geode Health, we take our commitment to patients and providers seriously. We focus every day on how to help patients across the United States get the best possible mental health care available. To achieve this, we focus on ensuring our providers have unmatched support and resources so that they can focus on providing great care. We are backed by KKR, a leading private equity firm with the experience and mission alignment to truly make an impact. Joining Geode Health will put you on the front-end of a rapidly growing movement to increase access and improve outcomes for mental health patients and providers across the nation.

To learn more, visit us as

Geode Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences of our workforce.

$20.00-$20.00

Job Description

A bit more about this role:


This position represents an amazing opportunity for a nurse practitioner or physician assistant with specialization in nephrology who has a big heart and entrepreneurial spirit and is committed to improving outcomes for people with chronic kidney disease.


Devoted Medical is building a next generation, value based, virtual-first CKD clinic that dramatically expands access to specialty care for America's most vulnerable seniors. The clinic will focus on delaying time to progression of CKD 4 and 5, and increasing the proportion of planned rather than emergency dialysis starts for Devoted Medical patients. The Chronic Kidney Disease Clinic is one of several of Devoted Medical’s virtual specialty care programs that are designed as “micro centers of excellence” that deliver highly tailored, specialized care to patients with specific chronic conditions– e.g. diabetes, congestive heart failure, hypertension, etc.


Responsibilities will include:

  • Your primary focus will be to deliver direct nephrology care to CKD patients to ensure medication optimization, manage electrolytes and volume status, facilitate shared decision making around goals of care, and ensure effective planning for vascular access or PD catheter placement for optimal dialysis initiation.
  • You will collaborate closely with other members of the nephrology care team including physicians, social workers, pharmacists, clinical assistants. You will interface closely with family members and caregivers to coordinate holistic care for the member, ensure continuity of care and deliver a collaborative care plan.
  • You will participate in regular panel review discussions to offer advice and provide guidance around medical management.
  • Perform comprehensive assessments including comprehensive diagnosis/disease review, medication review, and assessment for quality of care (STARS/HEDIS) interventions as well as social and home health/DME needs.
  • Utilize our home grown electronic health information system for visits while also providing feedback on how to improve the interface.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records, ensuring compliance with relevant legal and ethical guidelines.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and ongoing professional development to stay current on best practices and advancements in kidney care.
  • Adhere to all relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards, including patient privacy and telehealth regulations.

Attributes to success:

  • Skilled NP or PA with thorough understanding of nephrology management including disease process, treatment modalities, medication management and lifestyle modification. Direct experience working in a nephrology practice and/or a dialysis center is a must.
  • You are experienced working on an interprofessional team and enjoy team-based care.
  • You have great clinical and non-clinical judgment.
  • You are thorough and take the time to address the needs of your patients.
  • You are deeply empathetic and humanistic, and want to go the last mile for your patients.
  • You enjoy a fast-paced, high-energy, organization. Agility and collaboration are key as we will change and improve quickly.
  • You welcome learning and using new technologies that are being developed in parallel. You thrive on knowing your work can help make these technologies better for you and your patients.
  • You learn from every experience and are not afraid to fail - that's how you're wired.
  • Finally and most importantly, you have a passion for making healthcare better, solving complex problems, and supporting the delivery of healthcare that we would want for our own family members.

Skills and experience:

  • NP or PA with 5 or more years working in outpatient clinical practice.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a nephrology practice or dialysis unit required.
  • Proficiency in using telehealth technology and electronic health records (EHR).
  • Virtual care experience is preferred along with a strong desire to continue practicing clinical medicine and performing virtual visits.
  • An understanding of managed care is a plus, including how to appropriately assess STARS/HEDIS measures, code clinical comorbidities, and identify clinical care gaps.
  • Proficiency in Spanish is desired.

Licensure and Certification:

  • Must possess a current, active, and unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) license in at least one U.S. state.
  • Must be willing to obtain additional state licenses as required by the business. (We provide administrative assistance and cover 100% of the associated fees.)
  • Active BLS is required at time of hire and must be maintained while employed at Devoted Medical.

Salary Range: $120K-155K base range plus performance based bonus paid out quarterly or annually ($10K-$20K) for a total comp range of $130K-170K

The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

jobs.title: NEN Solution Engineering – Senior Voice Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on Senior Voice Engineer to join our Unified Communications and Collaboration (UC&C) Solution Engineering team.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on Senior Voice Engineer to join our Unified Communications and Collaboration (UC&C) Solution Engineering team. Reporting to the Voice Team Lead, this individual contributor will serve as a principal-level subject matter expert for enterprise voice and SIP signaling, with solid working knowledge of the network infrastructure that carries it.

This role is focused on deep technical execution rather than people management. The engineer will design, secure, and troubleshoot complex voice environments, owning the hardest Tier 3/Tier 4 escalations involving SIP dialog analysis and advanced call flows, and partnering with the dedicated LAN/WAN, Virtualization, and Cybersecurity teams when issues cross into their domains. The position is also accountable for verifying that voice and UC systems meet DISA Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) requirements.

This position supports multiple DoD contracts and serves as a cross-program technical authority for voice engineering. As a Level T5 engineer, the incumbent will influence solutions that affect strategic goals and business results across those programs, recommend and develop technical standards that are reused from contract to contract, and guide the technical work of other engineers. The position will work closely with Transport Engineering, Network Operations, Cybersecurity, program leadership, customers, and vendor partners.

Key Responsibilities

SIP Signaling and Advanced Call-Flow Troubleshooting

  • SIP Dialog Analysis: Serve as the senior escalation point for complex voice incidents, analyzing complete SIP dialogs (INVITE, provisional and final responses, ACK, re-INVITE, UPDATE, PRACK, REFER, BYE) to isolate signaling failures across multi-hop call paths.
  • Advanced Call Flows: Troubleshoot and resolve issues in complex scenarios, including attended and blind transfers, call forking, hunt and pilot groups, conferencing, call park, shared lines, simultaneous ring, emergency calling, and cloud/hybrid routing through multiple Session Border Controllers (SBCs).
  • Media and SDP Negotiation: Diagnose offer/answer and codec negotiation failures, early media, DTMF (RFC 2833/4733 and SIP INFO) mismatches, SRTP key exchange problems, one-way and no-way audio, and media anchoring or bypass issues.
  • Header and Normalization Analysis: Interpret and manipulate SIP headers (Via, Contact, Record-Route, P-Asserted-Identity, Diversion, History-Info, Session-Expires) and develop SBC message manipulation and normalization rules to resolve interoperability problems between carriers, call-control platforms, and cloud services.
  • Diagnostic Tooling: Use Wireshark/TShark, SBC debug and trace tools, call-control platform traces, call-detail records, and ladder diagrams to reconstruct call flows and document root cause.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Deliver written root-cause analyses with permanent corrective actions, and feed lessons learned into design standards and operating procedures shared across supported contracts.

STIG Compliance and Voice Security

  • STIG Compliance Checking: Perform and document compliance assessments of voice, UC, and SBC systems against applicable DISA STIGs and Security Requirements Guides (SRGs), including the Voice/Video Services Policy STIG and vendor-specific STIGs.
  • Scanning and Validation: Use DISA STIG Viewer, Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) Compliance Checker, Evaluate-STIG, and authenticated vulnerability scans to produce and maintain STIG checklists (.ckl/.cklb) and validate findings.
  • Remediation: Develop and implement remediation for open findings, harden configurations, and build secure configuration baselines that remain compliant through upgrades and changes.
  • Authorization Support: Provide voice-specific technical input to the Cybersecurity team for Risk Management Framework (RMF) packages, POA&Ms, and Authority to Operate (ATO) activities, including justification for deviations and mitigations.
  • Secure Signaling and Media: Implement and troubleshoot SIP over TLS, mutual TLS, SRTP, certificate and PKI management, and secure trunking to carriers and cloud platforms.

Layer 2 and Layer 3 Networking for Voice (in partnership with LAN/WAN teams)

  • Layer 2 Switching: Apply working knowledge of voice VLANs, 802.1Q trunking, Spanning Tree, LLDP-MED/CDP, Power over Ethernet, and 802.1X/MAB to troubleshoot endpoint registration and call-quality issues, and define voice requirements for the LAN team.
  • Layer 3 Routing: Understand routing behavior (static, OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, HSRP/VRRP, ACLs) well enough to identify when routing or asymmetric paths are breaking signaling or media, and provide clear evidence to the WAN team for resolution.
  • NAT, Firewall, and Traversal: Resolve SIP and RTP traversal issues at SBC demarcation points, and specify firewall, NAT, and port requirements for voice to the network and security teams.
  • QoS: Define voice and video QoS requirements (DSCP and CoS marking, trust boundaries, call admission control) and validate end-to-end QoS behavior with the LAN/WAN teams.
  • Network Performance Analysis: Isolate packet loss, jitter, latency, and MTU issues affecting voice using packet captures, interface statistics, and call-quality metrics.

Voice Platform Engineering and Delivery

  • Design Authority: Author and review high- and low-level designs, implementation procedures, test plans, and rollback plans for voice and UC solutions, and approve designs produced by other engineers.

This role helps deliver the partnership studies that run on our Clinical Superhighway, supporting seamless onboarding and high-quality execution of external partner projects in close partnership with the execution functions.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Leads the global cross-functional study team effectively, ensures effective decision making, and acts as point of escalation for resolution of study related issues.
  • Leads external vendors management involved in study delivery.
  • Builds trust and relationship with regional subject matter experts and supports the delivery of their local study objectives.
  • Collaborates with key stakeholders across the organization and provides regular updates on study progress to senior management as required.
  • Represents the study team at internal meetings and leads the cross-functional Clinical Study Team (CST) meetings.
  • Participates and presents at various topics of Clinical Study Management.
  • Participates in Clinical Operations Process improvement initiative.

Planning and Execution

  • Leads planning and management of the assigned clinical study(ies) from feasibility through closeout activities.
  • Generates, manages, maintains, and communicates high quality study timelines and tracks progress towards these.
  • Ensures that the clinical studies are operationally feasible along with Global Clinical Program Lead, oversees trial feasibility, trial allocation and site selection process across all regions.
  • Ensures timely availability of high-quality study documents to allow study submission to regulatory authorities and ECs/IRBs.
  • Provides oversight to study start up and site activation plans.
  • Ensures study plans (eg project management plan, monitoring plan, Trial Master File plan, data monitoring plan, ...) are created, updated and distributed timely and implemented appropriately.
  • Ensures study systems and tools are set up timely, correctly and are functioning properly. Ensures study level information is updated on an ongoing basis in all systems.
  • Implements RBQM end-to-end processes on time within the allocated study (e.g., periodic reviews, centralized monitoring analyses, action items).
  • Ensures relevant study specific training is developed and implemented and ensures training records are well documented and filed.
  • Ensures Trial Master File for study is created, maintained and QC’d on a regular basis as per the study TMF QC plan.
  • Collaborates closely with Global Clinical Supplies to forecast study drug and timely delivery of supplies to sites.
  • Supports and as needed drives overall data cleaning timelines in close collaboration with Data Management and other stakeholders.
  • Ensures planning and execution of the Clinical Study Report in collaboration with Medical Writing and relevant CST members.

Quality and Risk Management

  • Monitors study activities to ensure compliance with the study protocol, SOPs, all study plans, ICH/GCP and all other relevant regulations.
  • Regularly reviews and manages quality-related GCO metrics to be within acceptable limits.
  • Ensures inspection readiness at any point in time throughout the study life cycle.
  • Works with cross-functional study team to identify, interpret, and evaluate issues on the study and ensures corrective and preventative actions are implemented.
  • Ensures senior management and other key stakeholders are informed of risks and challenges and ensures risk mitigation plans are put in place and implemented.
  • Prepares team for quality assurance audits and inspections.
  • Collaborates with CST members and other colleagues to ensure cross-team, site learnings, and best practices are shared.
  • Leads improvements and partners with study team members to enhance the efficiency and the quality of the work performed on assigned studies.
  • Leads development, optimization and review of work instructions and SOPs as required.

Budget and Resources

  • Works with the sourcing team to select and manage study vendors, approving invoice payment throughout the study.
  • Manages study budgets, including baseline budget evaluation, change control, study closure budget, presents study budget for senior management engagement.
  • Adheres to clinical study budgeting processes and provides input to finance on budget accruals and forecasts.
  • Identifies and manages study team resource needs and establishes contingency plans for key resources.
  • Monitors Clinical Study Team resource utilization over the study life cycle.
  • Ensures clinical studies at a project level are executed within endorsed time, quality, and cost parameters.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Computer Skills:

Other Qualifications:

  • Proven Project Management experience in Global Clinical Studies (Oncology experience preferred).
  • Advanced knowledge of clinical operations methodologies, in depth understanding of all aspects of clinical study processes.
  • Able to independently lead global clinical studies.
  • 8 or more years of progressive experience in clinical research within biotech, pharma or CRO industry.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or healthcare discipline required (exceptions may be made for candidates with relevant clinical operations experience); higher degree preferred.

Travel:

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Manager, Trial Success

About the Role

  • Samsara's Trial Success team makes sure enterprise trials are executed with excellence, so prospects see the full value of our solutions and are ready for implementation.
  • As the Manager, Trial Success, you will lead and develop a team of 6+ Trial Success Managers (TSMs) who run customized trial plans for Enterprise prospects.
  • You own team results: trial conversion, trial quality, and TSM growth and retention.
  • You partner with Sales, Sales Engineering, Business Value Strategy, Product, and Customer Success leaders to drive deal progress and a consistent trial experience.
  • You will also shadow a small number of high-stakes trials yourself, and be able to train new hires & step in as an escalation point for strategic deals.
  • Remote position, open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 25% travel to Samsara and customer sites in the US and Canada.
  • Expect 3-5 onsite trips per quarter of 1-2 nights each, including team offsites and 1:1s with TSMs.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership

  • Hire and onboard: Build the hiring plan, run structured interviews, make strong hiring decisions, and ramp new TSMs to full productivity with a clear 30/60/90 plan.
  • Coach continuously: Hold weekly 1:1s, review live trial work and customer calls, and give timely, specific feedback that builds skills in value-based selling, change management, and executive communication.
  • Manage performance: Set clear goals and expectations, run goal-setting and performance review cycles, and address underperformance early with documented improvement plans when needed.
  • Develop careers: Create individual development plans, identify stretch assignments, and build a succession pipeline for the next level of TSM and leadership roles.
  • Calibrate and reward: Participate in calibration, promotion, and compensation cycles with fair, data-backed recommendations.
  • Build culture and engagement: Foster an inclusive, high-trust team, monitor engagement and burnout, recognize wins, and retain top talent.
  • Handle people operations: Manage time off, workload balance, coverage plans, and sensitive employee matters in partnership with People/HR.

Team Execution and Operations

  • Set the team's goals, KPIs, and operating rhythm (pipeline reviews, trial health reviews, weekly close).
  • Assign TSM coverage by account priority, segment, and capacity, and rebalance as deals shift.
  • Review trial plans, success criteria, and mutual action plans in Accord to ensure quality and standardization.
  • Inspect trial health, flag risks early, and lead account team strategy sessions to unblock deals.
  • Report trial conversion, cycle time, and team health metrics to senior leadership.

Strategy and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Own and evolve the trial methodology, including job aids, communication templates, and playbooks.
  • Partner with Sales, SE, BVS, Product, and Support leaders to bring the right resources to the right trial at the right time.
  • Drive adoption of tools and AI-enabled workflows that increase TSM capacity and trial quality.
  • Capture customer and field feedback from trials and share it with Product and Enablement.
  • Represent the team in executive trial reviews and customer-facing escalations.
  • Champion and model Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team).

What You'll Need to Succeed

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in a client-facing role working with Enterprise clients (strategic consulting, account management, project management, or sales); SaaS or technology experience preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience directly managing people.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Required Skills

  • Proven ability to hire, coach, develop, and retain high-performing client-facing teams.
  • Strong project management and change management experience (PMP certification is a plus).
  • Expertise in communication strategy, risk management, and executive stakeholder management.
  • Ability to set goals, measure performance with data, and manage by metrics (conversion, cycle time, pipeline).
  • Experience influencing cross-functional leaders without direct authority.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to convey complex ideas concisely.
  • Strong quantitative and presentation skills.
  • Technical aptitude with CRM and project management tools.
  • Comfort in an unstructured, fast-paced, change-heavy environment.

An Ideal Candidate Also Has

  • Experience managing or scaling a trial, proof-of-concept, or proof-of-value function in software or hardware.
  • Sales experience closing business with large Enterprise organizations.
  • Experience supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.
  • Experience building team processes, playbooks, and standards from scratch.
  • A strong bias for action, the ability to think big, and insistence on high standards.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$115,727—$175,050 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. Job Summary

The Project Manager - Global Labeling is responsible for planning, governing, and executing large-scale, enterprise-wide labeling initiatives within the Global Labeling organization. This role collaborates closely with functional leadership to scope initiatives, build robust project schedules, establish reporting dashboards, and proactively identify and escalate delivery risks. The position serves as a central operational liaison across Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Packaging Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations to assign deliverables, track progress, and drive cross-functional completion of critical compliance and labeling milestones.

  • Project Planning & Governance: Define and manage end-to-end project work breakdown structures, schedules, critical path milestones, and resource allocations for large-scale enterprise labeling projects using standard project management tools and methodologies; partner with the Strategic Labeling Manager to scope initiatives, establish project priority rankings, and define clear, measurable deliverables.

  • Risk Management & Issue Escalation: Proactively identify operational bottlenecks, dependencies, and regulatory compliance risks across project workstreams; develop risk mitigation strategies and escalate critical schedule or resource risks to management with actionable recommendations.
  • Cross-Functional Execution & Accountability: Coordinate daily with cross-functional teams—including Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Packaging Engineering, Global Trade, Marketing, and Sourcing—to communicate requirements, assign ownership, drive deliverables to timely closure, and ensure alignment with established labeling and artwork change control workflows.
  • Process Standardization & Compliance: Ensure all project management artifacts, documentation, and processes strictly adhere to internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, and external medical device regulations (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 801/820, EU MDR/IVDR, and UDI requirements), while actively contributing to the refinement of standard PM templates and governance frameworks.

  • Preferred Certifications: PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Etc

jobs.description:
FRESH. FORWARD. FLOWERS.

Flowers Foods, Inc. (NYSE:FLO) is not just about baking; it's about crafting moments of joy with every delicious bite. With 2025 sales of $5.3 billion, and as one of the leading producers of packaged bakery goods in the United States, Flowers Foods brings passion to the table. From the wholesome goodness of Nature's Own and Wonder to the bold and artisanal flavors of Dave's Killer Bread, the rustic goodness of Canyon Bakehouse, and the sweet delights of Tastykake, each product is a celebration of taste and quality. Beyond the oven, Flowers Foods fosters a culture that values and reflects Honesty & Integrity, Respect & Inclusion, Sustainability, Passion, and Humility. With a commitment to innovation and a recipe for success, Flowers Foods is more than a bakery – it's a delightful journey into the heart of flavor and community.

Full-time employees are offered the following benefits:

  • Comprehensive health and medical benefits
  • 401(k) Retirement savings plan
  • Professional growth and leadership training
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and parental leave

Benefits may vary depending on your work location.

Position Summary:

The Director of Category Management leads the development and execution of category plans for assigned product categories, translating company objectives into actionable recommendations that support category growth and profitability. This role manages category managers and partners with sales, marketing, Revenue Growth Management, supply chain, and product development to improve assortment, pricing and promotion recommendations, and shelf execution. The Director uses consumer and shopper insights, market trends, competitive intelligence, and retailer data to identify opportunities, guide customer-facing category work, and monitor results.

Rising to the Challenge: Position Responsibilities

  • Category Strategy Development: Develop and execute plans for assigned categories within company strategy, integrating recommendations for assortment, pricing, promotions, distribution, and shelf placement (space quality and quantity).
  • Market Analysis & Insights: Guide category managers in using syndicated data (e.g., Circana), consumer research, shopper insights, and competitive intelligence to assess market size, growth drivers, priority segments, purchase drivers, usage occasions, and unmet needs. Evaluate competitors’ share, pricing, promotions, and offerings, translating findings into category recommendations and customer presentations.
  • Retailer Collaboration: Manage category relationships with assigned retail partners, supporting joint business planning, leading category reviews, and recommending assortment, shelf, and promotional improvements that support mutual growth.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Manage, coach, and develop category managers. Set work priorities and clear deliverables, identify skill gaps, and provide training in category management, data analysis, space planning, and customer presentations.
  • Pricing & Promotion Strategy: In collaboration with Revenue Growth Management, develop data-driven pricing and promotional recommendations, support execution of approved plans, and evaluate results to improve profitability and competitive positioning.
  • Assortment & Distribution Optimization: Evaluate product performance, profitability, consumer demand, distribution gaps, and channel performance. Recommend assortment additions, renovations, discontinuations, and distribution opportunities to the appropriate decision-makers. Partner with sales and retail teams to implement approved changes and monitor results.
  • Shelf Space Management: Lead the development of shelf space and product placement recommendations that improve visibility and category performance. Coordinate space planning work and support retailer implementation.
  • Forecasting & Planning: Provide category trends, promotional insights, and assortment assumptions to sales and supply chain to support sales forecasts and product availability. Flag material changes in demand and emerging risks.
  • Budget Management: Manage the assigned category management budget within approved limits, prioritize resources against agreed initiatives, and escalate additional resource needs or spending variances.
  • Performance Monitoring & Risk Assessment: Track category KPIs and initiative results, assess potential market changes and risks, and recommend corrective actions or contingency responses.

Knead to Know: Preferred Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of progressive experience in category management within the CPG industry, including at least 3 years managing teams or leading category initiatives.
  • Strong working knowledge of category management principles, practices, and methodologies, with demonstrated ability to translate strategy into category and customer plans.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using syndicated data (e.g., Nielsen, Circana) and other market research tools.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with retail partners.
  • Demonstrated people management and coaching skills, with experience setting priorities, developing team capabilities, and delivering category initiatives.

Additional Ingredients: Essential Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field is required. Master’s degree in related field is recommended.

Salary Range- 140000 - 170000

Position Summary...

The Merchant is responsible for developing and executing category strategies that align with long-term business objectives. This role oversees pricing, promotion, and assortment planning while managing supplier relationships and financial performance. The Merchant leverages data analysis and market insights to drive customer-focused decisions across multiple channels. Leading a team, this position ensures operational excellence through effective collaboration, budget management, and continuous improvement. The role demands adaptability, strategic thinking, and a commitment to upholding company values while delivering measurable business results and enhancing the overall customer experience. About the team: The team leads category strategy and financial management for moderately complex categories, driving pricing, assortment, and supplier decisions to meet business goals. They collaborate across functions to optimize customer experience and channel alignment while managing inventory and promotional activities. Focused on data-driven insights, the team supports continuous improvement and operational excellence. They foster a performance-oriented environment by guiding and developing associates, ensuring adherence to company policies and ethical standards. This team plays a key role in executing strategic initiatives that enhance value and sustainability, contributing to Walmart’s commitment to delivering quality and affordability.

What you'll do...


  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with long-term business objectives, incorporating market trends and customer insights.

  • Drive channel strategy and collaborate with supply chain to optimize product availability and customer experience.
  • Supervise and develop team members, setting performance expectations and fostering a high-performing work environment.
  • Utilize data analysis to inform decisions, improve category performance, and support digital initiatives.
  • Support assortment planning, modular layout, and product lifecycle management across store and online channels.
