jobs.excerpt: About The Fundworks The Fundworks is a tech-enabled provider of working capital solutions (merchant cash advances and related financing) to small businesses nationwide.
jobs.description:
About The Fundworks
The Fundworks is a tech-enabled provider of working capital solutions (merchant cash advances and related financing) to small businesses nationwide. We are results-oriented, focused on execution and portfolio performance.

Role Overview
This is a new position created to own the monthly reporting package for our securitization while also taking primary responsibility for preparing the internal Risk Committee and Collections reporting. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience producing or supporting ABS/securitization investor or trustee reports and will be comfortable translating that discipline into clear, actionable internal cohort and segment performance reporting.

Key Responsibilities
Securitization / ABS Reporting

  • Own preparation and delivery of the monthly securitization reporting package (investor reports, trustee reports, data tapes, performance summaries, and any required supplemental analytics) in accordance with the transaction documents and timelines.
  • Coordinate with the trustee, placement agent, counsel, and internal teams to ensure data accuracy, timely delivery, and resolution of questions.
  • Monitor portfolio performance relative to triggers, covenants, expected curves, and other deal requirements; flag issues early with supporting analysis.
  • Reconcile securitization reporting data to internal systems and bank activity.
  • Support ad-hoc investor, rating agency, or placement agent requests.


Risk Reporting
  • Prepare the monthly (and weekly as needed) Risk Reports covering funded cohort performance by relevant segments (vintage, industry, broker/channel, risk grade, geography, product, etc.).
  • Identify anomalies or trends that warrant attention, pull supporting data, and draft clear commentary so the Risk Committee can focus on discussion and decisions rather than data assembly.
  • Maintain and improve the underlying data pulls, templates, and process so reporting is consistent, auditable, and less manual over time.


Collections Reporting & Support
  • Assist with regular Collections reporting and analysis (status, recoveries, trends by segment or vintage, etc.).
  • Support deeper dives into specific accounts or cohorts when performance deviates from expectations.


General
  • Improve and automate reporting processes where practical (Excel, SQL, Power Automate, Salesforce, or other internal tools).
  • Partner with Underwriting, Risk, Data, and Operations teams on data quality and reporting needs.
  • Provide ad-hoc analytical support for management, funding decisions, or portfolio reviews.


Qualifications
Required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3–6+ years of experience in financial analysis, portfolio performance reporting, specialty finance, or structured finance.
  • Direct experience preparing, reviewing, or supporting ABS / securitization investor or trustee reports (or equivalent detailed portfolio reporting in a warehouse, term ABS, or similar structure). Experience with commercial or specialty finance assets is a strong plus.
  • Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, reconciliation).
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet recurring monthly deadlines reliably.
  • Clear written communication skills for report commentary and external coordination.

Preferred
  • Familiarity with merchant cash advance, revenue-based financing, or small business lending performance metrics (delinquency, default, loss rates by vintage/segment, collections curves, etc.).
  • Experience with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools for data extraction and reporting.
  • Prior work in a smaller or independent specialty finance / fintech environment (comfortable wearing multiple hats and building processes).
  • Knowledge of securitization deal mechanics (waterfalls, triggers, credit enhancement, reporting covenants).


What Success Looks Like
  • Monthly ABS reporting is delivered accurately and on time with minimal escalation.
  • Risk Committee materials are circulated ahead of meetings with cohorts analyzed by segment and anomalies already highlighted and investigated.
  • Reporting processes become more repeatable and less dependent on manual effort.

Compensation

  • 80k-110k annual salary, based on experience
Benefits
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Paid vacation, sick, bereavement, and holiday time
  • Fully remote (Remote in Salt Lake City, UT or remote U.S.)

Reports to: Controller

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As a Domain Consultant (DC) for Next-Gen Trust Security (NGTS), you are the premier technical subject matter expert for Palo Alto Networks' Machine Identity Management portfolio. Following our integration with CyberArk, you will lead the technical charge in transforming how enterprises manage cryptographic trust.


You will be responsible for defining technical solutions that secure critical business imperatives, evangelizing our "better together" integration of Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) and Zero-Touch Public Key Infrastructure (ZTPKI) within the Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) platform. You will serve as the technical bridge between the Network Security teams and Identity stakeholders, ensuring that enforcement systems (NGFW/SASE) stay synchronized as certificate lifecycles compress.


Your Impact:

  • Technical Win Leadership: Lead Proof of Value (PoV) engagements and technical validations for NGTS, ensuring a high technical win rate by demonstrating operational resilience and outage elimination.
  • Solution Architecture: Design unified cryptographic governance models within Strata Cloud Manager that align certificate operations with network enforcement.
  • Strategic Execution: Identify critical projects and actions required to achieve a customer's desired security end-state; eliminate sales obstacles through creative and adaptive problem-solving.
  • Market Evangelism: Act as a thought leader on the "Cryptographic Reset," educating CISOs and VP-level stakeholders on the risks of 47-day certificate lifecycles and the path to Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).
  • Product Advocacy: Share industry experience regarding customer usage patterns to provide feedback to product teams on how to make NGTS/MIM easier for customers to adopt fully.
  • Strategic Discovery: Conduct deep-dive discovery sessions to uncover unmanaged or "rogue" certificates using network-native discovery tools.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Solutions Consultants (SCs), Account Managers, and the CyberArk MIM Specialist team to build and execute account-based pursuit strategies.
  • Platformization: Drive the adoption of Secure Flex credits by showing customers how to consolidate siloed CLM/PKI tools into a centralized control plane.

Qualifications


  • Professional Background: 5+ years of Sales Engineering or Consulting experience with a proven track record in a cybersecurity software vendor.
  • Deep Domain Expertise: Extensive experience in Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), PKI architecture (ZTPKI, Microsoft ADCS), and SSL/TLS protocols.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with automated provisioning (ACME, SCEP), Cloud-native connectors (Azure, GCP, AWS), and hardware/virtual security appliances.
  • DevOps & Modern Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with DevOps tools (Terraform, Git, Kubernetes, Ansible) and container technologies (Docker) is a significant benefit.
  • Network Security Foundation: Strong understanding of NGFW, SASE, and GlobalProtect architectures, particularly how they handle decryption, inspection, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Consultative Selling: Proven ability to simplify complex cryptographic concepts into business-value outcomes (e.g., preventing service outages).
  • Communication: Excellent written communication skills; bilingual proficiency in German is a requirement for this role.
  • Education & Certification: CISSP or equivalent Information Security certifications are preferred.

Technical Qualifications (Must-Haves)

  • PKI & Certificate Governance: Comprehensive knowledge of Public Key Infrastructure, including certificate authorities, lifecycle management, and trust models.
  • Cryptography Fundamentals: Deep understanding of symmetric and asymmetric encryption, key management, and cryptographic standards.
  • Network Protocols: Mastery of TLS/SSL handshakes, S/MIME, and secure communication protocols.
  • Future-Proof Security: Familiarity with Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and the migration strategies for quantum-safe algorithms.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionGreat content starts with a great MIND.
jobs.description:
Description

Great content starts with a great MIND.

The internet is filling up with content nobody wrote and nobody reads. We want a Content Marketing Manager who makes the other kind, built with real people and worth passing along to a colleague.

We’re looking for someone who can do more than write a great blog post. You’re a content creator at heart, equally comfortable crafting a thought-provoking article, producing an engaging video, experimenting with the latest AI tools or jumping in front of the camera to host a webinar or interview an industry expert.

You understand that great B2B content doesn’t have to be boring. You know how to make technical topics accessible, find the human story behind the technology and create content that educates, entertains and inspires action.

You won't start from a blank page. You'll inherit a working content engine, including our brand voice, a complete messaging guide and AI workflows we built in-house. Your job is to run it well and put a human face on it.

If you’re a natural storyteller, a creative thinker and someone who’s always exploring what’s next in content and AI, we’d love to pick your brain.

Why MIND?

At MIND, we’re reimagining data loss prevention (DLP) for the AI era. Our vision is simple: make data security simple, autonomous and complete to become Stress Free. We’re building a new approach to an old problem, and we need a storyteller who can help bring that vision to life.

We’re not interested in doing things simply because that’s how they’ve always been done.

At MIND, we’re challenging the status quo in data security, building technology that helps organizations mind what matters most without the complexity of traditional DLP.

We’re also building a team of people who care about the work, support one another and aren’t afraid to think differently.

Our values guide how we work:

  • Mind What Matters. Focus on the work that creates meaningful impact.
  • Act With Empathy. Lead with understanding and treat people with care.
  • Win Together. Great ideas and great results come from collaboration.
  • Improve Every Day. Stay curious, keep learning and never stop getting better.

Bring your ideas, your creativity and your personality. Come be a MINDer and MIND What Matters.

Responsibility

What you'll do

Run the content engine

  • Own the editorial calendar across blog, email, social and web, tied to product launches and the news cycle.
  • Use our AI workflows to research, draft and check work faster. Then add the judgment and human voice that AI can't supply.
  • Own and operate the MIND corporate social presence across LinkedIn, X, Reddit, YouTube and other social accounts.
  • Keep everything on brand and on message, with the MIND messaging guide as your source of truth.

Make it real

  • Find and tell customer stories. Interview CISOs and practitioners, and turn their words into articles, posts and clips.
  • Get on camera. Host short live sessions, interviews and webinars. They can be unpolished as long as you've done the prep.
  • Turn every conversation into a dozen pieces of content, including some light video editing.

Meet buyers where they are

  • Write content that answers the real questions security buyers ask, in search and in AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude.
  • Own how MIND shows up in AI answers and search engines. Track it, find what's missing or wrong and fix it at the source, working from the strategy product marketing sets.
  • Build content for every stage, from first curiosity to the technical deep dive.

Show up in the community

  • Spend time where security people hang out, like LinkedIn, Reddit, Slack groups and industry events. Listen first and give before you ask.
  • Support our podcast, Mind What Matters, and our customer advisory board.
  • Help build our new DLP education and certification program, from course content and practitioner-taught lessons to the community of graduates around it.

Measure and experiment

  • Track what resonates, double down on it and drop what doesn't.
  • Test at least one new format every month.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 3–5 years in B2B content marketing, journalism or content creation.
  • A working knowledge of cybersecurity. You can explain DLP, phishing and insider risk to a friend without looking them up.
  • Clear, human writing. You make technical topics make sense without dumbing them down.
  • Comfort on camera and in conversation. You enjoy interviewing people and you don't mind a live mic.
  • Daily, hands-on use of AI tools, plus the judgment to know when the output isn't good enough.
  • Range across formats, including long-form, social, email and short video scripts.
  • Ownership. You can take an idea from a Slack message to a published piece without much hand-holding.
  • Curiosity and a sense of humor. You know when to be serious and when a little personality makes something memorable.

Bonus points

  • Have created content for CISOs or security practitioners.
  • Have hosted a podcast, webinar, livestream or video series.
  • Have ghostwritten for executives or grown someone else's social following.
  • Can edit your own video in Riverside, Wistia, Canva or similar.
  • Know SEO, or better yet, how content shows up in AI answers.
  • Have built an audience of your own, through a newsletter, a channel or a social following.
  • Have helped build a content program at a growing startup.
  • Have a portfolio that makes us stop scrolling.

jobs.excerpt: About UsWe are a stealth-stage fund and tech startup operating at the intersection of alternative markets and quantitative strategy.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a stealth-stage fund and tech startup operating at the intersection of alternative markets and quantitative strategy. Backed by experienced operators and growing quickly, we are building the infrastructure to scale a high-performance, data-driven business.

We are a lean team with outsized ambition. The founder has a strong track record of execution and is currently the bottleneck on roughly a third of everything happening in the company. That is the problem this role solves.

The Role

This is not an executive assistant role and it is not a calendar job. You are a proxy for the founder: you take whole problems off his desk, own them end to end, and give them back finished.

In practice that means you will spend your time on the things that are important, unowned, and quietly costing the company a lot. A conversion problem nobody has sat down with. A process that works but nobody has ever timed. A function the company needs and does not have yet. You will find them, fix them, hand them to whoever should run them, and move to the next one.

The work changes constantly and the ambiguity is real. If you need a defined remit, this will be uncomfortable. If you have ever been the person who ends up owning the thing nobody else could, you will recognise the job immediately.

What You'll Do

Buy back the founder's time. Take the operational work currently sitting on him and either do it, systematise it, or find the person who should own it.

Fix the leaks in the funnel. We lose a large share of people at two specific points between first contact and being fully onboarded. Both are solvable with scheduling design, better communication and some tooling. Neither has an owner today.

Put numbers on work nobody has measured. Some of our teams have no defensible view of how long their work should take. You will run the time studies, set the quotas, and hold them.

Stand up functions from zero. We need a support function and it does not exist. You will write the playbook, define the tiers, and get it staffed and running.

Own special projects end to end. New market launches, new initiatives, senior hiring. You take them from idea to handed-off, several per quarter.

jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Revenue Experimentation team (Direct Revenue org) is the engine behind how we grow and monetize Life360 responsibly. We design, ship, and analyze high-velocity experiments across ads, subscriptions, and one-time purchases — pricing, paywalls, ad placement and mediation, upsell and upgrade flows — so every monetization decision is grounded in evidence, not instinct. Our work directly shapes the revenue behind nearly 100 million members.

We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We treat it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale.

About the Job

Life360 is hiring an AI-Native Senior Software Engineer II — a builder who thinks natively in AI tooling and takes real ownership of outcomes, not just tickets. You'll be central to how the Revenue Experimentation team designs and ships growth and monetization experiments across the Life360 app.

You'll take a hypothesis — sometimes a fully-specced brief, sometimes a rough idea from a Slack thread or a data science finding — and turn it into a running, safely-instrumented experiment. You default to shipping and iterating rather than waiting for a perfect spec or explicit permission. You'll run experiments confidently at a high clip.

This role is Android-first, but candidates who treat platform boundaries as fluid — willing to build across iOS, web, or backend when an experiment calls for it — are exactly who we're looking for.

In your first year, success looks like owning end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent experiment surfaces, and having at least one AI-native workflow you introduced adopted beyond this team.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $118,500 to $216,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 171,500 to 201,000 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build high-quality Android growth and monetization features and experiments — subscription paywalls and pricing tests, ad placement and mediation experiments, one-time purchase (IAP) flows, and upsell/upgrade surfaces — running dozens of concurrent tests across the Life360 app.
  • Partner with product, design, data science, and analytics to translate hypotheses into shippable experiments, and turn results into the next decision — pushing back when a hypothesis or plan doesn't hold up.
  • Work with AI (Claude Code or equivalent) as a first-class collaborator — your primary workflow involves orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and perform reviews.
  • Instrument experiments accurately — exposure logging and analytics — so the results downstream teams rely on are trustworthy.
  • Ship polished, performant, reliable Android experiences to tens of millions of users, with strong attention to startup time, memory, battery, ANR, and crash-free rates.
  • Own staged rollouts end-to-end — ramp exposure, monitor guardrails, and make the call to hold, roll back, or scale to 100%.
  • Help define and codify AI-native Android engineering practices for the team, establishing playbooks the broader mobile org can adopt.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement on the Android codebase.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and incident response for mobile experiments and releases.
  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to team processes and technical standards.

What We’re Looking For

Technical foundation:

  • 6+ years of Android software engineering experience shipping production apps at consumer scale.
  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs.
  • Strong proficiency with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose (and the Android View system); deep familiarity with the modern Android toolchain (Android Studio, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow).
  • Experience with Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, Jetpack/ViewModel/Navigation, Hilt or Dagger) in a large, multi-team codebase.
  • Comfort with mobile experimentation concepts: feature flagging, A/B testing, exposure logging, holdouts, and guardrail metrics.
  • Solid grounding in mobile performance, memory, battery, ANR, and crash diagnostics (Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto/Systrace, Macrobenchmark, Crashlytics or equivalent).
  • Experience with CI/CD for Android (Gradle, Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, or similar) and modular build systems.
  • Expertise with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, context-window management, and MCP/function calling — you understand the research-plan-implement cycle but don't outsource thinking to agents.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience.

What matters most to us:

  • Agency — You don't wait to be told what to do. You make the call when you're closest to the problem, escalate when you're not, and take responsibility for the outcome either way.
  • Ownership mentality — You own your work from design through production and beyond, including what happens when the experiment doesn't go as planned.
  • Taste and craft — You have opinions about what a good experiment, a good rollout, and a good user experience look like, and you can articulate why — not just execute a spec.
  • Growth mindset — You structure problems precisely, learn quickly, show interest outside "your lane," and are always happy to try something new.
  • AI-native working style — You use AI tooling (Claude Code or equivalent) as a genuine development partner: delegating discrete tasks, reviewing outputs critically, and running parallel workstreams rather than hand-holding one agent at a time.
  • Collaborative approach — You communicate clearly, work well across teams, and value diverse perspectives; you give and take feedback well.
  • We believe values alignment and problem-solving ability matter more than checking every technical box. We're happy to help you grow into areas where you have less experience.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience working with an experimentation platform (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, Eppo, GrowthBook, or similar).
  • Background in mobile analytics pipelines (Amplitude, Segment, Snowflake/Databricks downstream).
  • Familiarity with Bayesian or sequential testing methods and how they affect client-side implementation.
  • Previous work on subscription, paywall, pricing, or onboarding surfaces at consumer scale.
  • Deep in at least one of Kotlin/Android, Swift, or React, and comfortable shipping in another.
  • Contributions to mobile open source or internal developer tooling.

AI-Native Expectations

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. In practice:

  • Daily use — You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation, not just research or autocomplete.
  • Judgment and ownership — AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity — We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership — You share what works, automate prompting strategies others can build on, and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning — The tooling changes fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

We are looking for a skilled Senior Exposure Management Engineer to support GuidePoint Security's Mid-Atlantic Exposure Management practice. The Senior Exposure Management Engineer will be required to demonstrate strong asset management, integration, and risk-based vulnerability management skills, lead by influence, and strong business/financial acumen to drive the use of progressive exposure management programs that will align the delivery of business objectives and priorities.

About the Mid-Atlantic Exposure Management Practice

The Mid-Atlantic Exposure Management Practice is responsible for helping clients see everything they own and fix what matters most. We build unified, real-time asset inventories and risk-based exposure programs — with the Axonius Asset Cloud at the center — that turn fragmented data from hundreds of security and IT tools into a single, trusted asset model and a prioritized, business-aware remediation backlog.

Our team of exposure management engineers, Axonius platform specialists, and automation developers focuses on cyber asset attack surface management (CAASM), risk-based vulnerability management (RBVM), and exposure prioritization. We partner with client security, IT, infrastructure, and cloud teams to eliminate blind spots, de-duplicate findings across tools, assign asset ownership, and drive measurable risk reduction.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Exposure Management Platform Operations

  • Operate and maintain security platforms including vulnerability management, RBVM, CAASM, and CNAPP tools
  • Monitor security findings and support prioritization and remediation workflows
  • Assist in platform tuning, configuration optimization, and integration with client environments
  • Support onboarding of new assets, applications, and cloud environments into security platforms

Exposure Management Operations

  • Review exposure findings and assist with prioritization and remediation tracking
  • Help manage remediation workflows with client engineering teams
  • Generate operational dashboards and reporting for security leadership
  • Assist in maintaining asset inventory coverage and scanning accuracy

Traditional Vulnerability Management

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain vulnerability scanners (e.g., Tenable Nessus/Tenable.sc, Qualys VMDR, Rapid7 InsightVM) across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Design scan sites, asset groups, scan templates, and schedules that deliver complete coverage while minimizing operational impact on production systems.
  • Configure and manage authenticated (credentialed) scanning, scan engines, and agent deployments; troubleshoot credential failures and coverage gaps.
  • Execute and validate network, host, and web application vulnerability scans; verify findings and reduce false positives.
  • Manage the full vulnerability lifecycle — discovery, validation, assignment, remediation, re-scan verification, and closure.
  • Coordinate patch and configuration remediation with IT and system owners, and track risk acceptances, exceptions, and compensating controls.
  • Perform configuration and compliance scanning against benchmarks such as CIS and DISA STIG.
  • Maintain vulnerability management policies, SLAs, and standard operating procedures aligned to frameworks such as NIST, PCI DSS, and CIS Controls.
  • Produce recurring vulnerability metrics and reports, including open/aging vulnerabilities, mean time to remediate, and scan coverage.

Risk-Based Vulnerability Management Configuration

  • Configure risk-based vulnerability management (RBVM) so that vulnerabilities are prioritized by real-world risk — business impact, exposure, and exploitability — rather than by CVSS score alone.
  • Ingest and consolidate vulnerability findings from multiple scanners (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7) into RBVM platforms such as Axonius, Nucleus, Brinqa, Armor Code, Cogent, Zafran and configure de-duplication so a single vulnerability reported by different tools is represented once.
  • Build and maintain asset criticality ratings and business-context tags so prioritization reflects the importance of each asset to the business.
  • Configure enrichment of findings with threat intelligence and exploitability signals (e.g., known-exploited, active-in-the-wild) to surface the vulnerabilities attackers are most likely to use.
  • Design saved queries and dynamic asset/vulnerability views that isolate high-risk, exposed, mission-critical findings and filter out low-risk noise and items already within SLA.
  • Configure risk scoring, severity mapping, and prioritization logic that combine CVSS, exposure (internet-facing vs. isolated), exploit status, asset criticality, and existing mitigating controls.
  • Build automation workflows and dashboards to automate remediation workflows — create and route tickets to the correct owner in ServiceNow/Jira, notify teams, and track SLA and patch-window adherence.
  • Configure escalation (“fire alarm”) logic and SLA-based rules for critical and zero-day vulnerabilities that require faster-than-standard remediation.
  • Build dashboards and reporting that show remediation progress, SLA compliance, risk reduction over time, and coverage — tailored for both operational teams and security leadership.
  • Continuously tune prioritization models and reduce alert fatigue so client teams focus effort on the findings that actually reduce risk.

CNAPP & Cloud Security Support

  • Assist with the operation and optimization of CNAPP platforms (e.g., Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca)
  • Support cloud posture monitoring and exposure analysis
  • Assist with investigation of cloud misconfigurations, identity exposures, and attack paths
  • Work with senior engineers to onboard new cloud environments

Automation & Integrations

  • Develop scripts and automation to improve security workflows
  • Build integrations between security tools and ticketing systems
  • Automate reporting, vulnerability triage, and remediation tracking
  • Use APIs and automation frameworks to reduce manual operational effort
  • Use the Axonius Query Language, REST API, and Enforcement Center to automate asset queries, enrichment, ticketing, and remediation actions.

Client Engagement

  • Participate in regular operational cadence meetings with clients
  • Provide updates on platform findings and remediation progress
  • Assist senior engineers in troubleshooting security platform issues
  • Contribute to documentation and operational playbooks

Required Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering
  • Exposure management or risk-based vulnerability management experience
  • Experience building and maintaining unified asset inventories from disparate security and IT data sources.
  • Experience configuring asset criticality, ownership, and business context to drive risk-based prioritization.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management, exposure management, or CNAPP platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, Axonius, or similar tools
  • Hands-on experience running enterprise vulnerability scanning programs, including authenticated scanning, scan scheduling, false-positive validation, and remediation tracking.
  • Scripting experience (Python, PowerShell, or similar)
  • Experience working with APIs or automating workflows
  • Understanding of security fundamentals: vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, identity and access control, security monitoring
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with engineering teams
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with CNAPP platforms such as: Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca, Lacework
  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
  • Familiarity with container security and Kubernetes
  • Experience integrating security tools with ticketing platforms (Jira, ServiceNow)
  • Direct engineering experience with RBVM integrations, correlation tuning, and the Enforcement Center.
  • Experience with cyber asset management (CAASM), asset discovery, and network enumeration tooling.
  • Experience in Linux environments and API-based data retrieval from security/infrastructure tools (EDR, IdP, NGFW, cloud providers).
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools (LLMs, copilots, or agent frameworks) to accelerate scripting, analysis, and security operations workflows

Travel Requirements:

  • Up to 10% travel

Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary work
  • Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day
  • Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role.

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

  • Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)
  • Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)
  • Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans
  • 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program
  • Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance
  • Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment
  • Pet Benefit Option

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara's AI Experience team builds the Samsara Assistant and Agent Studio, where customers create chat and voice agents that work across their safety, maintenance and operations data.

Agent Studio is now generally available, and usage across chat and voice has more than tripled since June 2026.

This is a new role. We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead the teams behind the Assistant, Agent Studio and Agent Extensibility. Your job is to turn a fast-growing product into one customers trust and come back to every day: making answers trustworthy, getting more customers to try agents, and turning first-time users into daily ones.

This team is both a platform and a product. About half the work is helping engineering teams across Samsara, from Safety to Maintenance, build and launch their own agents. The other half is the frameworks those agents run on, used by Samsara teams and customers alike.

You'll lead about 10 machine learning engineers, applied scientists and full-stack engineers through two tech leads. The individual contributor bench is strong, so your first focus is scaling the product.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and Canada.

What makes Samsara different

  • Mission-driven impact. We improve safety, efficiency and sustainability for the industries that power the global economy.
  • A unique data advantage. IoT data at a scale few companies can match — 30+ trillion data points a year, 70+ billion miles driven.
  • Hands-on leadership and builder culture. Leaders at every level stay close to the product and the code.
  • Fast decisions, limited bureaucracy. Work directly with senior leadership and ship solutions that matter.
  • Growth and learning. Roles grow quickly here as the business grows. We invest heavily in R&D and in building for the long term.
  • Scale with startup energy. A public company (NYSE: IOT) with the resources and reach of scale, and the agility and pace of a high-growth technology company.

What makes this opportunity unique

  • Trusted answers for the people who keep the world running. Operators in transportation, construction, utilities and field services ask the Assistant about their drivers, vehicles and equipment. Your team makes sure the answers are right.
  • Just launched, already growing. Agent Studio went GA in October 2026. Chat and voice volume grew from about 100K in June to more than 350K, and power users are up week over week.
  • Platform and product at once. Your work powers agents across every Samsara product line and generates revenue for Samsara.
  • A new leadership seat. This is the first management layer for a team that has outgrown one manager. You shape how it works from day one.

In this role, you will

  • Own Assistant & Agent Studio and Agent Extensibility, leading about 10 engineers through two tech leads.
  • Grow activation, so more customers try agents, through recommended questions, automatically generated reports and proactive agents.
  • Drive answer quality and repeat usage, so customers trust what the Assistant tells them and come back daily.
  • Set technical direction through RFCs and design reviews for a platform used by customers and Samsara teams.
  • Raise the bar for how the team builds with AI, across coding, evaluation and operations.
  • Partner with product teams across Safety, Maintenance and more to build and launch their agents on the platform.
  • Champion Samsara’s cultural principles — Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team — as we scale globally.
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams.
  • Experience managing engineering teams and tech leads.
  • Experience across both machine learning and software engineering, including building agentic systems and traditional production software.
  • A track record of shipping production systems used at scale by external customers, B2B or B2C.
  • Experience building zero-to-one products in a fast-moving environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related technical field.

An ideal candidate also has

  • Agent platform depth. Has designed and scaled an agent platform that other teams build on.
  • User-facing AI products. Has built AI products that customers use directly, not only backend agents.
  • Growth and activation experience. Has moved activation or retention with recommendations, proactive experiences or usage loops.
  • Answer-quality rigor. Has set up evaluations and quality metrics for LLM-powered products.
  • Mixed-team leadership. Is comfortable leading machine learning engineers, applied scientists and full-stack engineers on one team.
  • An advanced degree. A Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field.

You should apply if

  • You are motivated by impact. You want to see a product you lead change how thousands of operators run their day.
  • You blend machine learning and software engineering. You've built agentic systems and traditional production software, and you're comfortable going deep on either.
  • You build from zero to one. You've taken products from idea to launch and know what to cut to ship.
  • You are AI-forward. You live and breathe AI like we do.
  • You care about the user. You think in activation, repeat usage and trust, not only in models and infrastructure.
  • You lead through others. You set direction with tech leads, grow people and raise the bar for design and execution.
  • You enable and collaborate with other teams. You enjoy building platforms that partner teams adopt and succeed with.

See Samsara in action

If you like, we would like to invite you to spend ten minutes getting to know us.

  • A quick video introducing our business (click herefor the Youtube Video).
  • 2026 Agent Studio reveal at Beyond, our annual customer event (click here for the Youtube Video and fast forward to 59:36)

Ready to make AI agents a daily habit for the world's operators? Apply now!

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description: Music ExpertRole Type: Contractor Location: Remote About the RoleWe are seeking experienced musicians and music teachers to support an AI training project by evaluating audio recordings, identifying musical elements, and providing detailed annotations and feedback.
jobs.description:
Job Description: Music Expert

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced musicians and music teachers to support an AI training project by evaluating audio recordings, identifying musical elements, and providing detailed annotations and feedback.

No prior AI experience is required.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Analyze 30–90-second audio recordings and identify instruments, tempo, musical key, and background sounds.
  2. Provide accurate annotations with timestamps through a project-specific platform.
  3. Compare recordings of the same song captured in different locations.
  4. Evaluate AI-generated music descriptions and provide feedback on their accuracy.
  5. Participate in onboarding, calibration sessions, and weekly online meetings.
  6. Maintain consistent quality and attention to detail across annotation tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. At least 3 years of experience as a musician, music teacher, producer, or audio professional.
  2. Formal music education or conservatory training is preferred.
  3. Strong analytical listening skills and the ability to identify instruments and musical elements.
  4. Ability to recognize musical keys and estimate tempo accurately.
  5. Experience in audio annotation, music transcription, or sound analysis is an advantage.
  6. Strong English communication skills.
  7. Access to quality headphones, a quiet workspace, and stable internet connectivity.

jobs.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

Sontiq is TransUnion’s identity protection and cyber safety business, helping consumers affected by identity theft, fraud, and data breaches protect and restore their identities through expert support and guidance. The team works closely with customers, clients, and internal specialists to provide timely assistance during challenging situations and make a meaningful difference throughout customers’ recovery journeys. This role offers an opportunity to develop expertise in identity protection and customer support within a collaborative, customer-focused environment. The position reports to the Associate Lead, Customer Support Operations.This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

As a Customer Service Incident Coordinator, you will support Arabic-, French-, and English-speaking customers and clients affected by fraud, data breaches, or identity theft. You will coordinate incident activities, maintain accurate records, and connect customers and clients with the appropriate internal and external resources.


This is a shift-pattern role: Wednesday to Sunday, 2.00pm-10.30pm

  • Interview customers and clients by telephone to gather information about suspected or confirmed data breaches, fraud, and identity theft.
  • Examine and analyse available information to assess incident severity and determine the assistance or remediation required.
  • Provide professional, courteous customer service and expert assistance, clearly explaining the services and support available while managing customer and client expectations.
  • Serve as a point of contact for customers, clients, and internal specialists, providing timely communication and coordinating discussions, meetings, escalations, and updates.
  • Gather, assemble, and preserve relevant facts, statements, affidavits, and other supporting evidence for breach remediation and the resolution of fraud or identity theft matters.
  • Prepare correspondence and coordinate communications with creditors, law enforcement agencies, government agencies, legal counsel, and other relevant third parties.
  • Consult with prospective and existing clients regarding breach incidents, remediation requirements, proposals, project schedules, document transfers, and customer communications.
  • Coordinate incident administration, including data review, letter production, client approvals, mailings, document transfers, and reporting on trends or unique customer situations.
  • Maintain complete and accurate case notes, monitor incident progress, support efficient case management, close resolved incident records, and provide final reports to clients or customers.

Required Knowledge And Experiences

  • Fluency in Arabic, French, and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills for supporting customers, preparing correspondence, and communicating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a client-facing or customer service environment, including managing expectations and assisting customers during sensitive or high-pressure situations.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse information, solve problems, manage multiple tasks moving at different paces, establish priorities, and meet deadlines with limited supervision.
  • Strong interpersonal, listening, organisational, and collaboration skills, with the ability to secure cooperation from clients, internal departments, and North American teams.

Required Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite for preparing correspondence, reports, proposals, and other business documentation.
  • Ability to use claims, customer, client, or incident-management systems to maintain detailed, accurate, and timely case records.
  • Ability to coordinate secure document and data transfers between the company, clients, and relevant third parties.
  • General technical confidence and the ability to learn and navigate business systems used for customer support, reporting, and case management.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing data, maintaining records, and preparing customer or client communications.


What’s in it for you?

At TransUnion you will be joining a friendly, forward thinking global business. As well as an excellent salary and bonus scheme or commission scheme (if joining our sales teams) our benefits package comes with:

  • 26 days annual leave and bank holidays (increasing with service)
  • Global paid wellness days off and a bonus day off to celebrate your birthday
  • A generous contributory pension scheme and access to the TransUnion Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Private health care and a variety of physical, mental and financial fitness wellbeing programmes such as access to mindfulness tools
  • Access to our diversity forums and communities so you can get involved in causes close to your heart

TransUnion – a place to grow:

If there’s something on the list of essential or desirable skills that you can’t quite tick off, don’t let that stop you from applying. We are open to exploring training and development opportunities for the right candidate to ensure you are successful. We know imposter syndrome is real, lets confront it so we can continue to grow and thrive together.

Flexibility at TU:

We recognise that our people need the freedom to balance their day-to-day lives with their work. This is why we’ve set out to create inclusive and flexible policies and practices for you to accommodate all your responsibilities and needs: children, family and beyond. If the role is advertised as full time, don’t let this stop you from applying. Let us know if you’re looking for a part time or flexible working arrangement and we can discuss this with you.

Additional support:

At TransUnion, we’re committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all individual’s talents and perspectives are valued. When you apply for a position with us, you’re not just joining a team, you’re becoming part of a community that celebrates differences and embraces equality. We understand that everyone has different needs, which is why we offer a range of reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments to help you through the application process or to attend an interview with us by contacting .

jobs.description:
What You Can Expect

As Head of Americas Channels, you'll define the strategic direction of Zoom's channel ecosystem across the Americas, leading a senior team of channel professionals and regional directors to accelerate partner-led revenue growth. This role sits at the intersection of executive relationship management, organizational transformation, and market expansion, offering a meaningful opportunity to shape how Zoom scales through its partner ecosystem. You'll design and govern multi-tier channel programs spanning Resale, Referral, Service Provider, and BPO routes to market, while identifying and capturing emerging opportunities that extend Zoom's competitive reach. If you're energized by building channel organizations from the inside out and driving meaningful change at the executive level, this role is built for you.


About the Team

Zoom's Americas Channel organization is at the heart of how we bring our platform to market through strategic partners, resellers, and service providers across the region. The team is a collaborative, high-performing group of channel professionals focused on building scalable programs and partnerships that create real value for Zoom, our partners, and the customers they serve. We move fast, think strategically, and believe deeply in the power of the channel to accelerate Zoom's growth.


Responsibilities

  • Define and execute comprehensive Americas channel strategies aligned with Zoom's growth objectives, market dynamics, and multi-year revenue targets.
  • Lead channel organization transformation through senior managers and regional directors, building high-performing teams through strategic talent acquisition and development.
  • Establish governance frameworks, compliance standards, and performance measurement systems across partner segments to drive consistent and scalable partner coverage.
  • Direct channel investment strategies and budget allocation across territories, evaluating ROI in partner enablement programs based on market opportunity and revenue potential.
  • Cultivate executive-level relationships with strategic channel partners, driving mutual business growth and maintaining strong competitive differentiation.
  • Design and execute channel innovation strategies to identify and capture emerging market opportunities across SMB, MidMarket, and UpMarket segments.
  • Accelerate Zoom's channel-first transformation by scaling Referral and Resale partner programs while expanding alternative routes to market, including Service Providers and Business Process Outsourcers.
  • Drive competitive channel displacement, with concentrated focus on converting Cisco Resale Channel partners and growing Zoom's position as the preferred Collaboration solution.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Zoom PSO, and field sales teams to align route-to-market strategy and support partner-led deployment programs.
  • Analyze competitive landscapes and channel dynamics to inform decisions on partner onboarding, investment prioritization, and sustained revenue acceleration.

What We're Looking For

  • 12+ years of progressive channel sales, partnerships, or business development experience in enterprise software or SaaS markets.
  • 5+ years leading senior channel management teams, including managing managers with a track record of building and retaining high-performing talent.
  • Proven success designing and scaling multi-tier Americas channel programs spanning Resale, Referral, Service Provider, and BPO routes to market.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and influence executive-level relationships both internally and externally, including at the C-suite level.
  • Strong strategic and financial acumen, including experience in channel investment planning, budget management, and cross-portfolio performance measurement.
  • Experience leading channel-first transformation initiatives and executing competitive displacement strategies, preferably within Collaboration, UCaaS, or adjacent markets.
  • Exceptional executive presence, communication skills, and the ability to translate complex channel dynamics into clear, actionable organizational strategy.


Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

$240,200.00 - $525,500.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.


We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

Ways of Working

jobs.description:
About Manifest

Manifest is building modern software for the tours and activities industry.

Our customers run real-world businesses: tours, attractions, experiences, rentals, and activities. They need software that helps them sell more, operate smoothly, and deliver great guest experiences.

We're building a B2B2C SaaS platform that brings booking, ecommerce, payments, accounting, operations, and customer experience together in a modern architecture. The product surface is broad, the workflows are nuanced, and the opportunity is big. That surface now spans several distinct product areas, including a newer, AI-native platform for building and delivering customer websites end-to-end. We're hiring more than one Senior Product Manager, and we'll match each hire to the area where their strengths fit best, from established features to fast-moving, zero-to-one greenfield work.

We're looking for Senior Product Managers to own product direction, roadmap, and prioritization for one or more key areas of Manifest.

This is not a backlog management role. We're looking for someone who can take ambiguous customer and business problems, find the shape of the opportunity, make smart tradeoffs, and help a cross-functional team ship high-quality product experiences.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll turn customer insight, business context, and technical possibilities into clear product direction and own the delivery end-to-end.

Modern product work is changing, and this role reflects that. We expect our PMs to be fluent and genuinely enthusiastic users of AI-assisted tools—using Claude, Cursor, v0, and similar tools to explore interactions, build lightweight prototypes, and make product ideas concrete before implementation begins. On some of our teams, AI-native workflows are not just a way of working faster; they're central to the product itself.

You'll work closely with Product leadership, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and design-minded front-end engineers. Depending on the area you own, there may not be a dedicated product designer, so you should be comfortable playing an active role in shaping user workflows, interaction patterns, and overall product quality.

You'll also be the bridge between executive vision and execution: taking high-level direction set by our leadership team and honing it into concrete, buildable product requirements. Leadership helps frame the why and the what, but you own the product decisions about what to build and how to bring it to life.

You do not need to be a front-end engineer, and you won't be expected to write production code. But strong technical fluency is a real advantage—enough to collaborate deeply with engineers on UI-heavy, technically nuanced product areas, and to understand the systems you're shaping. A technical or former engineering background is strongly preferred.

You should also be comfortable owning the delivery side of the work, along with the product vision, like milestones, sequencing, and keeping a small team moving.

What You'll Do

  • Own roadmap, prioritization, delivery, and product outcomes for one or more areas of Manifest
  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their businesses, and the tours and activities industry
  • Lead discovery with customers, internal stakeholders, support teams, sales, customer success, and go-to-market partners
  • Translate customer problems, business goals, and operational complexity into clear product direction
  • Define product requirements, success metrics, release scope, and tradeoffs
  • Partner closely with engineering to shape pragmatic, high-quality solutions, and help sequence and drive delivery
  • Work closely with front-end engineers on user flows, interaction details, edge cases, and product polish
  • Use AI-assisted tools, lightweight prototypes, wireframes, diagrams, and sketches to clarify product ideas and reduce ambiguity
  • Help raise the bar for UX quality, including in areas without a dedicated Product Designer
  • Create clear product artifacts: problem statements, opportunity briefs, product specs, workflow diagrams, acceptance criteria, launch plans, and release notes
  • Balance customer value, business impact, technical constraints, and delivery realities
  • Communicate product direction clearly across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and leadership
  • Collaborate with Product leadership on strategy while taking ownership of day-to-day product execution

What We're Looking For

  • Significant Product Management experience, ideally in a B2B or B2B2C SaaS environment
  • A track record of owning roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for meaningful product areas
  • Strong product judgment: you can move from ambiguous problems to coherent product direction
  • Strong written communication and the ability to create clear, actionable product specs
  • A measurement-driven approach to product, defining success metrics up front and proving the impact of changes quantitatively
  • Fluency and enthusiasm for AI-assisted product work using tools like Claude, Cursor, v0, Figma, or FigJam to prototype, explore, and communicate ideas
  • A technical background, former engineering experience, or strong technical fluency; enough to understand the product deeply and partner closely with engineers on technically nuanced, UI-heavy areas
  • Comfort owning delivery and project execution on small teams alongside product vision
  • Experience leading discovery, evaluating opportunities, and making thoughtful tradeoffs
  • Strong UX instincts and an eye for product quality, usability, workflow design, and polish
  • Familiarity with modern front-end patterns, design systems, HTML, CSS, or component-based product development
  • Experience with complex workflows, operational tools, booking flows, ecommerce, marketplaces, or other transaction-heavy SaaS products
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and bring structure to undefined problems, including in zero-to-one / startup-mode environments
  • A pragmatic, collaborative operating style

Nice to Have

  • Experience in travel, tourism, activities, hospitality, reservations, ecommerce, or booking platforms
  • Experience working on developer-adjacent products or platforms
  • Experience in a scale-up environment where product, design, and engineering responsibilities are highly collaborative
  • A track record of using AI tools to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, analysis, or specification in a real production setting
  • Experience with analytics, experimentation, funnel optimization, SEO, or conversion-focused product work

How We Work

We move quickly, but we care about craft.

Manifest serves users with complex day-to-day workflows, so product quality matters. We care about whether the product makes sense, whether the workflow is intuitive, whether the edge cases are handled thoughtfully, and whether the experience feels modern and trustworthy.

We value product managers who are curious, direct, clear-thinking, and outcome-oriented. We are not looking for someone who simply collects requirements or manages tickets. We're looking for someone who can understand customer problems, shape direction, make tradeoffs, and partner with Engineering from ambiguity through delivery and iteration.


The salary range for this position is $130,000 - $170,000 CAD, commensurate with experience.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior or Staff Backend Engineer with the Database Excellence group, you'll build and evolve database automation and PostgreSQL as a service capabilities for GitLab. The level will be determined during the hiring process. You'll use Go to automate the full lifecycle of PostgreSQL across GitLab's infrastructure, making database operations safer, more consistent, and easier to scale for databases that sit behind high-throughput, always-on internet services. You'll work closely with partner teams to shape how GitLab provisions and manages PostgreSQL in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment.

Some examples of our projects:

  • SQL Traffic Replay Tooling, which validates upgrades and changes against real production workloads.
  • PostgreSQL as a Service Platform, which provides standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management for internal product databases.
  • PostgreSQL Major Version Upgrade Automation, which supports safe, repeatable major upgrades at GitLab.com scale.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and maintain Go-based automation that manages the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning, reducing reactive operational work that currently takes more than 80% of the team's time.
  • Build automation that works across infrastructure-as-code tooling and cloud infrastructure, and evaluate operator-based approaches as the platform evolves.
  • Use AI agents as a regular part of building and operating services, including implementation, review, and reducing repetitive work, while keeping the context agents need in the repository so the whole team can build on it.
  • Build for internet scale by designing automation and services for high-throughput, always-on production workloads, where GitLab.com traffic sets the bar for correctness, latency, and availability.
  • Integrate compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and managed data services across cloud providers into one coherent PostgreSQL platform instead of creating bespoke setups for each database.
  • Build GitLab's PostgreSQL as a service platform to replace bespoke database setups with standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management, so supporting more databases doesn't require growing the operations team at the same rate.
  • Collaborate closely with product management, infrastructure, software delivery, and other engineering teams to design and ship high-performing solutions.
  • Research, design, and implement improvements to PostgreSQL performance, scalability, and data health, helping maintain more than 8 months of operational runway for all critical database saturation points.
  • Review database automation and Go changes from other engineers and contributors, with attention to safety, maintainability, and performance.
  • Document automation practices, PostgreSQL operational patterns, and guidance that helps engineers use and contribute to the platform.
  • Build safe, repeatable automation for PostgreSQL major version upgrades at GitLab.com scale, validating changes against real production traffic before rollout.
  • Operate what you build in production from end to end, using production feedback to guide each iteration.

What you’ll bring

  • Professional software engineering experience working with PostgreSQL in large, complex production environments, including experience building or operating a database-as-a-service product.
  • Proficiency with Go, including designing, implementing, testing, and reviewing backend services.
  • Experience developing Kubernetes operators, controllers, or similar automation for the lifecycle of stateful services, especially databases. Kubernetes experience is one way to demonstrate this skill, but isn't required; comparable experience building database or infrastructure automation is welcome.
  • Comfort with infrastructure as code and core database operations concepts such as high availability, replication, backups, and system-level performance trade-offs.
  • Familiarity with Ruby is a plus but isn't required. Much of GitLab's application codebase uses Ruby on Rails, and being able to read it helps when designing automation that application teams depend on. We’ll expect you to become comfortable with it on the job, not on day one.
  • Strong written communication skills and comfort working asynchronously in an all-remote, distributed team.
  • Self-directed work style with effective organizational skills, the ability to manage priorities as a "manager of one," and alignment with GitLab's values of transparency, collaboration, inclusion, and open source contribution, as well as its operating principles.
  • Ownership of the technical direction for a major initiative such as the PostgreSQL as a service platform, turning an ambiguous problem into an architecture and a sequenced plan that several engineers can execute in parallel.
  • Influence beyond the team, setting the patterns other engineers follow, partnering with sibling database, infrastructure, and platform teams, and growing engineers through design reviews and mentorship.

About the team

The Database Excellence group keeps GitLab’s databases running reliably through proactive health management, operational excellence, and strategic enablement. We maintain operational runway by identifying and addressing saturation points, operate infrastructure through automated and scalable processes, and provide tools and frameworks that help teams build features sustainably. Our primary focus is GitLab.com, and we're expanding our scope to provide database health frameworks and tooling that benefit self-managed customers as well.
