jobs.excerpt: Your wellbeing, our mission.  Join a company shaping a healthier world.
jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Website Experience Sr. Director in our Marketing Operations area in Brazil or the US (Remote accepted)!

Reporting to the VP of Marketing Operations, this role owns the evolution of Wellhub's website — from a traditionally-managed site to an Agentic Website Experience and Operations model, where AI agents increasingly handle content assembly, personalization, identity resolution, and optimization, freeing the team to focus on strategy, judgment calls, and the exceptions that matter. This is a hands-on strategic role: owning the roadmap, design, testing, data, and execution, and leading product managers, UX designers, web analytics, and developers to deliver on that vision. You're expected to have a real point of view on where agentic AI creates leverage on a website versus where it introduces risk, and to be able to defend that point of view to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the vision, roadmap, and strategy for Wellhub's website experience, driving its evolution toward an Agentic Website Experience and Operations model — where AI agents increasingly handle content assembly, personalization, and optimization.
  • Own conversion rate optimization end-to-end: define experimentation strategy, size and prioritize A/B tests, lead qualitative research and behavioral surveys, and translate results into optimization decisions.
  • Own website performance measurement and automated reporting (traffic, MQLs, sign-ups, conversions), analyzing visitor behavior through data synthesis, heat mapping, and tools like Amplitude + Looker.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the organization to shape the website experience for product launches, content, campaigns, and the broader roadmap.
  • Lead the website design and UX function, including the Mantra design system and the end-to-end design-to-code operating model (Figma to Mantra to Strapi), owning the quality bar for both human- and agent-generated work.
  • Evaluate, pilot, and scale agentic AI and AI orchestration tools for the website — defining human-in-the-loop boundaries, guardrails, and escalation paths — and identify, procure, and roll out best-in-class website technology and platforms.
  • Own the site's readiness for AI-driven discovery and personalization: architect content and information architecture for SEO, GEO/AEO, and Web MCP, lead the rollout of AI-powered personalization and predictive experimentation, and ensure conversational/AI-assisted website interactions align with the broader company AI architecture.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A seasoned digital/website leader with proven experience and ownership of a website and hands-on experience running experimentation programs.
  • Deep expertise across web tech stacks — analytics platforms, headless CMS, and web design systems — with a track record of managing them end-to-end.
  • Concrete, hands-on experience applying AI/agentic technology to marketing or web workflows (agent frameworks, AI personalization/CRO, conversational content tooling, or GEO/AEO strategy), including AI-assisted design-to-code workflows in production.
  • A clear, defensible point of view on where agentic AI creates leverage versus risk in B2B contexts, with the ability to bridge marketing, martech/engineering, and data teams on AI implementation.
  • Experience leading design and/or research functions, or credibly managing senior design ICs and design system owners, including owning a design system as shared infrastructure rather than a component library.
  • A strong cross-functional leader who thrives in matrixed, fast-paced, hyper-growth environments, balancing internal business needs with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Analytically rigorous, with strong critical thinking to translate complex AI topics into actionable insights and a sharp focus on KPIs and conversion metrics.
  • Quick to adapt to new domain contexts, AI trends, and vendor tools, with experience working across global companies and website localization.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in B2B website management and hands-on application of agentic AI/experimentation are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, secure, and optimize hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments.

  • Lead modernization initiatives involving NTLM, Kerberos, Conditional Access, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM.
  • Implement and support identity governance processes, including Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML), entitlement management, and access reviews.
  • Configure and integrate Microsoft security technologies including Defender for Identity, Sentinel, and Identity Protection.
  • Develop identity security standards, roadmaps, and technical recommendations.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to improve identity architecture and operational maturity.
  • Support audits, compliance initiatives, and security assessments.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Identity and Access Management (IAM) experience.
  • Strong experience with:
  • Active Directory
  • Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Hybrid Identity
  • Conditional Access
  • Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
  • Microsoft Defender for Identity
  • Microsoft Sentinel
  • Experience with modern authentication protocols including SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SCIM.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
  • Experience implementing identity governance and privileged access controls.
  • Understanding of Zero Trust security principles and Microsoft security best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certifications (SC-300, SC-200, AZ-500, SC-100)

  • Strong hands-on engineering capabilities across cloud architecture, APIs, data platforms, security, and modern software development.

Your success will be measured by the solutions you deliver, the engineering improvements you drive, and the teams you empower to succeed.

Principal Forward Deployed Engineer

DryvIQ | Nasuni

Location: Hyderabad, India | Remote (Hyderabad preferred)

Role Overview

Be the engineer customers trust to solve their most complex enterprise data challenges—and build solutions that scale beyond a single deployment.

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer at DryvIQ, part of Nasuni, you will provide hands-on technical leadership across complex enterprise customer implementations. You'll work directly with customers to understand their challenges, design scalable solutions, write production-quality C#/.NET code, and guide secure deployments through successful operation.

Enterprises need to discover, classify, protect, and govern growing volumes of unstructured content before they can confidently activate that information for AI. DryvIQ helps organizations manage these challenges across cloud and on-premises repositories.

We're looking for an experienced engineer who combines deep software development expertise with sound architectural judgment, customer consulting skills, and the ability to influence technical outcomes across multiple engagements.

This is a hands-on engineering and customer-delivery role, not a pre-sales-only or purely advisory position.

Your Scope and Impact

You will establish technical direction for complex, high-impact customer solutions while developing reusable engineering approaches that improve delivery across engagements.

You'll independently navigate difficult architecture decisions, guide senior technical contributors, resolve critical implementation challenges, and influence product improvements through insights gained from customer environments.

Your success will be measured through production outcomes, customer confidence, engineering quality, and the broader impact of the solutions and standards you establish.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical architecture and implementation across complex enterprise customer engagements, from discovery through validation, and production handoff.

  • Facilitate customer workshops with IT, security, and business stakeholders; translate requirements into scalable solution designs, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria.

  • Design, develop, test, and troubleshoot C#/.NET integrations, REST APIs, services, and supported workflows across Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes environments.

  • Establish reusable integration, testing, security, and troubleshooting patterns that improve reliability and delivery consistency.

  • Guide complex technical decisions involving supported configuration, customization, integrations, platform limitations, and long-term maintainability.

  • Architect and optimize solutions for enterprise content discovery, classification, lifecycle management, governance, migration, and policy-driven automation.

  • Lead resolution of critical issues involving connectors, authentication, permissions, distributed processing, performance, and environments.

  • Establish validation approaches for content classification, including representative sampling, precision and recall, false-positive and false-negative analysis, and business-owner review.

  • Partner with Professional Services, Project Management, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to assess delivery risks, guide technical estimates, and identify product improvements.

  • Mentor engineers, review complex designs and code, and share technical knowledge that raises delivery standards across teams.

  • Develop and promote responsible AI-assisted workflows for engineering, testing, troubleshooting, and technical analysis, with appropriate security controls and human validation.

Expected Outcomes and Impact

  • Successful, secure, and supportable production environments that meet agreed customer acceptance criteria.

  • Reduced implementation complexity and faster resolution of recurring technical issues.

  • Reusable engineering assets that improve delivery consistency and shorten time to customer value.

  • Improved solution reliability, classification quality, and production readiness.

  • Stronger alignment between customer implementation needs and Nasuni's product capabilities.

What You'll Bring

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Deep hands-on C#/.NET engineering experience, including modern .NET (.NET 8 or later), REST API development, integration design, and production troubleshooting.

  • Demonstrated technical ownership of complex enterprise software implementations, including architecture, coding, testing, and operational support.

  • Production experience with Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes or comparable container orchestration environments.

  • Ability to make and explain architectural tradeoffs involving scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Experience resolving complex integration or production issues across multiple systems and stakeholders.

  • Strong customer-facing technical communication, documentation, problem-solving, and collaborative leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise content management, information governance, content classification, or large-scale data migration.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, Purview, or other enterprise content repositories.

  • Experience with hybrid cloud architectures, distributed workloads, and large-scale file processing.

  • PowerShell or Python automation experience.

  • Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools with clear methods for validating generated code, analysis, and recommendations.

Ideal Candidate Differentiators

  • Has established reusable technical architectures or engineering standards across multiple customer implementations.

  • Demonstrates measurable improvements in deployment reliability, customer outcomes, or implementation efficiency.

  • Has influenced engineering or product priorities through recurring enterprise customer challenges.

  • Builds the capabilities of other engineers while remaining an effective hands-on contributor.

  • Has developed repeatable, responsibly governed AI-assisted engineering workflows.

Experience Guidelines

Typically 9–12 years of relevant software engineering, enterprise implementation, or technical consulting experience, including substantial hands-on customer-facing delivery and demonstrated technical leadership across complex engagements.

Equivalent experience demonstrating comparable ownership, technical depth, and results is welcome. Prior DryvIQ experience is not required.

AI at Nasuni

AI is used to improve efficiency, decision-making, and engineering outcomes across Nasuni. In this position, you'll apply AI-assisted development, analysis, testing, and automation where they add value, while ensuring that outputs meet security, correctness, quality, and maintainability standards.

We value engineers who use AI with context, sound judgment, validation, and accountability.

Location and Working Model

This position is remote within India, with a preference for candidates based near Hyderabad.

Regular collaboration with global teams and US customers during US Eastern business hours is required. Local working hours vary with US daylight saving time. Periodic customer-site travel to the United States is expected.

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits.

As a Vista Equity Partners-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform.

Our cloud-native technology combines enterprise file services, protection, and data intelligence, enabling organizations to unify information, strengthen security, simplify infrastructure, and activate trusted data for AI.

With DryvIQ's content intelligence and governance capabilities, we're expanding how enterprises discover, classify, protect, and manage information across complex environments.

Why Work at Nasuni

Join a global team working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, software engineering, enterprise data governance, and AI readiness.

You'll have the opportunity to solve meaningful technical challenges for enterprise customers, influence how complex implementations are delivered, and build solutions that improve outcomes beyond individual engagements.

Our Hyderabad Innovation Center connects talented engineers with global Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience teams. Through Vista Equity Partners' software ecosystem, Nasuni employees can benefit from cross-company learning, professional development, and opportunities to explore AI-driven innovation.

We value collaboration, accountability, technical curiosity, and continuous improvement. At Nasuni, your work can directly contribute to making enterprise data more accessible, secure, and useful for teams and the AI that supports them.

jobs.excerpt: Category: IT Services Location: Offshore Telangana India The Command Center Application Monitoring Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day operational monitoring of the Command Center App (CCA), ensuring that the application, dashboards, data pipelines, and underlying data products remain available, accurate, timely, and reliable.
jobs.description:
Category: IT Services

Location: Offshore Telangana India


The Command Center Application Monitoring Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day operational monitoring of the Command Center App (CCA), ensuring that the application, dashboards, data pipelines, and underlying data products remain available, accurate, timely, and reliable.
The role acts as the first line of operational monitoring, proactively identifying issues, performing initial investigation and validation, coordinating with relevant technical teams, and tracking incidents through to resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Command Center Application Monitoring
Perform daily monitoring of the Command Center App and its key business functionalities.
Validate that dashboards, KPIs, filters, navigation, and application features are functioning as expected.
Monitor application availability, performance, and data refresh status.
Identify anomalies, failures, missing data, or unexpected application behavior.
Perform scheduled monitoring checks throughout the business day.
Data Quality Monitoring
Monitor established data quality rules and dashboards.
Investigate data quality alerts, discrepancies, missing records, and unusual trends.
Perform initial validation against available source data or governed data products.
Escalate confirmed data quality issues to the appropriate Data Engineering, Data Product, or Analytics teams.
Track recurring data quality issues and support root-cause analysis.
Incident Management and Escalation
Act as the first point of contact for CCA operational issues.
Perform initial triage to determine whether an issue relates to the application, data, pipeline, access, or infrastructure.
Log production defects and incidents with clear issue descriptions, supporting evidence, and business impact.
Escalate incidents according to the defined severity and escalation process.
Follow up with responsible teams until resolution.
Validate fixes before incidents are closed.
Release and Deployment Monitoring
Support operational validation following CCA releases and production deployments.
Perform post-deployment smoke checks on critical application functionality.
Validate that key reports, dashboards, data pipelines, access controls, and application features remain operational.
Report deployment-related issues immediately and support rollback or escalation decisions where required.
User Access and Security Checks
Support monitoring of user access to CCA.
Assist with validation of SSO, role-based access, RLS/PLS, and user onboarding issues.
Escalate access and authentication issues to the appropriate support teams.
Ensure access-related activities follow established governance processes.
Operational Reporting
Maintain a daily monitoring checklist and issue tracker.
Provide regular operational status updates covering application availability, pipeline status, data freshness, data quality exceptions, open production incidents, outstanding defects, and release-related issues.
Highlight risks, recurring failures, ageing issues, and dependencies requiring management attention.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in Data Analytics, Application Support, Production Support, Data Operations, BI Operations, or a similar role.
  • Good understanding of how applications function, including key features, workflows, dependencies, and user interactions.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for basic data validation and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data refreshes, and data quality concepts.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and the Microsoft data and analytics ecosystem.
  • Basic knowledge of APIs and tools such as Swagger or Postman.
  • Experience logging, tracking, and managing production incidents and defects.
  • Ability to perform structured issue triage and distinguish between application, data, pipeline, access, and infrastructure problems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify unusual data or application behavior.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
Key Competencies
  • Proactive monitoring: Identifies potential issues before they are reported by users.
  • Analytical thinking: Investigates discrepancies and narrows down likely causes.
  • Attention to detail: Detects subtle data, application, or operational anomalies.
  • Ownership: Tracks issues through to resolution rather than simply escalating them.
  • Communication: Provides clear, concise updates to technical teams, business stakeholders, and management.
  • Prioritization: Distinguishes critical production incidents from lower-priority defects.
  • Process discipline: Consistently follows monitoring, escalation, incident, and deployment procedures.
Typical Daily Activities
  • Verify overnight pipeline and data-refresh status with GTDP.
  • Check the relevant monitoring portal for failed, delayed, or incomplete pipelines.
  • Perform CCA application health checks.
  • Validate key dashboards, KPIs, and critical business views.
  • Review data quality monitoring results.
  • Investigate exceptions and perform initial data validation.
  • Log and escalate confirmed production issues.
  • Follow up on outstanding incidents and defects.
  • Perform additional checks following deployments or releases.
  • Maintain the daily monitoring checklist and provide an operational status update.
Success Measures / KPIs
  • At least 98% completion of scheduled monitoring checks.
  • Critical monitoring checks completed within the agreed morning operational window.
  • Production issues proactively identified before significant user impact, where technically possible.
  • Timely escalation of critical incidents according to the agreed SLA.
  • Accurate documentation and classification of production issues.
  • Reduction in recurring production incidents through identification of patterns and root causes.
  • Post-deployment validation completed for 100% of production CCA releases.
  • Clear and up-to-date tracking of all open CCA operational issues.

About UBQ.io
UBQ.io is a global technology service provider dedicated to building a more sustainable, independent, and equitable future. We partner with global companies across industries, including AI, blockchain, software, biotech, and education, to transform bold ideas into real, meaningful solutions.

Our expertise spans technology consulting, AI and Machine Learning development, Blockchain integration, and global team collaboration. With a worldwide network of specialists, we help organizations stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

At UBQ.io, we don’t just advise, we collaborate. Our commitment to innovation, sustainability, and social responsibility guides everything we do as we help clients build technologies that empower people, communities, and industries to thrive.

About the role

We are looking for a Finance Developer to join our team and help build an internal web platform that supports portfolio management for our finance and operations teams. Working at the intersection of

finance and technology, you will turn financial data and business requirements into accurate, reliable tools. You will own features from end to end, from data queries and calculation logic through to the user interface.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain platform features, including summary metrics, interactive tables and data visualisations.

  • Translate financial methodologies such as valuation, P&L attribution, exposure and cost basis into clean, well-tested backend logic.

  • Make sure every figure reconciles accurately against source systems and existing reporting.

  • Write and optimise SQL queries against our cloud data warehouse.

  • Keep the platform fast and reliable through caching, performance tuning and robust error handling.

  • Work closely with finance and operations stakeholders to gather requirements, validate results and deliver improvements.

Our stack

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, Google BigQuery, Redis

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, Recharts, Tailwind CSS

  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud (Cloud Run), Google sign-in

Requirements

  • Solid professional experience with Python, including building backend services or data applications.

  • A good understanding of financial concepts: positions, P&L (daily, MTD, YTD, ITD), NAV, exposure and cost basis.

  • Comfort writing non-trivial SQL, ideally on BigQuery or another cloud warehouse.

  • A strong eye for detail and a habit of testing and reconciling numbers until they're right.

  • Clear communication, and the confidence to challenge and clarify requirements with finance teams.

  • A MSc in Finance, or progress towards a professional qualification such as CFA or CAIA (Level I or above), or equivalent.

Advantageous

  • Front-end experience with React and TypeScript, especially data-heavy UIs.

  • Experience with BI and reporting tools, or building analytics dashboards.

  • A background in asset management, fund administration, treasury or fintech.

  • Familiarity with multi-asset portfolios, e.g. equities, fixed income, digital assets and commodities.

  • Experience with Google Cloud and caching strategies.

That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

#RunwiththePack


At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.


We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.


More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.


We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

About the Position:

The Staff Threat Intelligence Researcher is an expert individual contributor aligned closely with the Adversary Operations team. This role leads rapid, intelligence-driven investigations into emerging threats, active campaigns, and high-impact adversary activity, using internal managed detection and response (MDR), incident response (IR), endpoint, network, cloud, identity, malware, infrastructure, and open-source data. The researcher connects signals across customer environments, develops defensible campaign and actor assessments, and translates findings into timely hunting guidance, durable detections, incident response actions, customer protections, and authoritative reporting. Success is demonstrated through fast, technically rigorous investigations; discovery of previously unknown or under-scoped activity; and clear operational impact across security operations, incident response, product, and customer-facing teams.

Responsibilities

Recognized as a technical authority, the Staff Threat Intelligence Researcher independently leads complex adversary investigations and helps shape how the organization identifies, validates, tracks, and responds to emerging threats across a large, multi-customer telemetry environment.

  • Lead rapid-response research into emerging threats, newly disclosed vulnerabilities, active exploitation, malware campaigns, ransomware operations, and nation-state or cybercriminal activity that may affect customers.
  • Proactively hunt across internal MDR and IR telemetry to identify active campaigns, previously unknown infrastructure, malware, intrusion patterns, and common adversary behaviors across customer environments.
  • Correlate endpoint, network, cloud, identity, email, vulnerability, malware, infrastructure, case, and open-source data to develop and test campaign hypotheses.
  • Scope potentially widespread activity by determining affected customers, observed behaviors, intrusion timelines, infrastructure overlap, and confidence in campaign or actor clustering.
  • Produce time-sensitive intelligence assessments, threat advisories, hunting packages, campaign reports, and executive or customer briefings during high-impact security events.
  • Develop and operationalize YARA, Sigma, behavioral analytics, search logic, indicators, and detection hypotheses in partnership with detection engineering, threat hunting, and security operations teams.
  • Partner closely with Adversary Response and Incident Response teams during active investigations, providing adversary context, collection requirements, analytical judgments, and follow-on hunting recommendations.
  • Establish and apply rigorous standards for campaign clustering, actor tracking, attribution, analytical confidence, evidence handling, and intelligence validation.
  • Build repeatable research methods, tooling, and automation that reduce the time from initial signal to validated finding and customer protection.
  • Publish high-quality internal and external research and represent the organization in customer briefings, intelligence-sharing communities, and industry forums.

Expert Positioning Goal

Serve as a recognized authority in adversary research and response by developing repeatable campaign-investigation tradecraft, mentoring other researchers, and producing original research that improves customer protection and industry understanding of active threats.

Example Key Results

  • Identified and scoped an active campaign through cross-customer MDR telemetry, enabling rapid customer notification, targeted hunting, and new behavioral detections.
  • Reduced time from emerging-threat signal to validated intelligence package by creating reusable queries, enrichment workflows, and investigation playbooks.
  • Established a defensible campaign-clustering and analytical-confidence approach used consistently in adversary reporting and response decisions.

Complexity & Problem Solving

Solves highly complex and ambiguous problems involving incomplete telemetry, noisy or deceptive indicators, uncertain attribution, multi-stage intrusions, and activity distributed across customer environments. Forms and tests competing hypotheses, distinguishes shared tooling from coordinated campaigns, assesses confidence and impact, and makes time-sensitive recommendations while identifying evidence gaps and alternative explanations.

About You

  • Extensive experience in cyber threat intelligence, adversary research, threat hunting, malware analysis, incident response, or a related discipline, with demonstrated technical leadership as a senior individual contributor.
  • Deep knowledge of nation-state, cybercriminal, ransomware, initial-access, malware, and vulnerability-exploitation ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated experience hunting across large-scale endpoint, network, cloud, identity, email, and security-operations telemetry using SIEM, EDR, data-lake, or similar analysis platforms.
  • Strong ability to use SQL, Python, Kusto Query Language, SPL, or comparable languages to analyze large datasets, automate enrichment, and build reusable research workflows.
  • Experience analyzing host and network telemetry such as process execution, command lines, authentication events, DNS, proxy, firewall, Zeek, Sysmon, auditd, and cloud audit logs.
  • Experience translating intelligence into YARA, Sigma, behavioral detections, hunting strategies, incident response actions, defensive controls, or product improvements.
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, intrusion analysis, structured analytic techniques, campaign clustering, attribution, and analytical confidence.
  • Familiarity with malware-analysis and reverse-engineering tools such as Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg, debuggers, sandboxes, and static or dynamic analysis utilities.
  • Proven ability to author publication-quality threat research and communicate technical findings, uncertainty, customer impact, and recommended actions to technical, executive, and customer audiences.
  • Sound judgment when handling sensitive intelligence, customer data, uncertain attribution, and high-impact or fast-moving security incidents.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

Benefits


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:


  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • 401(k) contribution and matching
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Security Requirements 

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Base Salary

The base salary range for this job family is 86,000 to 240,000 USD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

⚡️ About Merkle Science

Merkle Science provides blockchain transaction monitoring and intelligence solutions for web3 companies, digital asset service providers, financial institutions, law enforcement and government agencies to detect, investigate and prevent illicit use of cryptocurrencies. Our vision is to make cryptocurrencies safe and provide infrastructure for the safe and compliant growth of cryptocurrencies.
Merkle Science is headquartered in New York with offices in Singapore, Bangalore and London. The team has combined experience across Bank of America, Paypal, Luno, Thomson Reuters and Amazon. The company has raised over US$27 MM from SIG, Beco, Republic, DCG, Kenetic, GGV and several others.

The Role

You will design, build and run the systems behind our data products, covering ingestion, processing, analytical storage and serving. You own your work from the design document through to production. The people who design a pipeline also run it and answer for its numbers.

Our stack is very wide, and we go deep in every part of it. We don't stop at "it works." We keep measuring, profiling and tuning to make systems faster, cheaper and more reliable. We want engineers who are razor sharp, pay close attention to detail, and care as much about why a query takes 800 ms as whether it returns the right answer.

You don't need blockchain experience. If you're a strong data engineer who wants to learn it, we'd like to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build scalable, high-throughput data pipelines and platform systems for blockchain data across 30+ chains.

  • Build backend data services and loaders in Go and Python.

  • Design and evolve data models and analytical workloads in ClickHouse, and tune them for sub-second queries.

  • Build incremental, idempotent pipelines on Databricks over billions of rows and tens of terabytes.

  • Keep improving the scale, reliability, freshness, performance and cost efficiency of the platform.

  • Investigate hard performance and reliability problems and see them through to resolution.

  • Work closely with the product, analytics and investigations teams that use the data, and turn their needs into platform designs.

  • Help set technical direction through architecture discussions, design reviews and code reviews.

  • Mentor engineers and help set strong engineering and operational practices.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building and operating production data systems, including ETL and ELT pipelines. At least two of those years should be spent owning systems that other engineers depend on.

  • Expert Python and strong SQL. You write typed, tested code, are comfortable with asyncio and concurrency, and have built incremental data models over billions of rows.

  • Go for backend services. You have built and run high-throughput services or data loaders in Go in production.

  • ClickHouse in production. You know MergeTree schema and sort-key design, materialised views, bulk loads and query tuning.

  • Databricks in production. You have worked with PySpark, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog, designed incremental and idempotent tables, and kept an eye on compute cost.

  • Large-scale data. You have hands-on experience with pipelines over billions of rows and tens of terabytes. You understand how partitioning, clustering and file sizing affect cost and latency.

  • Kafka, Airflow and Kubernetes in production. You understand delivery semantics and idempotent writes, have handled backfills and failures, and have run data workloads with Docker and Helm. Google Cloud is preferred; AWS is fine.

  • An operations and communication mindset. You instrument what you build, write runbooks and post-incident reviews, and can write a design document that a reviewer in another time zone can approve.

Nice to Have

  • Blockchain data: EVM, UTXO or non-EVM chain data models, and pulling data from nodes over JSON-RPC or gRPC.

  • Graph or distributed key-value stores: entity resolution or clustering on large graphs.

  • Infrastructure as code, GitOps and observability: Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana, and load-test design.

  • Experience building platforms that serve multiple data sources, datasets or product teams.

  • AI-assisted development, and experience in fintech, compliance or AML.

How We Work

  • You'll join a small, senior team where everyone owns their work end to end.

  • We make decisions based on measured evidence, not opinion.

  • We keep design notes and runbooks next to the code.

  • We test at production scale and run blameless post-incident reviews.

  • We use AI coding tools every day, and we use judgement when reviewing what they produce.

❤️ Well Being, Compensation and Benefits

We care about your well-being. Along with excellent health insurance, we offer flexible time off, learning & development initiatives and hours that are designed to provide work/life balance. We regularly host team-building sessions and encourage discussions around mental health.
We reward talent and believe in acknowledging people for their contributions. We offer industry-leading compensation, along with generous equity. As a rapidly growing business, there are endless opportunities to grow your career with Merkle Science.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Backend
jobs.excerpt: About the teamThe Public Cloud Foundations (PCF) team is part of Platform Engineering.
jobs.description:
About the team

The Public Cloud Foundations (PCF) team is part of Platform Engineering. We build the internal cloud platform that every Zillow engineer builds on: the self-service APIs, paved paths, and automation that turn the raw complexity of AWS into a small set of safe, reliable, well-documented product surfaces.We treat the platform as a product. Rather than handling cloud infrastructure as a queue of tickets and one-off requests, we design software that lets teams provision accounts, networking, and shared infrastructure themselves, safe by default. Our current work shows the direction: self-service VPC connectivity, a Terraform delivery platform, container base images delivered as a managed product, and provisioning and policy capabilities exposed as APIs instead of runbooks. We partner closely with Runtime Platform, Database Engineering, Middleware Engineering, Delivery Engineering, and Security to replace manual cloud work with software.PCF is where you help decide how Zillow uses the public cloud, and how a platform team turns operational surface area into engineered products.

About the role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on Public Cloud Foundations, you will build the services and APIs that abstract away the complexity of the public cloud, and own them as products from design through operation.


In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and APIs that make cloud capabilities self-service: account provisioning, networking, IAM, and policy exposed as clean software interfaces rather than tickets or manual processes.
  • Turn recurring cloud work into products. Take patterns that today depend on human judgment or hand-run runbooks and encode them into APIs, controls, and automation that are safe by default.
  • Treat teams across Zillow as the customers of your platform: understand their use cases, shape the interfaces and paved paths they build on, and let their feedback and usage data drive your roadmap.
  • Own the reliability of what you build. Design for observability, SLOs, and self-healing so the platform runs itself. Like any team that owns services in production, you'll be on call for what you ship, and you'll lead the follow-up work that removes whole classes of problems rather than patching individual incidents.
  • Use modern AI-assisted and agentic tooling to accelerate design, implementation, and operations while keeping quality and safety high.
  • Influence how Platform Engineering approaches public cloud enablement, bringing a product mindset to design discussions and roadmap decisions.

You'll help take a set of foundational capabilities and turn them into a cohesive, self-service platform that Zillow engineers experience as a product, not a queue.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $164,400.00 - $262,600.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $156,200.00 - $249,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

You're a senior engineer who wants to build platforms, not just run them. You like taking messy, manual infrastructure work and turning it into clean software that other engineers build on, and you care about the developer experience of what you ship.


You'll bring:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating backend or platform services in production.
  • Solid system design skills for distributed systems and API-based platforms, with a practical approach to simplicity, resiliency, and observability.
  • Production experience in Golang or Python (preferred), or another modern language, with solid testing, code review, and debugging habits.
  • Strong experience with at least one public cloud provider (preferably AWS) and its core primitives such as VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancers, security groups, IAM, compute, and storage, deep enough to abstract them behind clean interfaces.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform, structured as reusable, tested software rather than copy-paste configuration, including reviewing changes for safety and managing drift.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals, e.g., IAM, network segmentation, encryption, and policy enforcement in multi-account environments.
  • Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo) for infrastructure and/or backend services.
  • A bias toward eliminating toil in software: when you see repeated manual work, your instinct is to build the system that makes it unnecessary.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building or contributing to internal platforms or developer tooling (account vending, golden paths, self-service provisioning, or similar).
  • Experience treating an internal platform as a product: defining interfaces, measuring adoption, and iterating on developer experience.
  • Familiarity with service-to-service networking, service mesh, workload identity, or rate limiting in cloud environments.
  • Strong Linux systems and networking fundamentals.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist - German Fluency
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You will be a part of our frontline support team made up of highly skilled and professional Technical Support Specialists. You will be responsible for responding to customer requests for technical assistance over the phone and via email. Your work will be fast-paced and independent in nature as you will be expected to manage yourself in a way to be available to respond quickly to our customers. Your work will also be collaborative, working together with other support representatives in multiple support locations to serve our customers.

Experience in a technical support role, proven customer-facing skills, and strong English communication skills are a must. You should be comfortable handling complex technical issues and working in a fast-paced support environment.

Location/Working Pattern: This is a remote position open to candidates based in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this Role, You Will:

  • Serve as the initial technical point of contact for basic and complex customer issues, working collaboratively within your first-line support team, across engineering, and product teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  • Provide in-depth technical troubleshooting for advanced issues across Samsara’s SaaS platform, hardware devices, and integrations, leveraging a deep understanding of networking, cloud technologies, and IoT systems.
  • Actively contribute to knowledge base development by documenting detailed resolutions, creating technical guides, and mentoring junior agents on your team.
  • Proactively identify trends in customer issues to influence product improvements and optimize support processes, driving continuous enhancement of the customer experience.
  • Deliver professional and clear communication to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring seamless resolution of escalated issues while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Champion Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team), driving innovation and collaboration within the team and across departments.

Minimum Requirements for this Role:

  • Language: Fluency in German
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technical discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Networking) or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in a technical product support or specialist role, preferably within SaaS, IoT, or networking environments. Proven track record of handling complex technical escalations and collaborating across departments to resolve advanced customer issues.

Technical Expertise: An understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, VPNs, DNS), cloud-based architectures, and hardware troubleshooting. Foundational knowledge in Artificial Intelligence.

  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide junior team members, fostering skill development and knowledge sharing. Experience leading projects or initiatives aimed at improving operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Problem Solving: Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving both technical and process-related challenges. Exceptional organizational skills to manage multiple escalations, prioritize workload effectively, and meet critical deadlines.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • French Fluency
  • General knowledge about electrical circuits, GPS and telematics.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols, APIs, and diagnostic tools is highly desirable
  • Proficiency in using diagnostic tools, APIs, and scripting (e.g., Python, Bash) to automate troubleshooting and issue resolution.
  • Advanced certifications (e.g., CCNA, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) are a strong plus.
  • Experience integrating and troubleshooting third-party applications and systems with APIs and webhooks.
  • Familiarity with Slack and Google Workplace applications (Gmail, Google Docs, etc.)
  • Flexibility: Availability to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends, and provide on-call support as needed for high-impact customer cases.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
